articles.title: Bright object beyond Pluto may be the solar system's sixth dwarf planet
articles.author: Damien Pine

paras.en: The Vera C. Rubin Observatory has found what might be a tiny new world in the far reaches of our solar system, hidden beyond the orbit of Neptune — and it is among the largest and brightest objects ever discovered beyond Neptune.

If confirmed, the miniature world would increase the number of officially recognized solar system dwarf planets to six. Upper estimates of the object's size place it at more than half the diameter of Pluto, the largest known dwarf planet.

"My first reaction was one of excited disbelief," Matthew Holman, an astrophysicist at the Smithsonian Astrophysical Observatory and member of the Rubin team who wrote the code that helped discover the prospective dwarf planet, said in a statement. "Objects like this are very rare, so I immediately started checking whether I or the code had done something wrong."

The potential dwarf planet, designated 2026 ED138, orbits the sun at roughly 46 times the distance between Earth and the sun. The potential new planetoid has been hiding behind galactic camouflage; with its orbit tilted at a 25-degree angle from the solar system plane, it's at just the right angle to get lost in the light from the inner Milky Way, the researchers said.

Many telescopes struggle to see past the millions of stars making up our galaxy's bulge. The Vera C. Rubin Observatory, however, images the entire southern sky every few nights with the largest digital camera ever built, sending out millions of nightly alerts for every object that has changed brightness or position. This makes it exceptional at identifying anything that moves, from solar system objects to transient events like supernova explosions.
The observatory had only just begun its 10-year mission of scanning the sky in July, and ED138 stood out in the data.

Holman works on the software algorithms that process the extreme amounts of data the observatory collects. The code he developed with his colleague, Kevin Napier, compares billions of observations to determine which ones are detections of the same moving object. Running data from Rubin through the code revealed the unusually large object.
Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.

By looking at past data from Rubin and archival images from the Dark Energy Camera mounted on the Victor M. Blanco 4-meter Telescope at Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory (both in Chile), the team was able to map out ED138's orbit over the past 10 years.

The Kuiper Belt is a region of the solar system beyond Neptune that is a wild frontier of small, mostly icy bodies made from frozen methane, ammonia, water and rock. It ranges from roughly 30 to 50 times the distance between Earth and the sun, and is home to most of the known dwarf planets, including Pluto. Thousands of Kuiper Belt objects have already been discovered. These space rocks can be frozen time capsules that hold clues about the early solar system's formation.

Dwarf planets are the largest Kuiper Belt objects that we know of. Bigger than asteroids but not quite planets, dwarf planets are big enough to be rounded under the force of their own gravity but too small to clear their orbits like planets do. While the International Astronomical Union (IAU) has officially confirmed five dwarf planets — Pluto, Ceres, Eris, Haumea and Makemake — astronomers studying dwarf planets often recognize at least nine, with several more candidates whose properties are still unknown.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Depending on which astronomer you ask, there could be anywhere from a handful to hundreds of dwarf planets in this part of the solar system. Identifying which Kuiper Belt objects are dwarf planets is tricky because they are often very dim and move very slowly from Earth's perspective, since their orbits are so large and distant. The likeliest candidates have high albedo (surface reflectivity) and diameters greater than roughly 370 to 500 miles (600 to 800 km).

What makes ED138 special is its size, inferred from its brightness, albedo and distance from the sun. It's estimated to have a diameter between 370 to 930 miles (600 to 1,500 km). For comparison, Pluto — the largest dwarf planet recognized by the IAU — is 1,477 miles (2,377 km) in diameter. Ceres, the smallest IAU-recognized dwarf planet, is 595 miles (958 km) in diameter. Future observations of ED138 will give researchers a more accurate idea of its diameter and density to determine if it's round enough to join the dwarf planet club.

paras.en: "If confirmed as a dwarf planet, ED138 would join a very small family of worlds," Holman said in the statement. "Rubin will image the whole southern sky again and again for ten years, so any others hiding in the places earlier surveys skipped are now within reach."

Damien Pine (he/him) is a freelance writer, artist, and former NASA engineer. He writes about science, physics, tech, art, and other topics with a focus on making complicated ideas accessible. He has a degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Connecticut, and he gets really excited every time he sees a cat.

articles.title: As Winnie-the-Pooh Turns 100, the Original Stuffed Toy Remains in New York. Will the Silly Old Bear Ever Return to Britain?

paras.en: The real-life stuffed animals that inspired British writer A.A. Milne’s beloved Winnie-the-Pooh stories have resided in New York City for nearly eight decades. But as the world marks the centenary of the 1926 publication of Winnie-the-Pooh, a renewed effort has emerged to bring the historic teddy bear and his companions back to Britain, even if only for a royal vacation.

The stuffed troupe comprising Pooh, Piglet, Eeyore, Kanga and Tigger—the childhood toys of Milne’s son, Christopher Robin—were donated to the New York Public Library (NYPL) in 1987, where they continue to form a centerpiece of the NYPL’s “Treasures” exhibition at the flagship Stephen A. Schwarzman Building on Fifth Avenue.

Across the Atlantic, Britain celebrated the centenary with anniversary editions, special stamps, and local tributes. Near Ashdown Forest, the inspiration for the fictional “Hundred Acre Wood,” enthusiasts gathered at the Pooh Corner tearoom to bury a time capsule destined to remain sealed until October 2126, the BBC’s Hannah Gray and Josh McLaughlin report.
For some British fans, however, the toys’ continued residence across the pond feels like an unresolved exile.

The latest debate was sparked when Gyles Brandreth, a biographer of Milne and trustee of the Queen’s Reading Room, Queen Camilla’s literary charity, approached NYPL leadership as an “emissary” of the Queen to explore the possibility of a temporary loan to Buckingham Palace ahead of the 100th anniversary, the Washington Post’s Steve Hendrix reports.

Library officials rebuffed the request. According to Brandreth, talks with NYPL President and CEO Anthony Marx quickly unraveled over the practical complexities of moving the fragile, 105-year-old toy bear across the Atlantic. “How do you transport this toy, which could well be the most valuable toy in the world?” Brandreth tells James Barron of the New York Times.
When word of the talks circulated, New Yorkers were quick to push back. Manhattan Borough President Brad Hoylman-Sigal declared on social media that “an international incident has ensued.”
“They are the property of the people of New York,” he added. “They are staying put.”

The British Embassy in Washington issued a lighthearted statement from its “adviser on bear-lateral relations,” dismissing rumors of a repatriation campaign as “unfounded” while noting that “there’s an open invite if Pooh ever wants to make a temporary visit to the U.K.”

Brandreth echoed that sentiment, telling the Times: “The long and the short of it is New York seems to be imagining stealing the bear when we don’t.” He added “A.A. Milne and Christopher Robin loved the bear being in America—that’s where the bear belongs.”
- While five of Christopher Robin’s original nursery toys made it to the United States, Roo, a miniature kangaroo, was lost in an apple orchard in the 1930s.
- This April, Queen Camilla gave the NYPL a 3.5-inch replica of Roo, custom-crafted by England’s oldest surviving teddy bear manufacturer using archival patterns.

The controversy over Pooh’s custody stretches back decades. Daphne Milne originally purchased the 20-inch Farnell teddy bear at Harrods in 1921 as a first-birthday gift for her son, Christopher Robin. Her husband drew inspiration from his son’s playtime and their rambles through Ashdown Forest as he built the fictional world of Winnie-the-Pooh.

In 1947, with the grown-up Christopher’s blessing, Milne sent the stuffed animals to the United States for a nationwide promotional tour organized by his American publisher, E.P. Dutton. The toys remained in Dutton’s New York City offices until 1987, when the publisher donated them to the NYPL.

British politicians have repeatedly challenged that arrangement. In 1998, Labour Member of Parliament Gwyneth Dunwoody demanded their return. “Just like the Greeks want their Elgin Marbles back, so we want our Winnie-the-Pooh back, along with all his splendid friends,” she said. “They plainly want to come home after 70 wasted years exile.”
That prompted then-New York City Mayor Rudy Giuliani to declare Pooh and friends immigrant success stories who came to the United States “to build a better life for themselves.”

To celebrate the centennial, the library has mounted “Silly Old Bear! Winnie-the-Pooh at 100,” a special pop-up exhibition that displays rare editions, E.H. Shepard’s original sketches and the newly gifted Roo through November 30.

Library officials insist that the toys are inseparable from the institution’s historic heritage. “The New York Public Library’s holdings of rare Winnie-the-Pooh materials ... stand as an important cornerstone of our world-class collection of children’s literature,” Brent Reidy, the NYPL’s director of research libraries, says in a statement.
And so, for the foreseeable future, the world’s most famous bear will remain right where he has sat for decades, quietly contemplating life from a glass case on Fifth Avenue.
“Silly Old Bear! Winnie-the-Pooh at 100” is on view at the New York Public Library’s Stephen A. Schwarzman Building until November 30, 2026.

articles.title: A Rare Nanotyrannus Skeleton Sells for $47.3 Million, Becoming the Second Most Valuable Dinosaur Ever Auctioned

paras.en: One year after the Nanotyrannus genus was largely confirmed as separate from its Tyrannosaurus rex cousin, the world’s most complete Nanotyrannus skeleton sold at auction for a whopping $47.3 million dollars. It’s now the second most valuable dinosaur ever sold, although auction house Sotheby’s has not disclosed the buyer.

Dubbed “Jodi,” the roughly 67-million-year-old skeleton measures nearly 10 feet tall and just over 19 feet long. The adult specimen represents one of three mostly complete Nanotyrannus skeletons and features bones including a skull, around 50 teeth, a pelvic girdle, many leg and arm bones, claws, and dozens of vertebrae and ribs, according to another statement.

The fossil’s namesake, rancher Jodi Pierson, discovered the Nanotyrannus remains on her land in Montana in 2019. The fossil was preserved in the Hell Creek Formation, a fossil-rich rock formation that stretches across Montana, the Dakotas and Wyoming. Pierson’s cousin Clayton Phipps, a commercial paleontologist nicknamed the “Dinosaur Cowboy,” excavated the skeleton.

This exceptional fossil became part of an enduring debate. It all started when paleontologists in Montana excavated a small Tyrannosaurus rex-like skull in 1942. Analyses of it split the research community into two camps: those who suspected it represented a new genus and species, N. lancensis, and those who instead suspected that it was just a young T. rex. More than 80 years later, Nanotyrannus supporters appear to have won.

In a Nature study published in October 2025, researchers claimed to have conclusively demonstrated that Nanotyrannus was its own genus and includes two known species, N. lancensis and N. lethaeus. They investigated a teensy tyrannosaur specimen from a larger fossil unit nicknamed the “Dueling Dinosaurs,” in which a Nanotyrannus and Triceratops look like they’re fighting. Jodi was found just eight miles from where the Dueling Dinosaurs were discovered in 2006.

Jodi is a Nanotyrannus cf. lancensis, though “cf.” means that the identification is still uncertain. In fact, the New York Times’ Sopan Deb reports that some scientists still argue over whether there are two distinct species in the genus.

Sotheby’s estimated Jodi would fetch between $6 million and $9 million. But by the end of an intense 12-minute bidding battle between six contenders on October 27, the skeleton sold for more than five times the high end of its maximum evaluation. Only one dinosaur—“Gus” the T. rex—has sold for more money. That fossil went for $50.1 million this past July.
At 38 feet long, Gus is about twice Jodi’s length. The T. rex stands at 12.5 feet tall.

“It does feel like this is a bubble of prices on dinosaurs which must burst at some point; they can’t keep rising forever,” David Hone, a paleontologist at Queen Mary University of London, tells CNN’s Jacopo Prisco. Hone was very surprised about Jodi’s steep winning bid.
The exceptional selling point prices out many public institutions, and some scientists worry about such special specimens disappearing into the hands of private owners.

“We’ve really just found out that Nanotyrannus is real, and now one of the best skeletons is about to be sold to the highest bidder,” Steve Brusatte, a paleontologist at the University of Edinburgh in Scotland, tells BBC News’ Angus Thompson. “It’s harrowing to think it could disappear into the vaults of a collector rather than displayed on a museum where it can wow and inspire kids and families and the public at large.”

“A person really interested in paleontology could do vastly more good by supporting the ongoing operations of multiple museums than the sale of one specimen,” Thomas R. Holtz Jr., a paleontologist at the University of Maryland, tells the Guardian’s Anna Betts and Jenna Amatulli.

But Megan Jacobs, a paleontologist at the University of Portsmouth in England, doesn’t “begrudge the people involved for wanting to sell it for such a large amount of money,” she tells BBC Radio 4’s “Today” program, per BBC News. “Although it’s a scary prospect, actually a lot of [dinosaurs sold to private collectors] have ended up in the public eye.”

For instance, a Stegosaurus skeleton called “Apex” was purchased by hedge fund billionaire Kenneth Griffin in a 2024 auction, but it’s currently on long-term loan at the American Museum of Natural History.
“These things without a doubt will end up in a museum at some point,” Jacobs adds.

articles.title: From a Black Limo With a Silken Armchair to a Bulletproof 'Sardine Can,' the Vatican Looks Back at the Evolution of the Popemobile

paras.en: Once dubbed a “sardine can” by Pope Francis, the popemobile—with its large, domed top and bulletproof glass—is truly the only vehicle of its kind on the road. Now, the story of how the fishbowl-esque automobile came to be is on display at the Vatican for visitors from around the world to see.

“A Century of the Popemobile,” an exhibition which opened at the Vatican Museums on Thursday, features eight iterations of popemobiles spanning from 1930 to 2012, all designed by Mercedes-Benz. Versions of the popemobile made by other auto companies, like Land Rover, Fiat and Ferrari are not included in the collection.

“Over the decades, the popemobile has evolved from a means of transportation into an instrument of encounter,” Pope Leo XIV told Mercedes-Benz executives in an address ahead of the exhibition’s official opening. “In this way, your work has helped facilitate the Church’s mission of reaching out to people and bringing a message of faith, of hope and of charity to the world.”

The oldest popemobile on display is a 460 Nürburg limousine gifted to Pope Pius XI in 1930. Unlike the hulking, glass popemobiles of today, this first custom-made model featured a black exterior and a red armchair upholstered in a silk brocade.
When Pius XI first took the 80-horsepower car for a spin around the Vatican Gardens, he reportedly cried out: “Beautiful car! A masterpiece … A wonder of modern technology!”
The 460 Nürburg and its immediate successors, however, tended to reside in the papal garage.

“The popemobile didn’t become standard-issue for getting the pontiff through crowds until the late 1970s,” Danny Lewis wrote for Smithsonian magazine in 2015. “Historically, the pope traveled by way of an extravagant sedan chair carried atop the shoulders of a squad of uniformed footmen.”

In order to allow the pope to engage with the faithful—and bless babies—from the confines of a car, automakers customized the vehicles to enhance the pope’s visibility and access to the external world.

“The so‑called popemobile serves to allow people to see the pope, but also to allow him to see,” Sandro Barbagallo, curator of the Historical Collections Department at the Vatican Museums, tells Francesco Sportelli and Nicole Winfield of the Associated Press (AP). “It serves so that people can greet the pope, but also and above all so that the pope can, along the roads, greet and at the same time bless.”

The first model to resemble the iconic modern design comes from 1980, a modified 230 G model with a large, glass dome in the back, allowing for congregants to see the pope as he passed. Popemobiles began incorporating bulletproof glass a year later, after an attempted assassination of Pope John Paul II while he was riding in an open-topped Fiat popemobile.

Designing papal automobiles comes with manifold security considerations. “It has to be safely conceived and executed in terms of the current modern risks you face if you are in big crowds,” Marcus Breitschwerdt, executive vice president of Mercedes-Benz and chief executive of Mercedes-Benz Heritage, tells EWTN News’ Ishmael Abiduah. “So we have armored versions; we have the secured glass popemobiles, which are very, very sophisticated.”

The exhibit also features a 1960 300D Landaulet with removable side windows built for Pope John XXIII, a 1997 “lungo” Landaulet featuring an electrohydraulic soft top designed for Pope John Paul II and Pope Benedict XVI’s 2012 ML 500, a behemoth with a large, enclosed glass rear, per Agence France-Presse.
When Pope Francis visited the United States in 2015, he rode around Washington, D.C., New York and Philadelphia in a tricked out Jeep Wrangler with open sides and rear seating.

“[The popemobile] was specifically built, designed and prepared for papal use, so much so that just by comparing it, you can see how it transitions from the serial to the unique,” Barbagallo tells the AP.

The popemobile has also reflected the distinct preferences of the popes themselves. In 2024, Mercedes-Benz gifted the environmentally minded Pope Francis the first electric car in the popemobile fleet.

In fact, Pope Leo XIV referenced this gift, and Pope Francis’ call to make the automotive sector more sustainable, in his address to the Mercedes-Benz executives: “In this spirit, I encourage you to continue placing technological innovation at the service of human dignity, care for creation and the common good.”
“A Century of the Popemobile” is on view at the Vatican Museums.

articles.title: Nothing Headphones Sale: Stylish and Up to 41% Off
articles.author: Harry Rabinowitz

paras.en: Nothing is one of my favorite headphone brands. That's saying a lot, considering that I’ve tested more than 100 pairs and currently lead WIRED's buying-guide coverage for the category. Nothing mixes bold, standout designs with great sound and competitive pricing, and its over-ear headphones have earned some seriously high marks in WIRED reviews (a lot of 9/10s).

As such, I am always on the lookout for a good deal from Nothing and its more affordable sub-brand, CMF. Well ahead of the Black Friday blitz, the Nothing Headphone (1) is steeply discounted, and the CMF Headphone Pro is at its lowest price ever. And when you think about it, there's arguably no better time than now—during the lead-up to holiday-travel season—to gift yourself a pair of high-performing, style-forward headphones to take you through busy airports and long flights.

The brand’s first over-ear headphones—the Nothing Headphone (1)—remain a home run for both their tech and look. They’re solid noise cancelers with a bold, transparent design on the ear cups that somehow appears techy, retro, and futuristic all at once. Among their best features are the on-ear controls, namely the clicky wheel that adjusts volume and the flat rocker paddle that you can push back and forth to move to the previous track or skip ahead, respectively. The feature is consistent, satisfyingly tactile, and a far cry from tapping and swiping on the side of a wireless earbud. At 33 percent off, this current price comes close to the all-time low I saw during October's Prime Day.

paras.en: The Nothing Ear (3a) set is among our favorite pairs of budget wireless earbuds. Like the Nothing over-ear headphones, these have a semi-transparent design and bold colors that stand out from the sea of sameness of an AirPods-like aesthetic. These earbuds have been coasting at 20 percent off for most of September and October, which is hardly a bad discount, but it's also not the best I've ever seen.
CMF is Nothing's sub-brand that focuses on delivering similarly stylish designs at a lower price.

This is the lowest price I’ve ever seen for the CMF Headphone Pro, one of my favorite pairs of cheap over-ear headphones. Frankly, $55 for these is a steal. Sure, they aren’t as premium as Nothing’s models, but they retain the essence: fun, tactile controls; good sound; and access to the useful, reliable Nothing X app, where you can manage settings and tweak an EQ.

articles.title: Polymarket Halted International Trading After Hackers Drained Accounts
articles.author: Kate Knibbs

paras.en: Trading has resumed on Polymarket’s flagship international platform after a hack that drained money from the wallets of some traders.

A third-party vendor based in the United Kingdom was breached, not the prediction market’s website itself. Law enforcement in the UK have been notified of the incident, the company said. Trading was initially paused while the company investigated for several hours.

On X, prominent traders complained that they had lost money; blockchain analytics firm Bubblemaps reported that around 700 users appeared to have been affected, with approximately $2.7 million stolen. Polymarket declined to comment when WIRED asked how many traders were impacted by the breach and how much money was lost, but the company said it will refund impacted traders.

The hack did not impact users on Polymarket US, the company’s newer platform for people within the United States. Polymarket runs two separate prediction markets; Polymarket US operates as a federally regulated financial exchange within the country, while the flagship Polymarket is a cryptocurrency-based platform that is banned in the United States and a number of other countries.

This is not the first time that Polymarket traders have experienced security woes. In June 2026, Polymarket experienced another breach, which resulted in over $2 million in losses for impacted traders.

The company has been a lightning rod for controversy since its 2020 launch. In the past few years, it has been the center of several high-profile alleged insider trading incidents resulting in arrests. One case involved a Special Forces soldier accused of wagering on the capture of Venezuela’s former leader; another involved a Google employee who allegedly used confidential information to make millions. In both cases, the suspects have pleaded not guilty.
Polymarket recently raised $1 billion in August 2026, with a fundraising round led by 1789 Capital, the venture capital firm where Donald Trump Jr. is a partner. It is now valued at $21 billion.

articles.title: What to Know About China’s Top-Secret Spaceplane
articles.author: Stephen Clark, Ars Technica

paras.en: A winged Chinese spacecraft bearing a strong resemblance to the US military’s X-37B spaceplane was photographed in orbit by a passing US-owned commercial satellite in 2024, and we finally have the image.

The Chinese spaceplane has delta wings, payload bay doors, a dark heat shield, and a rear-mounted service module with power-generating solar arrays. In other words, the design of the winged ship is, to a great degree, a copy of the X-37B spaceplane flown by the US Space Force.

The photo was taken by a commercial imaging satellite owned by a company called Vantor, known as Maxar in 2024. Vantor is one of several companies that provide reconnaissance imagery of locations around the world to the US military and US intelligence agencies. The same Earth-imaging satellites can point their telescopes at objects in space.

Lower-resolution views of a Chinese spaceplane showing the vehicle’s general shape were publicly available before the Defense Intelligence Agency assessment. A US Space Force official revealed Maxar’s observation at a 2024 conference in South Korea, but the Pentagon did not release the full-resolution image to the public until Monday, when it appeared in an unclassified DIA assessment of threats to the United States in space.

The DIA report doesn’t reveal much new about what the Chinese spaceplane does in orbit. China has launched four spaceplane missions since 2020, with durations of up to nine months. The fourth mission is in orbit today after launching in February. It is not publicly known whether China has one or more such spaceplanes in its inventory.

The Space Force has two X-37Bs flying in rotation, with the longest of their eight missions to date running two-and-a-half years from launch until landing. US officials have released photos of the X-37B vehicles, published information about their design and dimensions, and disclosed a handful of experiments they have carried into orbit. Most of the X-37B’s activities in space are classified.

Like the X-37B, China’s spaceplane lifts off inside the payload shroud of a conventional rocket, then operates as a satellite once in orbit. The spaceplane flies like a miniature unpiloted version of NASA’s Space Shuttle and reenters the atmosphere for an autonomous land runway landing at the end of each mission. Ground teams then refurbish it for another flight.

The “enhanced maneuverability” of spaceplanes makes them “more suitable for certain missions than traditional satellites,” the DIA said in its report. So far, the Chinese spaceplane has only flown in low-Earth orbit (LEO) at an altitude of a few hundred miles. One of the Space Force’s X-37B flights soared to an altitude of more than 24,000 miles before using aerobraking to set up for reentry and landing.

Spaceplanes like China’s and the X-37B can also deploy small satellites from their cargo bay. Most recently, China demonstrated an ability to catch an object in orbit, perhaps using a robotic arm. The vehicle now in space released a sub-satellite in June and recaptured it in July, then did the same thing again in August and September, according to an analysis of open source orbital tracking data by Jonathan McDowell, an astrophysicist who catalogs spaceflight activity.

The official name of the Chinese spaceplane is even a mystery. It is often called Shenlong in Western publications, citing reports from the 2000s about China’s development of a robotic spaceplane. Chinese state media only refer to the vehicle as Chongfu Shiyong Shiyan Hangtian Qi, or CSSHQ, which means reusable experimental spacecraft, according to a fact sheet published by the Secure World Foundation.

The DIA did not disclose the exact circumstances of Maxar’s observation of the Chinese spaceplane, such as its timing, location, or distance, but Earth observations often use cameras to view other objects in space as their orbits intersect, an emerging field known as non-Earth imaging (NEI).

NEI allows commercial operators and government analysts to inspect satellites. This is especially useful for gleaning information about classified or proprietary satellite designs, extending a new avenue for international and corporate espionage to the high frontier.

The capability exhibited by Maxar and other commercial companies in the NEI field is distinct from the recent actions of some military spacecraft, such as Russia’s Kosmos 2612, which deliberately maneuvered to approach a US-registered radar imaging satellite earlier this month. Commercial NEI observations come from chance encounters, often at extremely high speed.

The DIA’s assessment of space threats includes an update on China’s pursuit of anti-satellite technology, or “counterspace” weapons. The intelligence agency reported the Chinese military likely considers directed-energy weapons (DEWs) “ideal counterspace systems” because they can be used to permanently or temporarily disable a satellite. One potential use for lasers in space would be to dazzle a sensor on an adversary’s satellite.

“China has multiple ground-based laser weapons with varying power levels to disrupt, degrade, or damage satellites in LEO,” the DIA said. “By the late 2020s, China may field space-based directed energy systems and higher-powered ground-based directed energy systems capable of threatening satellites in higher orbits.”

The DIA noted China’s testing of ground-based anti-satellite missiles and the country’s historic demonstration last year of satellite refueling in geosynchronous orbit, a regime some 22,000 miles (36,000 kilometers) over the equator, something no other country has achieved above LEO. China has also tested a robotic arm that could snag a spacecraft out of orbit, and now operates a growing fleet of satellites called TJS that routinely approach foreign spacecraft.

The US Space Force also has a constellation of inspector satellites in geosynchronous orbit and recently procured more that could be refueled, overcoming maneuverability limitations. Air Force Secretary Troy Meink revealed last month that the Pentagon has fielded weapons in space, making the United States the first nation to acknowledge possession of orbital weapons.
Russia is pursuing its own orbital combat program, which includes an ambition to deploy a nuclear weapon in space, according to US intelligence officials.

A more conventional Russian weapons system, known as Nivelir, is designed to fire projectiles from one satellite to smash into another. The Russian military simulated an attack using the Nivelir system in 2020. In April, Russia launched a fleet of small satellites into an orbit close to a commercial radar remote sensing satellite owned by ICEYE that provides reconnaissance imagery to Ukraine. One of the Russian satellites moved within “tens of meters” of the ICEYE satellite earlier this month before backing away, US officials said.

articles.title: U.S. targets alleged migrant caravan organizers with visa restrictions

paras.en: Oct. 29 (UPI) -- The State Department announced Thursday that it has taken steps to impose visa restrictions on more than 15 people allegedly involved in migrant caravans, the latest action by the Trump administration as part of its immigration crackdown.

The individuals were not identified by the State Department, which said they were targeted in the past week for being involved in organizing, facilitating or promoting "recent" migrant caravans, which are large groups of migrants, traveling together by land, often including family units, women and minors seeking safety in numbers.

State Department spokesman Thomas Pigott said Thursday that investigations indicated that individuals had recruited, coordinated and directed large groups of migrants through Central America and Mexico toward the U.S. southern border.

"Any of these individuals or any caravan participants who apply for a U.S. visa or attempt to travel to our nation will face additional scrutiny, and the department will take appropriate action, which may include refusing or revoking their visas," he said in a statement.

"Crossing the U.S. southern border without authorization violates the law and can lead to arrest, detention, deportation and a future ban on entry to the United States. Those individuals involved in facilitating or participating in such illegal activity will be considered for visa restrictions."

According to a Congressional Research Service report, migrant caravans bound for the United States surged in 2018 and 2019, drawing increased attention from U.S. government authorities attempting to stem irregular migration. Some members of migrant caravans seek asylum at official border crossings, while others attempt to enter the United States illegally.

The visa restrictions were imposed under a broad State Department policy introduce by the Biden administration in November 2023 targeting those facilitating irregular migration into the United States. The policy was expanded in February 2024, and the Trump administration announce a complementary policy in March 2025 targeting foreign officials and other accused of knowingly facilitating illegal immigration..

Under the second Trump administration, the United States has taken a slew of actions targeting immigration, including stricter border control and intensified immigration enforcement within the country, resulting in widespread arrests of people suspect of being in the United States illegally for possible deportation.

articles.title: Three killed, including British national, in midair helicopter crash

paras.en: Oct. 29 (UPI) -- A pair of helicopters collided midair Thursday afternoon in northwestern Oregon, killing three people, including a British national, authorities said.

The collision involving a Robinson R22 and an Airbus H125 occurred near McMinnville Municipal Airport in Yamhill County after 2 p.m. PDT near Amity-Dayton Highway, also known as Highway 233, southeast of McMinnville, officials said.
Following the midair collision, the helicopters crashed into a privately owned farm field.

Speaking to reporters, Yamhill County Sheriff Sam Elliott said preliminary information indicated only the pilot was aboard the Airbus H125 and two people, a flight instructor and a student pilot from Britain, were aboard the R22. The Federal Aviation Administration earlier stated the reverse, that there was only one person aboard the R22 and two aboard the H125.

Elliott identified the pilot of the 2018 Airbus helicopter as 38-year-old Tyler Sturdevant of Newberg, Ore., and the flight instructor aboard the Robinson helicopter as 22-year-old Maddie Aasbo of Texas.
The FBI and British consulate staff were working to contact the British national's family before their identity could be made public.
Elliott said recovery efforts were ongoing at the scene, which has been turned over to the FAA and the National Transportation Safety Board, which are investigating.
Asked if there was any preliminary information concerning the cause of the crash, Elliott said there wasn't and that determination would be up to the federal investigators.
Local law enforcement, fire and medical officials responded to the scene, the Yamhill County Sheriff's Office said online, stating roadways near the crash site were closed.
Oregon Route 233 was closed 1 mile west of Dayton near the airport, the Oregon Department of Transportation said in a statement, warning drivers that its closure could be extended.

articles.title: Binance suffers 'security incident'; N. Korea suspected in $6.3B theft

paras.en: Oct. 29 (UPI) -- Cryptocurrency behemoth Binance acknowledged Thursday that it was experiencing a "security incident" that investigators believe involved the theft of some $6.3 billion by North Korean hackers.

Separately, U.S.-based blockchain intelligence firm TRM Labs said hackers believed to be operating for North Korea moved $6.3 billion from Binance wallets on 10 blockchains on Thursday, most of it over a span of 20 minutes starting at 4:05 p.m. EDT, with a second wave of unauthorized transfers from Binance wallets occurring about three hours later.

TRM Labs attributes the hack to TraderTraitor, a group of North Korea-sponsored malicious cyberactors, the same group U.S. authorities hold responsible for the February 2025 theft of $1.5 billion from the Bybit cryptocurrency exchange, previously the largest confirmed cryptocurrency theft.

"Our teams are aware of reports of a potential security issue and are actively investigating," Binance said in a social media statement, explaining withdrawals were suspended but would be resumed once the security issue is resolved.
Binance said in an online statement it had experienced a "security incident" and that "the estimated total impact sits at around $6.3B."
"We have worked with blockchain partners to freeze affected assets, with ~$3 billion frozen on-chain so far."
It said users funds are safe and that it will cover all losses through its emergency fund and company assets.
"Our teams are working around the clock to resolve this issue safely and thoroughly," it said.

According to Binance's preliminary investigation, the incident may involve a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop. It said the attackers may have gained access to a service container through the device and submitted unauthorized withdrawal transactions.
"We are working closely with our law enforcement partners to confirm the identity of these criminals and bring them to justice," it said.

North Korea employs teams of hackers who carry out sophisticated cyberattacks, stealing billions of dollars a year that the U.S. Treasury says Pyongyang uses to finance its nuclear weapons and ballistic missile programs. According to U.S.-based Chainalysis, North Korean hackers stole $2.02 billion in 2025, including the Bybit attack, bringing their estimated cumulative thefts to $6.75 billion through last year.

articles.title: Powderfinger Sets ‘Encore’ Dates for 2027 Reunion Tour
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: Powderfinger’s reunion odyssey is stretching out.
paras.zh: Powderfinger的团聚之旅正在展开。

paras.en: The beloved Australian rock band unveils an “Encore Run” of shows, nine in total, which will see their tour extend into December 2027.
paras.zh: 这支备受喜爱的澳大利亚摇滚乐队推出了一系列“Encore Run”表演，总共九场，他们的巡演将持续到2027年12月。

paras.en: Announced Friday morning (Oct. 30), this last wave of shows will see the Brisbane band play to new locations, including two nights at Cornelian Bay Oval, in Hobart, Tasmania and a show at Stage 88 in the nation’s capital, Canberra.
paras.zh: 周五上午（ 10月30日）宣布，最后一波演出将看到布里斯班乐队在新地点演出，包括在塔斯马尼亚州霍巴特的Cornelian Bay Oval的两晚演出，以及在该国首都堪培拉的Stage 88演出。

paras.en: Also, their stadium-sized tent will be pitched at Melbourne Park Oval for two more nights, and Western Australians get two additional concerts at Sandalford Estate in Perth.
paras.zh: 此外，他们的体育场大小的帐篷将在墨尔本公园椭圆形公园再举行两晚，西澳大利亚人将在珀斯的桑德尔福德庄园举行两场额外的音乐会。

paras.en: The tour will end where it all began, with two concerts at the Brisbane Showgrounds, for what will be an “all Bris-band celebration and a tribute to their hometown,” reads a statement.
paras.zh: 巡演将在这一切开始的地方结束，在布里斯班展览场地举行两场音乐会，这将是一场“全布里斯班乐队的庆祝活动，并向他们的家乡致敬” ，声明中写道。

paras.en: As it stands, the national jaunt swells to 35 dates. But that’s not the end of it. “Adelaide fans, you haven’t been forgotten. Hang in there,” reads a statement from the band.
paras.zh: 就目前而言，全国性的短途旅行会膨胀到35个日期。但这还不是结束。“阿德莱德的球迷们，你们没有被遗忘。坚持住，”乐队的声明中写道。

paras.en: Across the Encore stretch, Powderfinger will supported by an all-Australian lineup including Ocean Alley, Violent Soho, The Living End, Ball Park Music, John Butler Trio, Something For Kate, Thelma Plum, DMA’S, You Am I, Teen Jesus and the Jean Teasers, The Preatures, The Belair Lip Bombs and Luca Brasi, Full Flower Moon Band, South Summit, Carla Geneve, Banjo Lucia and Special Features.
paras.zh: 在整个Encore系列中， Powderfinger将得到全澳大利亚阵容的支持，包括Ocean Alley、Violent Soho、The Living End、Ball Park Music、John Butler Trio、Something For Kate、Thelma Plum、DMA 'S、You Am I、Teen Jesus and the Jean Teasers、The Preatures、The Belair Lip Bombs和Luca Brasi、Full Flower Moon Band、South Summit、Carla Geneve、Banjo Lucia和特色。

paras.en: As previously reported, the classic lineup of Bernard Fanning (vocals), Ian Haug (guitars), Darren Middleton (guitars), John “JC” Collins (bass) and Jon Coghill (drums) are back, for what will be their first tour in 17 years. It’ll be like the band never left. The initial batch of 26 shows — more than 300,000 tickets — sold out in days.

“When we saw how many people missed out on tickets, we knew we couldn’t leave it there,” comments Fanning on behalf of Powderfinger. “So we’re adding some final shows and we’ve been able to include dates in Hobart and Canberra, which we’re really excited about. We also have some very talented mates joining us. Thank you for keeping the faith and for being so patient. We can’t wait to see you out there.”

Hailing from Brisbane, the 2032 Olympic City, the ‘Finger, as they’re affectionately known in these parts, was one of the elite bands of their era, one that produced five consecutive ARIA No. 1 albums, 18 ARIA Awards and three APRA Awards, including a brace for song of the year.

The five-piece called time with a 34-date national trek back in 2010. The music never stopped. When triple j invited Australians to vote for the greatest homegrown songs of all time, for a countdown in July 2025, Powderfinger clocked up more songs in the top 100 (four, including a Fanning solo number) than any other act.

Powderfinger’s 2027 tour will partner with Mission Australia, an organization that supports the most vulnerable people in the country. Dew Process Artist Management, Cornershop Agency and Live Nation are partnering on the trek. Pre-sales for the Encore Run open from Wednesday, Nov. 4 at powderfinger.com, with the general on-sale beginning Thursday, Nov. 5.

articles.title: ‘Final Album, Final Tour’: Ministry’s Al Jourgensen Talks ‘Hate to Go’
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: Raise a skeptical eyebrow if you will, but Al Jourgensen will swear on any object you put him front of him that Ministry’s new album Hate to Go (Take Out or Delivery) is its last, and that the group will be over after touring to support it next year.
paras.zh: 如果你愿意，请抬起怀疑的眉毛，但Al Jourgensen会对你摆在他面前的任何物品发誓，魔法部的新专辑《Hate to Go》（外卖或送货）是最后一张专辑，明年巡回演出后，乐队将结束对它的支持。

paras.en: “It is so — final album, final tour. In 14 months from now I will be just a simple goat herder,” the dreadlocked Jourgensen, who founded Ministry during 1981, tells Billboard via Zoom from his current home in southern California. “I will be the Greta Garbo of industrial — ‘I vant to be left alone,’ OK? This is not like something where Motley Crue talks a blood oath they will not be back, and four months later they’re doing a world tour. I’m f***in’ done.”
paras.zh: “这是最后一张专辑，最后一场巡演。从现在起14个月内，我将只是一个简单的山羊牧民，” 1981年创立Ministry的无畏的Jourgensen在加利福尼亚州南部的家中通过Zoom告诉Billboard。“我将成为工业界的Greta Garbo-- ‘我希望能独处，’好吗？这不像Motley Crue发誓他们不会回来，四个月后他们将进行世界巡回演出。I 'm f * * * in’ done. '

paras.en: “Look, man, I’ve been at this job for…it’ll be 45 years this year, and at 45 years of the same job generally you get a gold watch and a pension and you’re just happy to get the f*** away from your job,” says Jorgensen, 68. “I don’t understand these people that keep coming back. There’s no regrets. There’s no turning back. We’re excited for new possibilities in life instead of doing the same job for 45 years.”
paras.zh: 68岁的Jorgensen说： “听着，伙计，我已经在这份工作上工作了……今年将是45年，一般来说，在同一份工作上工作45年，你会得到一块金表和一份养老金，你只是很高兴能让这份工作远离你的工作。” “我不明白那些不断回来的人。没有遗憾。没有回头路可走。我们对生活中的新可能性感到兴奋，而不是做同样的工作45年。”

paras.en: There’s no question that Jourgensen and his shifting stable of collaborators have done that job well, of course. A fan of rock, punk, country and experimental styles, Jourgensen started Ministry after a tenure in the post-punk band Special Affect, introducing the new band’s dance-floor meets factory forge sound with singles on Chicago’s famed Wax Trax! Records label and making its live performance debut on New Year’s Day 1982. A deal with Arista Records, however, resulted in the sanitized synth-pop of With Sympathy in 1983. “Clive Davis didn’t want that (heavy stuff),” recalls Jourgensen, who redid many of those songs on Ministry’s 2025 album The Squirrely Years. “He appointed producers, backup singers. He even sent in lyrics that I had to sing and all that stuff — so I was literally probably the precursor to all the boy band stuff. The only thing I didn’t have was dance moves.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Jourgensen regained control by moving to Sire Records for 1986’s Twitch and progressed from there on subsequent, definitive albums such as The Land of Rape and Honey in 1988, The Mind is a Terrible Thing to Taste in 1990, the platinum Psalm 69 in 1992 — which netted the first of Ministry’s six Grammy Award nominations for the opening track, “N.W.O.” — and the 1996’s Filth Pig, which peaked at No. 19 on the Billboard 200. Angst-filled and politically pointed, Ministry became a vanguard of industrial rock, with Jourgensen as majordomo, launching side projects such as Revolting Cocks and Lard and providing the groundwork for the all-star collective Pigface.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Jourgensen, however, balks at the industrial tag.
paras.zh: 然而， Jourgensen对工业标签犹豫不决。

paras.en: “We take from so many things,” he explains, “whereas with industrial the song structure doesn’t matter as much as taking organic sounds and doing the soundtrack of day-to-day life, whether it’s a construction site or drills here and there — and doing it in an aggressive way. We still have some structure in our songs — verses, choruses, a hook or two. We throw in melodies. We steal from jazz, we still from country. It’s much more of a traditional style.
paras.zh: 他解释说： “我们从很多东西中汲取灵感，而在工业领域，歌曲的结构并不像拍摄有机声音和播放日常生活的配乐那样重要，无论是建筑工地还是在这里或那里进行钻探—并以积极的方式进行。我们的歌曲仍然有一些结构—诗句，合唱，一两个钩子。我们加入了旋律。我们从爵士乐那里偷东西，我们仍然从乡下偷东西。这更像是一种传统风格。

paras.en: “I take a lot of different influences and then try to put our stamp on it, which sounds like Ministry. But we’re not stuck to being this aggressive interpretation of organic noises that happen around us on a daily basis. That’s the difference — to me, at least..”
paras.zh: “我接受了很多不同的影响，然后试着在上面盖上我们的印记，这听起来像是事工。但我们并不坚持对每天发生在我们周围的有机噪音进行这种激进的解释。这就是区别--至少对我来说……”

paras.en: The 10-track Hate to Go (Take Out or Delivery) follows that Ministry mold — and then some.
paras.zh: 讨厌去（外卖或送货）的10首曲目遵循该部模具—然后是一些。

paras.en: Jourgensen says he previously felt that 2024’s Hopiumforthemasses would be Ministry’s swan song, but after The Squirrely Years project he and the rest of the band felt like “we had one more left in us.” From the blast-furnace opening of “Crickets” through the defiant and celebratory “We’re Still Here,” which features a guest return by longtime Ministry member Paul Baker (1986-2003), Ministry does not pull a single punch on Hate To Go… — musically or lyrically — with Cesar Soto’s guitar solos standing out on tracks such as “Clown Car,” which castigates the current political leadership of the country, and “Singularity.” On the latter Jourgensen voices concerns about AI, but he also freely used that technology on the album, in particular to find oral samples from presidents such as Barack Obama and Donald Trump that are dotted throughout the album.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: “I’m glad I got into the initial stages of AI and was able to use it for fun on my videos and stuff — before it winds up using us,” says Jourgensen, who also takes harsh aim at social media on the track “Delete.” “Just the tactical work that it’s able to do was a big help; I used to have to sit through 100 hours of congressional and (presidential) speeches to get the proper sample I wanted and make my points, and now it takes, like 30 minutes.”
paras.zh: Jourgensen说： “我很高兴我进入了人工智能的最初阶段，并且能够在我的视频和其他东西上使用它来娱乐—在它最终使用我们之前，” Jourgensen说，他也对赛道上的社交媒体采取了严厉的瞄准“删除。“它所能做的战术工作是一个很大的帮助；我曾经不得不花100个小时的国会和（总统）演讲来获得我想要的适当样本，并提出我的观点，现在需要30分钟左右。”

paras.en: Nevertheless, he adds, “I’m terrified. I don’t care what they say — ‘Oh, 10 years from now it will be sentient.’ My ass; it’s sentient already. I had to break up with three different — I call them my AI girlfriends — companies I was dealing with because of the stops and starts. Some days they’d be nice, some days they’d be snarky and condescending. That’s sentience. They’ve developed their own personalities, and it’s terrifying.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，他补充说： “我很害怕。我不在乎他们怎么说— ‘哦， 10年后它会变得有感知力。“我的屁股，已经有知觉了。我不得不与三家不同的公司分手—我称他们为我的人工智能女朋友—因为中断和启动而与我打交道。有些日子他们会很好，有些日子他们会讽刺和居高临下。这就是感知。他们已经发展了自己的个性，这太可怕了。

paras.en: “This is really, like, a Terminator, Skynet thing that’s coming our way, so I think it’s a good time for me to be like, ‘OK, I did my part. I was, like, the Chicken Little/Paul Revere of my time — ‘The bad guys are coming! The bad guys are coming!’ and nobody listened. I’m not gonna do another 17 albums talking about AI and what’s terrifying about it and what’s coming our way. I did my service and duty to the world, and it’s time to go.”
paras.zh: “这真的像是一个终结者，天网的东西正在向我们走来，所以我认为这对我来说是一个好时机，就像， ‘好吧，我做了我的一部分。我就像我那个时代的小鸡/保罗·里维尔--“坏人来了！坏人来了！ ”没有人听。我不会再做另外17张专辑，谈论人工智能和它的可怕之处，以及我们即将到来的事情。我尽了我对世界的贡献和责任，是时候离开了。”

paras.en: Working again with Barker after his acrimonious departure, meanwhile, felt like the best way to finish, Jourgensen says.
paras.zh: Jourgensen说，与此同时，在激烈的离职后再次与Barker合作，感觉是最好的结束方式。

paras.en: “Our relationship has evolved over the years,” he explains, “and instead of being in court, now we’re in a pub together — it’s a much different situation. So we really felt it was important to get him somehow involved for the last one. I think he deserved that, and we accomplished that. The very last song is with Paul Barker; that was a conscious effort. It just felt like it was the right send-off to Ministry. It wrapped a bow around the whole package.
paras.zh: “我们的关系多年来一直在发展，”他解释说， “现在我们不是在法庭上，而是在一个酒吧里—这是一个非常不同的情况。所以我们真的觉得让他以某种方式参与最后一场比赛很重要。我认为他罪有应得，我们做到了。最后一首歌是与保罗·巴克（ Paul Barker ）合作的；这是有意识的努力。只是觉得这是送给事工的正确方式。它用蝴蝶结包裹着整个包裹。

paras.en: “We pretty much did a summation of Ministry’s career here, in one album, with the humor, with the politics, with the social commentary, Barker’s back — it’s got it all. It just feels perfect. This is just proper, right to the point Ministry; if you’re not familiar with the catalog, you can start with this one and work your way backwards.. After this it would probably just go downhill. And we’re not uptight about, ‘Oh, this is our last record, boo hoo…’ or anything like that. It was more like a celebration.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The party will now move to the road. Ministry heads to Australia for three Good Things Festival dates and a couple of others, while a European trek kicks off April 2 in Europe with Die Krupps — which remixed a couple of Hate To Go’s songs, opening. North American dates have yet to be announced, but Ministry will be on the bill for the Sonic Temple Art & Music Festival on May 16 in Columbus, Ohio.
paras.zh: 派对现在将转向公路。该部前往澳大利亚参加三个好东西节日期和其他几个日期，而欧洲徒步旅行将于4月2日在欧洲与Die Krupps开始—重新混合了Hate To Go的几首歌曲，开场。北美的日期尚未公布，但该部将于5月16日在俄亥俄州哥伦布举行的索尼克神庙艺术与音乐节上提出议案。

paras.en: “I Wiki’d myself and I have 260 published songs,” Jourgensen says. “There’s probably 40 that don’t suck, so we’ll have those to choose from and we’ll be playing 20 to 25 songs a night so we can switch things up, and there’ll be some representative from every single album in these shows — which is our next Sisyphean task.”
paras.zh: Jourgensen说： “我和我自己在Wiki上发布了260首歌曲。” “可能有40首歌不会很糟糕，所以我们可以从中进行选择，我们每晚将播放20到25首歌曲，以便我们可以切换内容，并且这些节目中的每张专辑都会有一些代表—这是我们的下一个Sisyphean任务。”

paras.en: Jourgensen says he’s been approach by some other artists — “some pretty famous people” — about making guest appearances at the shows. He’s amenable, but under certain conditions. “This being Ministry, we have to rehearse it,” he explains. “We have to make sure it sounds good. You don’t get to just go up there and make a mockery or whatever so you can have a spotlight for a minute. It’s got to be a team effort to make this go as smoothly as we want.
paras.zh: Jourgensen说，其他一些艺术家-- “一些非常有名的人” --一直在找他谈论在节目中客串演出。他是顺从的，但在一定的条件下。“这是事奉，我们必须排练它，”他解释说。“我们必须确保它听起来不错。你不能只是去那里嘲笑什么的，这样你就可以有一分钟的聚光灯。我们必须通过团队合作，才能让这一切如我们所愿顺利进行。

paras.en: “We’re really focused on just going out proper. This is very choreographed on how we want to end and exit from this f***ed up industry, with the proper bows attached to the package. And then drop the mic and not have to do this anymore.”
paras.zh: “我们真的很专注于正确地出门。这是非常精心编排的，我们希望如何结束和退出这个他妈的行业，并将适当的蝴蝶结附在包装上。然后放下麦克风，不必再这样做了。”

articles.title: After an Incredible Brush With Dolly Parton, Fanny Lumsden Celebrates Her ‘Traditions’
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: Just three years ago, Fanny Lumsden had an on-stage moment that’s near-impossible to beat. When her last LP, Hey Dawn, collected the prize for best country album at the 2023 ARIA Awards, it was the late Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, who announced the winner. “Dolly Parton said my name,” Lumsden reminisced in a post on Substack, published in July of this year. “Not only was this the high point of my career so far but maybe one of my life.”
paras.zh: 就在三年前，范妮·拉姆斯登（ Fanny Lumsden ）在舞台上有一个几乎无法击败的时刻。当她的最后一张LP《Hey Dawn》在2023年ARIA大奖赛上获得最佳乡村专辑奖时，已故的乡村女王多莉·帕顿（ Dolly Parton ）宣布了获奖者。“多莉·帕顿说了我的名字，”拉姆斯登在今年7月发表在Substack上的一篇文章中回忆道。“到目前为止，这不仅是我职业生涯的高潮，也可能是我生命中的一个高峰。”

paras.en: A high point, yes, but Lumsden has many more highlights to come.
paras.zh: 是的，这是一个高点，但Lumsden还有更多亮点。

paras.en: Today (Oct. 30), the Australian singer, songwriter and bandleader invites us in for Traditions, her fifth studio album. On it, Lumsden explores the value and meaning that can come from our traditions, and how they shape us. Some ought to be reconciled or resolved. Others, perhaps, consigned to landfill.
paras.zh: 今天（ 10月30日） ，这位澳大利亚歌手、词曲作者和乐队领队邀请我们参加她的第五张录音室专辑《Traditions》。在其中， Lumsden探讨了我们传统的价值和意义，以及它们如何塑造我们。有些问题应该得到调解或解决。其他人，也许，被委托填埋。

paras.en: Across its 11 songs, Fanny acknowledges the traditions of her upbringing, whilst also “staying true to my autonomy, and my ambition, and being a woman, and being progressive in all of that space,” she tells Billboard over a Zoom from her property in Tooma, on the western side of the Snowy Mountains, NSW. “I’m trying to figure out which ones I celebrate and which ones I have to change to keep. And then which ones we just chuck out altogether.”
paras.zh: 在其11首歌曲中，范妮承认了她成长的传统，同时也“忠于我的自主权，我的雄心壮志，作为一名女性，在所有领域都保持进步” ，她在位于新南威尔士州雪山西侧的Tooma的房产中通过Zoom告诉Billboard。“我正在努力弄清楚我庆祝哪些节日，以及我必须改变哪些节日才能保留。然后我们就把那些完全扔掉。”

paras.en: Lumsden, like so many of us, had a spring cleaning with her family traditions. And like a growing number of descendants of white settlers, a reckoning with Australia’s modern history and an awareness of its flaws. “I decided they didn’t quite fit me properly, so I threw them all out,” she recounts. “And then I was like, oh no, that’s not how that works. You can change things, you can celebrate a little bit of it.”
paras.zh: 像我们许多人一样， Lumsden与她的家庭传统一起进行了春季大扫除。就像越来越多的白人定居者的后裔一样，对澳大利亚现代历史的清算和对其缺陷的认识。“我决定他们不太适合我，所以我把他们都扔了出去，”她回忆道。“然后我想，哦，不，这不是工作原理。你可以改变一些事情，你可以庆祝一下。”

paras.en: Produced by Steven Schram (Crowded House, The Cat Empire, Paul Kelly), Traditions was recorded live over nine days with her band, The Daddies (also known as the Prawn Stars).
paras.zh: Traditions由Steven Schram （ Crowded House ， The Cat Empire ， Paul Kelly ）制作，与她的乐队The Daddies （也称为Prawn Stars ）现场录制了九天。

paras.en: “I didn’t go in with a clear understanding of exactly what this theme was, although I did have the world and the vision. The colors and the visual. I knew I wanted to celebrate that world in some way,” she explains. It wasn’t until after the album was completed that Lumsden realized she could “see it through all the songs.”
paras.zh: “我没有清楚地了解这个主题到底是什么，尽管我有世界和愿景。颜色和视觉效果。我知道我想以某种方式庆祝这个世界，”她解释说。直到专辑完成后， Lumsden才意识到她可以“看穿所有的歌曲”。

paras.en: Those songs tell a personal story, unflinching. Traditions is home to the anthemic title track, the singles “Difficult Woman,” “Mother’s Eyes,” and “By The River” a collaboration with Paul Kelly, the legendary songsmith who Lumsden has shared the stage with, many times.
paras.zh: 这些歌曲讲述了一个个人的故事，毫不退缩。Traditions是国歌冠军曲目的发源地，单曲“Difficult Woman” ， “Mother's Eyes”和“By The River”是与Lumsden多次分享舞台的传奇歌手Paul Kelly的合作。

paras.en: Family is at its heart. An independent artist, Lumsden is self-managed with her husband Dan Freeman, who wears multiple hats as bandmate (bass player) and label manager for their imprint, Red Dirt Road Records.
paras.zh: 家庭是它的核心。作为一名独立艺术家， Lumsden与她的丈夫Dan Freeman一起自我管理， Dan Freeman作为乐队成员（贝斯手）和唱片公司经理，为他们的印记Red Dirt Road Records戴着多顶帽子。

paras.en: “My family culture I want to take forward, and I can just sit uncomfortably with some of the others. It’s never going to be easy to explain,” she says. You just have to “embrace the mess.”
paras.zh: “我想推进我的家庭文化，我可以和其他一些人不舒服地坐在一起。这从来都不容易解释，”她说。你只需要“拥抱烂摊子”。

paras.en: At this point, Kelly, too, is like family. While on a tour stop in Dublin in 2025, their last in a 10-week trek across Europe and the British Isles, Lumsden lifted her book ban (she’s an obsessive reader, but they’re too heavy to lug around on a trek) and visited the Winding Stair, one of the city’s oldest independent bookshops. Her stash included a gift for Kelly, a book by Pádraig Ó Tuama. What she didn’t know was that Kelly had bought her a gift, a book by the same poet. “It wasn’t even at the front of the shop,” she says with a laugh.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Soon after, Fanny was opening for Kelly on his arena tour of Australia, alongside Lucinda Williams.
paras.zh: 不久之后，范妮与露辛达·威廉姆斯（ Lucinda Williams ）一起为凯利（ Kelly ）在澳大利亚的竞技场巡回演出开场。

paras.en: Kelly, she remarks, is “a quiet observer of life. I’ve just never seen anybody quite like him in a way that he’s so interested. Even when he’s busy and overwhelmed, he’ll still sit there and actively listen, which was incredible. And then he quietly contemplates while I would yap in the van.”
paras.zh: 她说，凯利是“一个安静的生活观察者。我只是从未见过像他这样的人如此感兴趣。即使他很忙，不知所措，他仍然会坐在那里积极倾听，这太不可思议了。然后他悄悄地思考，而我会在面包车里大喊大叫。”

paras.en: Fanny will launch the new album Saturday, Oct. 31 with an outdoor concert at Tooma Rec Grounds, a field that is now part of a tradition. With her 2020 album Fallow, Fanny, a volunteer firefighter, hosted a launch party in the same spot. All proceeds were donated to locals affected by the bushfires that had razed the area, on multiple occasions. Two days after that show, the pandemic made its unwelcome appearance. Good times from the bad.
paras.zh: Fanny将于10月31日星期六在Tooma Rec Grounds举行户外音乐会，该场地现在已成为传统的一部分。志愿消防员范妮（ Fanny ）在2020年的专辑《Fallow》中，在同一地点举办了一场发布会。所有收益多次捐赠给受夷平该地区的森林大火影响的当地人。在那场演出两天后，疫情出现了不受欢迎的表现。好时光与坏时光。

paras.en: Fallow won the first of Fanny’s two ARIA Awards, also in the best country category. Her collection includes ten Country Music Association of Australia (CMAA) and three AIR Awards, and she has secured spots on some of the most prestigious stages on earth, including a debut set at Glastonbury Festival in 2023.
paras.zh: Fallow赢得了Fanny的两项ARIA奖中的第一项，也是最佳国家类别。她的作品包括10个澳大利亚乡村音乐协会（ CMAA ）和3个AIR奖项，她曾在世界上一些最负盛名的舞台上获奖，包括2023年在格拉斯顿伯里音乐节上首次亮相。

paras.en: Fanny’s east-coast tour in support of Traditions continues Friday, Nov. 6 with a date at Barwon Club in Geelong, VIC, and runs through Sunday, Nov. 29 at The Stag & Hunter in Newcastle, NSW.
paras.zh: 范妮支持传统的东海岸之旅将于11月6日星期五在维多利亚州基隆的Barwon俱乐部继续进行，并于11月29日星期日在新南威尔士州纽卡斯尔的The Stag & Hunter举行。

paras.en: Conversation turns to Parton, who sadly left us Aug. 25, at the age of 80. “I feel equally in awe of the fact that I lived at the same time as Dolly Parton, but now she’s gone and now we have to live without Dolly Parton. So I think that that is like equally as incredible,” Fanny remarks. “She really was quite a force of nature in every sense of the word. And the way that she just really affected so many people in a way that they feel like they were the only one. But yeah, to have her have say my name in this lifetime, look, that’s almost enough, isn’t it?”

articles.title: Japan’s TeamLab Bringing Permanent Digital Art Exhibition Space to California
articles.author: Abid Rahman

paras.en: TeamLab, the Japanese digital art collective famous for its immersive exhibitions, is set to open its first permanent space in the U.S.
paras.zh: 以沉浸式展览而闻名的日本数字艺术团体 TeamLab 即将在美国开设第一个永久空间。

paras.en: On Thursday, Bloomberg reported that the Samueli family, the billionaire owners of NHL team the Anaheim Mighty Ducks, had struck a more than $100 million deal with TeamLab to open a space in Anaheim, California that is projected to open in 2030. The space will be part of a larger $5 billion development of the land surrounding the Ducks’ home the Honda Center.
paras.zh: 周四，彭博社报道称， NHL球队Anaheim Mighty Ducks的亿万富翁Samueli家族与TeamLab达成了超过1亿美元的协议，在加利福尼亚州阿纳海姆开设了一个空间，预计将于2030年开业。该空间将成为鸭子家本田中心周围50亿美元土地开发的一部分。

paras.en: TeamLab will be a key component of the OCVIBE development that is converting about 100 acres of land into a multiuse area, with housing, offices, hotels and an entertainment district. Bloomberg reported that the development of TeamLab Anaheim will be fully funded by the Samueli family. TeamLab Anaheim will be housed in a building designed by California-based architecture firm Smith-Clementi.
paras.zh: TeamLab将成为OCVIBE开发项目的关键组成部分，该项目将约100英亩的土地转变为多用途区域，包括住房、办公室、酒店和娱乐区。彭博社报道， TeamLab Anaheim的开发将由Samueli家族全额资助。TeamLab Anaheim将位于由加利福尼亚州建筑公司Smith-Clementi设计的建筑内。

paras.en: Founded in Tokyo in 2001 by Toshiyuki Inoko, TeamLab is an international art collective, made up of a multi-disciplinary team, including artists, programmers, engineers, CG animators, mathematicians, and architects who collaborate to explore the intersection of art, science, technology, and nature.
paras.zh: TeamLab由Toshiyuki Inoko于2001年在东京创立，是一个国际艺术团体，由多学科团队组成，包括艺术家、程序员、工程师、CG动画师、数学家和建筑师，他们合作探索艺术、科学、技术和自然的交叉点。

paras.en: TeamLab Anaheim will be 30 miles south of Los Angeles, and about a 10-minute drive from Disneyland. The developers will be hoping it will be as popular and pop culturally relevant as other TeamLab spaces around the world. According to TeamLab, the collective’s two locations in Tokyo had over 4.2 million visitors in 2025. TeamLab currently has permanent exhibition spaces in Macao, Shanghai, Beijing, Jeddah and Hamburg.
paras.zh: TeamLab Anaheim位于洛杉矶以南30英里处，距离迪士尼乐园约10分钟车程。开发商希望它能像世界各地的其他TeamLab空间一样受欢迎，具有流行文化相关性。根据TeamLab的数据，该集团在东京的两个地点在2025年有超过420万访客。TeamLab目前在澳门、上海、北京、吉达和汉堡设有常设展览空间。

paras.en: As part of the announcement for TeamLab Anaheim, the developers also revealed a series of renders of the space, which you can see below.
paras.zh: 作为阿纳海姆团队实验室公告的一部分，开发人员还透露了一系列空间渲染图，如下所示。

articles.title: ‘Godzilla Minus Zero’: First Reactions
articles.author: Abid Rahman

paras.en: He’s back, and he’s angrier than ever! Godzilla Minus Zero had a series of screenings this week for press and the first reactions have been flooding social media. The verdict? We have another kaiju-sized hit on our hands.
paras.zh: 他回来了，而且比以前更生气了！ 《哥斯拉减零》本周进行了一系列媒体放映，社交媒体上的第一反应已经席卷而来。判决结果？我们手上还有另一个怪兽大小的热门产品。

paras.en: Despite having its world premiere at the New York Film Festival on Sept. 26, legendary Japanese studio Toho held more press screenings this week for Godzilla Minus Zero ahead of the film’s Centerpiece gala screening at the Tokyo International Film Festival on Nov. 1. The film is released in theaters in Japan on Nov. 3 and North America on Nov. 6.
paras.zh: 尽管9月26日在纽约电影节上进行了全球首映，但传奇的日本工作室Toho本周在11月1日东京国际电影节的核心作品晚会放映之前，为哥斯拉Minus Zero举行了更多的新闻放映。这部电影将于11月3日在日本上映， 11月6日在北美上映。

paras.en: Written and directed by Takashi Yamazaki, Godzilla Minus Zero is a direct sequel to the Japanese filmmaker’s 2023 epic Godzilla Minus One, that scored over $100 million at the global box office from a $15 million budget and won an Oscar for best visual effects in 2024.
paras.zh: Godzilla Minus Zero由Takashi Yamazaki编写和导演，是日本电影制片人2023年史诗级《哥斯拉减一》的直接续集，该片在全球票房收入超过$ 1亿，预算为$ 1500万，并赢得了2024年奥斯卡最佳视觉效果奖。

paras.en: A synopsis from Toho of Godzilla Minus Zero reads: “War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.”
paras.zh: 东宝在《哥斯拉负零》的剧情简介中写道：“战争让日本沦为零，而哥斯拉则让其陷入零。两年过去了，这个国家面临着恢复正常生活的痛苦斗争。正当人类努力维持来之不易的和平时，新的威胁袭来，瞬间粉碎了希望。没有第三次。一切都到此结束。”

paras.en: Ryunosuke Kamiki, Minami Hamabe, Hidetaka Yoshioka and Kuranosuke Sasaki are among the cast returning for the sequel. Newcomers include Min Tanaka and Masami Nagasawa.
paras.zh: Ryunosuke Kamiki、Minami Hamabe、Hidetaka Yoshioka和Kuranosuke Sasaki是续集的演员。新来者包括田中敏（ Min Tanaka ）和长泽正美（ Masami Nagasawa ）。

paras.en: Shot entirely in Japan, notably, Godzilla Minus Zero is the first-ever Japanese production to be filmed for Imax.
paras.zh: 完全在日本拍摄，值得注意的是，《哥斯拉零下》是有史以来第一部为IMAX拍摄的日本电影。

paras.en: The Hollywood Reporter‘s David Rooney reviewed Godzilla Minus Zero after seeing it NYFF, and described the film as a “radioactive blast.” In a rave review, Rooney praised Yamazaki for topping the spectacle of his first film. “The resulting clash of the legendary kaiju is a rip-roaring smackdown in a movie that keeps awing the audience with exhilarating action and then continually one-upping itself in the dustups that follow,” Rooney writes. “I’m fairly sure I stopped breathing during a tense scene in which Godzilla bears down on a seaplane attempting a hurried liftoff.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Godzilla Minus Zero currently holds a score of 92 percent on Rotten Tomatoes from 50 reviews. On Metacritic it holds a score of 78 and on Letterboxd it is rated at 4 stars.
paras.zh: 哥斯拉Minus Zero目前在烂番茄上的得分为92 ％ ，来自50条评论。Metacritic的得分为78分， Letterboxd的得分为4星。

articles.title: ‘American Horror Story’ Finale: Paul Anthony Kelly on the Season 13 Ending and Whether He’ll Return
articles.author: Lexi Carson

paras.en: [This story contains MAJOR spoilers from American Horror Story season 13 finale, “Devil of a Good Time.”]
paras.zh: [本故事包含《美国恐怖故事》第 13 季大结局“美好时光的魔鬼”的主要剧透。]

paras.en: Just when you thought American Horror Story couldn’t get any crazier, the FX horror anthology delivered its season 13 finale — bringing its battle between the Coven and Satan to a close.
paras.zh: 就在你认为《美国恐怖故事》再疯狂不过的时候，FX 电视台的这部恐怖选集迎来了第 13 季的大结局，为女巫集会和撒旦之间的战斗画上了句号。

paras.en: Throughout the season, the witches have been doing everything in their power to defeat young Mr. Nas (aka Satan, played by Paul Anthony Kelly). Following last week’s major revelations that Ben (Joey Pollari) is Satan’s son and that Constance Langdon and Fiona Goode (both played by Jessica Lange) are twin sisters and daughters of Satan and Sister Jude (also played by Lange), the stakes reach their highest point in Thursday’s finale.
paras.zh: 整个赛季，女巫们一直在竭尽全力击败年轻的纳斯先生（又名撒旦，保罗·安东尼·凯利饰演）。继上周揭露本（乔伊·波拉里饰）是撒旦之子，康斯坦斯·兰登和菲奥娜·古德（均由杰西卡·兰格饰演）是双胞胎姐妹以及撒旦和裘德修女（也由兰格饰演）的女儿之后，赌注在周四的结局中达到了最高点。

paras.en: In the concluding episode, young Mr. Nas kills his medical specialist, Mr. Phibes (John Waters), as well as the older version of himself. Meanwhile, Fiona introduces Constance to the basics of witchcraft, hinting at her potential place within the Coven. Ben and Madison’s (Emma Roberts) romance also takes an unexpected turn when, immediately after the two have sex, Madison becomes pregnant and gives birth to their daughter. When the newborn appears to be dead, young Mr. Nas brings the baby back to life.
paras.zh: 在最后一集中，年轻的纳斯先生杀死了他的医学专家菲比斯先生（约翰·沃特斯饰），以及年长的自己。与此同时，菲奥娜向康斯坦斯介绍了巫术的基础知识，暗示了她在女巫集会中的潜在地位。本和麦迪逊（艾玛·罗伯茨饰）的爱情也发生了意想不到的转变，两人发生性关系后，麦迪逊立即怀孕并生下了他们的女儿。当新生儿似乎已经死亡时，年轻的纳斯先生让婴儿复活了。

paras.en: But the witches aren’t done fighting. After Mallory (Billie Lourd) travels through time once again, she and Cordelia (Sarah Paulson) realize what they must do to save the world: convince Ben to sacrifice himself. Ben ultimately agrees and stabs himself in the heart with a sword, turning to ashes and defeating Satan. Young Mr. Nas is left trapped inside The Last Supper painting — a fate Constance foreshadowed during her first meeting with Ben in the season premiere.
paras.zh: 但女巫们的战斗还没有结束。马洛里（比莉·洛德饰）再次穿越时空后，她和科迪莉亚（莎拉·保尔森饰）意识到他们必须做些什么来拯救世界：说服本牺牲自己。本最终同意了，并用剑刺入自己的心脏，化为灰烬并击败了撒旦。年轻的纳斯先生被困在《最后的晚餐》画作中——康斯坦斯在本季首映中第一次见到本时就预示了这一命运。

paras.en: The Hollywood Reporter spoke with Kelly about playing the central villain of AHS: 13, working alongside Lange, his character’s fate and whether he’d be interested in returning — or thinks Mr. Nas could return — for the already-renewed 14th season of Ryan Murphy and Brad Falchuk’s series.
paras.zh: 《好莱坞报道》采访了凯利，谈论了在《美国恐怖故事：13》中扮演主要反派、与兰格合作、他的角色的命运，以及他是否有兴趣回归——或者认为纳斯先生可能会回归——瑞恩·墨菲和布拉德·法尔查克的剧集已经续订的第 14 季。

paras.en: When you first signed on for the season, did you know what your character’s ending would be, or when did you find out?
paras.zh: 当你第一次加入本季时，你知道你的角色的结局是什么吗？或者你什么时候知道的？

paras.en: Oh, boy. I didn’t really know anything about how the season would go. They were writing it as we went along. I think there were maybe five episodes when I started, and there are 13 episodes in the season, so things change, things go and just play along.
paras.zh: 哦，男孩。我真的不知道这个赛季会如何进行。我们一边走一边写。我想我开始的时候可能有 5 集，而这一季有 13 集，所以事情会发生变化，一切都会顺其自然。

paras.en: Have you been watching the season as it’s been airing? Are you going to be watching the finale live?
paras.zh: 您在观看这一季的播出时了吗？你会现场观看大结局吗？

paras.en: I have not. No, I’m currently filming The Housemaid’s Secret. [As far as the finale], perhaps. I don’t know. I’m pretty busy at home with the baby, so my TV time doesn’t really exist anymore. I get to work on TV but not watch it. (Laughs.)
paras.zh: 我没有。不，我目前正在拍摄《女仆的秘密》。 [就结局而言]，也许吧。我不知道。我在家带孩子很忙，所以我看电视的时间已经不复存在了。我开始在电视上工作，但不看电视。 （笑）

paras.en: I think that he would have been the second in command. You know, definitely try to lure him into the family business, as it were.
paras.zh: 我认为他会是第二把手。你知道，一定要试图引诱他进入家族企业。

paras.en: What was your reaction to Ben sacrificing himself to defeat you?
paras.zh: 你对本牺牲自己打败你有何反应？

paras.en: Well, I was flabbergasted. (Laughs.) I’m very unimpressed. Very disappointed in his choices.
paras.zh: 嗯，我惊呆了。 （笑）我很不以为然。对他的选择非常失望。

paras.en: At the premiere, you told me your character had some good. In the finale, we see him show mercy to one of the men in the opening scene, and later to a dog. Then he saves Madison and Ben’s child. Is that what you meant? What good did you see?
paras.zh: 在首映式上，你告诉我你的角色有一些优点。在结局中，我们看到他在开场场景中对一名男子表现出怜悯，后来又对一只狗表现出怜悯。然后他救了麦迪逊和本的孩子。这就是你的意思吗？你看到了什么好东西？

paras.en: Yeah, that’s it. He decides to call it all off to end the great game; he saves a few people along the way.
paras.zh: 是的，就是这样。他决定取消一切，结束这场伟大的比赛；他一路上救了一些人。

paras.en: Why did he allow the Coven to get so close to defeating him?
paras.zh: 为什么他让女巫会如此接近击败他？

paras.en: Well, Sarah Paulson’s character is his grandchild, so you know, it’s a familial thing.
paras.zh: 嗯，莎拉·保尔森的角色是他的孙子，所以你知道，这是一个家庭的事情。

paras.en: Could you explain the final scene with John Waters’ character? Is that just him back in hell?
paras.zh: 你能解释一下John Waters角色的最后一幕吗？那只是他回到地狱吗？

paras.en: Yes, absolutely. Condemned him to hell, but he got everything he ever wanted. You know, he wanted to. His desire was to make that biker movie. Now he’s stuck making it for eternity, and I think he loves it.
paras.zh: 是的，绝对是。判他下地狱，但他得到了他想要的一切。你知道，他想这么做。他的愿望是制作一部摩托车电影。现在他被困在永恒之中，我认为他喜欢它。

paras.en: In American Horror Story, there are a lot of twists; we see characters come back, and just because they die doesn’t mean they’re necessarily dead. But this ending felt pretty final. What did it feel like for you? Is he ready dead or back in hell?
paras.zh: 在《美国恐怖故事》中，有很多曲折；我们看到角色回来了，仅仅因为他们死了并不意味着他们一定死了。但这个结局感觉已经很确定了。你感觉如何？他准备好死了还是回到地狱了？

paras.en: Stuck in the painting for all eternity. (Laughs.) I think maybe it’s more of a purgatory situation. I mean, he’s stuck in the painting, being overwatched by the Coven. For as long as he’s stuck in there, who’s to say? Maybe season 18 will be the rise of young Mr. Nas again.
paras.zh: 永远沉浸在画中。 （笑）我想这可能更像是炼狱般的情况。我的意思是，他被困在画里，被女巫集会监视着。只要他被困在那里，谁又能说呢？也许第18季将是年轻的纳斯先生再次崛起。

paras.en: Were you told your character’s fate? Do you know a true answer on that?
paras.zh: 你被告知你的角色的命运了吗？你知道这个问题的真实答案吗？

paras.en: Nope. I don’t think anybody knows a true answer on that. It needs to be written.
paras.zh: 没有。我认为没有人知道这个问题的真正答案。需要写下来。

paras.en: Constance obviously made a lot of deals with your character. What do you think ultimately happens to her?
paras.zh: Constance显然与你的角色做了很多交易。你认为她最终会发生什么？

paras.en: You filmed with so much of AHS royalty. What was your favorite or most memorable scene to film this season?
paras.zh: 你和很多美国卫生服务公司的皇室成员一起拍摄过。本季您最喜欢或最难忘的拍摄场景是什么？

paras.en: Tango dancing with Jessica Lange. That was definitely a high point for me.
paras.zh: 与杰西卡·兰格一起跳探戈。这对我来说绝对是一个高峰。

paras.en: What was it like filming some of the death scenes where your character has to kill people?
paras.zh: 拍摄一些你的角色必须杀人的死亡场景感觉如何？

paras.en: It was a lot of fun. I mean, the prosthetic work was incredible. The effects, the blood splattering — especially when my character, young Mr. Nas, has to kill the old version of Mr. Nas — got gory. There was a lot of that black goo; it got everywhere. It was actually a little bit of a mishap and sprayed me down. It wasn’t supposed to, but it was a lot of fun. (Laughs.)
paras.zh: 非常有趣。我的意思是，假肢的工作是令人难以置信的。效果，血液飞溅—特别是当我的角色，年轻的纳斯先生，不得不杀死纳斯先生的旧版本—变得血淋淋。那里有很多黑色的黏液；到处都是。这实际上是一场小小的不幸，把我喷倒了。本不该这样，但很有趣。（笑）

paras.en: This is also your first season in the franchise. Was there anyone in the cast who took you under their wing?
paras.zh: 这也是你加盟球队的第一个赛季。剧组里有没有人庇护过你？

paras.en: I spent a lot of time with Jessica Lange, which is really incredible. She’s amazing. Sarah Paulson and I are friends now. It was a great experience. I got to be around legendary actors, try to glean some things from them and have fun doing it.
paras.zh: 我花了很多时间和Jessica Lange在一起，这真是令人难以置信。她太棒了。Sarah Paulson和我现在是朋友了。这是一次很棒的体验。我得和传奇演员待在一起，试着从他们身上收集一些东西，玩得开心。

paras.en: Yeah. The first couple seasons were really stellar, and then I kind of fell off [watching it], to be honest.
paras.zh: 是的。说实话，前几季真的很出色，然后我就有点崩溃了。

paras.en: Honestly, I really like Freak Show. Freak Show is so fun.
paras.zh: 说实话，我真的很喜欢《怪胎秀》。怪胎秀太好玩了

paras.en: Could you see your character coming back for a future season of AHS?
paras.zh: 您能看到您的角色在未来的AHS赛季中回归吗？

paras.en: Yeah, I could. (Laughs.) Who knows with Ryan Murphy? He’s always bringing things back and new twists and tales. It’s very possible.
paras.zh: 是的，我可以。 （笑）谁知道瑞恩·墨菲呢？他总是带回一些东西，带来新的曲折和故事。这是很有可能的。

paras.en: The 14th season has been renewed. What have you heard about that? Are you hoping to return?
paras.zh: 第14季已续订。你听说过什么？你希望回来吗？

paras.en: If I get the call, then yeah, I would seriously consider it. Yeah, but I have no idea. Who knows what’s in store.
paras.zh: 如果我接到电话，我会认真考虑的。是的，但我不知道。谁知道店里有什么。

paras.en: This is your first time working in the horror genre as well. Is that a genre that you hope to continue in?
paras.zh: 这也是您第一次涉足恐怖类型。这是您希望继续发展的类型吗？

paras.en: I would love to. Yeah, I am a fan of horror.
paras.zh: 我很乐意。是的，我是恐怖片的粉丝。

paras.en: All episodes of FX’s American Horror Story: 13 are now streaming on Hulu. Read all of The Hollywood Reporter’s season coverage here.
paras.zh: FX的《美国恐怖故事： 13》的所有剧集现在都在Hulu上直播。在此处阅读《好莱坞报道》的所有季度报道。

articles.title: Israel faces weeks of coalition haggling as Netanyahu’s party claims election 'stolen'

paras.en: Israel’s final election count left both Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s right-wing bloc and the opposition led by former military chief Gadi Eisenkot short of the 61 seats needed to form a government.
paras.zh: 以色列最终的选举计票结果显示，总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的右翼集团和前军事首长加迪·艾森科特领导的反对派都缺少组建政府所需的 61 个席位。

paras.en: The outcome sets up weeks of coalition bargaining and political uncertainty, with the opposition alliance facing an uphill battle to assemble a majority government in the 120-seat Knesset.
paras.zh: 这一结果引发了数周的联盟谈判和政治不确定性，反对派联盟面临着一场艰苦的战斗，要在拥有 120 个席位的议会中组建多数政府。

paras.en: Netanyahu’s Likud party and its hard-right allies won 53 seats in the Knesset, according to the Central Elections Committee, short of the 61 needed for a majority and down from 64 seats in the 2022 election.
paras.zh: 根据中央选举委员会的数据，内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团及其极右翼盟友在议会赢得了 53 个席位，未达到多数席位所需的 61 个席位，也低于 2022 年选举的 64 个席位。

paras.en: The main opposition bloc, led by Eisenkot, won 48 seats, falling short of the 61 needed for a majority.
paras.zh: 艾森科特领导的主要反对派集团赢得了 48 个席位，未达到多数席位所需的 61 个席位。

paras.en: Eisenkot now faces a difficult coalition path. Most parties in his bloc have rejected relying on the Arab-led parties, while Eisenkot has said neither meets his conditions for a partnership. The Joint List and Ra’am won a combined 19 seats, an all-time high for Arab-led parties.
paras.zh: 艾森科特现在面临着一条艰难的联合之路。他所在集团的大多数政党都拒绝依赖阿拉伯领导的政党，而艾森科特则表示，这两个政党都不符合他的合作条件。联合名单党和拉姆党总共赢得了 19 个席位，这是阿拉伯领导政党的历史新高。

paras.en: Netanyahu's party has intensified claims that the Arab-led parties "stole" the election, amplifying an allegation that spread after exit polls showed the prime minister's bloc had suffered a setback.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡的政党强化了阿拉伯领导的政党“窃取”选举的说法，放大了出口民意调查显示总理集团遭受挫折后广泛传播的指控。

paras.en: Likud asserted Thursday, without evidence, that foreign interference was "aimed at facilitating a foreign takeover of the Knesset, the Islamization of Israel and toppling of the right wing government."
paras.zh: 利库德集团周四在没有证据的情况下声称，外国干涉“旨在促进外国接管以色列议会、以色列伊斯兰化以及推翻右翼政府”。

paras.en: The statement came a day after Supreme Court Justice Noam Sohlberg, who chairs the Central Elections Committee, asked the Shin Bet security agency to investigate "serious suspicions" of improper influence through funding from foreign entities.
paras.zh: 该声明发表前一天，中央选举委员会主席、最高法院法官诺姆·索尔伯格要求辛贝特安全机构对通过外国实体资助进行不当影响的“严重怀疑”进行调查。

paras.en: Sohlberg said he couldn't attest to the substance of the suspicions and directed agencies to verify the claims.
paras.zh: 索尔伯格表示，他无法证明怀疑的实质内容，并指示各机构核实这些说法。

paras.en: Qatar, accused of trying to mobilize Arab voters, has denied interfering in the elections, calling the allegations “ridiculous and dangerous in equal measure.”
paras.zh: 被指控试图动员阿拉伯选民的卡塔尔否认干涉选举，称这些指控“同样荒谬和危险”。

paras.en: Opposition leaders also called for a full investigation, while warning against using the allegations to cast doubt on or otherwise influence the election results.
paras.zh: 反对派领导人还呼吁进行全面调查，同时警告不要利用这些指控来质疑或以其他方式影响选举结果。

paras.en: Although the vote count is complete, the results remain subject to possible “minor corrections” before they are certified and submitted to President Isaac Herzog next Wednesday, according to the Central Elections Committee.
paras.zh: 据中央选举委员会称，尽管计票已经完成，但结果在下周三获得认证并提交给总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格之前，仍可能进行“小幅修正”。

paras.en: The new Knesset is due to be sworn in Nov. 10, while parties have until Nov. 18 to challenge the results.
paras.zh: 新一届议会将于 11 月 10 日宣誓就职，而各党派必须在 11 月 18 日之前对选举结果提出质疑。
