articles.title: Patrick Stewart, renowned actor and ‘Star Trek’s’ Captain Picard, dies at 86
articles.author: Jeff Spry

paras.en: Less than a week after the fates took Walter Koenig from our galaxy, another "Star Trek" legend has left us: Sir Patrick Stewart has died at the age of 86.
paras.zh: 命运将沃尔特·科尼格从我们的银河系带走后不到一周，另一位《星际迷航》传奇人物就离开了我们：帕特里克·斯图尔特爵士去世，享年 86 岁。

paras.en: According to his spokesperson Kelly Bush Novak, the beloved Shakespearean actor passed away on Wednesday (Oct. 28) at his Los Angeles home after a short struggle with Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy body dementia.
paras.zh: 据他的发言人凯莉·布什·诺瓦克称，这位深受喜爱的莎士比亚演员在与阿尔茨海默病和路易体痴呆症进行了短暂的斗争后于周三（10 月 28 日）在洛杉矶的家中去世。

paras.en: "He has been held in the warm embrace of family and friends, surrounded by live music, prayer, tears, laughter and the kind of profound emotion that only he could inspire after a lifetime of devotion to us all," Bush Novak shared. "We will forever cherish the peaceful ease and reflection on his face, an enduring reminder of his invincible grace."
paras.zh: 布什·诺瓦克分享道：“他被家人和朋友温暖的拥抱所包围，周围环绕着现场音乐、祈祷、泪水、笑声，以及只有他在一生为我们所有人奉献之后才能激发的深刻情感。” “我们将永远珍惜他脸上的平静安逸和倒影，这将永远提醒我们他无敌的恩典。”

paras.en: The first time I ever saw Patrick Stewart was in director John Boorman’s masterful 1981 King Arthur film, "Excalibur." As a young teenager, I was immediately captivated by his commanding presence and charisma portraying King Leodegrance of Cameliard — Queen Guinevere’s noble father and a cunning warrior.
paras.zh: 我第一次见到帕特里克·斯图尔特是在导演约翰·保曼 (John Boorman) 1981 年精彩的亚瑟王电影《神剑》(Excalibur) 中。作为一个年轻的青少年，我立即被他所扮演的卡梅利亚国王利奥德格朗斯（王后格尼薇儿的高贵父亲和狡猾的战士）的威严和魅力所吸引。

paras.en: In 1984, he entered the sci-fi realm in David Lynch's grand and ambitious adaptation of Frank Herbert's "Dune," in which he played Paul Atreides' good friend and mentor, War Master Gurney Halleck.
paras.zh: 1984 年，他在大卫·林奇 (David Lynch) 改编自弗兰克·赫伯特 (Frank Herbert) 的宏伟而雄心勃勃的小说《沙丘》(Dune) 中进入科幻领域，在片中他扮演保罗·阿特雷迪斯 (Paul Atreides) 的好朋友兼导师、战争大师格尼·哈莱克 (Gurney Halleck)。

paras.en: Stewart was later cast as the U.S.S. Enterprise’s Capt. Jean-Luc Picard in "Star Trek: The Next Generation. He entranced millions of viewers in this role, traveling the final frontier with his gallant crew and redefining the brave and compassionate traits of a Federation starship commander. His adventurous journey on that popular show, a spinoff of "Star Trek: The Original Series," ran from 1987 to 1994, encompassing 178 episodes across seven seasons confronting Klingons, Cardassians, Romulans and The Borg.
paras.zh: 斯图尔特后来被选为美国总统。 《星际迷航：下一代》中的企业号船长让-卢克·皮卡德 (Jean-Luc Picard) 吸引了数百万观众。他与英勇的船员们一起穿越最后的边疆，重新定义了联邦星舰指挥官的勇敢和富有同情心的特质。他在这部热门剧中的冒险之旅是《星际迷航：原始系列》的衍生剧，从 1987 年持续到 1994 年，共 7 季 178 集，与克林贡人对抗，卡达西人、罗慕兰人和博格人。

paras.en: When the series ended, Stewart continued on in the Enterprise's center seat by starring in four "Star Trek" feature films: 1994’s "Star Trek: Generations," 1996’s "Star Trek: First Contact," 1998’s "Star Trek: Insurrection," and 2002’s "Star Trek: Nemesis." Stewart also reprised the role of Jean-Luc Picard in three seasons of Paramount+’s "Star Trek: Picard," which ran from 2020 to 2023.
paras.zh: 系列结束后，斯图尔特继续在企业号的中心位置上主演了四部《星际迷航》故事片：1994 年的《星际迷航：世代》、1996 年的《星际迷航：第一次接触》、1998 年的《星际迷航：叛乱》和 2002 年的《星际迷航：复仇女神》。斯图尔特还在派拉蒙+的《星际迷航：皮卡德》三季（2020 年至 2023 年播出）中再次扮演让-吕克·皮卡德这一角色。

paras.en: Stewart's prodigious talent was on further display in the hit adaptations of Marvel’s "The X-Men." He played the powerful, wheelchair-bound telepath Professor Charles Xavier in 2000’s "X-Men," 2003’s "X2: X-Men United," 2006’s "X-Men: The Last Stand," 2014’s "X-Men: Days of Future Past," and 2017’s "Logan."
paras.zh: 斯图尔特的惊人才华在漫威电影《X战警》的热门改编作品中得到了进一步展示。他在2000年的《X战警》、2003年的《X战警：X战警联队》、2006年的《X战警：背水一战》、2014年的《X战警：逆转未来》和2017年的《洛根》中饰演强大的、坐在轮椅上的心灵感应教授查尔斯·泽维尔。

paras.en: Stewart, and Xavier, were prominently featured in those films. The actor and character also appeared in 2009’s "X-Men Origins: Wolverine" and 2013’s "The Wolverine," and will do so again in "Avengers: Doomsday," which will be released around Christmastime this year.
paras.zh: 斯图尔特和泽维尔在这些电影中扮演了重要角色。这位演员和角色还出现在 2009 年的《X 战警前传：金刚狼》和 2013 年的《金刚狼》中，并将在今年圣诞节前后上映的《复仇者联盟：世界末日》中再次出现。

paras.en: Aside from the two "Star Trek" and "The X-Men" franchise roles, Stewart had a flourishing career that spanned radio, stage and screen and was always a stellar attraction at any comic-con or other fan event around the world. Another of his many memorable projects was the compelling one-man stage show in which he played all the characters in Charles Dickens' novella "A Christmas Carol," captured on a two-disc CD set that I listen to each holiday season.
paras.zh: 除了在《星际迷航》和《X战警》系列中扮演两个角色之外，斯图尔特的职业生涯也蒸蒸日上，横跨广播、舞台和银幕，在世界各地的任何动漫展或其他粉丝活动中始终是一个引人注目的明星。他的另一个令人难忘的项目是引人入胜的单人舞台表演，他在其中扮演了查尔斯·狄更斯的中篇小说《圣诞颂歌》中的所有角色，我在每个假期都会听一张两张光盘的 CD，收录了该作品。

paras.en: Knighted by Queen Elizabeth II in 2010, Sir Patrick Stewart leaves behind a remarkable legacy that brought a rare gravitas and humanity to every performance he was ever involved in, and his passing leaves fans, friends and loved ones with heavy hearts. Here’s to a wonderful life well-lived!
paras.zh: 帕特里克·斯图尔特爵士于 2010 年被英国女王伊丽莎白二世封为爵士，留下了一份非凡的遗产，为他参与的每场表演带来了罕见的庄严和人性，他的去世让粉丝、朋友和亲人心情沉重。 Here’s to a wonderful life well-lived!

paras.en: Jeff Spry is an award-winning screenwriter and veteran freelance journalist covering TV, movies, video games, books, and comics. His work has appeared at SYFY Wire, Inverse, Collider, Bleeding Cool and elsewhere. Jeff lives in beautiful Bend, Oregon amid the ponderosa pines, classic muscle cars, a crypt of collector horror comics, and two loyal English Setters.
paras.zh: 杰夫·斯普里 (Jeff Spry) 是一位屡获殊荣的编剧和资深自由记者，报道电视、电影、视频游戏、书籍和漫画。他的作品曾出现在 SYFY Wire、Inverse、Collider、Bleeding Cool 等网站上。 Jeff lives in beautiful Bend, Oregon amid the ponderosa pines, classic muscle cars, a crypt of collector horror comics, and two loyal English Setters.

articles.title: Global Satcom Services Revenues to Reach $145 Billion by 2035
articles.author: Novaspace

paras.en: Paris, France | October 2026 – Global satellite services revenues are forecast to grow 44% to reach $145 billion by 2035, according to the 33rd edition of Novaspace’s Satellite Connectivity and Video Market report. The next decade will mark a fundamental shift in the industry as data services become the dominant growth engine, driving revenues to nearly $100 billion by 2035.
paras.zh: 法国巴黎 | 2026 年 10 月——根据 Novaspace 第 33 版卫星连接和视频市场报告，全球卫星服务收入预计将增长 44%，到 2035 年达到 1,450 亿美元。随着数据服务成为主要的增长引擎，到 2035 年收入将接近 1000 亿美元，未来十年将标志着该行业的根本性转变。

paras.en: Data services are expected to increase their share of total satellite services revenues from 26% to 68% over the decade, as demand for connectivity accelerates across consumer, defense, government, and enterprise markets.
paras.zh: 随着消费者、国防、政府和企业市场对连接的需求加速增长，数据服务在卫星服务总收入中的份额预计将在十年内从 26% 增加到 68%。

paras.en: While video remains the industry’s largest revenue segment today, future growth will be driven by connectivity. Consumer Broadband, Milsatcom, and Enterprise Networks are forecast to lead market expansion, adding $22.6 billion, $19.2 billion, and $17.2 billion in revenues, respectively, over the next decade.
paras.zh: 虽然视频仍然是当今行业最大的收入领域，但未来的增长将由连接性推动。消费者宽带、军事卫星通信和企业网络预计将引领市场扩张，在未来十年内分别增加 226 亿美元、192 亿美元和 172 亿美元的收入。

paras.en: Milsatcom is emerging as a particularly important growth engine, fueled by rising defense spending and broader adoption of satcom-enabled operational concepts across military forces. At the same time, NGSO constellations are becoming an increasingly important source of resilient capacity for government and defense users.
paras.zh: 在国防支出不断增加以及军队更广泛采用卫星通信作战概念的推动下，军事卫星通信正在成为一个特别重要的增长引擎。与此同时，NGSO 星座正成为政府和国防用户日益重要的弹性能力来源。

paras.en: “Satellite connectivity is moving firmly into the mainstream,” said Dimitri Buchs, Project Manager and Editor of the report. “The rapid expansion of NGSO capacity, declining bandwidth costs, and growing demand for resilient, always-available connectivity are fundamentally changing where and how satellite communications compete.”
paras.zh: “卫星连接正在坚定地成为主流，”项目经理兼报告编辑 Dimitri Buchs 说。 “NGSO 容量的快速扩张、带宽成本的下降以及对弹性、始终可用连接的需求不断增长，正在从根本上改变卫星通信的竞争地点和方式。”

paras.en: The satellite capacity market is forecast to exceed $46 billion by 2035, more than tripling from 2025 levels. Video Distribution, the largest capacity segment in 2025, is expected to account for just 3% of capacity revenues by 2035. Consumer Broadband and Milsatcom, meanwhile, are projected to represent more than half of total capacity revenues.
paras.zh: 预计到 2035 年，卫星容量市场将超过 460 亿美元，比 2025 年的水平增加两倍多。视频分发是 2025 年最大的容量部分，预计到 2035 年将仅占容量收入的 3%。与此同时，消费者宽带和军事卫星通信预计将占总容量收入的一半以上。

paras.en: Declining bandwidth costs, driven by HTS systems and a growing number of NGSO projects, are accelerating satellite connectivity’s expansion into mass-market applications. Providers such as Starlink are increasingly competing with terrestrial broadband on price, strengthening satellite broadband’s position as a viable alternative to fiber and wireless connectivity in a growing range of markets.
paras.zh: 在 HTS 系统和越来越多的 NGSO 项目的推动下，带宽成本不断下降，正在加速卫星连接向大众市场应用的扩展。 Starlink 等提供商在价格上与地面宽带的竞争日益激烈，从而巩固了卫星宽带在越来越多的市场中作为光纤和无线连接的可行替代方案的地位。

paras.en: The transformation is also reshaping the role of GEO operators. Following a low of six commercial GEO orders in 2024, the market rebounded to 10 orders in 2025, with another 14 recorded by mid-September 2026. The renewed activity reflects evolving multi-orbit strategies and continued demand for GEO capabilities alongside rapidly expanding NGSO systems.
paras.zh: 这一转变也正在重塑 GEO 运营商的角色。继 2024 年 6 个商业 GEO 订单的低点之后，市场在 2025 年反弹至 10 个订单，到 2026 年 9 月中旬又记录了 14 个订单。新的活动反映了不断发展的多轨道战略以及对 GEO 能力的持续需求以及快速扩展的 NGSO 系统。

paras.en: “This is not a return to the traditional GEO model,” Buchs added. “Software-defined satellites, more flexible commercial models, sovereign requirements, and growing multi-orbit strategies are redefining GEO’s role. The future of satellite communications will not be GEO or NGSO—it will increasingly be an ecosystem in which each architecture serves distinct and complementary requirements.”
paras.zh: “这并不是对传统 GEO 模式的回归，”布克斯补充道。 “软件定义的卫星、更灵活的商业模式、主权要求和不断增长的多轨道战略正在重新定义 GEO 的角色。卫星通信的未来将不再是 GEO 或 NGSO，而是越来越成为一个生态系统，其中每种架构都满足不同且互补的需求。”

paras.en: The 33rd edition of Satellite Connectivity and Video Market provides a comprehensive assessment of global satellite service revenues, capacity demand, pricing trends, competitive dynamics, and operator strategies across video, broadband, enterprise, mobility, government, and defense markets through 2035.
paras.zh: 第 33 版《卫星连接和视频市场》对 2035 年之前的视频、宽带、企业、移动、政府和国防市场的全球卫星服务收入、容量需求、定价趋势、竞争动态以及运营商战略进行了全面评估。

paras.en: This edition introduces a granular bottom-up model for Enterprise Networks Back-up terminals, providing greater visibility into market demand and deployment trends. It also features a revised commercial Milsatcom model with deeper analysis by region, frequency band, and infrastructure type.
paras.zh: 该版本引入了企业网络备份终端的细粒度自下而上模型，提供了对市场需求和部署趋势的更深入的了解。它还具有修订后的商业军事卫星通信模型，可按地区、频段和基础设施类型进行更深入的分析。

paras.en: The report also provides an updated assessment of major developments shaping the satellite communications market, including the evolution of NGSO constellations, emerging Q/V frequency bands and other regulatory developments, government and defense spending trends, and the changing competitive dynamics between satellite and terrestrial connectivity.
paras.zh: 该报告还对塑造卫星通信市场的主要发展进行了最新评估，包括NGSO星座的演变、新兴的Q/V频段和其他监管发展、政府和国防支出趋势，以及卫星和地面连接之间不断变化的竞争动态。

paras.en: Novaspace is the leading independent consulting and market intelligence firm dedicated to the global space sector. Leveraging over 40 years of industry expertise, the company supports public and private stakeholders across the entire space value chain with high-impact, data-driven advisory services, combining management and technology consulting, market intelligence, and executive summits to help organizations navigate complexity, manage risk, and capture growth opportunities.
paras.zh: Novaspace 是致力于全球航天领域的领先独立咨询和市场情报公司。该公司利用 40 多年的行业专业知识，通过高影响力、数据驱动的咨询服务，结合管理和技术咨询、市场情报和高管峰会，为整个空间价值链的公共和私人利益相关者提供支持，帮助组织应对复杂性、管理风险并抓住增长机会。

paras.en: Trusted by more than 1,200 clients in over 60 countries, Novaspace operates globally with offices in Bangalore, Brussels, London, Montreal, Munich, Paris, São Paulo, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo, Toulouse, and Washington, D.C.
paras.zh: Novaspace 深受 60 多个国家 1,200 多名客户的信赖，在全球范围内开展业务，在班加罗尔、布鲁塞尔、伦敦、蒙特利尔、慕尼黑、巴黎、圣保罗、新加坡、悉尼、东京、图卢兹和华盛顿特区设有办事处。

articles.title: Nov. 5: Satellite Mission Management at the Edge
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: Satellite operations are growing more complex. For national security missions, that means faster decisionmaking, greater resilience and the ability to adapt on orbit is needed. Today’s operators must modernize mission management, integrate new technologies and deliver capabilities without compromising security, reliability or operational control.
paras.zh: 卫星操作变得越来越复杂。对于国家安全任务来说，这意味着需要更快的决策、更强的弹性和在轨道上的适应能力。当今的运营商必须在不影响安全性、可靠性或运营控制的情况下实现任务管理现代化、集成新技术并提供功能。

paras.en: Join SpaceNews and RTX on Nov. 5 for a virtual event exploring how emerging technologies and commercial capabilities are transforming satellite operations and enabling more dynamic, resilient and affordable national security space missions.
paras.zh: 11 月 5 日与 SpaceNews 和 RTX 一起参加虚拟活动，探讨新兴技术和商业能力如何改变卫星运营，并实现更具活力、更有弹性和负担得起的国家安全太空任务。

paras.en: Speakers will discuss advances in mission management, edge computing, automation and cloud-native architectures, as well as the challenges of integrating new capabilities with legacy systems. The conversation will examine how modular approaches can accelerate technology upgrades, strengthen mission assurance and improve affordability.
paras.zh: 演讲者将讨论任务管理、边缘计算、自动化和云原生架构方面的进步，以及将新功能与遗留系统集成的挑战。对话将探讨模块化方法如何加速技术升级、加强任务保证并提高可承受性。

paras.zh: - Dave Huber，RTX 太空 ISR 副总裁

paras.zh: - Brandon Miller，亚马逊网络服务全球防务合作伙伴临时总监

paras.zh: - Dave Gauthier，GXO, Inc. 首席战略官

paras.zh: - 由 SpaceNews 首席内容和战略官 Mike Gruss 主持

paras.zh: 边缘卫星任务管理

paras.en: This virtual event will take place via Zoom. You will receive a unique link to join with your registration confirmation. A recording will be posted here shortly after the event concludes.
paras.zh: 该虚拟活动将通过 Zoom 进行。您将收到一个独特的加入链接以及您的注册确认信息。活动结束后不久将在此处发布录音。

paras.en: With more than 180,000 global employees, we push the limits of technology and science to redefine how we connect and protect our world. With industry-leading capabilities, we advance aviation, engineer integrated defense systems for operational success, and develop next-generation technology solutions and manufacturing to help global customers address their most critical challenges. The company, with 2025 sales of more than $88 billion, is headquartered in Arlington, Virginia.
paras.zh: 我们在全球拥有超过 180,000 名员工，不断突破技术和科学的极限，重新定义我们连接和保护世界的方式。凭借行业领先的能力，我们推动航空业发展，设计综合防御系统以实现运营成功，并开发下一代技术解决方案和制造，以帮助全球客户应对最关键的挑战。该公司总部位于弗吉尼亚州阿灵顿，到 2025 年销售额将超过 880 亿美元。

articles.title: Ukrainian startup, GomSpace test satellite for future communications network
articles.author: Sandra Erwin

paras.en: WASHINGTON — A Ukrainian defense technology company and a Danish satellite manufacturer have begun operating an experimental communications satellite in orbit.
paras.zh: 华盛顿——一家乌克兰国防技术公司和一家丹麦卫星制造商已经开始在轨道上运行一颗实验通信卫星。

paras.en: Ukrainian startup Himera and Denmark’s GomSpace said Oct. 27 that their Obria Nano satellite, launched Oct. 1 aboard the SpaceX Transporter-18 rideshare mission, is undergoing tests. The companies plan to design a constellation that would provide communications coverage across Ukraine.
paras.zh: 乌克兰初创公司 Himera 和丹麦 GomSpace 于 10 月 27 日表示，他们的 Obria Nano 卫星于 10 月 1 日搭载 SpaceX Transporter-18 拼车任务发射，目前正在进行测试。两家公司计划设计一个星座，为整个乌克兰提供通信覆盖。

paras.en: The project is one of at least two European-backed initiatives aimed at giving Ukraine greater control over satellite communications, following disruptions this month to SpaceX’s Starlink and Starshield services that affected Ukrainian military operations.
paras.zh: 该项目是至少两项欧洲支持的举措之一，旨在让乌克兰更好地控制卫星通信，本月 SpaceX 的 Starlink 和 Starshield 服务中断，影响了乌克兰的军事行动。

paras.en: The announcement comes five days after Finnish satellite manufacturer Iceye and telecommunications equipment maker Nokia signed a letter of intent with Ukraine’s Defense Ministry to explore developing a sovereign broadband satellite communications network.
paras.zh: 五天前，芬兰卫星制造商 Iceye 和电信设备制造商诺基亚与乌克兰国防部签署了一份意向书，探讨开发主权宽带卫星通信网络。

paras.en: Ukraine has relied heavily on SpaceX’s satellite services for battlefield communications since Russia’s invasion in 2022. The services have become essential to military command networks, drone operations and communications in areas where terrestrial infrastructure has been destroyed or disrupted.
paras.zh: 自俄罗斯 2022 年入侵乌克兰以来，乌克兰一直严重依赖 SpaceX 的卫星服务进行战场通信。这些服务对于地面基础设施遭到破坏或中断的地区的军事指挥网络、无人机操作和通信至关重要。

paras.en: But restrictions imposed in mid-October limited satellite connectivity, interfering with Ukrainian drone operations, including efforts to intercept Russian attack drones.
paras.zh: 但十月中旬实施的限制限制了卫星连接，干扰了乌克兰无人机的行动，包括拦截俄罗斯攻击无人机的努力。

paras.en: Ukraine said Oct. 24 that Starlink and Starshield services had returned to normal operating speeds. The disruptions prompted a dispute over responsibility, with SpaceX chief executive Elon Musk and U.S. officials offering conflicting explanations about who had authorized the limits.
paras.zh: 乌克兰10月24日表示，星链和星盾服务已恢复正常运行速度。这些干扰引发了责任纠纷，SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克和美国官员对于谁授权了这些限制给出了相互矛盾的解释。

paras.en: Himera and GomSpace said the Obria Nano project is intended to establish a communications system under Ukrainian control, with plans eventually to manufacture satellites and ground terminals domestically.
paras.zh: Himera 和 GomSpace 表示，Obria Nano 项目旨在建立乌克兰控制下的通信系统，并计划最终在国内制造卫星和地面终端。

paras.en: “For us, this project is about more than launching a satellite. It is an opportunity to lay the foundation for an independent communications network for Ukraine,” said Misha Rudominski, Himera’s co-founder and chief executive.
paras.zh: Himera 联合创始人兼首席执行官 Misha Rudominski 表示：“对我们来说，这个项目不仅仅是发射一颗卫星。这是一个为乌克兰独立通信网络奠定基础的机会。”

paras.en: “We are starting by testing technologies in orbit, while our long-term goal is to develop capabilities that will strengthen the country’s strategic security and reduce dependence on external communications providers,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们首先在轨道上测试技术，而我们的长期目标是发展加强国家战略安全并减少对外部通信提供商的依赖的能力。”

paras.en: Himera, founded in 2022, develops secure tactical radio systems for military forces, including equipment designed to operate in environments affected by electronic warfare.
paras.zh: Himera 成立于 2022 年，为军队开发安全战术无线电系统，包括设计用于在受电子战影响的环境中运行的设备。

paras.en: GomSpace, headquartered in Aalborg, Denmark, manufactures small satellites, communications payloads and spacecraft subsystems.
paras.zh: GomSpace 总部位于丹麦奥尔堡，生产小型卫星、通信有效载荷和航天器子系统。

paras.en: The companies said Obria Nano is operating in orbit and undergoing testing that will inform the design of a constellation. They did not disclose the satellite’s specifications, communications capacity, project financing or the number of satellites envisioned for the network.
paras.zh: 两家公司表示，Obria Nano 正在轨道上运行并正在进行测试，这将为星座的设计提供信息。他们没有透露卫星的规格、通信能力、项目融资或网络中设想的卫星数量。

paras.en: Neither European initiative is expected to replace Starlink’s extensive global network. Smaller national constellations could provide dedicated communications for selected military operations while supplementing commercial services.
paras.zh: 预计这两项欧洲举措都不会取代星链广泛的全球网络。较小的国家星座可以为选定的军事行动提供专用通信，同时补充商业服务。

articles.title: World News in Brief: 5 children killed in Sudan, Haiti hunger emergency, Yemen war update

paras.en: World News in Brief: 5 children killed in Sudan, Haiti hunger emergency, Yemen war update
paras.zh: 世界新闻简讯：苏丹 5 名儿童丧生、海地饥饿紧急情况、也门战争最新动态

paras.en: At least five children were killed and two others injured in a drone attack on a market in Nyala, in Sudan’s South Darfur state, on Monday, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) said on Thursday.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会（儿童基金会）周四表示，周一，苏丹南达尔富尔州尼亚拉的一个市场遭遇无人机袭击，造成至少 5 名儿童死亡，另外两人受伤。

paras.en: The victims were three boys and two girls aged between seven and 14, according to Etleva Kadilli, UNICEF Regional Director for Eastern and Southern Africa.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会东部和南部非洲区域主任埃特勒瓦·卡迪利 (Etleva Kadilli) 表示，遇难者是三名男孩和两名女孩，年龄在 7 岁到 14 岁之间。

paras.en: The attack came a week after armed drone strikes reportedly killed at least 80 people, including women and children, in a busy market in Abyei.
paras.zh: 据报道，武装无人机袭击了阿卜耶伊一个繁忙的市场，造成至少 80 人死亡，其中包括妇女和儿童。

paras.en: “Markets are places where families buy food and people work to make a living. A trip to the market should never cost a child their life,” Ms. Kadilli said.
paras.zh: “市场是家庭购买食物和人们工作谋生的地方。去市场绝不应该让孩子失去生命，”卡迪利女士说。

paras.en: More than 400 children were reported killed or injured in Sudan between January and September this year. Armed drone attacks caused a significant share of these casualties, UNICEF said. Drone strikes have also damaged homes, schools, health facilities, water systems and markets.
paras.zh: 据报道，今年 1 月至 9 月期间，苏丹有 400 多名儿童死亡或受伤。联合国儿童基金会表示，这些伤亡中很大一部分是由武装无人机袭击造成的。无人机袭击还损坏了房屋、学校、医疗设施、供水系统和市场。

paras.en: “For children in Sudan, even the most ordinary parts of daily life are becoming increasingly dangerous,” Ms. Kadilli said.
paras.zh: “对于苏丹的儿童来说，即使是日常生活中最普通的部分也变得越来越危险，”卡迪利女士说。

paras.en: “After more than three years of conflict, children in Sudan need greater protection from violence, not new ways for the conflict to reach them. The killing and injuring of children must end.”
paras.zh: “经过三年多的冲突，苏丹的儿童需要更多的保护，免受暴力侵害，而不是让冲突以新的方式影响他们。必须停止对儿童的杀戮和伤害。”

paras.en: Haiti: Emergency food kits help families facing growing hunger
paras.zh: 海地：紧急食品包帮助面临日益严重饥饿的家庭

paras.en: More than 5.9 million people in Haiti face high levels of acute food insecurity, amid a deepening hunger crisis driven by violent insecurity and this year’s strong El Niño.
paras.zh: 由于暴力不安全和今年强烈的厄尔尼诺现象导致饥饿危机不断加深，海地有超过 590 万人面临严重的严重粮食不安全。

paras.en: That’s the warning from the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), which cited the latest assessments indicating that the island nation has one of the highest levels of hunger in the world today, affecting more than one in two people.
paras.zh: 这是联合国粮食及农业组织（FAO）发出的警告，该组织引用的最新评估表明，这个岛国是当今世界上饥饿程度最高的国家之一，影响了超过二分之一的人。

paras.en: “The issues around violence are impacting people’s access to markets, access to their land, access to agricultural inputs,” said Rein Paulsen, Director of FAO’s Office of Emergencies and Resilience.
paras.zh: “暴力问题正在影响人们进入市场、获得土地和农业投入品，”粮农组织紧急情况和复原力办公室主任雷因·保尔森说。

paras.en: “And then in addition to this, of course we have a very, very strong El Niño phenomenon, which is impacting many parts of the world. It’s impacting the Caribbean, and for Haiti this means much drier conditions than normal and higher temperatures.”
paras.zh: “除此之外，当然我们还有非常非常强烈的厄尔尼诺现象，它正在影响世界许多地区。它正在影响加勒比地区，对于海地来说，这意味着比正常情况更加干燥和更高的气温。”

paras.en: El Niño is expected to contribute to crop losses and delayed planting, pushing acute food insecurity in Haiti to even more critical levels next year.
paras.zh: 厄尔尼诺现象预计将导致农作物损失和播种推迟，从而将海地明年严重的粮食不安全推向更加严重的水平。

paras.en: At the same time, inflation running at approximately 17 per cent is eroding purchasing power and reducing households’ access to sufficient and diversified food.
paras.zh: 与此同时，约 17% 的通货膨胀正在削弱购买力，并减少家庭获得充足和多样化食品的机会。

paras.en: To help, FAO offers emergency assistance kits that include seeds, poultry and ducks, as well as goats and other animals. These help farmers start producing milk and eggs to sell at market immediately and give them access to food to sustain their families.
paras.zh: 为了提供帮助，粮农组织提供了紧急援助包，其中包括种子、家禽、鸭子、山羊和其他动物。这些帮助农民开始生产牛奶和鸡蛋并立即在市场上出售，并让他们获得食物来维持家庭。

paras.en: Separately, the World Food Programme (WFP) warned on Thursday that acute hunger is on track to reach record levels, with some 6.35 million people projected to face acute food insecurity between March and June next year.
paras.zh: 另外，世界粮食计划署（WFP）周四警告称，严重饥饿有望达到创纪录水平，预计明年 3 月至 6 月期间约有 635 万人将面临严重粮食不安全。

paras.en: WFP has supported 2.6 million people so far in 2026 and needs $78 million to sustain operations through March.
paras.zh: 2026 年迄今为止，粮食计划署已为 260 万人提供了支持，需要 7800 万美元来维持整个 3 月份的运作。

paras.en: The Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan for Haiti remains less than half funded.
paras.zh: 海地人道主义需求和应对计划的资金仍不足一半。

paras.en: Yemen: Vital medical supplies reach Taiz City, access challenges remain
paras.zh: 也门：重要医疗用品抵达塔伊兹市，但获取挑战仍然存在

paras.en: The UN World Health Organization (WHO) has delivered trauma and emergency surgery kits to hospitals facing acute shortages in Taiz City, which remains almost entirely surrounded by Houthi forces.
paras.zh: 联合国世界卫生组织（世卫组织）已向塔伊兹市面临严重短缺的医院提供了创伤和紧急手术包，该市几乎完全被胡塞武装包围。

paras.en: The lifesaving shipment reached the city at the weekend and has been shared among several facilities, according to a WHO update on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 据世界卫生组织周三发布的最新消息，这批救生物资已于周末抵达该市，并已在多个设施之间共享。

paras.en: The agency noted that movement restrictions in Taiz City have forced community midwives to stop working. Access to Taiz province from Government-controlled Aden and from the west coast also remains restricted.
paras.zh: 该机构指出，塔伊兹市的行动限制迫使社区助产士停止工作。从政府控制的亚丁和西海岸进入塔伊兹省也仍然受到限制。

paras.en: WHO highlighted acute shortages of medicines, fuel and water in Taiz.
paras.zh: 世卫组织强调塔伊兹的药品、燃料和水严重短缺。

paras.en: It also warned of an increased risk of disease outbreaks: waste management has been disrupted, and the city’s dumps are too dangerous to reach because of the ongoing conflict.
paras.zh: 它还警告疾病爆发的风险增加：废物管理受到干扰，由于持续的冲突，城市的垃圾场太危险而无法到达。

paras.en: Further north, in Marib governorate, primary healthcare is on the “verge of collapse” because of funding cuts.
paras.zh: 再往北，在马里卜省，由于资金削减，初级医疗保健正处于“崩溃的边缘”。

paras.en: Only six out of 31 mobile medical teams are still operational and 15 health facilities have stopped functioning altogether.
paras.zh: 31个流动医疗队中只有6个仍在运作，15个医疗机构已完全停止运作。

articles.title: AI is changing the way we think. The question is whether we’ll notice in time

paras.en: AI is changing the way we think. The question is whether we’ll notice in time
paras.zh: 人工智能正在改变我们的思维方式。问题是我们是否会及时注意到

paras.en: Artificial intelligence promises to make life easier. With a few keystrokes, it can write emails, summarize reports, generate ideas and answer complex questions in seconds. For many people, it feels like a technological leap on par with the arrival of the internet itself.
paras.zh: 人工智能有望让生活变得更轻松。只需按几下按键，它就可以在几秒钟内编写电子邮件、总结报告、产生想法并回答复杂的问题。对于许多人来说，这感觉就像是与互联网本身的到来同等的技术飞跃。

paras.en: But according to neuroscientist David Rock, the bigger question is not what AI is doing for us. It is what it might be doing to us.
paras.zh: 但根据神经科学家大卫·洛克的说法，更大的问题不是人工智能为我们做了什么。这就是它可能对我们做的事情。

paras.en: “In some ways, technology isn't changing us at all,” Mr. Rock told us.
paras.zh: “在某些方面，技术根本没有改变我们，”洛克先生告诉我们。

paras.en: Human brains still make decisions, solve problems and respond to challenges much as they have for thousands of years. Yet history shows that major events and long-term pressures can leave lasting marks on the brain, shaping behaviour for years or even generations.
paras.zh: 人类大脑仍然像几千年来一样做出决定、解决问题和应对挑战。然而历史表明，重大事件和长期压力可能会在大脑中留下持久的印记，影响数年甚至几代人的行为。

paras.en: Today’s technological revolution may be one of those moments.
paras.zh: 今天的技术革命可能就是其中之一。

paras.en: The difference, Mr. Rock argues, is that technology increasingly gives us a sense of control over almost everything. Need a ride? Press a button. Want dinner delivered? Press another. Looking for information? It is available instantly.
paras.zh: 洛克先生认为，不同之处在于，技术越来越让我们有一种对几乎所有事物的控制感。需要搭车吗？按一个按钮。晚餐要送吗？按另一个。寻找信息？它立即可用。

paras.en: That growing sense of autonomy can be liberating. But it also creates a subtle trap, especially as AI systems become capable of performing tasks that once required significant mental effort.
paras.zh: 日益增强的自主感可以带来解放。但它也造成了一个微妙的陷阱，特别是当人工智能系统变得能够执行曾经需要大量脑力劳动的任务时。

paras.en: The real concern is not that AI is becoming more powerful. It is that people are becoming too willing to hand over their thinking.
paras.zh: 真正令人担忧的并不是人工智能变得越来越强大。而是人们变得太愿意交出他们的思想。

paras.en: Mr. Rock recently described the current moment as a transition from “AI FOMO” to an “AI hangover”. Organizations rushed to adopt generative AI tools, often before fully understanding their long-term effects. Now the consequences are becoming clearer.
paras.zh: Rock 先生最近将当前时刻描述为从“AI FOMO”到“AI 宿醉”的转变。组织往往在充分了解其长期影响之前就急于采用生成式人工智能工具。现在后果越来越明显。

paras.en: A small minority of workers, perhaps five to 10 per cent, are using AI as intended: offloading routine tasks and freeing up mental capacity for more demanding work. Most, however, are doing the opposite.
paras.zh: 一小部分工人（也许是 5% 到 10%）正在按预期使用人工智能：减轻日常任务并释放脑力来完成更艰巨的工作。然而，大多数人却在做相反的事情。

paras.en: Change has never been this fast, but it will never be this slow again – Dr. David Rock
paras.zh: 变化从未如此之快，但也不会再如此缓慢——大卫·洛克博士

paras.en: “The brain loves conserving energy,” he said. “It’s very tantalizing to save your brain from thinking at all.”
paras.zh: “大脑喜欢保存能量，”他说。 “让你的大脑完全不思考是非常诱人的。”

paras.en: The result, he warns, is a gradual erosion of judgment. When people outsource not only routine work but also analysis, evaluation and decision-making, they risk losing the ability to distinguish good ideas from bad ones.
paras.zh: 他警告说，其结果是判断力逐渐受到侵蚀。当人们不仅外包日常工作，还外包分析、评估和决策时，他们就有可能失去区分好想法和坏想法的能力。

paras.en: AI may provide answers quickly, but speed is not the same as wisdom.
paras.zh: 人工智能可能会很快给出答案，但速度不等于智慧。

paras.en: “Keep your brain in the game,” he said. “When your brain’s not in the game, you very quickly lose those skills.”
paras.zh: “把你的大脑放在游戏中，”他说。 “当你的大脑不在游戏中时，你很快就会失去这些技能。”

paras.en: The rise of AI comes at a time when many people are already struggling to focus.
paras.zh: 人工智能的兴起正值许多人已经难以集中注意力的时候。

paras.en: According to Mr. Rock, the greatest challenge facing workers today is not a lack of information but an overwhelming excess of it.
paras.zh: 洛克先生认为，当今工人面临的最大挑战不是信息缺乏，而是信息过多。

paras.en: He compares the current moment to the arrival of email, which dramatically increased the amount of information people had to process. Today, however, the scale is far greater. Workers are bombarded by messages, updates, notifications and AI-generated summaries, often far beyond what the human brain can realistically manage.
paras.zh: 他将当前时刻与电子邮件的到来进行了比较，电子邮件极大地增加了人们必须处理的信息量。然而今天，规模要大得多。工作人员受到消息、更新、通知和人工智能生成的摘要的轰炸，通常远远超出了人脑的实际管理能力。

paras.en: “Our brains actually have real limits,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们的大脑实际上有真正的局限性，”他说。

paras.en: Computers can process thousands of decisions in moments. Humans cannot. Yet many organizations continue to operate as though people have unlimited capacity for attention and decision-making.
paras.zh: 计算机可以瞬间处理数千个决策。人类不能。然而，许多组织继续运作，就好像人们的注意力和决策能力是无限的。

paras.en: Mr. Rock believes society is still in a “settling-in period” with AI, much like the early days of automobiles before traffic laws and speed limits existed. The technology has arrived faster than the social norms and guardrails needed to use it responsibly.
paras.zh: 洛克先生认为，社会仍处于人工智能的“适应期”，就像交通法规和速度限制出现之前的汽车早期一样。该技术的到来速度快于负责任地使用该技术所需的社会规范和护栏。

paras.en: The technology that wants to be your friend
paras.zh: 科技想成为你的朋友

paras.en: Unlike previous technological breakthroughs, AI may be transforming something even more fundamental than work.
paras.zh: 与之前的技术突破不同，人工智能可能正在改变比工作更根本的东西。

paras.en: While televisions, books and smartphones competed for our attention, AI increasingly competes for our relationships. More and more people are turning to chatbots not merely for information but for conversation, companionship and advice.
paras.zh: 当电视、书籍和智能手机争夺我们的注意力时，人工智能越来越多地争夺我们的人际关系。越来越多的人转向聊天机器人，不仅仅是为了获取信息，还为了对话、陪伴和建议。

paras.en: Research, he noted, suggests that people who spend significant time interacting with AI companions may feel more lonely rather than less. Other studies point to links between heavy reliance on chatbots and increased disconnection from real-world social interactions.
paras.zh: 他指出，研究表明，花大量时间与人工智能同伴互动的人可能会感到更孤独，而不是更少。其他研究指出了对聊天机器人的严重依赖与与现实世界社交互动的日益脱节之间的联系。

paras.en: The human brain evolved around relationships with other people. Replacing too much of that interaction with machines may come at a psychological cost that society is only beginning to understand.
paras.zh: 人类大脑是围绕与他人的关系而进化的。过多地取代与机器的互动可能会带来心理成本，而社会才刚刚开始理解这一点。

paras.en: As AI becomes more sophisticated, and as robotics, faster computing and next-generation internet technologies converge, those questions are likely to become even more pressing.
paras.zh: 随着人工智能变得更加复杂，随着机器人技术、更快的计算和下一代互联网技术的融合，这些问题可能会变得更加紧迫。

paras.en: Why human connection may become more valuable
paras.zh: 为什么人际关系可能变得更有价值

paras.en: Paradoxically, the more capable machines become, the more valuable human relationships could become.
paras.zh: 矛盾的是，机器的能力越强，人际关系就越有价值。

paras.en: Mr. Rock believes the future will place a premium on trust, authenticity and genuine human connection. In a world where machines can generate content, analyse data and imitate conversation, what remains uniquely human may become more precious.
paras.zh: 洛克先生相信，未来将更加重视信任、真实性和真正的人际关系。在一个机器可以生成内容、分析数据和模仿对话的世界里，人类独有的东西可能会变得更加珍贵。

paras.en: “The human experience is going to be that much more high value,” he said.
paras.zh: “人类体验的价值将会更高，”他说。

paras.en: Rather than replacing people, AI may ultimately increase the importance of human networks, deeper relationships and meaningful collaboration.
paras.zh: 人工智能最终可能会提高人类网络、更深层次的关系和有意义的协作的重要性，而不是取代人类。

paras.en: That future is not guaranteed. But it is one possible response to a world of accelerating technological change.
paras.zh: 那个未来是没有保障的。但这是对技术变革加速的世界的一种可能的回应。

paras.en: And acceleration is exactly what Mr. Rock expects.
paras.zh: 而加速正是洛克先生所期望的。

paras.en: “Change has never been this fast,” he said, “but it will never be this slow again.”
paras.zh: “变化从来没有这么快过，”他说，“但也不会再这么慢了。”

paras.en: Mr. Rock's answer comes down to a single concept: metacognition, or thinking about thinking.
paras.zh: 洛克先生的答案归结为一个概念：元认知，或关于思考的思考。

paras.en: Instead of allowing AI to take over, he argues that people should remain firmly in control, using these systems to challenge and expand their perspectives rather than replace them.
paras.zh: 他认为，人们不应该让人工智能接管，而是应该保持牢牢的控制权，利用这些系统来挑战和扩展他们的观点，而不是取代他们。

paras.en: AI can help people consider viewpoints they might otherwise overlook, test assumptions and explore alternative interpretations. But the responsibility for judgment must remain human.
paras.zh: 人工智能可以帮助人们考虑他们可能会忽视的观点、测试假设并探索替代解释。但判断的责任必须由人来承担。

paras.en: He calls this approach “human in the lead”.
paras.zh: 他将这种方法称为“以人为本”。

paras.en: The technology, he says, works best when it deepens thinking rather than substitutes for it.
paras.zh: 他说，当技术深化思考而不是替代思考时，它的效果最好。

paras.en: As AI becomes woven into everyday life, that distinction could prove critical. The machines may become smarter and faster, but the challenge for humanity will be ensuring that our own minds remain engaged.
paras.zh: 随着人工智能融入日常生活，这种区别可能变得至关重要。机器可能会变得更智能、更快，但人类面临的挑战将是确保我们自己的思维保持活跃。

paras.en: Because the future may depend not on how intelligent AI becomes, but on whether we continue exercising the intelligence we already have.
paras.zh: 因为未来可能不取决于人工智能变得多么智能，而是取决于我们是否继续运用我们已经拥有的智能。

paras.en: Dr. David Rock, who coined the term “neuroleadership”, is the co-founder and CEO of the NeuroLeadership Institute, a global consultancy that applies neuroscience to leadership and organizational performance. Author of several books, including the bestseller Your Brain at Work and his latest, Your Story Has a Villain, he is one of the keynote speakers at UN Skills Fest 2026, themed People at the Centre.
paras.zh: David Rock 博士创造了“神经领导力”一词，是 NeuroLeadership Institute 的联合创始人兼首席执行官，该研究所是一家将神经科学应用于领导力和组织绩效的全球咨询公司。他是多本书的作者，包括畅销书《你的大脑在工作》和他的最新著作《你的故事有一个恶棍》，他是 2026 年联合国技能节的主讲人之一，主题为“人民在中心”。

articles.title: Myanmar’s illicit economy fuels escalating violence, with civilians bearing the brunt

paras.en: Myanmar’s illicit economy fuels escalating violence, with civilians bearing the brunt
paras.zh: 缅甸非法经济助长暴力升级，平民首当其冲

paras.en: Myanmar has been engulfed in civil war since the military overthrew the democratically elected Government in February 2021, triggering widespread armed resistance across the country.
paras.zh: 自2021年2月军方推翻民选政府以来，缅甸一直陷入内战，引发全国广泛的武装抵抗。

paras.en: Special Rapporteur Kelley Anne Eckels-Currie’s new report found that at least 8,384 civilians have been killed by the military since the coup, up until 15 September 2026.
paras.zh: 特别报告员凯利·安妮·埃克尔斯-居里的新报告发现，自政变以来，截至 2026 年 9 月 15 日，至少有 8,384 名平民被军方杀害。

paras.en: Special Rapporteurs are independent experts appointed by the UN Human Rights Council who serve in their individual capacity and receive no salary for their work.
paras.zh: 特别报告员是由联合国人权理事会任命的独立专家，以个人身份任职，不领取工资。

paras.en: Despite the regime launching a so-called “100-day peace plan” between 20 April and 31 July 2026, the situation in the country has only deteriorated, the independent expert found.
paras.zh: 独立专家发现，尽管该政权在2026年4月20日至7月31日期间启动了所谓的“百日和平计划”，但该国的局势只会恶化。

paras.en: The military continues to use weapons of war – including airstrikes and artillery – to target and destroy civilian infrastructure, including schools, healthcare facilities, religious buildings, markets and displacement camps.
paras.zh: 军方继续使用战争武器（包括空袭和大炮）来瞄准和摧毁民用基础设施，包括学校、医疗设施、宗教建筑、市场和流离失所者营地。

paras.en: “These are not accidents…This is intentional infliction of harm on civilian populations for the purpose of terrorising them and trying to force them into submission,” Ms Eckels-Currie told journalists.
paras.zh: “这些不是意外……这是为了恐吓平民并试图迫使他们屈服而故意对平民造成伤害，”埃克尔斯-柯里女士告诉记者。

paras.en: Around 753 civilians were killed during the 100 day period, with the Myanmar military and paramilitary forces responsible for 89 per cent of civilian deaths.
paras.zh: 在这 100 天内，大约有 753 名平民被杀，其中 89% 的平民死亡是缅甸军队和准军事部队造成的。

paras.en: The military’s strategy is rooted in the “Four Cuts” doctrine, the Special Rapporteur noted: sever food, resources, humanitarian access, and support networks from any area resisting the regime.
paras.zh: 特别报告员指出，军方的战略植根于“四切断”学说：切断任何抵抗政权地区的粮食、资源、人道主义准入和支持网络。

paras.en: She found that the military deliberately obstructs humanitarian operations through telecommunications blackouts, movement restrictions and checkpoints, preventing the critical delivery of food, medicine, fuel and other essential supplies to displaced communities.
paras.zh: 她发现，军方通过电信中断、行动限制和检查站故意阻碍人道主义行动，阻止向流离失所社区运送关键的食品、药品、燃料和其他必需品。

paras.en: Aid workers also face harassment, arbitrary detention, torture and killings. In July 2026, three humanitarian workers were reportedly tortured and killed in the southeastern city of Dawei.
paras.zh: 援助人员还面临骚扰、任意拘留、酷刑和杀害。据报道，2026 年 7 月，三名人道主义工作者在东南部城市土瓦遭到酷刑并被杀害。

paras.en: The Special Rapporteur also warned that Myanmar’s growing illicit economy has become a major driver of the conflict, rather than simply a consequence of it.
paras.zh: 特别报告员还警告说，缅甸不断增长的非法经济已成为冲突的主要驱动因素，而不仅仅是冲突的结果。

paras.en: As the formal economy shrinks under the weight of war and economic mismanagement, criminal activity – including online scam centres, illegal mining, human trafficking and forced labour – are increasingly filling the gap.
paras.zh: 随着正规经济在战争和经济管理不善的重压下萎缩，犯罪活动 — — 包括在线诈骗中心、非法采矿、人口贩运和强迫劳动 — — 越来越多地填补了这一空白。

paras.en: Black market profits are helping to finance the military’s weapons purchases, including from China and Russia, and sustain loyalty within the junta’s ranks, Ms. Eckels-Currie explained.
paras.zh: 埃克尔斯-柯里女士解释说，黑市利润有助于资助军方购买武器（包括从中国和俄罗斯购买武器），并维持军政府内部的忠诚度。

paras.en: Chinese transnational criminal networks provide the “backbone” of most of the criminal enterprises in Myanmar, using cryptocurrency platforms like Tether and social media like TikTok, Meta and X to facilitate their operations, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，中国跨国犯罪网络是缅甸大多数犯罪企业的“支柱”，利用 Tether 等加密货币平台和 TikTok、Meta 和 X 等社交媒体来促进其运作。

paras.en: Corruption in neighbouring countries, meanwhile, is enabling this cross-border trafficking, she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说，与此同时，邻国的腐败也助长了这种跨境贩运。

paras.en: The Special Rapporteur also highlighted the difficulty of disrupting these networks without harming civilians. For instance, efforts to cut off Starlink internet access to scam centres have also left humanitarian organisations and local communities without vital connectivity.
paras.zh: 特别报告员还强调了在不伤害平民的情况下破坏这些网络的难度。例如，切断星链网络对诈骗中心的互联网访问的努力也导致人道主义组织和当地社区失去了重要的连接。

paras.zh: 兰多·诺里斯赢得了去年的墨西哥城大奖赛，但迈凯伦在上个月的状态有所下滑，红牛和法拉利被证明是梅赛德斯最大的挑战者。

paras.zh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘曾五次在罗德里格斯赛道上夺冠，创下了纪录，但所有人的目光都集中在安东内利以及他能否以时尚的方式赢得冠军。

paras.en: Mexico City track layout - Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez
paras.zh: 墨西哥城赛道布局 - Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez

paras.en: The Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez is 2,200m above sea level, so the air is thin and the power units get seriously tested at altitude.
paras.zh: 罗德里格斯赛车场海拔 2,200m，空气稀薄，动力装置在高海拔地区受到严格考验。

paras.en: The thin air also creates less downforce, so the teams are forced to run Monaco levels of downforce to have strong corner performance, which is particularly important in the high-speed middle sector and the slow final sector which sees the cars go through an old baseball stadium.
paras.zh: 稀薄的空气也会产生较少的下压力，因此车队被迫运行摩纳哥级别的下压力，以获得强大的弯道性能，这在高速的中间部分和缓慢的最后部分尤其重要，因为赛车会穿过一个旧棒球场。

paras.en: Overtaking is very much possible with long straights down to Turn 1 and Turn 4 where we have seen drivers get their elbows out, including Verstappen against Norris in 2024.
paras.zh: 在直达第 1 号弯和第 4 号弯的长直道上，超车的可能性很大，我们已经看到车手们竭尽全力，包括 2024 年维斯塔潘对阵诺里斯的比赛。

paras.zh: 墨西哥城罗德里格斯赛道的天气

paras.en: Similarly to Austin, it is set to be another dry and hot weekend with no rain on the forecast in Mexico City and temperatures reaching 27C for qualifying and the race.

articles.title: 'I'm built differently' - Hamilton defiant over extending F1 career into 2030s

paras.en: Lewis Hamilton: Ferrari driver says he 'is built differently' amid defiance over extending his F1 career into 2030s
paras.zh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿：法拉利车手表示，在将他的 F1 职业生涯延长到 2030 年代的抗议中，他“身材不同”

paras.en: Lewis Hamilton insists the idea of him continuing his F1 career into the 2030 is realistic; the 41-year-old wants to compete in F1's first race in Rwanda; watch every session of the Mexico City GP with Friday's practice sessions at 6.30pm and 10pm, live on Sky Sports F1
paras.zh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿坚称，他将 F1 职业生涯延续到 2030 年的想法是现实的；这位 41 岁的车手希望参加在卢旺达举办的首场 F1 比赛；观看墨西哥城大奖赛的每一场比赛，以及周五下午 6.30 和晚上 10 点的练习赛，天空体育 F1 直播

paras.en: Lewis Hamilton insisted he "is built differently" as he continued to rule out extending his Formula 1 career into the 2030s.
paras.zh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿 (Lewis Hamilton) 坚称自己“生来与众不同”，并继续排​​除将自己的一级方程式职业生涯延长至 2030 年代的可能性。

paras.en: Following the announcement earlier in October that Africa will return to the F1 calendar at some point in the 2030s with a race in Rwanda, Hamilton had said he hoped he would be able to compete in the first grand prix on the continent since 1993.
paras.zh: 十月初宣布非洲将在 2030 年代的某个时候重返 F1 赛程并在卢旺达举行比赛后，汉密尔顿曾表示，他希望能够参加自 1993 年以来首次在非洲大陆举行的大奖赛。

paras.en: Given Hamilton turns 42 in January and will be 45 at the start of the 2030 F1 season, at which point it is far from certain the circuit in Rwanda will be ready, it was initially unclear how seriously his comments should be taken.
paras.zh: 鉴于汉密尔顿将于 1 月年满 42 岁，到 2030 年 F1 赛季开始时将年满 45 岁，届时卢旺达赛道是否准备就绪还远未确定，因此最初并不清楚他的评论应该得到多么认真的对待。

paras.en: But quizzed on the topic on Thursday ahead of this weekend's Mexico City Grand Prix, the seven-time world champion said: "I mean, firstly, you've never had anyone like me here in the 70 years [of the sport's history], so I feel that I'm built differently.
paras.zh: 但在本周末墨西哥城大奖赛之前的周四，这位七届世界冠军在被问及这个话题时表示：“我的意思是，首先，在[这项运动的历史]70年里，这里从来没有像我这样的人，所以我觉得我的体质不同。

paras.en: "Of course, there are challenges up ahead that I can't foresee that come with age. But along this way, along this journey, there have been so many preconceived ideas about the fact that your reaction time drops off.
paras.zh: “当然，随着年龄的增长，前方会出现我无法预见的挑战。但一路走来，一路走来，有很多先入为主的想法，认为你的反应时间会下降。

paras.en: "Did you see my reaction in the last race? My reaction is faster than some of the youngest people here. There are lots of tools that you can utilise to continue to keep yourself, your mind sharp.
paras.zh: “你看到我在上一场比赛中的反应了吗？我的反应比这里最年轻的一些人更快。你可以利用很多工具来继续保持自己的头脑敏锐。

paras.en: "I guess as long as you're willing to sacrifice everything, which I am right now, I can't say in four years whether I want to continue to do what I'm doing. But I love what I'm doing still now. I'm still all in, and I will be for the foreseeable future."
paras.zh: “我想只要你愿意牺牲一切，就像我现在一样，我不能说四年后我是否想继续做我正在做的事情。但我喜欢我现在仍在做的事情。我仍然全力以赴，在可预见的未来我也会如此。”

paras.en: Hamilton's current contract with Ferrari is understood to run until the end of the 2027 season, with the Brit holding an option to extend for a further year should he wish to do so.
paras.zh: 据了解，汉密尔顿目前与法拉利的合同将持续到 2027 赛季结束，如果他愿意的话，英国人可以选择延长一年。

paras.en: After a blockbuster move from Mercedes to Ferrari for the 2025 season, Hamilton's performances during his first year in red raised doubts, at times from the driver himself himself, over whether his skills were declining, but he has bounced back with a much-improved 2026 campaign, which included a memorable victory in Barcelona.
paras.zh: 在 2025 赛季从梅赛德斯转会到法拉利后，汉密尔顿在红衣第一年的表现引起了人们的怀疑，有时甚至来自车手本人，怀疑他的技术是否在下降，但他在 2026 年的赛季中取得了很大的进步，其中包括在巴塞罗那取得了令人难忘的胜利。

paras.en: Hamilton continued: "Whether or not I can compete at 44 with a 20-year-old, who knows? But at 41, I can compete with a 20-year-old. So, time will tell whether I'm here in the 2030s, we'll see.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿继续说道：“我是否能在44岁时与20岁的人竞争，谁知道呢？但在41岁时，我可以与20岁的人竞争。所以，时间会告诉我我是否会在2030年代在这里，我们拭目以待。”

paras.en: "But I never want to overstay my welcome in the sense of still not having the performance. I don't want to be driving around with that really dropped off.
paras.zh: “但我不想在没有表演的情况下停留太久，我不想在这种情况下开车四处走动。

paras.en: "My reaction has dropped off, my driving has dropped off, and my pace has dropped off, which everyone assumed last year. But I've proved everyone wrong with that, and I'll continue to try to do so."
paras.zh: “我的反应能力下降了，我的驾驶能力下降了，我的步伐也下降了，这是去年每个人都认为的。但我已经证明每个人都错了，我将继续努力这样做。”

paras.en: Hamilton's focus on Constructors', not Drivers' Championship
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿专注于车队冠军，而不是车手冠军

paras.en: While Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli is set to seal the Drivers' Championship this weekend with four races to spare, Hamilton is part of an extremely tight four-way battle for second place in the standings.
paras.zh: 虽然梅赛德斯车队的基米·安东内利将在本周末以四场比赛的方式锁定车手冠军，但汉密尔顿正在参加一场极其激烈的四路争夺积分榜第二名的战斗。

paras.en: Antonelli's team-mate George Russell is in second, a point ahead of Hamilton, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen five points further back and the other Ferrari of Charles Leclerc three more points adrift.
paras.zh: 安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔位居第二，领先汉密尔顿一分，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘落后五分，而另一辆法拉利车队的查尔斯·勒克莱尔则落后三分。

paras.en: Hamilton insists his focus is on ensuring Ferrari seal second in the Constructors' Championship, in which they hold a 119-point over Red Bull and McLaren, with Mercedes 133 points clear out front.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿坚称他的重点是确保法拉利在车队锦标赛中获得第二名，他们在积分榜上领先红牛和迈凯轮 119 分，而梅赛德斯以 133 分遥遥领先。

paras.en: "I'm not going to say it [second in the Drivers' Championship] doesn't mean anything, but it's not something I focus on," Hamilton said. "Winning the championship is the only thing any of us really care about.
paras.zh: “我不会说它（车手锦标赛第二名）没有任何意义，但这不是我关注的事情，”汉密尔顿说。 “赢得冠军是我们每个人唯一真正关心的事情。

paras.en: "Maybe some people do care about the other positions, but for me, my sole focus is on making sure that we secure second in the Constructors' Championship because the team deserve it.
paras.zh: “也许有些人确实关心其他位置，但对我来说，我唯一的关注点是确保我们在车队锦标赛中获得第二名，因为这是球队应得的。

paras.en: "It's a huge boost from last year and it really is something we can build on for next year.
paras.zh: “与去年相比，这是一个巨大的推动，这确实是我们明年可以继续努力的目标。

paras.en: "In terms of finishing second, third, fourth, you want to finish first."
paras.zh: “就获得第二、第三、第四名而言，你想获得第一。”

paras.en: Hamilton is hopeful Ferrari can deliver a strong weekend in Mexico, where many believe the turbo element of their engine, which is smaller than their rivals', could be an advantage at high altitude.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿希望法拉利能够在墨西哥度过一个强劲的周末，许多人相信他们的发动机的涡轮元件比他们的竞争对手小，可能在高海拔地区具有优势。

paras.en: Asked about Ferrari's chances, Hamilton said: "Someone just said that it should be good for our car, and I really have no idea.
paras.zh: 当被问及法拉利的机会时，汉密尔顿说：“有人只是说这对我们的赛车应该有好处，我真的不知道。

paras.en: "I mean, everyone's going to be maximum downforce here. It would be an unusual experience for us all, because it's like 25 or 30 per cent less downforce than we had the last time we drove here.
paras.zh: “我的意思是，每个人都会在这里获得最大的下压力。这对我们所有人来说都是一次不寻常的经历，因为这比我们上次在这里开车时的下压力减少了 25% 或 30%。

paras.en: "So, whether we can get the tyres switched on... the car should be good here.
paras.zh: “所以，我们是否可以打开轮胎……赛车在这里应该表现良好。

paras.en: "And being that we have high altitude, hopefully straight-line speed won't be as affected as it is in some of the other places where at sea level the drag is significant.
paras.zh: “由于我们海拔较高，希望直线速度不会像其他一些在海平面阻力很大的地方那样受到影响。

paras.en: "So, I'm hoping that we are able to continue on from the strong performance we had last year and bring it into this weekend."
paras.zh: “所以，我希望我们能够继续去年的强劲表现，并将其带入本周末。”

articles.title: 'Paul could beat AJ with right preparation'

paras.en: Jake Paul capable of beating Anthony Joshua with right preparation, according to MVP co-founder Nakisa Bidarian
paras.zh: MVP 联合创始人纳基萨·比达里安表示，杰克·保罗有能力在适当的准备下击败安东尼·约书亚

paras.en: MVP co-founder Nakisa Bidarian claims Jake Paul could beat Anthony Joshua were the pair to fight again; Paul announced this week he will return to the ring in Dubai on December 24 for the first time since fighting Joshua
paras.zh: MVP 联合创始人纳基萨·比达里安 (Nakisa Bidarian) 声称，如果两人再次交手，杰克·保罗 (Jake Paul) 可以击败安东尼·约书亚 (Anthony Joshua)；保罗本周宣布，他将于 12 月 24 日重返迪拜擂台，这是自与约书亚交锋以来的首次

paras.en: Jake Paul could beat Anthony Joshua were he to prepare with a real training camp second time around, believes MVP co-founder Nakisa Bidarian.
paras.zh: MVP 联合创始人纳基萨·比达里安 (Nakisa Bidarian) 认为，如果杰克·保罗第二次准备真正的训练营，他可以击败安东尼·约书亚。

paras.en: Paul made the most daunting step-up of his crossover career last December when he faced former two-time heavyweight world champion Joshua, who broke the jaw of his opponent in a sixth-round stoppage victory.
paras.zh: 去年12月，保罗在他的跨界职业生涯中取得了最令人畏惧的进步，当时他面对前两届重量级世界冠军约书亚，约书亚在第六回合的补时胜利中打碎了对手的下巴。

paras.en: Paul was required to have some teeth removed and had two titanium plates put in his mouth such was the damage caused by Joshua.
paras.zh: 保罗被要求拔掉一些牙齿，并在他的嘴里放入两块钛板，这就是约书亚造成的伤害。

paras.en: Joshua later overcame two first-round knockdowns to beat Albanian heavyweight Kristian Prenga, and is now gearing up to face Tyson Fury in a long-awaited all-British showdown at Cardiff's Principality Stadium on December 11.
paras.zh: 约书亚后来在首轮两次击倒对手，击败了阿尔巴尼亚重量级拳手克里斯蒂安·普伦加，现在他正准备于 12 月 11 日在卡迪夫公国体育场举行期待已久的全英对决，迎战泰森·富里。

paras.en: "I was pretty vocal that I didn't want him to do the fight on three weeks' notice," said MVP chief executive Bidarian of Paul's fight with Joshua.
paras.zh: MVP首席执行官比达里安在谈到保罗与约书亚的比赛时表示：“我直言不讳地表示，我不希望他在提前三周通知的情况下参加比赛。”

paras.en: "He did better than the guy Anthony Joshua fought in July [Prenga] and was not KO'd.
paras.zh: “他比安东尼·约书亚在七月（普伦加）对阵的那个人表现得更好，而且没有被KO。

paras.en: "I don't think it was a massive overshoot, Jake landed quite a few times on AJ and you saw in July AJ is vulnerable but it was too fast, not enough prep time.
paras.zh: “我不认为这是一个巨大的超调，Jake 在 AJ 上着陆了很多次，你在 7 月份看到 AJ 很脆弱，但速度太快了，没有足够的准备时间。

paras.en: "He was cutting weight to fight Gervonta Davis and then suddenly fighting a guy who was 40lbs naturally heavier than him.
paras.zh: “他当时正在减肥以对抗格文塔·戴维斯，然后突然与一个自然重于他 40 磅的人打斗。

paras.en: "If Jake had to do that with the right training camp he'd have a really good shot at beating AJ."
paras.zh: “如果杰克必须在正确的训练营中做到这一点，他就有很大机会击败 AJ。”

paras.en: Paul announced this week he will return to the ring against an unnamed opponent in Dubai on Christmas Eve, his first scheduled bout since facing Joshua.
paras.zh: 保罗本周宣布，他将在平安夜重返擂台，在迪拜对阵一位未透露姓名的对手，这是他自对阵约书亚以来的第一场预定比赛。

paras.en: Darren Till is among the possible opponents as Paul looks to bolster a resume already including Mike Tyson, Julio César Chávez Jr, Nate Diaz and Joshua.
paras.zh: 达伦·蒂尔是可能的对手之一，因为保罗希望充实自己的简历，其中包括迈克·泰森、小胡利奥·塞萨尔·查韦斯、内特·迪亚兹和约书亚。

paras.en: "One of the things Jake said last week was, 'I'm a bigger dog than I've ever been because none of those punches actually hurt, sure he broke my jaw and I fell down but if you saw my face I said woah, that was a zinger, that felt good'.
paras.zh: “杰克上周说的其中一件事是，‘我是一只比以往任何时候都更大的狗，因为这些拳头实际上都没有受伤，当然他打断了我的下巴，我摔倒了，但如果你看到我的脸，我会说哇，那是一个有趣的感觉，感觉很好’。

paras.en: "Tell me who else breaks their jaw in two places, stands in the ring and does and interview for 10 minutes talking about the fight. That's who the warrior Jake Paul is."
paras.zh: “告诉我还有谁的下巴有两处骨折，但他仍然站在拳台上接受 10 分钟的采访，谈论这场比赛。这就是勇士杰克·保罗。”

paras.en: Bidarian explained that the shortlist of potential fights for Paul is now at three or four names, with a view to announcing the opponent in the next fortnight.
paras.zh: 比达里安解释说，保罗可能参加的比赛的候选名单现在有三到四个名字，以期在接下来的两周内宣布对手。

paras.en: "We are down to three or four names, just trying to see ultimately who we get across the finish line," he told Sky Sports News.
paras.zh: 他告诉天空体育新闻：“我们只剩下三四个名字，只是想看看最终谁能冲过终点线。”

paras.en: "Darren [Till] is definitely somebody we've had on the list. There are two or three names that are still under consideration.
paras.zh: “达伦（蒂尔）绝对是我们名单上的人。还有两三个名字仍在考虑中。

paras.en: "It's going to be exciting, and, as every Jake Paul fight is, an even match-up. Every step Jake has taken based on experience or level has been evenly matched and he's come through, other than the fight against Anthony Joshua, he has come through with flying colours.
paras.zh: “这将是令人兴奋的，而且，正如杰克·保罗的每一场比赛一样，都是一场势均力敌的对决。杰克根据经验或水平采取的每一步都是势均力敌的，他已经成功了，除了与安东尼·约书亚的战斗之外，他都取得了出色的成绩。

paras.en: "Thirteen months ago, he pressed me on fighting Anthony Joshua within a three-week window, he pressed me he could beat him.
paras.zh: “十三个月前，他向我施压，要求我在三周内与安东尼·约书亚对决，他向我施压，他可以击败他。

paras.en: "He was knocked down, TKO'd, broken jaw in two places and now he's back after a year off so just trying to manage the right opponent who has commercial viability, who is a true test but who doesn't have a massive advantage versus Jake Paul.
paras.zh: “他被击倒了，TKO，下巴两处骨折，现在他在休息一年后回来了，所以只是想管理一个有商业可行性的正确对手，他是一个真正的考验，但与杰克·保罗相比并没有巨大的优势。

paras.en: "I'm hoping whether it's next week or week after we'll announce who that opponent is."
paras.zh: “我希望无论是下周还是下周我们都会宣布对手是谁。”

articles.title: Israel’s final election results show neither Netanyahu nor rival can immediately form government
articles.author: Chantal Da Silva

paras.en: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s right-wing bloc won 53 seats in Israel’s 120-member Knesset, or parliament, results released by election officials on Thursday showed, well below the 68 it had controlled at its peak in the previous parliament.
paras.zh: 选举官员周四公布的结果显示，总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡的右翼集团在由 120 名议员组成的以色列议会中赢得了 53 个席位，远低于其在上届议会高峰时期控制的 68 个席位。

paras.en: The bloc supporting Netanyahu’s main rival, Gadi Eisenkot, won 48 seats in an extremely tight election race, meaning neither secured the 61 seats needed to form a government.
paras.zh: 支持内塔尼亚胡主要竞争对手加迪·艾森科特的集团在一场极其激烈的选举中赢得了 48 个席位，这意味着双方都没有获得组建政府所需的 61 个席位。

paras.en: The count is complete, but the results still need to be certified and submitted to President Isaac Herzog next Wednesday.
paras.zh: 计票工作已完成，但结果仍需认证并于下周三提交给总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格。

paras.en: Herzog will then consult with party chairs and choose a candidate who he thinks has the best chance to form a government.
paras.zh: 赫尔佐格随后将与各党主席协商，并选择他认为最有机会组建政府的候选人。

paras.en: Parties led by Israel’s Arab minority made historic gains, winning a combined 19 seats in a race in which Palestinians with Israeli citizenship headed to the polls in record numbers Tuesday, many hoping to oust Netanyahu and far-right members of his coalition, including Bezalel Smotrich, his finance minister, and National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir.
paras.zh: 以色列阿拉伯少数民族领导的政党取得了历史性的进展，在一场竞选中总共赢得了 19 个席位，周二，拥有以色列公民身份的巴勒斯坦人参加投票的人数创历史新高，许多人希望推翻内塔尼亚胡及其联盟中的极右翼成员，包括他的财政部长贝扎莱尔·斯莫特里奇和国家安全部长伊塔马尔·本·格维尔。

paras.en: Both leading blocs have ruled out the possibility of forming a government with the two main Arab parties, Ra’am and the Joint List. But their rise as potential kingmakers has brought the complex realities faced by Palestinian Israeli nationals into fresh focus.
paras.zh: 两个主要集团都排除了与两个主要阿拉伯政党拉姆党和联合名单党组建政府的可能性。但他们作为潜在王者的崛起使巴勒斯坦以色列国民面临的复杂现实成为新的焦点。

paras.en: Ahead of the election, Netanyahu and other members of his coalition amplified allegations of foreign election interference, referring Arab parties to the domestic security service, the Shin Bet, for investigation over allegations of Qatari intervention.
paras.zh: 选举前，内塔尼亚胡和他的联盟的其他成员放大了对外国干预选举的指控，将阿拉伯政党提交给国内安全部门辛贝特，以调查卡塔尔干预的指控。

paras.en: Qatar denied the allegations. Mansour Abbas, the head of Ra’am, said his party had “no connection” to such conduct and urged a full investigation. He also accused Netanyahu of a “campaign of incitement and delegitimization” against Arab citizens.
paras.zh: 卡塔尔否认了这些指控。拉姆党主席曼苏尔·阿巴斯表示，他的党派与此类行为“无关”，并敦促进行全面调查。他还指责内塔尼亚胡对阿拉伯公民进行“煽动和非法化运动”。

paras.en: Dean Livne, the acting director general of Israel’s Central Elections Committee, said in a published letter sent to a member of parliament that there was “no basis for allegations of systematic violations of electoral integrity.”
paras.zh: 以色列中央选举委员会代理总干事迪安·利夫尼在致一名议会议员的公开信中表示，“关于系统性违反选举诚信的指控没有依据”。

paras.en: Before the election, both Netanyahu and Eisenkot ruled out forming a government with the Arab parties.
paras.zh: 选举前，内塔尼亚胡和艾森科特都排除了与阿拉伯政党组建政府的可能性。

paras.en: But Yair Golan, the head of the smaller left-wing Democrats party, called for a government formed “in partnership” with Arab parties. “We must no longer accept Netanyahu’s racist division between Jewish votes and Arab votes,” he said Wednesday on X.
paras.zh: 但规模较小的左翼民主党党魁亚伊尔·戈兰呼吁与阿拉伯政党“合作”组建政府。 “我们不能再接受内塔尼亚胡对犹太人选票和阿拉伯选票的种族主义划分，”他周三在 X 上表示。

paras.en: The majority of Palestinians with Israeli citizenship are the descendants of those who remained within what became Israel during the war that led to the country’s founding in 1948. At the time, hundreds of thousands more fled or were expelled from their homes.
paras.zh: 大多数拥有以色列公民身份的巴勒斯坦人都是 1948 年以色列建国战争期间留在以色列境内的人的后裔。当时，还有数十万人逃离家园或被驱逐出家园。

articles.title: Patrick Stewart and Ian McKellen: A friendship that surpassed the stage and screen
articles.author: Marlene Lenthang

paras.en: To many, Patrick Stewart and Ian McKellen represent a formidable mutant rivalry in the “X-Men” films or two of theater’s pre-eminent Shakespearean actors, but behind the curtain the pair shared something even more enduring: a friendship that spanned decades.
paras.zh: 对许多人来说，帕特里克·斯图尔特和伊恩·麦凯伦代表了《X战警》电影中强大的变种人竞争，或者是两位戏剧界杰出的莎士比亚演员，但在幕后，两人分享了更持久的东西：跨越数十年的友谊。

paras.en: Stewart died Wednesday at age 86 following a diagnosis of Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy body dementia. McKellen, Stewart’s artistic brother-in-arms, remembered him Thursday as “the most respected and beloved actor of his generation on either side of the Atlantic.”
paras.zh: 斯图尔特于周三去世，享年 86 岁，他被诊断出患有阿尔茨海默病和路易体痴呆症。斯图尔特的艺术战友麦克莱恩周四回忆他为“大西洋两岸这一代人中最受尊敬和喜爱的演员”。

paras.en: “He wore his heart on his sleeve, which made him a man to rely on, to admire and in my case, love,” McKellen said in a statement on social media.
paras.zh: 麦凯伦在社交媒体上的一份声明中说：“他把自己的心表露在外，这使他成为一个值得信赖、值得钦佩的人，对我来说，也是一个值得爱的人。”

paras.en: The pair — about a year apart in age — met at England’s esteemed Royal Shakespeare Company, with Stewart joining in 1966 and McKellen in 1974.
paras.zh: 两人年龄相差约一岁，在英国著名的皇家莎士比亚剧团相识，斯图尔特于 1966 年加入，麦凯伦于 1974 年加入。

paras.en: “We first met as ambitious young actors with the Royal Shakespeare Company half a century ago but we weren’t in the same productions,” McKellen, 87, said Thursday.
paras.zh: “半个世纪前，我们作为雄心勃勃的年轻演员第一次在皇家莎士比亚剧团见面，但我们不在同一部作品中，”87 岁的麦凯伦周四说道。

paras.en: They starred in Tom Stoppard’s play “Every Good Boy Deserves Favour” in 1977 in collaboration with the Royal Shakespeare Company but weren’t close at the time.
paras.zh: 1977 年，他们与皇家莎士比亚剧团合作主演了汤姆·斯托帕德 (Tom Stoppard) 的戏剧《每个好男孩都值得青睐》(Every Good Boy Deserves Favour)，但当时关系并不密切。

paras.en: “I had admired him from the start of his career,” Stewart told The Guardian in 2019. “When he joined the RSC, I was frankly intimidated.”
paras.zh: 斯图尔特在 2019 年告诉《卫报》：“我从他职业生涯一开始就很钦佩他。”“坦白说，当他加入英国皇家化学会时，我感到害怕。”

paras.en: Still, Stewart later sought McKellen’s advice about taking on “Star Trek: The Next Generation” in a role that he later billed as life-changing. McKellen advised him against it.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，斯图尔特后来就出演《星际迷航：下一代》征求了麦凯伦的建议，他后来称这个角色改变了他的生活。麦凯伦建议他不要这样做。

paras.en: “My first strong memory was a few years later, meeting him in the street in central London when he told me about an offer to take over a leading part in ‘Star Trek,’” McKellen said in the statement.
paras.zh: “我第一个强烈的记忆是几年后，在伦敦市中心的街上见到他，当时他告诉我要接任《星际迷航》的主角，”麦凯伦在声明中说。

paras.en: “‘But Patrick think of your stage career in the UK. Do you really want to risk — getting lost in Hollywood for years and years?’” he recalled.
paras.zh: “但是帕特里克想到了你在英国的舞台生涯。你真的想冒险——在好莱坞迷失多年吗？”他回忆道。

paras.en: In a 2014 SAG-AFTRA Foundation conversation with the two actors, Stewart joked, “The only person who advised me not to do it is sitting to my left,” to the laughter of the crowd. “That ... changed my life. Every single corner of it has not been unaffected by that,” he added.
paras.zh: 2014 年，在 SAG-AFTRA 基金会与两位演员的对话中，斯图尔特开玩笑说，“唯一建议我不要这样做的人就是坐在我左边的人”，引起了观众的笑声。 “那......改变了我的生活。它的每一个角落都没有受到影响，”他补充道。

paras.en: McKellen said in his tribute that he was grateful Stewart took the role, nonetheless.
paras.zh: 麦克莱恩在悼念中表示，尽管如此，他还是很感激斯图尔特担任这个角色。

paras.en: “Well, he took the risk and thank goodness for us all that he did for not just his devoted Trekkies but film and theatre audiences, who marvelled at his using international celebrity to star in a string of cinema successes (‘X-Men’ of course) and in great classical plays by Shakespeare, Ibsen, Arthur Miller, Peter Shaffer, Pinter and Beckett at Stratford-upon-Avon, in London’s West End and on Broadway,” McKellen said.
paras.zh: “好吧，他为我们所有人承担了风险，谢天谢地，他不仅为他忠实的星际迷航者，也为电影和戏剧观众所做的，他们惊叹于他利用国际名人主演了一系列成功的电影（当然是《X战警》），以及在埃文河畔斯特拉特福、伦敦西区和百老汇演出的莎士比亚、易卜生、阿瑟·米勒、彼得·谢弗、品特和贝克特的伟大古典戏剧。”说。

paras.en: “X-Men” left a mark on both of their Hollywood careers.
paras.zh: 《X战警》在他们的好莱坞职业生涯中留下了印记。

paras.en: It started with the first “X-Men” blockbuster in 2000, with Stewart playing the powerful mutant telepath Professor Charles Xavier, also known as Professor X, and McKellen portraying the antihero Erik Magnus Lehnsherr, or Magneto, with the daunting power to manipulate metal and magnetic fields.
paras.zh: 它始于2000年的第一部《X战警》大片，斯图尔特扮演强大的变种人心灵感应教授查尔斯·泽维尔，也被称为X教授，而麦凯伦扮演反英雄埃里克·马格努斯·莱恩谢尔，或万磁王，拥有操纵金属和磁场的可怕力量。

paras.en: The subsequent franchise films highlighted the complex bond between the characters, ideologically at odds over how to protect mutantkind.
paras.zh: 随后的系列电影强调了角色之间复杂的联系，在如何保护变种人的问题上存在意识形态上的分歧。

paras.en: On screen they sparred, but off set they bonded.
paras.zh: 在银幕上他们争吵不休，但在戏外他们却结下了不解之缘。

paras.en: “We have to thank ‘X-Men’ for the two of us really getting to know one another, because every day on an ‘X-Men’ movie you spend far more time sitting in your trailer than you do on the set doing a drop of work — and those trailers are extremely luxurious. And we had adjoining ones, so we sat around and talked and reminisced,” Stewart said on the 2014 panel. “And I discovered a lot about this chap and he about me, and we found that there were many, many overlaps in our careers and many areas where we had little in common.”
paras.zh: “我们必须感谢《X战警》，让我们两个人真正认识了彼此，因为每天在《X战警》电影中，你坐在预告片里的时间比在片场做一点工作的时间还要多——而且那些预告片非常豪华。而且我们有相邻的预告片，所以我们围坐在一起交谈和回忆，”斯图尔特在 2014 年的座谈会上说道。 “我发现了很多关于这个人和他关于我的事情，我们发现我们的职业生涯有很多很多重叠，而且我们在很多领域几乎没有共同点。”

paras.en: The rest is history. The two shared a friendship adored by fans, often seen greeting each other with an affectionate kiss on the lips whether on TV programs or on the red carpet.
paras.zh: 剩下的就是历史了。两人的友谊深受粉丝喜爱，无论是在电视节目还是在红地毯上，两人经常以深情的嘴唇亲吻打招呼。

paras.en: Stewart told The Guardian that McKellen is “very close” to his wife, singer-songwriter Sunny Ozell, and that she was the one who suggested McKellen officiate their wedding. In 2013, he did just that.
paras.zh: 斯图尔特告诉《卫报》，麦凯伦与他的妻子、歌手兼作曲家桑尼·奥泽尔“非常亲密”，她是建议麦凯伦主持他们婚礼的人。 2013年，他就这么做了。

paras.en: Stewart was also a supporter of the LGBTQ+ community and praised activists like McKellen, who is gay.
paras.zh: 斯图尔特也是 LGBTQ+ 群体的支持者，并赞扬像麦克莱恩这样的同性恋活动人士。

paras.en: “I think this is where the theater is such an appealing world, because it embraces everything and always has. So there was never a moment where I made an intellectual choice that I would be a supporter of gay civil rights. It was always a natural and uncomplicated choice,” he told The Advocate in 2015. “Then later in life, as I got to know well-known activists like Ian McKellen, I was only too happy to join campaigns, march, and support in whatever way I could because it always seemed to me to be something that much too much fuss was being made about.”
paras.zh: “我认为这就是戏剧世界如此吸引人的地方，因为它包容一切，而且一直如此。因此，我从来没有做出明智的选择，成为同性恋公民权利的支持者。这始终是一个自然而简单的选择，”他在 2015 年告诉《倡导者》。“后来，当我认识了像伊恩·麦克莱恩这样的知名活动家时，我非常高兴能够以任何方式参与竞选、游行和支持。因为在我看来，这件事总是被大惊小怪。”

paras.en: Both men built separate and successful legacies in cinema — McKellen as the beloved wizard Gandalf in the “Lord of the Rings” and “The Hobbit” films and Stewart as Capt. Jean-Luc Picard of the long-running “Star Trek” franchise.
paras.zh: 两人在电影界都留下了各自的成功遗产——麦凯伦在《指环王》和《霍比特人》电影中饰演深受喜爱的巫师甘道夫，而斯图尔特则在长期上映的《星际迷航》系列电影中饰演让-吕克·皮卡德上尉。

paras.en: They were also both honored with knighthood by Queen Elizabeth II — McKellen in 1991 and Stewart in 2010.
paras.zh: 他们还分别于 1991 年和 2010 年被英国女王伊丽莎白二世授予爵士爵位：麦凯伦 (McKellen) 和斯图尔特 (Stewart)。

paras.en: Through it all, they remained devoted to their first love of theater and co-starred in two productions, to much acclaim.
paras.zh: 尽管经历了这一切，他们仍然忠于对戏剧的初恋，并共同主演了两部作品，广受好评。

paras.en: In Samuel Beckett’s play “Waiting for Godot,” Stewart was the optimistic Vladimir and McKellen the weary Estragon. Their performances — at London’s West End in 2009 and on New York’s Broadway in 2013-14 — were praised for their humor and comedy.
paras.zh: 在塞缪尔·贝克特的戏剧《等待戈多》中，斯图尔特扮演乐观的弗拉基米尔，麦凯伦扮演疲惫的爱斯特拉冈。他们于 2009 年在伦敦西区和 2013-14 年在纽约百老汇的表演因其幽默和喜剧而受到称赞。

paras.en: They also starred in Harold Pinter’s “No Man’s Land” in 2013 at the Berkeley Repertory Theatre and on Broadway and again in 2016 in the West End. Stewart played Hirst and McKellen Spooner.
paras.zh: 他们还在 2013 年在伯克利话剧团和百老汇主演了哈罗德·品特的《无人之地》，并于 2016 年在伦敦西区再次出演。斯图尔特饰演赫斯特和麦凯伦·斯普纳。

paras.en: Speaking to The Guardian about their friendship and onstage charisma, Stewart said, “Sometimes I feel we’re enjoying it too much and the audience don’t quite understand why we’re having so much fun.”
paras.zh: 斯图尔特在接受《卫报》采访时谈到他们的友谊和舞台魅力时说：“有时我觉得我们太享受了，而观众不太明白为什么我们玩得这么开心。”

paras.en: During the SAG-AFTRA Foundation panel, Stewart spoke about his theater career success and the joy of sharing the stage with McKellen.
paras.zh: 在 SAG-AFTRA 基金会座谈会上，斯图尔特谈到了他戏剧生涯的成功以及与麦凯伦同台表演的乐趣。

paras.en: “And that I get to spend six nights a week and three afternoons on stage with this chap is still ...,” he said before stopping, overcome with emotion. McKellen, next to him, held his hand. “Because I was a fan!” Stewart said, gesturing to McKellen.
paras.zh: “我每周能在舞台上与这个家伙共度六个晚上和三个下午，这仍然是……”他在停下来之前说道，情绪激动不已。麦克莱恩在他旁边握住了他的手。 “因为我是粉丝！”斯图尔特指着麦凯伦说道。

articles.title: Retiring Swan Rampe 'hurt' over Pullman Hotel saga

paras.en: Thu, 3 Sept, 8:10 pm, Final score, Dockers 40, Hawks 72
paras.zh: 9 月 3 日星期四，晚上 8:10，最终比分，码头工人 40，老鹰 72

paras.en: Sydney stalwart Dane Rampe "selfishly" grappled with putting off retirement, feeling hurt and upset that the Pullman Hotel saga had derailed his final AFL season.
paras.zh: 悉尼坚定的丹恩·兰普“自私地”努力推迟退休，他对铂尔曼酒店事件让他最后一个 AFL 赛季脱轨感到受伤和沮丧。

paras.en: The 36-year-old defender, who has confirmed his playing career is over, had quietly settled on making this season his last and seemed on track to have one last crack at an elusive premiership after the Swans finished second on the ladder ahead of the finals.
paras.zh: 这位36岁的后卫已经确认自己的球员生涯已经结束，他已经悄悄决定将本赛季作为他的最后一个赛季，在天鹅队在决赛前获得第二名后，他似乎有望在难以捉摸的英超联赛中获得最后的机会。

paras.en: But Sydney's premiership bid — as Swans chairman Andrew Pridham put it — was "torpedoed" after vice-captain Isaac Heeney, Chad Warner, Nick Blakey, James Jordon and Riley Bice were stood down.
paras.zh: 但正如天鹅队主席安德鲁·普里汉姆所说，悉尼的英超竞逐在副队长艾萨克·希尼、查德·华纳、尼克·布莱基、詹姆斯·乔丹和莱利·比斯被解职后被“鱼雷”摧毁。

paras.en: The five were suspended from round 24 and the club's two finals for what the Swans termed a "serious breach of expected club behaviour and standards".
paras.zh: 这五人被禁止参加第 24 轮比赛和俱乐部的两场决赛，天鹅队称其“严重违反了俱乐部的预期行为和标准”。

paras.en: Those AFL-endorsed club bans were separate from a police investigation into an alleged sexual assault at the Pullman Hotel, which is ongoing. No charges have been laid and there is no suggestion of wrongdoing on the part of the suspended players.
paras.zh: 这些 AFL 认可的俱乐部禁令与警方对铂尔曼酒店涉嫌性侵犯事件的调查是分开的，该调查正在进行中。目前尚未提出任何指控，也没有迹象表明被停赛的球员有任何不当行为。

paras.en: Rampe, who played in four losing grand finals (2014, '16, '22 and '24) across 289 games, confessed to his personal hurt at what happened.
paras.zh: Rampe 在 289 场比赛中四次输掉了总决赛（2014 年、16 年、22 年和 24 年），他承认所发生的事情给他带来了个人伤害。

paras.en: The former Swans co-captain was emotional and held back tears as he announced his retirement on Friday in front of family, teammates and media.
paras.zh: 这位前天鹅队联队长周五在家人、队友和媒体面前宣布退役时，情绪激动，忍住泪水。

paras.en: "Deep down, I probably knew at this time last year, this was going to be my last year," Rampe said on Friday.
paras.zh: “在内心深处，我可能知道去年的这个时候，这将是我的最后一年，”拉姆佩周五说道。

paras.en: "Everything was going swimmingly … and then, I'm not going to lie, the events that happened at the back end of the season really muddied those waters.
paras.zh: “一切都进展顺利……然后，我不会撒谎，赛季末发生的事件确实让事情变得更加混乱。

paras.en: "It really threw into disarray what I was thinking, what I hadn't probably admitted to myself yet.
paras.zh: “这真的让我的想法变得混乱，我可能还没有向自己承认这一点。

paras.en: "Selfishly, there was part of me that felt a little bit upset and hurt by what had happened.
paras.zh: “自私地说，我内心的一部分对所发生的事情感到有点不安和伤害。

paras.en: "I was struggling to accept whether this was the way I was going to bow out.
paras.zh: “我很难接受这是否是我要退出的方式。

paras.en: "And then, coupled with that, was the place in which the club found itself. It didn't feel right. It didn't feel right leaving with where things are at."
paras.zh: “然后，随之而来的是俱乐部发现自己所处的位置。感觉不对。离开现在的情况感觉不对。”

paras.en: Rampe said conversations with coach Dean Cox and football Leon Cameron had helped him achieve "clarity" surrounding his retirement.
paras.zh: 兰佩表示，与教练迪恩·考克斯和足球界莱昂·卡梅伦的对话帮助他“明确”了自己的退休生活。

paras.en: He was re-drafted as a rookie this season alongside fellow defender Jake Lloyd, who has signed on for a 15th season.
paras.zh: 本赛季，他作为新秀与队友后卫杰克·劳埃德（Jake Lloyd）一起重新入选，后者已签约第 15 个赛季。

paras.en: Cox "delicately" suggested that Rampe was struggling to meet the physical demands after 14 seasons in the system.
paras.zh: 考克斯“微妙地”暗示，兰佩在体系中效力了 14 个赛季后，正在努力满足身体需求。

paras.en: "I couldn't quite give the 100 per cent that made me Dane Rampe, the Swans player," Rampe said.
paras.zh: “我无法百分百地表达我成为天鹅队球员丹恩·兰普的原因，”兰普说。

paras.en: "I'm grateful for the way he [Cox] delicately posed that to me, because it was something I needed to hear.
paras.zh: “我很感激他（考克斯）巧妙地向我提出这个问题，因为这是我需要听到的。

paras.en: "Given the emotions of the back end of the season, it was hard for me to see the forest for the trees."
paras.zh: “考虑到赛季末的情绪，我很难只见树木，只见森林。”

paras.en: A Swans fan who sprinted onto the SCG in 1999 after Tony Lockett broke the league's goal-kicking record, Rampe has been a heart-and-soul player since he was drafted as a rookie in 2012, aged 22.
paras.zh: 1999 年，在托尼·洛基特 (Tony Lockett) 打破联盟进球纪录后，兰佩成为了一名天鹅球迷，自 2012 年 22 岁作为新秀被选中以来，他就一直是一名全心全意的球员。

paras.en: He made his debut in 2013 and went on to co-captain the Swans with Josh Kennedy and Luke Parker from 2019 to 2023.
paras.zh: 他于 2013 年首次亮相，并于 2019 年至 2023 年与乔什·肯尼迪和卢克·帕克共同担任天鹅队队长。

paras.en: Rampe is a Bob Skilton Medallist (2019) as the club best and fairest and an All-Australian ('16), making him one of the club's greatest rookie-list success stories alongside childhood idol Brett Kirk.
paras.zh: Rampe 是鲍勃·斯基尔顿奖牌得主（2019 年），是俱乐部最好、最公平的球员，也是全澳大利亚人（'16），这使他与儿时偶像布雷特·柯克一起成为俱乐部最伟大的新秀名单成功故事之一。

paras.en: When captain Callum Mills suffered an ACL injury last month in their semi-final win over Brisbane, it was only natural for the Swans to turn to Rampe.
paras.zh: 当队长卡勒姆·米尔斯上个月在半决赛战胜布里斯班的比赛中前十字韧带受伤时，天鹅队转向兰普是很自然的事情。

paras.en: Rampe would captain the Swans in what would be his final match, the club's preliminary final loss to Fremantle.
paras.zh: 兰佩将在他的最后一场比赛中担任天鹅队队长，俱乐部在决赛中输给了弗里曼特尔。

paras.en: With nothing confirmed for his future besides a break from the AFL, Rampe said he leaves the club with confidence.
paras.zh: 除了退出 AFL 之外，他的未来没有任何确定，兰佩表示他充满信心地离开了俱乐部。

paras.en: "I'm completely at peace with where the club sits," Rampe said.
paras.zh: “我对俱乐部所处的位置完全满意，”兰佩说。

paras.en: "Does that mean that we're not going to be having robust conversations? Absolutely not.
paras.zh: “这是否意味着我们不会进行激烈的对话？绝对不会。

paras.en: "In fact, I hope to hear that they are having challenging conversations going forward, and that the media is reporting difficult conversations.
paras.zh: “事实上，我希望听到他们正在进行具有挑战性的对话，并且媒体正在报道困难的对话。

paras.en: "That's a sign of a healthy club, a healthy culture, and I urge and implore the boys and the rest of the club to lean into that."
paras.zh: “这是一个健康的俱乐部、健康的文化的标志，我敦促并恳求男孩们和俱乐部的其他成员都向这一点靠拢。”

articles.title: Woman says she runs for cover when helicopter takes off from Canberra hospital
articles.author: Monte Bovill and Madeleine Rojahn

paras.en: Canberra woman says life disrupted after near miss from road sign sent flying by helicopter
paras.zh: 堪培拉女子称直升机差点撞上路标后生活被打乱

paras.en: Documents show multiple cases of damage or flying debris at the Canberra Hospital helipad in recent years, requiring investigations and repairs.
paras.zh: 文件显示，近年来堪培拉医院直升机停机坪发生多起损坏或碎片飞扬的情况，需要调查和修复。

paras.en: One neighbouring resident says she lives in fear after nearly being hit by a sign swept off the ground by a landing helicopter.
paras.zh: 一名邻近居民表示，她差点被一架降落的直升机从地面上扫下的标牌击中，生活在恐惧之中。

paras.en: Canberra Health Services says it works proactively to respond to all safety and operational concerns.
paras.zh: 堪培拉卫生服务中心表示，它正在积极应对所有安全和运营问题。

articles.title: Minister concedes Alice Springs school upgrade funding inadequate
articles.author: Chris Murrkarany Fitzpatrick and Stewart Brash

paras.en: Education minister admits $500,000 not enough for Alice Springs school merger
paras.zh: 教育部长承认 50 万美元不足以支持爱丽斯泉学校合并

paras.en: NT Education Minister Jo Hersey has conceded $500,000 allocated for upgrades at Centralian Middle School is inadequate and has promised additional funding to prepare the campus for its transition to Alice Springs College.
paras.zh: 北领地教育部长乔·赫西 (Jo Hersey) 承认，用于升级 Centralian 中学的 50 万美元资金不足，并承诺提供额外资金，为校园过渡到爱丽丝泉学院 (Alice Springs College) 做好准备。

paras.en: Construction is now expected to begin about November 24, with the minister guaranteeing the campus would be ready for the new school year.
paras.zh: 目前预计施工将于 11 月 24 日左右开始，部长保证校园将为新学年做好准备。

paras.en: The minister has promised school councils an updated plan within two weeks.
paras.zh: 部长已向学校理事会承诺在两周内提供更新计划。

articles.title: Spanish rescue workers search for any survivors in high-speed rail crash, with 69 dead

paras.en: Spanish rescue workers search for any survivors in high-speed rail crash, with 69 dead
paras.zh: 西班牙救援人员搜寻高铁事故幸存者，已造成69人死亡

paras.en: Death toll could rise, officials say, as Canadian government monitors 7 citizens affected by crash
paras.zh: 官员称，加拿大政府正在监测受事故影响的 7 名公民，死亡人数可能会上升

paras.en: Spain's second high-speed rail disaster this year, in which one train struck another from behind, killing 69 people, has raised fresh concerns about the safety of the country's rail network ahead of a national election.
paras.zh: 西班牙今年发生的第二起高铁事故，一列火车从后面撞上另一列火车，造成 69 人死亡，在全国大选之前引发了对该国铁路网络安全的新担忧。

paras.en: Search teams with sniffer dogs continued to look for victims on Thursday morning, a day after the collision in central Spain. Cranes helped shift the carriages as police and soldiers helped pick through the wreckage strewn down the gravel slope where at least three train carriages were tossed by the impact.
paras.zh: 周四上午，即西班牙中部发生撞车事件的第二天，搜救队带着嗅探犬继续寻找遇难者。起重机帮助移动车厢，警察和士兵帮助清理散落在砾石斜坡上的残骸，至少有三节火车车厢因撞击而被抛起。

paras.en: Officials have said the death toll was provisional. One more body was found overnight, taking the death toll to 69, according to the regional leader of Castilla La Mancha, Emiliano García-Page.
paras.zh: 官员们表示，死亡人数是临时数字。卡斯蒂利亚拉曼查地区领导人埃米利亚诺·加西亚-佩奇称，夜间又发现了一具尸体，死亡人数达到 69 人。

paras.en: García-Page said that a crane would lift a damaged carriage that had flipped over. He added that 50 people remained hospitalized. "Besides bodies, there are body parts that need to be identified," García-Page said.
paras.zh: 加西亚-佩奇说，起重机可以吊起一辆翻倒的受损车厢。他补充说，还有 50 人仍在医院接受治疗。加西亚-佩奇说：“除了尸体之外，还有身体部位需要识别。”

paras.en: Spain's government declared three days of mourning starting Thursday.
paras.zh: 西班牙政府宣布从周四开始哀悼三天。

paras.en: Relatives of passengers are seen near a religious residence converted into a temporary medical facility in Toledo, Spain after the deadly train collision. (Andrea Comas/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 西班牙托莱多发生致命火车相撞事故后，乘客亲属出现在一座改建为临时医疗设施的宗教住宅附近。 （安德里亚·科马斯/美联社）

paras.en: Relatives and friends flooded social media with desperate appeals for information on the whereabouts of their loved ones, posting photos or describing their physical appearance and clothing when they boarded the trains bound for Seville.
paras.zh: 亲友们涌入社交媒体，迫切希望获得亲人的下落，发布照片或描述他们登上开往塞维利亚的火车时的外貌和服装。

paras.en: Cesar Vicente, an actor, was among those who spent the night at a religious centre converted into a base for those affected by the disaster. He travelled 495 kilometres from his native Seville to Toledo in search of his father, also named Cesar.
paras.zh: 演员塞萨尔·维森特 (Cesar Vicente) 是在一个宗教中心过夜的人之一，该宗教中心改建为受灾群众的基地。他从家乡塞维利亚出发，长途跋涉 495 公里来到托莱多寻找他的父亲（也叫塞萨尔）。

paras.en: "I don't want this to happen to anyone. This is unbearable," said Vicente. "This is hell."
paras.zh: “我不希望这种事发生在任何人身上。这是难以忍受的，”维森特说。 “这里就是地狱。”

paras.en: Global Affairs Canada (GAC) told CBC News on Wednesday that it is aware of six Canadians who were injured in the crash, and a seventh person was unaccounted for. The severity of injuries was not clear, with the department citing privacy considerations.
paras.zh: 加拿大全球事务部 (GAC) 周三告诉 CBC 新闻，已知有六名加拿大人在事故中受伤，第七人下落不明。受伤的严重程度尚不清楚，该部门以隐私考虑为由。

paras.en: "Our thoughts are with their families and loved ones as well as all of those affected," the GAC statement said. "Canadian officials are providing consular assistance and are in contact with local authorities to gather more information."
paras.zh: GAC 声明称：“我们与他们的家人、亲人以及所有受影响的人同在。” “加拿大官员正在提供领事协助，并与地方当局联系以收集更多信息。”

paras.en: Spain's high-speed rail network has been considered one of the nation's crowning achievements. It is the world's second-largest, after China's. Until this year, it had not endured a deadly crash since coming into service more than three decades ago.
paras.zh: 西班牙的高铁网络被认为是该国的最高成就之一。它是世界第二大经济体，仅次于中国。自三十多年前投入使用以来，直到今年为止，它还没有经历过致命的坠机事故。

paras.en: Forty-six people died in a January crash when one train jumped the track and slammed into the side of another going the opposite way in southern Spain.
paras.zh: 一月份西班牙南部发生的一起事故中，一列火车冲出铁轨，撞上另一列相反方向的火车侧面，造成 46 人死亡。
