paras.en: Both deadly crashes this year took place on the same rail line. Each involved a train operated by state-owned RENFE and another operated by privately owned IRYO. Spain liberalized its high-speed rail service in 2021, with the Italian IRYO starting service the following year.
paras.zh: 今年的两起致命事故都发生在同一条铁路线上。每趟列车都涉及一趟由国有 RENFE 运营的列车和另一趟由私营 IRYO 运营的列车。西班牙于 2021 年开放高铁服务，意大利 IRYO 于次年开始运营。

paras.en: Emergency crews use heavy cranes Thursday to remove damaged carriages from the crash between the high-speed trains. (Oscar Del Pozo/AFP/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 周四，紧急救援人员使用重型起重机移除高速列车相撞事故中受损的车厢。 （奥斯卡德尔波索/法新社/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: "As a society, we have once again suffered a devastating blow. But we must keep moving forward, even amid this pain, without ever forgetting the wound they have left us," said Spain's King Felipe VI.
paras.zh: 西班牙国王费利佩六世表示：“作为一个社会，我们再次遭受了毁灭性的打击。但即使在这种痛苦之中，我们也必须继续前进，永远不要忘记他们给我们留下的创伤。”

paras.en: The king and Queen Letizia spent more than an hour visiting injured passengers at Toledo University Hospital.
paras.zh: 国王和王后莱蒂齐亚花了一个多小时在托莱多大学医院看望受伤的乘客。

paras.en: "Let us move forward in their memory. Let us do so together, united. Let us do so with dignity and with resolve," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“让我们在他们的记忆中继续前进。让我们团结一致，带着尊严和决心这样做。”

paras.en: Transport Minister Óscar Puente faced media questions over whether he would resign following a second major train wreck under his watch. He said he was fully focused on dealing with the collision, not his future.
paras.zh: 交通部长奥斯卡·普恩特面临媒体提问，询问他是否会在他领导下的第二次重大火车失事后辞职。他说他完全专注于处理碰撞事件，而不是他的未来。

paras.en: Puente said that the crash was caused by what he called the "inexplicable" order from a central command centre for Spain's trains after a security system had failed. He said the train engineers were not to blame.
paras.zh: 普恩特表示，这起事故是由西班牙火车中央指挥中心在安全系统失效后发出的“莫名其妙”的命令造成的。他说火车工程师不应该受到责备。

paras.en: IRYO employees react Thursday after observing a minute of silence for the train disaster victims, at Atocha railway station in Madrid. (Bernat Armangue/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 星期四，IRYO 员工在马德里阿托查火车站为火车灾难遇难者默哀一分钟后做出了反应。 （贝尔纳特·阿芒格/美联社）

paras.en: Puente said that at 8:30 a.m. local time the security system on a stretch of 63 kilometres stopped working due to a computer malfunction, causing all trains on that stretch to stop. At that point the IRYO train was stopped near the town of Urda, while the RENFE train was 25 kilometres behind it.
paras.zh: 普恩特说，当地时间上午8点30分，由于电脑故障，一段63公里路段的安全系统停止工作，导致该路段所有列车停止运行。此时，IRYO 列车停在乌尔达镇附近，而 RENFE 列车则在其后方 25 公里处。

paras.en: But a few minutes later the central command told the RENFE train to start running again without any speed restrictions, and it ended up colliding with the stationary IRYO train at 8:53 a.m.
paras.zh: 但几分钟后，中央指挥部要求 RENFE 列车重新开始运行，不受任何速度限制，最终于上午 8 点 53 分与静止的 IRYO 列车相撞。

paras.en: Puente said that the train should never have been told to start moving again since there was still a "stop signal" active on that line. And if it had, at least it should have been told to go at reduced speed.
paras.zh: 普恩特表示，火车根本不应该被告知重新开始行驶，因为该线路上仍然有“停止信号”。如果有的话，至少应该告诉它放慢速度。

paras.en: Thousands of travellers were left stranded and searching for alternative transport after the high-speed line connecting Madrid and Seville was shut down.
paras.zh: 连接马德里和塞维利亚的高速线路关闭后，数千名旅客陷入困境，寻找替代交通工具。

paras.en: Crash becomes another issue on campaign trail
paras.zh: 崩溃成为竞选活动中的另一个问题

paras.en: The collision Wednesday morning that turned a sleepy stretch of rail lined by olive groves into a scene of carnage came just four weeks before the country votes in a national election.
paras.zh: 周三早上，距离该国全国大选投票仅四个星期，这起撞车事故将一段橄榄林两旁的昏昏欲睡的铁路变成了大屠杀现场。

paras.en: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez visited the crash site and has pledged an investigation into the latest collision and improvements to prevent another tragedy.
paras.zh: 西班牙首相佩德罗·桑切斯视察了坠机现场，并承诺对最近的事故进行调查并进行改进，以防止再次发生悲剧。

paras.en: "It is clear that we need to reinforce the safety of our train service to rebuild the trust in our high-speed rail," Sánchez said. "It is not acceptable for a country like Spain to endure two high-speed train accidents in the same year."
paras.zh: 桑切斯说：“显然，我们需要加强火车服务的安全性，以重建人们对我们高铁的信任。” “像西班牙这样的国家在同一年遭遇两起高铁事故是不可接受的。”

paras.en: - How did Spain's housing crisis get so bad it forced the PM to call a snap election?
paras.zh: - 西班牙的住房危机为何如此严重，迫使首相提前举行大选？

paras.en: - Spanish pensioner Maricarmen, symbol of country's housing crisis, dead at 87
paras.zh: - 西班牙养老金领取者马里卡门去世，享年 87 岁，他是该国住房危机的象征

paras.en: Sánchez has weathered many crises since taking power in 2018, but polls show he and his Socialists faces another uphill battle when voters cast ballots in Spain's first national election in more than three years, on Nov. 29.
paras.zh: 自 2018 年掌权以来，桑切斯经历了许多危机，但民意调查显示，当选民在 11 月 29 日西班牙三年多来的首次全国大选中投票时，他和他的社会党面临着另一场艰苦的战斗。

paras.en: Discontent over housing costs and high rents led to the early election call. Sánchez now also faces questions about the safety of Spain's rail service along with criticism from right-wing parties of his liberal migration policies and accusations of corruption against his party and his wife, which both he and his wife deny.
paras.zh: 对住房成本和高租金的不满导致了提前选举的呼吁。桑切斯现在还面临着西班牙铁路服务安全的问题，右翼政党对他的自由移民政策的批评，以及对他的政党和妻子的腐败指控，但他和他的妻子都否认了这一点。

paras.en: Members of Spain's Military Emergency Unit are shown Thursday near a tent set up next to the Institute of Forensic Medicine following the train collision in Toledo. (Andrea Comas/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周四，托莱多发生火车相撞事故后，西班牙军事应急部队的成员出现在法医研究所旁搭建的帐篷附近。 （安德里亚·科马斯/美联社）

paras.en: Sánchez's main rival, People's Party Leader Alberto Núñez Feijóo, demanded a full investigation of the crash on Wednesday. The conservative leader said that in respect for the victims his party cancelled its campaign events for the day.
paras.zh: 桑切斯的主要竞争对手、人民党领袖阿尔贝托·努涅斯·费霍周三要求对事故进行全面调查。这位保守党领袖表示，为了尊重受害者，他的政党取消了当天的竞选活动。

paras.en: The far-right Vox leader, Santiago Abascal, who is likely hoping to enter a coalition government with the conservatives, did not show the same restraint.
paras.zh: 极右翼 Vox 领导人圣地亚哥·阿巴斯卡尔 (Santiago Abascal) 可能希望与保守派组成联合政府，但他没有表现出同样的克制。

paras.en: "I promise to work tirelessly until this government, which is a criminal organization, is sitting in a courtroom to answer for its crimes," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我保证将不懈努力，直到这个犯罪组织政府坐在法庭上对其罪行负责。”

articles.title: Dirty tricks or much ado about nothing? Why Alaska, for once, is front and centre in midterms
articles.author: Chris Iorfida

paras.en: Dirty tricks or much ado about nothing? Why Alaska, for once, is front and centre in midterms
paras.zh: 肮脏的伎俩还是无事生非？为什么阿拉斯加这一次在中期选举中名列前茅

paras.en: Democrats pan Republicans' suggestion that confusion over namesakes could sway consequential race
paras.zh: 民主党人反对共和党人的建议，即同名者的混淆可能会影响相应的种族

paras.en: The presence of two candidates named Dan Sullivan on the Alaska ballot for a Senate election has attracted attention for about six months now in U.S. political news coverage.
paras.zh: 两名名叫丹·沙利文的候选人出现在阿拉斯加参议院选举的投票中，在美国政治新闻报道中引起了大约六个月的关注。

paras.en: Right-wing media outlets have suspected it was not a mere coincidence, but an example of chicanery, and an investigation by the New York Times resulted in an article Wednesday that suggests a co-ordinated effort by individuals associated with Democrat Mary Peltola's campaign to recruit anyone with the same name as Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan.
paras.zh: 右翼媒体怀疑这不仅仅是巧合，而是欺骗的一个例子，《纽约时报》周三的调查结果发表了一篇文章，指出与民主党玛丽·佩尔托拉竞选活动有关的个人协同努力，招募与共和党现任总统丹·沙利文同名的人。

paras.en: A spokesperson for the Peltola campaign had previously said it had "no involvement with either Sullivan campaign."
paras.zh: 佩尔托拉竞选团队的发言人此前曾表示，该团队“与沙利文竞选团队没有任何关系”。

paras.en: While political action committees and campaigns for both parties have occasionally engaged in similar "ballot-stacking" tactics that appeared to have the express purpose of siphoning votes from well-established politicians, the Alaska scenario is perhaps the most high-profile example yet seen.
paras.zh: 虽然两党的政治行动委员会和竞选活动偶尔会采取类似的“堆积选票”策略，其明确目的似乎是从知名政客那里吸走选票，但阿拉斯加的情况可能是迄今为止最引人注目的例子。

paras.en: Attorney General Todd Blanche said Wednesday it "should be" illegal, and U.S. President Donald Trump has suggested that criminal prosecutions should result, without specifying on what grounds, or for which particular individuals.
paras.zh: 司法部长托德·布兰奇周三表示，这“应该”是非法的，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普建议应进行刑事起诉，但没有具体说明理由是什么，也没有具体说明针对哪些特定个人。

paras.en: Here's a look at how we got here and the questions that have emerged ahead of Tuesday's midterms.
paras.zh: 以下是我们如何走到这一步以及周二中期选举之前出现的问题。

paras.en: Several candidates appeared on the Senate ballot in the spring, including incumbent Dan Sullivan, whose middle name is Scott. But also on the ballot was Republican Dan J. Sullivan. A retired schoolteacher, he is a neophyte in terms of political office and has registered as a Democrat in the past.
paras.zh: 春季参议院投票中出现了几名候选人，其中包括现任丹·沙利文，他的中间名是斯科特。共和党人丹·J·沙利文(Dan J. Sullivan)也参加了投票。他是一名退休教师，在政治职务方面是新手，过去曾注册为民主党人。

paras.en: In June, the state's Republican lieutenant-governor disqualified Dan J. Sullivan under a state regulation that forbids ballot names that are "confusing or misleading to voters or compromises the fairness or neutrality of the ballot."
paras.zh: 6月，该州共和党副州长根据一项州法规取消了丹·J·沙利文(Dan J. Sullivan)的资格，该法规禁止“混淆或误导选民或损害选票公平性或中立性”的选票名称。

paras.en: A campaign spokesperson for Democratic Senate hopeful Mary Peltola, seen in Anchorage, Alaska, on Oct. 14, has previously said it had 'no involvement with either Sullivan campaign.' (Becky Bohrer/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 10 月 14 日，民主党参议院候选人玛丽·佩尔托拉 (Mary Peltola) 的竞选发言人出现在阿拉斯加的安克雷奇，她此前曾表示“与沙利文的竞选活动没有任何关系”。 （贝基·博勒/美联社）

paras.en: But a state judge's reversal of that decision was upheld by the Alaska Supreme Court. The gist of their ruling was that there is no statutory or constitutional mechanism to remove a person from the ballot if they had met the qualifications to register as a candidate, no matter the origin story of the candidacy.
paras.zh: 但阿拉斯加最高法院维持了州法官推翻该决定的决定。他们裁决的要点是，如果某人符合登记为候选人的资格，则没有任何法定或宪法机制可以将其从选票中删除，无论候选人的起源如何。

paras.en: "There's a lot of different ways you can distinguish these two candidates on the ballot, short of precluding access to the ballot to begin with," Aimee Oravec, an Alaska justice, said during oral arguments in the case.
paras.zh: 阿拉斯加法官艾米·奥拉维克（Aimee Oravec）在该案的口头辩论中表示：“有很多不同的方法可以在选票上区分这两位候选人，除了从一开始就阻止他们进入选票之外。”

paras.en: What the composition of the Senate will look like after its three-dozen races are called is seen as an unpredictable puzzle by pollsters. Republicans hold a 53-47 majority and Democrats need four pickups to regain control of the chamber, so the race between Peltola and the incumbent Sullivan could be pivotal.
paras.zh: 在三打竞选结果公布后，参议院的组成将是什么样子，这被民意调查者视为一个不可预测的谜题。共和党以 53 比 47 占据多数席位，而民主党需要四次选举才能重新获得众议院的控制权，因此佩尔托拉和现任议员沙利文之间的竞争可能至关重要。

paras.en: Alaska is one of the smallest electorates. Sullivan was elected to office in 2014 by two percentage points, which translated to just over 6,000 more votes than his opponent.
paras.zh: 阿拉斯加是最小的选区之一。 2014 年，沙利文以两个百分点的优势当选，这相当于比他的对手多了 6,000 多张选票。

paras.en: In the all-party primary in August to determine the top four candidates, the candidate derisively nicknamed "Decoy Dan" by some garnered 4,107 votes, about 2 per cent of the total vote. This despite the fact he's reportedly spent no money on campaign staff or media.
paras.zh: 在8月份确定前四名候选人的全党初选中，这位被一些人戏称为“诱饵丹”的候选人获得了4,107张选票，约占总选票的2%。尽管据报道他没有在竞选工作人员或媒体上花钱，但事实还是如此。

paras.en: Democrats have defended the manoeuvre as an example of political hardball. They have pointed to examples nationally of Republican-led efforts to place candidates on ballots as a diversionary tactic, and Alaska Democrats alleged in 2024 that Republicans were behind a scheme to get an incarcerated candidate — who's running again this year — on the ballot to siphon votes from their preferred U.S. House candidate.
paras.zh: 民主党人为这一举措辩护，称其为政治强硬的一个例子。他们指出，在全国范围内，共和党领导的将候选人列入选票的行动是一种转移注意力的策略，阿拉斯加民主党人在 2024 年声称，共和党人支持一项计划，让今年再次参选的被监禁候选人参加选票，以从他们喜欢的美国众议院候选人手中夺取选票。

paras.en: Peltola and her campaign haven't fully addressed the Times allegations, merely calling it a "diversion." The revelation could backfire for Peltola, a Yup'ik who became the first Indigenous person from Alaska to ever serve in Congress when she won a House seat in 2022.
paras.zh: 佩尔托拉和她的竞选团队尚未完全回应《纽约时报》的指控，只是称其为“转移注意力”。这一揭露可能会给佩尔托拉带来适得其反的影响。佩尔托拉是尤皮克人，她在 2022 年赢得众议院席位，成为第一位在国会任职的阿拉斯加原住民。

paras.en: In addition to Sullivan, Republican Lisa Murkowski, the other U.S. senator from Alaska, is calling for her to come clean about her knowledge of the scheme.
paras.zh: 除了沙利文之外，另一位来自阿拉斯加的美国参议员、共和党人丽莎·默科斯基也呼吁她坦白自己对该计划的了解。

paras.en: - Analysis U.S. midterms could be the country's most expensive elections yet. To what end?
paras.zh: - 分析美国中期选举可能是该国迄今为止最昂贵的选举。为了什么目的？

paras.en: - Why the Hispanic vote could sway the outcome of the U.S. midterm elections
paras.zh: - 为什么西班牙裔投票可能影响美国中期选举的结果

paras.en: The gambit could also just breed more general cynicism in a country where unfounded allegations of vote fraud in the 2020 election led to a riot at the U.S. Capitol.
paras.zh: 这一策略还可能在这个国家滋生更普遍的愤世嫉俗，2020 年大选中毫无根据的选举舞弊指控导致美国国会大厦发生骚乱。

paras.en: "How does this increase voter confidence in our election process?" the Juneau Empire, the newspaper out of the state capital, asked in a recent editorial.
paras.zh: “这如何增强选民对我们选举过程的信心？”州首府《朱诺帝国报》在最近的一篇社论中问道。

paras.en: After the Times article landed, Republican Gov. Mike Dunleavy said he was directing the state's Department of Public Safety to investigate the scheme to see if criminal or civil offences occurred.
paras.zh: 《纽约时报》的文章发表后，共和党州长迈克·邓利维表示，他正在指示该州公共安全部调查该计划，看看是否发生刑事或民事犯罪。

paras.en: "Deliberately tricking voters into casting their ballots for someone else strikes at the integrity of our elections," said Dunleavy.
paras.zh: 邓利维说：“故意欺骗选民为其他人投票，损害了我们选举的公正性。”

paras.en: Several days before the Times exposé landed, the Justice Department filed a lawsuit to demand that Alaska be blocked from certifying a Peltola win if Dan J. Sullivan remains on the ballot.
paras.zh: 在《泰晤士报》曝光的几天前，司法部提起诉讼，要求如果丹·J·沙利文仍然留在选票上，则禁止阿拉斯加州证明佩尔托拉获胜。

paras.en: Trump said he had ordered the department to do that and no criticism emerged in Congress from Republicans who regularly lobbed accusations about a politicized Justice Department under Democratic predecessor Joe Biden.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，他已命令司法部这样做，国会中没有出现来自共和党人的批评，他们经常对民主党前任乔·拜登领导下的司法部提出政治化指控。

paras.en: It is hard to predict if any criminality occurred, given what is known so far. But vote-siphoning schemes have led to charges for individuals before.
paras.zh: 鉴于目前已知的情况，很难预测是否发生任何犯罪行为。但吸选票计划之前曾导致个人受到指控。

paras.en: As for the Justice Department suit, the U.S. Constitution grants states the power to run their own elections. Election experts are pessimistic about its chances for success, and even the Trump-friendly Wall Street Journal editorial page called it a "legal Hail Mary."
paras.zh: 至于司法部的诉讼，美国宪法赋予各州自行选举的权力。选举专家对其成功机会持悲观态度，就连对特朗普友好的《华尔街日报》社论版也称其为“合法的万福玛丽”。

paras.en: "The statute simply doesn't let the Department of Justice enjoin certification," Derek Muller, University of Notre Dame law professor, told the Associated Press last week. "The lawsuit could well be mooted by a wide Democratic victory or a narrow Republican one, and if not, the court will likely dismiss it next month."
paras.zh: “该法规根本不允许司法部强制进行认证，”圣母大学法学教授德里克·穆勒上周告诉美联社。 “民主党大获全胜或共和党小胜很可能会引发诉讼，如果不是，法院可能会在下个月驳回诉讼。”

paras.en: The lawsuit asks the court to block certification until an investigation determines whether enough voters were fooled in a way that swings the election. It doesn't explain how that would happen, and the right to privacy provides another complication, as votes are supposed to be confidential.
paras.zh: 该诉讼要求法院阻止认证，直到调查确定是否有足够多的选民被愚弄，从而影响了选举。它没有解释这是如何发生的，而隐私权又带来了另一个复杂性，因为投票应该是保密的。

paras.en: Election expert Rick Hasen called the Times report a "bombshell" and said perjury prosecutions were possible if it could be established someone lied about involvement in the scheme. But Hasen, UCLA law professor and director of the Safeguarding Democracy Project, wrote Wednesday on his blog that he didn't think the new reporting changed the equation on the Justice Department suit.
paras.zh: 选举专家里克·哈森称《泰晤士报》的报道是一个“重磅炸弹”，并表示，如果可以确定有人在参与该计划时撒了谎，那么就有可能进行伪证起诉。但加州大学洛杉矶分校法学教授兼维护民主项目主任哈森周三在他的博客上写道，他认为新的报道并没有改变司法部诉讼的等式。

paras.en: Hasen also said he didn't see any mechanism for the government to criminalize Dan J. Sullivan's campaign.
paras.zh: 哈森还表示，他认为政府没有任何机制将丹·沙利文的竞选活动定为犯罪。

paras.en: "And if it could do so, then it could be a crime every time that the Republican Party backs a Green Party candidate, or Democrats support a MAGA candidate in a primary in the hopes that the candidate would be weaker against a Democrat in the general election," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“如果可以这样做，那么每次共和党支持绿党候选人，或者民主党在初选中支持一位让美国再次伟大的候选人，希望该候选人在大选中比民主党更弱，都可能是犯罪。”

paras.en: A sample election ballot for Alaska shows how the two Sullivan's running for a Senate seat are being distinguished. (Haven Daley/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 阿拉斯加州的选举选票样本显示了沙利文两位参议员竞选参议员的情况如何不同。 （海文·戴利/美联社）

paras.en: Alaska employs a ranked-choice ballot. Some local editorials, as well as the Wall Street Journal, have argued that such a system encourages the possibility of voter confusion and sham candidates.
paras.zh: 阿拉斯加采用排名选择投票。一些当地的社论以及《华尔街日报》都认为，这种制度可能会导致选民混乱和冒充候选人。

paras.en: Democrats counter that the local electorate has likely been inundated for months with stories and video differentiating the two men. In addition, they say, a voter could just simply choose not to rank Peltola at all on their ballot, with the likelihood that the less seasoned Sullivan comes out on top over the man who's represented Alaska for over a decade considered remote.
paras.zh: 民主党人反驳说，几个月来，当地选民可能已经被区分这两个人的故事和视频淹没了。此外，他们还表示，选民可以选择根本不将佩尔托拉列入选票，因为经验不足的沙利文可能会比代表阿拉斯加十多年的被认为遥不可及的人名列前茅。

paras.en: - FRONT BURNER US Politics! Will Texas flip, who's bailing on Trump?
paras.zh: - 美国政治的前沿！得克萨斯州会翻转吗？谁会抛弃特朗普？

paras.en: - Analysis Democrats promise Epstein probes will be a priority if they win midterms, but to what end?
paras.zh: - 分析 民主党人承诺，如果他们赢得中期选举，爱泼斯坦调查将成为优先事项，但目的是什么？

paras.en: It's not the citizenry's first go-round with the system, which has been in place since 2022. Even Republican Murkowski, criticizing the Justice Department suit last week, has said that "Alaskans don't need any help voting for their preferred candidates."
paras.zh: 这并不是公民第一次使用该系统，该系统自 2022 年以来一直存在。就连上周批评司法部诉讼的共和党人穆尔科斯基也表示，“阿拉斯加人不需要任何帮助来投票给他们喜欢的候选人。”

paras.en: It is too late to change ballots. Dan J. Sullivan is listed as "Daniel J. Sullivan Jr.," without a party label, and Dan S. Sullivan is listed as "Dan S. Sullivan (Registered Republican) Incumbent."
paras.zh: 改变选票已经太晚了。 Dan J. Sullivan 被列为“Daniel J. Sullivan Jr.”，没有政党标签，Dan S. Sullivan 被列为“Dan S. Sullivan（注册共和党）现任”。

articles.title: Australian court says mushroom poison murderer should never be released from prison

paras.en: Australian court says mushroom poison murderer should never be released from prison
paras.zh: 澳大利亚法院称蘑菇毒杀人犯永远不应出狱

paras.en: Erin Patterson poisoned estranged husband, his relatives with death cap mushrooms
paras.zh: 艾琳·帕特森用死帽蘑菇毒死了分居的丈夫和他的亲戚

paras.en: An Australian appeals court on Friday ordered triple-murderer Erin Patterson to never be released from prison because of the "shocking criminality" involved in poisoning four of her estranged husband's relatives with death cap mushrooms.
paras.zh: 周五，澳大利亚一家上诉法院下令三重杀人犯艾琳·帕特森永远不得出狱，因为她涉嫌用死帽蘑菇毒害她已疏远的丈夫的四名亲戚，其罪行“令人震惊”。

paras.en: The three judges of the Victoria state Court of Appeal dismissed Patterson's appeal of her convictions and upheld prosecutors' challenge to the leniency of her 33-year non-parole sentence, meaning she will spend the rest of her life behind bars. Beforehand, she would have been 82 years old when she could be considered for release.
paras.zh: 维多利亚州上诉法院的三名法官驳回了帕特森对其定罪的上诉，并维持了检察官对她 33 年不得假释的宽大判决的质疑，这意味着她将在监狱中度过余生。此前，她已经82岁了，才可以考虑释放。

paras.en: "This offending was extraordinarily cold and calculated and stands to be denounced in the strongest terms," Justice Stephen McLeish said on behalf of all three judges.
paras.zh: 法官斯蒂芬·麦克利什代表所有三名法官表示：“这一罪行极其冷酷且经过精心策划，应该受到最强烈的谴责。”

paras.en: "In all the circumstances after anxious consideration, we have concluded that the case involved such shocking criminality that it is inappropriate to fix a non-parole period," McLeish added.
paras.zh: 麦克利什补充说：“经过焦急的考虑，我们得出的结论是，该案涉及的犯罪行为如此令人震惊，因此确定非假释期是不合适的。”

paras.en: The convictions stemmed from a family meal she hosted at her rural home in Leongatha in July 2023.
paras.zh: 这些定罪源于 2023 年 7 月她在 Leongatha 农村家中举办的一次家庭聚餐。

paras.en: Death cap mushrooms are seen in this undated handout by the B.C. Centre for Disease Control. (BC Centre for Disease Control/The Canadian Press)
paras.zh: BC省这份未注明日期的讲义中发现了死帽蘑菇。疾病控制中心。 （BC 省疾病控制中心/加拿大通讯社）

paras.en: She can apply to Australia's High Court to overturn the verdicts on her sentence and her convictions. The High Court is her last appeal option.
paras.zh: 她可以向澳大利亚高等法院申请推翻对她的判决和定罪。高等法院是她最后的上诉选择。

paras.en: Patterson insisted she added death cap mushrooms to the beef Wellington pastry dishes accidentally.
paras.zh: 帕特森坚称她不小心在惠灵顿牛肉糕点中添加了死帽蘑菇。

paras.en: She was sentenced last year to three life sentences for murder and 25 years for attempted murder.
paras.zh: 去年，她因谋杀罪被判处三项无期徒刑，并因谋杀未遂罪被判处 25 年徒刑。

paras.en: The deaths of Patterson's parents-in-law Don and Gail Patterson, and Gail's sister, Heather Wilkinson, within days of having lunch immediately attracted an extraordinary level of global media attention.
paras.zh: 帕特森的岳父唐·帕特森和盖尔·帕特森以及盖尔的妹妹希瑟·威尔金森在吃午饭后几天内就去世，立即引起了全球媒体的高度关注。

paras.en: The case has also inspired podcasts, books and screen adaptations.
paras.zh: 该案例还为播客、书籍和电影改编提供了灵感。

paras.en: Heather's husband Ian Wilkinson survived the lunch after spending weeks in hospital. Erin Patterson was convicted of his attempted murder.
paras.zh: 希瑟的丈夫伊恩·威尔金森在医院住了几周后，在午餐中幸存下来。艾琳·帕特森被判犯有谋杀未遂罪。

paras.en: Prosecutors argued at an appeal hearing in August that she should never become eligible for parole.
paras.zh: 检察官在八月份的上诉听证会上辩称，她永远不应该获得假释资格。

paras.en: They argued the minimum period behind bars did not reflect the "calculated criminality" of the case.
paras.zh: 他们认为，最短监禁期限并不能反映该案“经过计算的犯罪行为”。

paras.en: McLeish said Patterson's intent to murder all four was sustained for almost three weeks from when she invited them to lunch.
paras.zh: 麦克利什说，从她邀请他们共进午餐起，帕特森谋杀这四人的意图持续了近三周。

paras.en: Her crimes involved an "elaborate series of deceptions" including falsely claiming a cancer diagnosis to explain the absences of her two children from the lunch, the judge said.
paras.zh: 法官说，她的罪行涉及“一系列精心设计的欺骗行为”，包括谎称患有癌症，以解释她的两个孩子缺席午餐的原因。

paras.en: The only survivor, Ian Wilkinson, testified that Erin Patterson had told her guests she wanted their advice about what to tell the children about her diagnosis.
paras.zh: 唯一的幸存者伊恩·威尔金森作证说，艾琳·帕特森告诉她的客人，她希望他们就如何向孩子们讲述她的诊断结果提出建议。

paras.en: McLeish noted Erin Patterson had destroyed evidence, denied foraging for mushrooms and repeatedly made false claims about where the mushrooms had come from.
paras.zh: 麦克利什指出，艾琳·帕特森销毁了证据，否认采摘蘑菇，并多次对蘑菇的来源做出虚假陈述。

paras.en: "The offending was carefully planned and deliberate. It represented a cruel breach of trust," McLeish said.
paras.zh: 麦克利什说：“这起犯罪行为是经过精心策划和蓄意的。它代表着对信任的残酷破坏。”

paras.en: Patterson opted not to attend court and watched the verdicts by video link from prison.
paras.zh: 帕特森选择不出庭，并在监狱中通过视频链接观看了判决结果。

paras.en: In a supplied court sketch, Erin Patterson is depicted on a video link, as seen in the Victorian Court of Appeal in Melbourne, Australia, on Aug. 19. (Anita Lester/Australian Associated Press/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 在提供的法庭草图中，视频链接上描绘了艾琳·帕特森 (Erin Patterson)，如 8 月 19 日在澳大利亚墨尔本维多利亚上诉法院看到的那样。（Anita Lester/澳大利亚美联社/美联社）

paras.en: Because of her notoriety, Patterson is held in the high-security Gordon Unit of Melbourne's Dame Phyllis Frost Centre women's prison. The unit is for prisoners assessed as being at high risk from other inmates.
paras.zh: 由于声名狼藉，帕特森被关押在墨尔本菲利斯弗罗斯特夫人中心女子监狱戒备森严的戈登牢房。该牢房专为被评估为与其他囚犯处于高风险的囚犯而设。

paras.en: In sentencing her in September 2025, trial judge Christopher Bale said there was a "substantial chance" that Patterson could be held in "solitary confinement for years to come."
paras.zh: 审判法官克里斯托弗·贝尔 (Christopher Bale) 在 2025 年 9 月对帕特森宣判时表示，帕特森“很有可能”在“未来几年内被单独监禁”。

paras.en: Patterson's estranged husband, Simon Patterson, was invited to the lunch but declined the day before.
paras.zh: 帕特森分居的丈夫西蒙·帕特森被邀请参加午餐，但在前一天拒绝了。

paras.en: After her conviction, pretrial evidence was released that detailed the husband's suspicion that Erin Patterson had previously attempted to kill him.
paras.zh: 定罪后，公布的审前证据详细说明了丈夫怀疑艾琳·帕特森此前曾试图杀死他。

paras.en: Simon Patterson testified at a pretrial hearing that he had declined the lunch invitation out of fear.
paras.zh: 西蒙·帕特森在审前听证会上作证说，他出于恐惧而拒绝了午餐邀请。

articles.title: Ship reported on fire off Oman as Iran escalation fears mount

paras.en: A ship on fire has been reported in the Strait of Hormuz, British maritime agency UKMTO said on Thursday.
paras.zh: 英国海事机构 UKMTO 周四表示，一艘船只在霍尔木兹海峡起火。

paras.en: The agency, which is run by the British Royal Navy, did not give details on the cause of the blaze or any casualties.
paras.zh: 该机构由英国皇家海军管理，没有提供火灾原因或人员伤亡的详细信息。

paras.en: Iran has, however, recently stepped up its attacks on ships that it sees as using the waterway without proper authorization.
paras.zh: 然而，伊朗最近加大了对其认为未经适当授权使用该水道的船只的攻击力度。

paras.en: Iran's Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC) said in a statement on Thursday that three tankers had exploded and caught fire in the past 24 hours after hitting sea mines while using an "unauthorized" route, but it is not known if the case reported to the UKMTO is one of them.
paras.zh: 伊朗革命卫队(IRGC)周四在一份声明中表示，过去24小时内，三艘油轮在使用“未经授权”的路线时触雷后发生爆炸并起火，但目前尚不清楚向UKMTO报告的案件是否是其中之一。

paras.en: This comes as Iran has reported shooting down another US drone east of the waterway as fears grow of a new escalation in the US-Iran war.
paras.zh: 与此同时，伊朗报告称，由于人们担心美伊战争新一轮升级，伊朗在水道以东击落了另一架美国无人机。

paras.en: Iran steps up attacks in Strait of Hormuz
paras.zh: 伊朗加大对霍尔木兹海峡的攻击力度

paras.en: The UKMTO said the captain of another ship had reported the blaze onboard a vessel spotted 9 nautical miles (17 kilometers) north of the town of Khasab in Oman, which is located just off the strait.
paras.zh: UKMTO表示，另一艘船的船长报告了一艘在阿曼海塞卜镇以北9海里（17公里）处发现的船只起火的情况，该镇位于海峡附近。

paras.en: The status of the crew is unknown, and so far no information has emerged pertaining to damage or environmental impact.
paras.zh: 船员的状况尚不清楚，到目前为止还没有有关损害或环境影响的信息。

paras.en: Since the Middle East war was triggered in February by US and Israeli attacks on Iran, Tehran has sought to control the strait, a key transit point for global oil and natural gas supplies, and has attacked ships it considers to be unauthorized users of the waterway.
paras.zh: 自二月份美国和以色列对伊朗的袭击引发中东战争以来，德黑兰一直寻求控制该海峡这一全球石油和天然气供应的关键中转站，并袭击了它认为未经授权使用该水道的船只。

paras.en: Oil exports through the waterway fell again last week, according to shipping data provider Kpler.
paras.zh: 根据航运数据提供商 Kpler 的数据，上周通过该水道的石油出口再次下降。

paras.en: Attacks on ships in the strait are at the highest level since the war began, according to US-based think tank Washington Institute for Near East Policy.
paras.zh: 据美国智库华盛顿近东政策研究所称，该海峡对船只的袭击达到了战争开始以来的最高水平。

paras.en: The US Navy, which is enforcing its own blockade of Iranian vessels, has recently escorted tankers through the strait in the area where the burning ship was reportedly sighted.
paras.zh: 美国海军正在对伊朗船只实施封锁，最近在据报道看到燃烧船只的地区护送油轮通过海峡。

paras.en: The reported ship fire comes as Iran says its forces have downed a drone near the strait, with the Tasnim news agency citing the IRGC as saying a new, advanced air defense system was used.
paras.zh: 据报道，船只起火之际，伊朗称其军队在海峡附近击落了一架无人机，塔斯尼姆通讯社援引伊朗革命卫队的话说，使用了一种新的先进防空系统。

paras.en: The report said that Iran's armed forces have destroyed 14 drones of this type and more than 50 MQ-9 Reaper drones since the war broke out.
paras.zh: 报道称，自战争爆发以来，伊朗武装部队已摧毁了14架该型无人机和50多架MQ-9“死神”无人机。

paras.en: The claims have not been independently verified, though the US Congressional Research Service says dozens of US aircraft and drones have been reported lost or damaged since the war began.
paras.zh: 尽管美国国会研究服务处表示，自战争开始以来，已有数十架美国飞机和无人机丢失或损坏，但这些说法尚未得到独立证实。

paras.en: The latest incidents come as US President Donald Trump is widely seen to be considering fresh strikes against Iran after the US midterm elections on November 3.
paras.zh: 最新事件发生之际，人们普遍认为美国总统唐纳德·特朗普正在考虑在 11 月 3 日美国中期选举后对伊朗发动新的打击。

paras.en: Last week, Trump said, "we may do another little Epic Fury," referring to the US-Israeli attacks on Tehran in February that triggered the war. He did not, however, give any timeframe.
paras.zh: 上周，特朗普表示，“我们可能会再做一次小小的史诗般的愤怒”，指的是二月份美国和以色列对德黑兰的袭击，引发了战争。不过，他没有给出任何时间表。

paras.en: A third US aircraft carrier and thousands of additional troops are currently heading to the region.
paras.zh: 第三艘美国航空母舰和数千名额外士兵目前正在前往该地区。

paras.en: As reports of a possible renewed escalation swirl, US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has reportedly nonetheless fired the Pentagon's top military planner, Army Lieutenant General Brett Sylvia.
paras.zh: 尽管有报道称升级漩涡可能再次升级，但据报道，美国国防部长皮特·赫格斯 (Pete Hegseth) 已解雇了五角大楼最高军事规划师、陆军中将布雷特·西尔维娅 (Brett Sylvia)。

paras.en: If confirmed, the ouster would be the latest in a series of such high-level departures under the Trump administration, with Sylvia's predecessor, Lieutenant General Joseph McGee being forced to retire last October.
paras.zh: 如果得到证实，这次罢免将是特朗普政府一系列高层离职中的最新一起，西尔维娅的前任、约瑟夫·麦吉中将去年十月被迫退休。

paras.en: According to a report in The Atlantic, no reason was given for Sylvia's departure and no replacement has been named.
paras.zh: 据《大西洋月刊》报道，西尔维娅没有给出离职原因，也没有任命继任者。

articles.title: European Central Bank (ECB) head Christine Lagarde to step down in February, before her term ends

paras.en: Christine Lagarde, who has headed the European Central Bank for seven years, has announced that she is stepping down prematurely from the position.
paras.zh: 担任欧洲央行行长七年的克里斯蒂娜·拉加德宣布提前辞去这一职务。

paras.en: "European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde today informed the Governing Council and the president of the European Council Antonio Costa that she will step down from her position on 7 February 2027," the ECB said in a statement.
paras.zh: 欧洲央行在一份声明中表示：“欧洲央行行长克里斯蒂娜·拉加德今天通知管理委员会和欧洲理事会主席安东尼奥·科斯塔，她将于 2027 年 2 月 7 日辞去职务。”

paras.en: European Council President Antonio Costa said a process to find her successor would start immediately.
paras.zh: 欧洲理事会主席安东尼奥·科斯塔表示，寻找继任者的程序将立即启动。

paras.en: The announcement comes ahead of a key meeting of the bank this week that is likely to focus on France's deteriorating public finances.
paras.zh: 该公告是在本周央行召开一次重要会议之前宣布的，会议的重点可能是法国不断恶化的公共财政。

paras.en: No reason has so far been given for Lagarde's premature departure, but there has been speculation that she would leave early to enable EU leaders to choose her successor before French elections in the spring that could see a eurosceptic far-right victory influence the choice.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，还没有给出拉加德提前离职的原因，但有人猜测她会提前离职，以便欧盟领导人在春季法国大选之前选择她的继任者，而欧洲怀疑论的极右翼胜利可能会影响这一选择。

paras.en: Her term, which began on November 1, 2019, would normally have ended at the end of October 2027.
paras.zh: 她的任期于 2019 年 11 月 1 日开始，通常应于 2027 年 10 月结束。

paras.en: Lagarde, a former French finance minister, was also head of the International Monetary Fund from 2011 to 2019.
paras.zh: 拉加德曾任法国财政部长，并于 2011 年至 2019 年担任国际货币基金组织总裁。

paras.en: Lagarde 'provided steady and determine stewardship' — Costa
paras.zh: 拉加德“提供了稳定而坚定的管理”——科斯塔

paras.en: Costa praised Lagarde's leadership during her seven-year stint at the ECB helm, a period in which the EU and the world faced great challenges.
paras.zh: 科斯塔赞扬了拉加德在执掌欧洲央行七年期间的领导才能，在此期间，欧盟和世界面临着巨大挑战。

paras.en: "Through a global pandemic, a war in Europe, energy crises and inflation shocks, she has provided a steady and determined stewardship, helping to safeguard stability and the resilience of the euro area," Costa posted on social media.
paras.zh: 科斯塔在社交媒体上发帖称：“经历了全球大流行、欧洲战争、能源危机和通胀冲击，她提供了稳定而坚定的领导，帮助维护了欧元区的稳定和恢复力。”

paras.en: "To ensure a smooth transition to the next leadership of the ECB, the process for the appointment of her successor will be initiated today and will proceed without delay, with a view to a timely decision," Costa said.
paras.zh: 科斯塔表示：“为了确保欧洲央行下一任领导层顺利过渡，继任者的任命程序将于今天启动，并将毫不拖延地进行，以期及时做出决定。”

paras.en: Lagarde herself has voiced satisfaction with her record.
paras.zh: 拉加德本人也对自己的记录表示满意。

paras.en: "I leave this institution with a sense of good work done and an ECB that is fit for the future," Lagarde, a French economist, said in a short video shared on social media.
paras.zh: 法国经济学家拉加德在社交媒体上分享的一段短视频中表示：“我离开这个机构时，感觉工作做得很好，欧洲央行适合未来。”

paras.en: The ECB head is chosen by the leaders of the 21 eurozone countries.
paras.zh: 欧洲央行行长由21个欧元区国家的领导人选出。

paras.en: ECB to decide interest rate, discuss France
paras.zh: 欧洲央行决定利率，讨论法国

paras.en: The announcement of Lagarde's imminent departure comes as the ECB is to hold a meeting this week where it is expected to keep its deposit rate at 2.5%, while signaling that this is likely to rise again before the end of the year.
paras.zh: 拉加德宣布即将离职之际，欧洲央行将于本周召开会议，预计将把存款利率维持在 2.5%，同时暗示存款利率可能会在年底前再次上升。

paras.en: The bank has already raised interest rates twice since June in a bid to curb inflation fueled by the energy shock caused by the Iran war.
paras.zh: 自6月份以来，该银行已两次加息，以抑制伊朗战争造成的能源冲击引发的通货膨胀。

paras.en: However, Thursday's meeting is also likely to focus on the fiscal and political crisis in France, Europe's second-biggest economy.
paras.zh: 然而，周四的会议也可能集中讨论欧洲第二大经济体法国的财政和政治危机。

paras.en: French bond yields, which reflect the cost of government borrowing, rose to their highest level in 25 years last week amid a deadlock over next year's budget.
paras.zh: 由于明年预算陷入僵局，反映政府借贷成本的法国债券收益率上周升至25年来的最高水平。

paras.en: Recent protests, at which many demonstrators were calling for more spending on public services, were also marred by considerable violence.
paras.zh: 最近的抗议活动中，许多示威者呼吁增加公共服务支出，但也出现了大量暴力事件。

paras.en: There has been speculation as to whether the ECB could, for the first time, use the Transmission Protection Instrument (TPI), a crisis-fighting tool that allows the bank to buy bonds of a eurozone member if yields rise uncontrollably and there is a risk of financial stress spreading.
paras.zh: 人们猜测欧洲央行是否可以首次使用传输保护工具（TPI），这是一种应对危机的工具，允许欧洲央行在收益率上升失控且存在金融压力蔓延风险的情况下购买欧元区成员国的债券。

paras.en: However, most observers believe the problems in France do not yet meet the strict conditions stipulated for its use.
paras.zh: 然而，大多数观察家认为，法国的问题尚未满足其使用规定的严格条件。

articles.title: Can EU and India work together to secure Indo-Pacific?

paras.en: The European Union is vying for a larger role in Indo-Pacific security as the US finds itself on the back foot in the Eastern Hemisphere.
paras.zh: 随着美国发现自己在东半球处于不利地位，欧盟正在争夺在印太安全中发挥更大作用。

paras.en: India is among the regional powers looking for new allies. Its rising economy and increasingly global ambitions have pushed it into new forums and partnerships, including ever closer defense ties with the European bloc.
paras.zh: 印度是寻找新盟友的地区大国之一。其不断增长的经济和日益增长的全球野心推动其建立新的论坛和伙伴关系，包括与欧洲集团日益密切的防务关系。

paras.en: In January this year, India and the EU signed a Security and Defense Partnership, followed by their first formal Security and Defense Dialogue in March. More meetings followed throughout the year, including the fifth Maritime Security Dialogue in Brussels last month.
paras.zh: 今年1月，印度和欧盟签署了安全与防务伙伴关系，随后于3月举行了首次正式安全与防务对话。全年举行了更多会议，包括上个月在布鲁塞尔举行的第五次海事安全对话。

paras.en: However, while both sides want to boost cooperation on maritime security, working together in the Indo-Pacific remains a challenge — India and European countries simply have different defense priorities.
paras.zh: 然而，尽管双方都希望加强海上安全合作，但在印太地区的合作仍然是一个挑战——印度和欧洲国家的国防重点不同。

paras.en: France a player in the Indian Ocean theater
paras.zh: 法国是印度洋战区的参与者

paras.en: "Europe can be a credible defense partner of India, especially in the maritime theater in general and Indo-Pacific in particular," Mohan Kumar, a former Indian ambassador to France, told DW.
paras.zh: 印度前驻法国大使莫汉·库马尔对德国之声表示：“欧洲可以成为印度可靠的防务伙伴，特别是在整个海上战区，特别是印太地区。”

paras.en: But Europe's capacity to expand its role is constrained by other security crises.
paras.zh: 但欧洲扩大其作用的能力受到其他安全危机的限制。

paras.en: "European distractions such as the conflict in Ukraine, which is of existential importance for it, do detract from this objective and can be a limiting factor," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“乌克兰冲突等欧洲的干扰因素对其存在至关重要，但确实有损于这一目标，并可能成为一个限制因素。”

paras.en: France is a notable exception, given its established military presence in the Indian Ocean.
paras.zh: 鉴于法国在印度洋的军事存在，它是一个明显的例外。

paras.en: "France, with its presence in Reunion Island and Mayotte, is already cooperating with India in the Indian Ocean theater and this cooperation can be intensified," added Kumar.
paras.zh: 库马尔补充道：“法国在留尼汪岛和马约特岛有存在，已经在印度洋战区与印度进行合作，而且这种合作可以加强。”

paras.en: Javed Ashraf, another Indian diplomat, said that France has been "a strong, trusted and consistent security partner across the full spectrum of defense cooperation."
paras.zh: 另一位印度外交官贾韦德·阿什拉夫表示，法国一直是“在全方位防务合作中强大、值得信赖和始终如一的安全伙伴”。

paras.en: "What makes the partnership easier is the acceptance that the two may not always agree or be in a position to cooperate," said Ashraf.
paras.zh: 阿什拉夫说：“让合作变得更容易的是接受两者可能并不总是意见一致或能够合作。”

paras.en: "France also stands out for India because [France] has currently no defense cooperation with Pakistan or with China."
paras.zh: “法国对印度来说也很突出，因为[法国]目前与巴基斯坦或中国没有国防合作。”

paras.en: While France remains the EU's only nuclear power and maintains its strongest military force, a cooperation between Paris and New Delhi does not automatically translate into a coherent European security role across the Indo-Pacific.
paras.zh: 尽管法国仍然是欧盟唯一的核国家，并保持着最强大的军事力量，但巴黎和新德里之间的合作并不会自动转化为欧洲在印太地区协调一致的安全角色。

paras.en: "Europe as an entity has very little role in the Indo-Pacific security despite the announcement of a strategy in 2025," said Tara Kartha, a former member of India's National Security Council Secretariat.
paras.zh: 印度国家安全委员会秘书处前成员塔拉·卡塔表示：“尽管欧洲在 2025 年宣布了一项战略，但作为一个实体，欧洲在印太安全中的作用非常小。”

paras.en: She pointed to political differences among EU members as an obstacle to a coherent security outlook.
paras.zh: 她指出，欧盟成员国之间的政治分歧是实现一致安全前景的障碍。

paras.en: Those differences were on display during the EU's October 15–16 summit in Brussels, when leaders reaffirmed support for Ukraine, but also signaled disagreements over funding and national priorities.
paras.zh: 这些分歧在 10 月 15 日至 16 日布鲁塞尔欧盟峰会上得到了体现，当时领导人重申了对乌克兰的支持，但也表明了在资金和国家优先事项方面存在分歧。

paras.en: This could also explain why, as India's defense ties with Europe keep expanding, much of that cooperation still takes place between New Delhi and individual European nations.
paras.zh: 这也可以解释为什么随着印度与欧洲的防务关系不断扩大，大部分合作仍然发生在新德里与个别欧洲国家之间。

paras.en: Germany, Spain, Italy and Poland have all emerged as important partners.
paras.zh: 德国、西班牙、意大利和波兰都已成为重要的合作伙伴。

paras.en: Ashraf said Brussels could signal broader support for its member states' partnerships with India and provide access to EU-funded programs, boosting cooperation in areas such as maritime security, space, critical minerals, chips and defense technologies.
paras.zh: 阿什拉夫表示，布鲁塞尔可以向其成员国与印度的伙伴关系发出更广泛的支持，并提供参与欧盟资助项目的机会，从而促进海上安全、太空、关键矿产、芯片和国防技术等领域的合作。

paras.en: "India is also becoming an important source of defense supplies for a re-arming Europe," the diplomat added.
paras.zh: 这位外交官补充道：“印度也正在成为欧洲重新武装的重要国防物资来源。”

paras.en: There may also be opportunities to share experience in emerging areas of warfare.
paras.zh: 也可能有机会分享新兴战争领域的经验。

paras.en: "India could also access drone technology in light of valuable experience gained by Europeans in Ukraine," Kumar said.
paras.zh: 库马尔说：“鉴于欧洲人在乌克兰获得的宝贵经验，印度也可以使用无人机技术。”

paras.en: Germany, the EU's largest economy, is another important part of this relationship. Alongside France, it has become a defense partner for India, including through major equipment purchases. India could push for its relationship with Berlin to include industrial partnerships and technology development.
paras.zh: 欧盟最大经济体德国是这一关系的另一个重要组成部分。它与法国一起成为印度的防务伙伴，包括通过购买主要装备。印度可以推动与柏林的关系，包括工业伙伴关系和技术开发。

paras.en: But experts warn that closer defense ties should not be confused with a shared strategic outlook, as European countries have their own priorities.
paras.zh: 但专家警告说，更紧密的防务关系不应与共同的战略前景相混淆，因为欧洲国家有自己的优先事项。

paras.en: The differences between Brussels and New Delhi are particularly clear when it comes to Russia and China.
paras.zh: 当涉及俄罗斯和中国时，布鲁塞尔和新德里之间的差异尤其明显。

paras.en: India still relies heavily on Russian equipment and technology, even as it seeks to diversify its defense supplies. European governments, meanwhile, have been engaged in a tense standoff with Russia since its 2022 invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 尽管印度寻求国防供应多元化，但它仍然严重依赖俄罗斯的装备和技术。与此同时，自俄罗斯 2022 年入侵乌克兰以来，欧洲各国政府一直与俄罗斯陷入紧张对峙。

paras.en: That creates a problem for those seeking to deepen defense industry ties.
paras.zh: 这给那些寻求加深国防工业联系的人带来了问题。

paras.en: "Buying a few big-ticket defense items, such as Rafale fighter jets from France or submarines from Germany, is one thing," said Gulshan Sachdeva, a professor of European Studies at Jawaharlal Nehru University in New Delhi.
paras.zh: 新德里贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁大学欧洲研究教授古尔尚·萨奇德瓦表示：“购买一些大宗国防项目，例如法国的阵风战斗机或德国的潜艇，是一回事。”

paras.en: "However, integrating India's defense industry into the expanding European defense value chain is more challenging as long as Russia remains Europe's principal security concern."
paras.zh: “然而，只要俄罗斯仍然是欧洲的主要安全问题，将印度国防工业融入不断扩大的欧洲国防价值链就更具挑战性。”

paras.en: China presents a different but equally important challenge. For India, China is a rival and source of major security issues, including an ongoing border dispute. While the EU also sees China as a "systemic rival," its members differ in how they balance security concerns with their economic relationships with China.
paras.zh: 中国提出了一个不同但同样重要的挑战。对于印度来说，中国是主要安全问题的竞争对手和根源，其中包括持续的边界争端。尽管欧盟也将中国视为“系统性竞争对手”，但其成员国在如何平衡安全担忧与与中国的经济关系方面存在分歧。

paras.en: These differences complicate attempts to develop a shared assessment of Indo-Pacific threats.
paras.zh: 这些差异使得对印太威胁进行共同评估的尝试变得更加复杂。

paras.en: On a geopolitical level, India wants partnerships that strengthen its capabilities without requiring it to align fully with another power's strategic priorities. European governments are also weighing their regional ambitions against security demands closer to home.
paras.zh: 在地缘政治层面上，印度希望建立能够增强其能力的伙伴关系，而不要求其与另一个大国的战略重点完全一致。欧洲各国政府也在权衡其地区野心与国内安全需求。

paras.en: The new India-EU partnership creates a framework for closer engagement, but it does not amount to a joint security commitment.
paras.zh: 新的印度与欧盟伙伴关系为更密切的接触创造了框架，但并不等于联合安全承诺。

paras.en: Ashraf said the two sides could strengthen their mutual capabilities but were unlikely to exercise a visible influence on the global security order.
paras.zh: 阿什拉夫表示，双方可以加强相互能力，但不太可能对全球安全秩序产生明显影响。

paras.en: For now, maritime domain awareness, information-sharing, defense technology and selective industrial cooperation offer more realistic prospects than a common security role of the EU and India across the Indo-Pacific.
paras.zh: 目前，海域意识、信息共享、国防技术和选择性工业合作比欧盟和印度在印太地区的共同安全角色提供了更现实的前景。

articles.title: Flash floods kill five in Syria

paras.en: Heavy rains have been pouring over several Syrian provinces, leaving at least five people dead, including four children, in northern and eastern regions.
paras.zh: 叙利亚多个省份遭遇暴雨，北部和东部地区至少造成五人死亡，其中包括四名儿童。

paras.en: The four children all drowned in bodies of water across Raqqa and Deir Az Zor governorates, the Ministry of Emergency and Disaster Management said in a statement on Thursday.
paras.zh: 紧急和灾害管理部周四在一份声明中表示，这四名儿童均在拉卡省和代尔祖尔省的水体中溺亡。

paras.en: A man also died when his car was caught in floodwaters near al-Salmani Bridge in the western Raqqa countryside.
paras.zh: 拉卡西部乡村的萨尔马尼大桥附近，一名男子的汽车被洪水淹没而身亡。

paras.en: Five others, including two children, remain missing in the storms that have drenched the country.
paras.zh: 包括两名儿童在内的另外五人在席卷全国的风暴中仍然失踪。

paras.en: Thursday marked the second day the ministry recorded responses to flooding across the country. It continues to issue situation updates on its X account.
paras.zh: 周四是该部记录全国洪水应对措施的第二天。它继续在其 X 帐户上发布最新情况。

paras.en: The ministry reported infrastructure damage and disruptions to several bridges in affected areas: Aleppo, Raqqa, Deir Az Zor, Hasakah and Homs.
paras.zh: 该部报告了受影响地区的基础设施损坏和多座桥梁中断：阿勒颇、拉卡、代尔祖尔、哈塞克和霍姆斯。

paras.en: State news agency SANA said al-Salmani Bridge, west of Tabqa, collapsed in the flooding, shutting the road linking Raqqa to Aleppo.
paras.zh: 国家通讯社SANA称，塔布卡以西的萨尔马尼大桥在洪水中倒塌，导致连接拉卡和阿勒颇的道路关闭。

paras.en: Emergency teams also reported rescuing 15 civilians whose vehicles were trapped by floodwaters. The ministry said it evacuated approximately 375 families from three camps on the rural outskirts of Raqqa.
paras.zh: 应急小组还报告称，营救了 15 名车辆被洪水困住的平民。该部表示，已从拉卡乡村郊区的三个营地中疏散了约 375 个家庭。

paras.en: This is not the first time the country has faced the threat of heavy rains and the flooding that follows.
paras.zh: 这并不是该国第一次面临暴雨和随之而来的洪水威胁。

paras.en: UNICEF reported in June that 17,000 people had been adversely affected by flooding so far in the year. At the time, the UN agency said 700 families had been displaced, including around 2,000 children, and that 49 water treatment plants in Deir Az Zor and Raqqa governorates had also gone out of service.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会 6 月报告称，今年迄今已有 17,000 人受到洪水的不利影响。当时，联合国机构表示，已有 700 个家庭流离失所，其中包括约 2000 名儿童，代尔祖尔省和拉卡省的 49 个水处理厂也已停止服务。

articles.title: US judge blocks Trump’s Medicaid rule forcing ill to prove impairment

paras.en: A federal judge has ruled against enforcing a new rule by the administration of US President Donald Trump that would require chronically ill people on Medicaid, a public health insurance programme for low-income individuals, to prove themselves “medically frail” to qualify for work exemptions.
paras.zh: 一名联邦法官裁定不执行美国总统唐纳德·特朗普政府的一项新规定，该规定要求接受医疗补助（一项针对低收入个人的公共健康保险计划）的慢性病患者证明自己“身体虚弱”，才有资格获得工作豁免。

paras.en: US District Judge Richard Stearns blocked the rule on Thursday, siding with 25 states and the District of Columbia, which had sued the Trump administration in June over the change, arguing that it unlawfully limits exemptions for people with serious medical conditions.
paras.zh: 美国地区法官理查德·斯特恩斯 (Richard Stearns) 周四阻止了这一规定，他站在 25 个州和哥伦比亚特区一边，哥伦比亚特区曾于 6 月就这一变化起诉特朗普政府，认为该规定非法限制了对患有严重疾病的人的豁免。

paras.en: The law says the definition of medically frail must include people who are blind or disabled, have substance use disorders or disabling mental disorders, have certain disabilities that significantly impair daily activities, or have serious or complex medical conditions.
paras.zh: 该法律规定，身体虚弱的定义必须包括失明或残疾、患有药物滥用障碍或致残性精神障碍、患有严重影响日常活动的某些残疾或患有严重或复杂疾病的人。

paras.en: But the administration’s rule went further, requiring people in those categories to show that their conditions also “significantly impair” their ability to comply with the law’s work requirements.
paras.zh: 但政府的规定更进一步，要求这些类别的人证明他们的条件也“严重损害”他们遵守法律工作要求的能力。

paras.en: The plaintiffs argued that the stricter rule would prevent eligible Americans from accessing the care they need, and that it oversteps the law’s text.
paras.zh: 原告辩称，更严格的规则将阻止符合条件的美国人获得他们所需的护理，并且它超越了法律文本。

paras.en: “The states have met their burden of showing irreparable harm for which monetary damages would provide inadequate compensation – they face the burden of costly and intensive alterations to their eligibility verification systems,” Stearns said in his 16-page ruling.
paras.zh: 斯特恩斯在长达 16 页的裁决中表示，“各州已经承担了显示无法弥补的损害的责任，而金钱损失不足以提供足够的赔偿——他们面临着对其资格验证系统进行代价高昂和密集修改的负担。”

paras.en: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, the agency that adopted the rule, declined to comment.
paras.zh: 采用该规则的机构医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心拒绝发表评论。

paras.en: Medicaid is a public health insurance programme for low-income people, funded by state and federal governments.
paras.zh: 医疗补助是一项针对低收入人群的公共健康保险计划，由州和联邦政府资助。

paras.en: Starting January 1, 2027, Medicaid expansion enrollees aged 19 to 64 must show that they work or do community service at least 80 hours a month, or are in school at least half the time. There are exceptions for those considered medically frail or in addiction treatment programmes, among others.
paras.zh: 从 2027 年 1 月 1 日开始，年龄在 19 岁至 64 岁之间的医疗补助扩展参与者必须证明他们每月工作或从事社区服务至少 80 个小时，或者至少有一半的时间在学校。那些被认为身体虚弱或正在接受成瘾治疗计划的人等也有例外。

paras.en: Notably, while the ruling will make it easier for some Medicaid recipients with qualifying medical conditions to obtain an exemption from the new work requirements, Stearns’s decision does not strike down the work requirements as unlawful.
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，虽然该裁决将使一些具有合格医疗条件的医疗补助受益人更容易获得新工作要求的豁免，但斯特恩斯的决定并没有将工作要求视为非法。

paras.en: Stearns serves in the District of Massachusetts and was appointed by President Bill Clinton.
paras.zh: 斯特恩斯在马萨诸塞州特区任职，由比尔·克林顿总统任命。

paras.en: His ruling upheld two other federal restrictions on how states can verify medical frailty that the states and the District of Columbia had also contested.
paras.zh: 他的裁决维持了关于各州如何核实医疗缺陷的另外两项联邦限制，各州和哥伦比亚特区也对此提出了异议。

articles.title: Venezuela’s Machado lauds Trump for ‘freedom’, urges 2027 elections

paras.en: Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado has thanked US President Donald Trump’s administration for opening the “floodgate to freedom” by abducting President Nicolas Maduro in January.
paras.zh: 委内瑞拉反对派领导人玛丽亚·科里纳·马查多感谢美国总统唐纳德·特朗普政府在一月份绑架了尼古拉斯·马杜罗总统，打开了“自由的闸门”。

paras.en: The Nobel Peace Prize laureate on Thursday also called for elections to be held in Venezuela next year, in her first public remarks since returning from more than 10 months in exile.
paras.zh: 这位诺贝尔和平奖获得者周四还呼吁委内瑞拉明年举行选举，这是她流亡十多个月回国后的首次公开讲话。

paras.en: “Thanks to their vision, their courage, and their action on January 3, the floodgate to freedom has been opened,” Machado told a news conference in Caracas, naming Trump, his administration and Secretary of State Marco Rubio.
paras.zh: 马查多在加拉加斯举行的新闻发布会上表示：“由于他们的远见、勇气和 1 月 3 日的行动，自由的闸门已经打开。”他点名特朗普、他的政府和国务卿马可·卢比奥。

paras.en: Rubio “has set out a sequence of events aimed at moving toward a democratic transition that makes clear the holding of presidential elections in 2027”, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，卢比奥“已经制定了一系列旨在实现民主过渡的活动，明确了将于 2027 年举行总统选举”。

paras.en: Machado has praised Trump before, presenting the president with her Nobel medal – a prize he feverishly coveted for himself in 2025.
paras.zh: 马查多此前曾赞扬过特朗普，并向总统颁发了诺贝尔奖章——这​​是他在 2025 年为自己疯狂渴望获得的奖项。

paras.en: A longtime activist, Machado fled Venezuela for Oslo in December to accept the Nobel Peace Prize. On Thursday, she said she had come home to “mobilise society”. US special forces veterans with an organisation called Grey Bull Rescue helped Machado escape by boat after she spent a year in hiding from Maduro’s regime.
paras.zh: 作为一名长期的活动家，马查多于 12 月逃离委内瑞拉前往奥斯陆接受诺贝尔和平奖。周四，她说她回家是为了“动员社会”。在马杜罗躲避马杜罗政权一年后，美国特种部队退伍军人与灰牛救援组织帮助马查多乘船逃亡。

paras.en: Since Maduro’s abduction in January, the country has been ruled by his former Vice President Delcy Rodriguez.
paras.zh: 自马杜罗一月份被绑架以来，该国一直由他的前副总统德尔西·罗德里格斯统治。

paras.en: Machado was greeted by cheering supporters as she travelled in her motorcade after she returned to Venezuela on Sunday. Rodriguez voiced distaste for the fanfare.
paras.zh: 马查多周日返回委内瑞拉后，在车队中受到了欢呼的支持者的欢迎。罗德里格斯对这种大张旗鼓表示厌恶。

paras.en: “The show could have been avoided – the airports are right here,” she said on state television.
paras.zh: “这场演出本来可以避免——机场就在这里，”她在国家电视台上说道。

paras.en: When asked about a possible meeting with Rodriguez, the opposition leader said she had not received any message from her or from Washington.
paras.zh: 当被问及是否可能与罗德里格斯会面时，这位反对派领导人表示，她没有收到她或华盛顿的任何消息。

paras.en: Shortly before Machado’s statements on Thursday, Rodriguez assured the nation that elections would be held in Venezuela “with the world as witness” but did not specify a date.
paras.zh: 在马查多周四发表声明之前不久，罗德里格斯向全国保证，选举将在委内瑞拉举行，“全世界都将见证”，但没有具体说明日期。

paras.en: Her return comes just weeks after a controversial US oil deal that will see Venezuela hand over 20 percent of its vast oil reserves.
paras.zh: 就在她回归的几周前，美国达成了一项颇具争议的石油协议，委内瑞拉将交出其庞大石油储备的 20%。

paras.en: “This agreement does not reflect the levels of transparency that Venezuelan society wants,” Machado said, criticising the deal.
paras.zh: “这项协议没有反映委内瑞拉社会想要的透明度水平，”马查多批评该协议时说。

articles.title: How AI drones are influencing the course of the Ukraine war
articles.author: Joanna Kakissis

paras.en: How AI drones are influencing the course of the Ukraine war
paras.zh: 人工智能无人机如何影响乌克兰战争的进程

paras.en: KYIV, Ukraine — Like many tech entrepreneurs in Ukraine, Yaroslav Azhnyuk turned to developing drone warfare after Russia's 2022 invasion.
paras.zh: 乌克兰基辅——与乌克兰的许多科技企业家一样，雅罗斯拉夫·阿兹纽克 (Yaroslav Azhnyuk) 在俄罗斯 2022 年入侵后转向开发无人机战争。

paras.en: Drones have transformed the way wars are fought. Azhnyuk says artificial intelligence is making drones faster and more capable.
paras.zh: 无人机改变了战争的方式。阿兹纽克表示，人工智能正在使无人机变得更快、能力更强。

paras.en: "When the other side has orders of magnitudes higher capabilities, it gives you an asymmetric advantage," he says. "It can make you 10,000 times more effective."
paras.zh: “当对方拥有高出几个数量级的能力时，就会给你带来不对称的优势，”他说。 “它可以让你的效率提高一万倍。”

paras.en: Azhnyuk runs the Ukraine-based defense firms The Fourth Law and Odd Systems. They are among the top companies producing AI-powered drones in Ukraine. Dozens of Ukrainian military units already use their autonomous drone, called the Lupynis-10-TFL-1.
paras.zh: 阿兹纽克经营着总部位于乌克兰的国防公司“第四定律”和“奇怪系统”。他们是乌克兰生产人工智能无人机的顶级公司之一。数十个乌克兰军事单位已经使用了名为 Lupynis-10-TFL-1 的自主无人机。

paras.en: Russia is also deploying AI-enabled drones against Ukraine. AI warfare is part of a high-tech arms race that has many worried, including Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. He has warned that AI could lead decisions on the battlefield as soon as next year.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯还针对乌克兰部署人工智能无人机。人工智能战争是高科技军备竞赛的一部分，引起许多人的担忧，其中包括乌克兰总统泽伦斯基。他警告说，人工智能最早可能在明年主导战场决策。

paras.en: Azhnyuk told NPR that he acknowledges the concern over destructive weapons but says it's not specific to AI.
paras.zh: 阿兹纽克告诉美国国家公共广播电台，他承认人们对破坏性武器的担忧，但表示这并不是专门针对人工智能的。

paras.en: "It has been with humanity since the invention of fire or steel," he says. "Any kind of tool can be used for good or for bad. And in the end, it's the human that decides how to use that tool."
paras.zh: “自从火或钢发明以来，它就一直伴随着人类，”他说。 “任何类型的工具都可以用来做好事，也可以用来做坏事。最终，是人类决定如何使用该工具。”

paras.en: Azhnyuk is 37, a gregarious computer scientist who hails from a family of scholars and scientists. NPR meets him in a conference room in Kyiv; for security reasons he asked us not to reveal much else about the location.
paras.zh: 阿兹纽克现年 37 岁，是一位善于交际的计算机科学家，出身于学者和科学家家庭。 NPR 在基辅的一间会议室与他会面；出于安全原因，他要求我们不要透露有关该地点的更多信息。

paras.en: He worked for years in Silicon Valley and started several companies, including Petcube, which makes smartphone-powered cameras that use artificial intelligence to watch and even entertain pets while they're alone.
paras.zh: 他在硅谷工作了多年，创办了几家公司，其中包括 Petcube，该公司生产智能手机驱动的摄像头，利用人工智能来观察甚至娱乐宠物独处时的情况。

paras.en: "These cameras allow pet parents to watch pets when they're not at home," he says, "and fling treats to them and shine a laser toy for them. We sold a million of these devices that are quite popular in the U.S."
paras.zh: “这些摄像头可以让宠物父母在宠物不在家时观察它们，”他说，“并向它们扔零食，并为它们照射激光玩具。我们售出了 100 万个这样的设备，这些设备在美国很受欢迎。”

paras.en: After Russia launched its full-scale war, Azhnyuk, by then living in Ukraine, pivoted to the defense space.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯发动全面战争后，当时居住在乌克兰的阿兹纽克转向了国防领域。

paras.en: "I was like, OK, I've got to move on from Petcube and do something to protect my country," he says. "And so now we're making not cameras that fling treats but cameras that fling explosives at people who came to occupy our land."
paras.zh: “我当时想，好吧，我必须离开 Petcube，做一些事情来保护我的国家，”他说。 “所以现在我们制造的不是可以投掷零食的摄像机，而是可以向占领我们土地的人投掷炸药的摄像机。”

paras.en: The cameras he's talking about are part of an image recognition system incorporated into first-person-view or FPV drones.
paras.zh: 他所说的相机是第一人称视角或 FPV 无人机中图像识别系统的一部分。

paras.en: "We are leaders in autonomous drones and thermal cameras," he says.
paras.zh: “我们是自主无人机和热像仪领域的领导者，”他说。

paras.en: The autonomous Lupynis TFL-1 drone combines a small, affordable FPV drone with an autonomous terminal guidance unit. That means the drone has an onboard computer and AI technology that takes control during the last 500 meters (or 0.3 miles) of the flight.
paras.zh: Lupynis TFL-1 自主无人机将小型、经济实惠的 FPV 无人机与自主终端制导装置结合在一起。这意味着无人机拥有机载计算机和人工智能技术，可以在飞行的最后 500 米（或 0.3 英里）期间进行控制。

paras.en: "But it's very different from, say, the kind of AI that sits on those data centers that power Claude," he says. "Or even the kind of AI that does self-driving for your Tesla."
paras.zh: “但这与为克劳德提供动力的数据中心上的人工智能有很大不同，”他说。 “甚至是为你的特斯拉自动驾驶的人工智能。”

paras.en: Azhnyuk says this AI technology uses simple tools to recognize images and make smart software "which then allows you either to navigate autonomously without a human or to choose a target autonomously or to fly toward the target autonomously."
paras.zh: 阿兹纽克表示，这项人工智能技术使用简单的工具来识别图像并制作智能软件，“然后它可以让你在没有人类的情况下自主导航，或者自主选择目标，或者自主飞向目标。”

paras.en: The Fourth Law's autonomous drone is named after the 20th century Ukrainian poet and political activist Anatoliy Lupynis, who endured decades of Soviet imprisonment and psychiatric torture. The company named all its weapons after Ukrainian intellectuals and artists killed or persecuted by Russians in the last century.
paras.zh: 第四定律的自主无人机以 20 世纪乌克兰诗人和政治活动家阿纳托利·卢皮尼斯 (Anatoliy Lupynis) 的名字命名，他忍受了几十年的苏联监禁和精神折磨。该公司以上个世纪被俄罗斯人杀害或迫害的乌克兰知识分子和艺术家的名字命名其所有武器。

paras.en: "It is important for us to help to resurrect those people," Azhnyuk says. "Their ideas are still with us. And now they're fighting back."
paras.zh: 阿兹纽克说：“帮助这些人复活对我们来说很重要。” “他们的想法仍然存在。现在他们正在反击。”

paras.en: The Fourth Law teams test the Lupynis TFL-1 drones every day. We meet one team in an overgrown field outside Kyiv. They've set up a fold-out table near a copse of trees and a hornets' nest.
paras.zh: 第四定律团队每天都会测试 Lupynis TFL-1 无人机。我们在基辅郊外一片杂草丛生的田野里遇到了一支队伍。他们在树林和马蜂窝附近摆了一张折叠桌。

paras.en: A slight, sandy-haired man stands up from the fold-out table and says he's the head of the test and integration team. He uses the military call sign Stab. The Fourth Law asked NPR not to reveal this location or the identities of those who work here for security reasons.
paras.zh: 一个身材瘦小的、黄褐色头发的男人从折叠桌上站起来，说他是测试和集成团队的负责人。他使用军事呼号“Stab”。出于安全原因，第四条法律要求 NPR 不得透露该地点或在此工作的人员的身份。

paras.en: "So you see here is our camera, plus the microcomputer inside this 3-D model," Stab says. "All of the mind is here," he adds with a laugh.
paras.zh: “所以你可以看到这里是我们的相机，以及这个 3D 模型内的微型计算机，”Stab 说。 “所有的心思都在这里，”他笑着补充道。

paras.en: The microcomputer inside the drone runs on a deep-learning neural network that uses hours of combat footage to recognize targets.
paras.zh: 无人机内部的微型计算机在深度学习神经网络上运行，该网络使用数小时的战斗镜头来识别目标。

paras.en: "Like vehicles, light-armored vehicles, tanks, and flying objects," he says.
paras.zh: “比如车辆、轻型装甲车、坦克和飞行物体，”他说。

paras.en: The drone begins its flight guided by a pilot, who also asked us to use his call sign, Professor. He navigates the drone with a control stick. He selects a target and checks a video monitor. Then he sees a red flash.
paras.zh: 无人机在一名飞行员的引导下开始飞行，飞行员还要求我们使用他的呼号“教授”。他用控制杆操纵无人机。他选择一个目标并检查视频监视器。然后他看到一道红色闪光。

paras.en: The drone has locked onto its target: a dilapidated car an employee is driving along a dirt road. Professor lets go of the control stick. The drone flies itself to the car. The microcomputer inside constantly runs algorithms to keep it on course.
paras.zh: 无人机已锁定目标：一名员工在土路上行驶的一辆破旧汽车。教授松开控制杆。无人机自动飞向汽车。内部的微型计算机不断运行算法以保持其正常运行。

paras.en: "See, Professor is doing nothing, and the drone is doing everything itself," Stab says.
paras.zh: “看，教授什么也没做，无人机自己做所有事情，”斯塔布说。

paras.en: On the battlefield, the drone would carry an explosive to hit the car. The test drone doesn't have one.
paras.zh: 在战场上，无人机会携带炸药攻击汽车。测试无人机没有。

paras.en: Stab says AI drones are useful because they're hard to jam. He also insists safeguards are in place so The Fourth Law drones won't go rogue. Humans select the target, he says.
paras.zh: 斯塔布表示，人工智能无人机很有用，因为它们很难被干扰。他还坚称，保障措施已经到位，因此第四定律无人机不会失控。他说，人类选择目标。

paras.en: Back in the conference room, Azhnyuk says his company's AI-powered drones are not killer robots.
paras.zh: 回到会议室，阿兹纽克表示，他公司的人工智能无人机并不是杀手机器人。

paras.en: "They're very far from a Terminator kind of scenario, right?" he says. "These are just sort of calculators. Like they're no more likely for a Terminator uprising than a warehouse with artillery shells."
paras.zh: “他们离终结者那种场景还很远，对吧？”他说。 “这些只是计算器之类的。就像它们不太可能引发终结者​​起义，就像一个装着炮弹的仓库一样。”

paras.en: He does acknowledge, though, that AI is developing quickly. "It's not unthinkable," he says, "to imagine that some years in the future there will be drones that will be able to make their own decisions on designating targets or not."
paras.zh: 不过，他确实承认人工智能正在快速发展。 “这并非不可想象，”他说，“想象未来几年将会出现能够自行决定是否指定目标的无人机。”

paras.en: That's the future. Right now he is focused on what Ukraine needs today.
paras.zh: 这就是未来。现在他专注于乌克兰今天的需求。

paras.en: "Our adversaries are using the very same technologies, and if they use AI for decision-making in an offensive scenario, and if we refuse to use AI in decision-making in a defensive scenario, we've lost, right?" he says. "Because their systems are capable of making decisions in microseconds, and human control takes minutes, hours and sometimes days."
paras.zh: “我们的对手正在使用完全相同的技术，如果他们在进攻场景中使用人工智能进行决策，而如果我们拒绝在防御场景中使用人工智能进行决策，那么我们就输了，对吗？”他说。 “因为他们的系统能够在微秒内做出决策，而人类的控制需要几分钟、几小时，有时甚至几天。”

paras.en: If Ukraine loses, he says, "there's no way for us to argue about the ethics of AI."
paras.zh: 他说，如果乌克兰输了，“我们就没有办法争论人工智能的道德问题。”

paras.en: The most important thing, he says, is don't die.
paras.zh: 他说，最重要的是不要死。

paras.en: NPR's Polina Lytvynova contributed to this story from Kyiv.
paras.zh: NPR 的 Polina Lytvynova 在基辅对这篇报道做出了贡献。

articles.title: GDP report to give insight before Election Day. And, Israel's election is deadlocked
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: GDP report to give insight before Election Day. And, Israel's election is deadlocked
paras.zh: GDP 报告将在选举日之前提供见解。而且，以色列选举陷入僵局

paras.en: As Election Day approaches, data suggest that the focus is now less on whether a Democratic wave will happen and more on its potential magnitude. Democrats continue to invest in competitive Republican-dominated races, and Republicans are matching those efforts. An NPR analysis found 70 districts where both Democrats and Republicans are investing more than six figures in their final messaging. These are the races to watch.
paras.zh: 随着选举日的临近，数据表明，现在人们关注的焦点不再是民主党浪潮是否会发生，而是其潜在的规模。民主党人继续投资于共和党主导的竞争性竞选，共和党人也在做出同样的努力。 NPR 的一项分析发现，民主党和共和党在 70 个选区的最终信息传递上投入了超过六位数的资金。这些都是值得观看的比赛。

paras.en: - 🎧 Former President Barack Obama campaigned last night in Georgia for Democrats, highlighting the high cost of living and how Trump's policies contribute to rising prices, NPR's Stephen Fowler tells Up First. Democratic Sen. Jon Ossoff is likely to win the Senate race, while Georgia's governor race remains uncertain. Millions have already cast their votes early, and Fowler says data show increased turnout among Latino and young voters in Democratic areas, as well as among non-supervoters, who typically don't participate in primaries. The trend creates some uncertainty around what the final electorate will look like, and indicates that Republicans will have to rely on a large Election Day turnout to stay competitive, Fowler says.
paras.zh: - 🎧 前总统巴拉克·奥巴马昨晚在佐治亚州为民主党竞选，强调了高昂的生活成本以及特朗普的政策如何导致物价上涨，NPR 的斯蒂芬·福勒 (Stephen Fowler) 告诉 Up First。民主党参议员乔恩·奥索夫很可能赢得参议院竞选，而佐治亚州州长竞选仍不确定。数百万人已经提前投票，福勒说，数据显示，民主党地区的拉丁裔和年轻选民以及通常不参加初选的非超级选民的投票率有所增加。福勒说，这一趋势给最终选民的情况带来了一些不确定性，并表明共和党人将不得不依靠选举日的大量投票率来保持竞争力。

paras.en: - ➡️ A federal judge has denied the Department of Justice's emergency request to halt the processing of ballots for 20,000 individuals it identified as "likely" noncitizens. The department filed a notice that it is appealing the decision.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 一名联邦法官拒绝了司法部停止处理 20,000 名“可能”非公民个人选票的紧急请求。该部门已发出通知，表示正在对该决定提出上诉。

paras.en: - ➡️ Across the U.S., voters will see 145 statewide ballot measures on the November ballot, according to Ballotpedia. Key themes include abortion, LGBTQ+ rights, taxes, and voting.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 根据 Ballotpedia 的数据，在美国各地，选民将在 11 月份的投票中看到 145 项全州投票措施。关键主题包括堕胎、LGBTQ+ 权利、税收和投票。

paras.en: - ➡️ The NPR App has all of NPR's election coverage in one place — from the biggest stories across the country, to the issues that matter close to home. Browse headlines, playlists, podcast episodes, videos and more, all on the 2026 Election tab.
paras.zh: - ➡️ NPR 应用程序将 NPR 的所有选举报道集中在一个地方 - 从全国最大的新闻到与家庭息息相关的问题。浏览头条新闻、播放列表、播客剧集、视频等，所有这些都在 2026 年选举选项卡上。

paras.en: Americans will receive a final reading on the country's gross domestic product and the state of inflation today before next week's midterm election. The report will show whether the economy grew faster in the summer compared to spring. Economists expect GDP to be higher, but some say the growth feels delicate.
paras.zh: 今天，在下周中期选举之前，美国人将收到有关该国国内生产总值和通胀状况的最终数据。该报告将显示夏季经济增长是否比春季更快。经济学家预计国内生产总值会更高，但有些人表示增长感觉很微妙。

paras.en: - 🎧 The tech industry's continued investment in artificial intelligence and consumer spending are driving the GDP, NPR's Stephan Bisaha says. But economist Mark Zandi tells him it's a "very, very fragile growth." Zandi blames inflation for this sense of fragility. Consumer prices rose 3.7% in September from a year earlier, and prices are outpacing wage growth. After keeping interest rates steady yesterday, the Fed will be paying close attention to today's inflation reading from the Commerce Department.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的 Stephan Bisaha 表示，科技行业对人工智能的持续投资和消费者支出正在推动 GDP 增长。但经济学家马克·赞迪告诉他，这是“非常非常脆弱的增长”。赞迪将这种脆弱感归咎于通货膨胀。 9月份消费者价格同比上涨3.7%，物价涨幅超过工资涨幅。在昨天维持利率稳定之后，美联储将密切关注今天商务部的通胀数据。

paras.en: Israel's election is in a deadlock. More than 90% of the votes have been counted, and no candidate has a clear path to forming a coalition. Parties need 61 seats in parliament for a majority. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his allies have secured 53 seats, while his top rival Gadi Eisenkot and his allies have garnered 48.
paras.zh: 以色列选举陷入僵局。超过90%的选票已经清点完毕，没有候选人有明确的组建联盟路径。政党需要在议会中获得 61 个席位才能获得多数席位。总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡及其盟友获得了 53 个席位，而他的头号竞争对手加迪·艾森科特及其盟友获得了 48 个席位。

paras.en: - 🎧 NPR's Daniel Estrin says there are several options for breaking the impasse. Eisenkot's camp could win by partnering with Arab-led parties, which recently secured a record 19 seats in parliament, NPR's Daniel Estrin says. But this partnership seems unlikely due to the political risks. Estrin says Arab political leaders in Israel have been demonized. Israel could hold repeat elections, but Eisenkot doesn't want that because the opposition would have a hard time getting votes a second time. Estrin says Eisenkot will be under pressure to enter a unity government with Netanyahu, especially if Israel launches a new war with Iran.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的丹尼尔·埃斯特林 (Daniel Estrin) 表示，打破僵局有多种选择。 NPR 的丹尼尔·埃斯特林 (Daniel Estrin) 表示，艾森科特的阵营可以通过与阿拉伯领导的政党合作获胜，这些政党最近在议会中获得了创纪录的 19 个席位。但由于政治风险，这种伙伴关系似乎不太可能。埃斯特林说，以色列的阿拉伯政治领导人已被妖魔化。以色列可以举行重复选举，但艾森科特不希望这样做，因为反对派很难再次获得选票。埃斯特林表示，艾森科特将面临与内塔尼亚胡组成联合政府的压力，特别是如果以色列与伊朗发动新的战争。

paras.en: A lawsuit filed yesterday against the Department of Education alleges that the Trump administration is illegally refusing to follow the rules of a program known as "closed school discharge." For more than three decades, federal law has required the U.S. Secretary of Education to cancel debts for qualified borrowers when their schools close unexpectedly. Student Defense, a nonprofit borrower advocacy group, filed the suit on behalf of potentially thousands of borrowers. The Education Department told NPR it stands by its implementation of the program.
paras.zh: 昨天针对教育部提起的诉讼称，特朗普政府非法拒绝遵守“学校停课”计划的规则。三十多年来，联邦法律一直要求美国教育部长在学校意外关闭时取消合格借款人的债务。非营利借款人权益倡导组织学生保护组织代表数千名潜在借款人提起诉讼。教育部告诉美国国家公共广播电台，它支持该计划的实施。

paras.en: Bernie Taupin is Elton John's lyricist on nearly every album. Now, for the first time in 40 years, he's stepping into the spotlight. His new album, The Sea Has No Mercy, features a collection of songs entirely written and sung by him. Taupin admits that until recently, he hadn't considered writing for himself, but now he's ready to share his own musical voice. He tells Morning Edition's A Martínez that more so than a songwriter and a lyricist, Taupin thinks of himself as a storyteller. Listen to snippets of the album and hear about how Taupin has been able to keep his and John's relationship so strong.
paras.zh: 伯尼·陶平 (Bernie Taupin) 几乎是埃尔顿·约翰 (Elton John) 每张专辑的作词者。现在，40 年来他第一次成为人们关注的焦点。他的新专辑《The Sea Has No Mercy》包含完全由他创作和演唱的歌曲集。陶平承认，直到最近，他还没有考虑过为自己写作，但现在他准备分享自己的音乐声音。他告诉早间版的马丁内斯，陶平不仅是一位歌曲作者和作词家，还认为自己是一个讲故事的人。聆听专辑的片段，了解陶平如何能够保持他和约翰的牢固关系。

paras.en: Medicare's open enrollment window runs through Dec. 7. More than half of Americans in Medicare choose a Medicare Advantage plan, which is run by private insurers instead of the federal government. Medicare Advantage is popular because it covers dental and vision, often with lower premiums than traditional Medicare. But private carriers can pick and choose where it's offered, and withdraw from unprofitable communities. Over the last three years, insurers have left regions on an increasingly large scale, according to recent JAMA research. Here are some tips to help navigate Medicare open enrollment this year:
paras.zh: Medicare 的开放投保窗口截止到 12 月 7 日。超过一半的 Medicare 美国人选择 Medicare Advantage 计划，该计划由私人保险公司而非联邦政府运营。 Medicare Advantage 很受欢迎，因为它涵盖牙科和视力，而且保费通常比传统 Medicare 低。但私人运营商可以选择提供服务的地点，并退出无利可图的社区。根据《美国医学会杂志》最近的研究，在过去三年里，保险公司离开地区的规模越来越大。以下是一些有助于引导今年医疗保险公开注册的提示：

paras.en: - ➡️ Check if your Medicare Advantage plan is still offered. Plans closing should have sent letters in early October. You can also log in to Medicare.gov to verify your plan's status.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 检查您的 Medicare Advantage 计划是否仍然提供。计划结束应该在十月初寄出信件。您还可以登录 Medicare.gov 验证您的计划状态。

paras.en: - ➡️ Try calling your state's State Health Insurance Assistance Program. It's free, federally mandated and offers unbiased information on all options. Visit shiphelp.org to find your state's program.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 尝试致电您所在州的州健康保险援助计划。它是免费的、联邦政府强制执行的，并提供有关所有选项的公正信息。请访问 Shiphelp.org 以查找您所在州的计划。

paras.en: - ➡️ Look for local Medicare counseling services. Brokers can be helpful, but make sure to choose one who discusses all your options, including traditional Medicare and supplemental plans.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 寻找当地的医疗保险咨询服务。经纪人可能会有所帮助，但请务必选择一位能够讨论您所有选择的经纪人，包括传统的医疗保险和补充计划。

paras.en: - ➡️ Double-check anything you see on Medicare's Plan Finder with your doctor's office or other Medicare assister.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 与您的医生办公室或其他 Medicare 助手仔细检查您在 Medicare 计划查找器上看到的任何内容。

paras.en: - ➡️ Be cautious about sharing your personal information, such as your phone number. Some online agencies may sell it, leading to spam calls and potential scams.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 谨慎分享您的个人信息，例如您的电话号码。一些在线机构可能会出售它，从而导致垃圾电话和潜在的诈骗。

paras.en: - American automakers reported increased revenues for the third quarter but face serious challenges. They are paying more for key components like computer chips, steel and copper, as well as higher transport fuel costs.
paras.zh: - 美国汽车制造商报告第三季度收入增加，但面临严峻挑战。他们为计算机芯片、钢铁和铜等关键部件支付了更高的费用，并且运输燃料成本也更高。

paras.en: - A hacking group breached the U.S. Department of Homeland Security's personnel files yesterday, exposing the names, phone numbers and addresses of over 40,000 DHS agents and associates, including those in undercover operations.
paras.zh: - 昨天，一个黑客组织入侵了美国国土安全部的人事档案，暴露了超过 40,000 名国土安全部特工和同事的姓名、电话号码和地址，其中包括从事卧底行动的人员。

paras.en: - The Department of Health and Human Services announced a new policy that will let small compounding pharmacies make six peptides that haven't been approved by the Food and Drug Administration.
paras.zh: - 卫生与公众服务部宣布了一项新政策，允许小型复合药房生产六种未经食品和药物管理局批准的肽。

articles.title: What killed 500-plus penguins? How scientists solved the mystery
articles.author: Gabrielle Emanuel

paras.en: What killed 500-plus penguins? How scientists solved the mystery
paras.zh: 是什么杀死了 500 多只企鹅？科学家如何解开这个谜团

paras.en: Sailing toward the Danger Islands, Dr. Ralph Vanstreels had a good idea of what he might find: A lot of dead Adélie penguins.
paras.zh: 在驶向危险群岛的途中，拉尔夫·范斯特里斯博士很清楚他可能会发现什么：大量死去的阿德利企鹅。

paras.en: It was March 2024 and a virus had been sweeping through the area, leaving deceased birds in its wake.
paras.zh: 那是 2024 年 3 月，一种病毒席卷了该地区，留下了死去的鸟类。

paras.en: Vanstreels got the crime right but the culprit wrong. There were dead penguins but a virus was not to blame.
paras.zh: 范斯特里尔斯的罪行是正确的，但罪魁祸首却是错误的。有企鹅死亡，但病毒并不是罪魁祸首。

paras.en: As his vessel pulled up to a landing ramp on one of the islands — located just off the Antarctic Peninsula — Vanstreels and his fellow researchers immediately noticed bumps in the snow.
paras.zh: 当他的船停在位于南极半岛附近的一个岛屿上的登陆坡道时，范斯特里尔斯和他的研究同事们立即注意到雪上有凹凸不平的地方。

paras.en: "Was each bump a rock or was it a carcass? We had to do quite a bit of intensive searching [through the snow]," says Vanstreels, who is based in Argentina and is a wildlife veterinarian with the University of California, Davis.
paras.zh: “每个撞击物是一块石头还是一具尸体？我们必须在雪地里进行大量的密集搜索，”住在阿根廷、加州大学戴维斯分校的野生动物兽医范斯特雷尔斯说。

paras.en: The team ultimately found more than 537 penguin carcasses on just the ramp, which he estimates was about the size of an airport runway.
paras.zh: 研究小组最终在坡道上发现了超过 537 具企鹅尸体，他估计坡道的大小与机场跑道差不多。

paras.en: There were many more carcasses elsewhere on the Danger Islands, which are home to two mega colonies for penguins. The researchers estimate there were thousands of dead Adélie penguins and other species of birds. But they had to work quickly and couldn't do a complete count, Vanstreels says.
paras.zh: 危险群岛的其他地方还有更多的尸体，这里是两个大型企鹅栖息地的所在地。研究人员估计有数千只阿德利企鹅和其他鸟类死亡。但范斯特里斯说，他们必须快速工作，无法完成完整的计数。

paras.en: "You cannot stay there very long because you might be locked down with an iceberg blocking your way out," he says.
paras.zh: “你不能在那里呆太久，因为你可能会被冰山封锁，挡住你的出路，”他说。

paras.en: As the team has pieced together this tragic penguin mystery, Vanstreels says, the case holds broader lessons for tracking the spread of diseases globally.
paras.zh: 范斯特雷尔斯说，当研究小组拼凑出这个悲惨的企鹅之谜时，这个案例为追踪疾病在全球的传播提供了更广泛的教训。

paras.en: The only continent to dodge the virus — until now
paras.zh: 迄今为止唯一避开病毒的大陆

paras.en: Now let's time jump to Australia a few months ago for another bird disease conundrum.
paras.zh: 现在让我们把时间跳到几个月前的澳大利亚，看看另一个鸟类疾病难题。

paras.en: In June, H5N1 — high pathogenicity avian influenza also known as bird flu — arrived in mainland Australia. Up until that point, Australia had been the only continent to dodge the virus which has traversed the globe, leaving a trail of carcasses in its path.
paras.zh: 6月，H5N1——高致病性禽流感，也称为禽流感——抵达澳大利亚大陆。在那之前，澳大利亚是唯一一个躲过这种席卷全球的病毒的大陆，在其传播路径上留下了尸体的踪迹。

paras.en: Since late 2021, the virus has led to the death of nearly 300 million poultry birds. Either the virus killed them or they were culled as a preventive measure to stop the spread of the disease, according to the World Animal Health Information System. Further, bird flu is estimated to have killed millions of wild animals and marine mammals, although it's hard to get an exact figure.
paras.zh: 自2021年底以来，该病毒已导致近3亿只家禽死亡。根据世界动物健康信息系统的数据，要么是病毒杀死了它们，要么是为了阻止疾病传播而将它们扑杀。此外，据估计禽流感已经杀死了数百万野生动物和海洋哺乳动物，尽管很难得到确切的数字。

paras.en: Researchers were amazed that Australia could stay bird-flu-free for six years. And the virus didn't take the path that scientists expected.
paras.zh: 研究人员对澳大利亚能够在六年内保持无禽流感的状态感到惊讶。而且病毒并没有按照科学家预期的方式发展。

paras.en: "We have a lot of migration of birds between Australia and Southeast Asia, so for the first few years, we're like: That's where the virus is coming from," says Dr. Amandine Gamble, an assistant professor at Cornell University in the Department of Public and Ecosystem Health.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学公共与生态系统健康系助理教授阿曼丁·甘布尔博士说：“澳大利亚和东南亚之间有大量鸟类迁徙，因此在最初几年，我们认为：这就是病毒的来源。”

paras.en: The way bird flu eventually got there was from the other direction. It came from Antarctica likely via migrating birds.
paras.zh: 禽流感最终到达那里的方式是从另一个方向。它可能是通过候鸟来自南极洲的。

paras.en: "This is a virus that's not assisted by airplanes," Michelle Wille, senior research fellow at the Center for Pathogen Genomics at the University of Melbourne, told NPR in 2025. "This is a virus that's traveling by mass mortality after mass mortality after mass mortality after mass mortality."
paras.zh: 墨尔本大学病原体基因组学中心高级研究员米歇尔·威尔 (Michelle Wille) 于 2025 年向 NPR 表示：“这是一种没有飞机帮助的病毒。这是一种以大规模死亡方式传播的病毒。”

paras.en: So when Vanstreels set sail to check on the penguins, he assumed bird flu would be the culprit.
paras.zh: 因此，当范斯特雷尔起航检查企鹅时，他认为禽流感是罪魁祸首。

paras.en: Bird flu arrived in Antarctica in late 2023 and early 2024. Vanstreels and his colleagues rapidly arranged for a trip to try to figure out exactly what was happening.
paras.zh: 禽流感于 2023 年底和 2024 年初抵达南极洲。范斯特里斯和他的同事迅速安排了一次旅行，试图弄清楚究竟发生了什么。

paras.en: "The expedition was initially fully set up to look for bird flu because that was the panic," he explains, adding that ongoing fear of a continuing global panzootic — or pandemic among animals — is justified.
paras.zh: 他解释说：“这次探险活动最初是为了寻找禽流感而准备的，因为这引起了恐慌。”他补充说，人们对全球范围内的动物流行病或动物间大流行的持续担忧是有道理的。

paras.en: In several layers of warm clothes covered by protective gear — double gloves, coveralls, glasses and masks — Vanstreels and the team started taking samples of the penguin corpses they found.
paras.zh: 范斯特里尔斯和团队穿着几层保暖的衣服，上面覆盖着防护装备——双层手套、工作服、眼镜和口罩——开始对他们发现的企鹅尸体进行取样。

paras.en: "We looked a little bit stiff when walking — like a penguin walking almost — because of all the gear," he says. "We had very strict biosafety standards."
paras.zh: “由于装备太多，我们走路时看起来有点僵硬——几乎就像企鹅走路一样，”他说。 “我们有非常严格的生物安全标准。”

paras.en: They brought samples from the deceased penguins back to a mini-lab on their boat. By evening, they had early results. But not the results they expected.
paras.zh: 他们将死去企鹅的样本带回船上的迷你实验室。到了晚上，他们就得到了初步结果。但并不是他们所期望的结果。

paras.en: "There is bird flu here, but the virus loads are low," he recalls. "That was a little bit puzzling."
paras.zh: “这里有禽流感，但病毒载量很低，”他回忆道。 “这有点令人费解。”

paras.en: The carcasses were not very old, so Vanstreels would have expected to find far more bird flu virus if that had killed the birds. Perhaps something else was the main driver? "We were unsure what was happening," he recalls.
paras.zh: 这些尸体的年代并不长，所以如果这些鸟儿被禽流感病毒杀死的话，范斯特里尔斯预计会发现更多的禽流感病毒。也许还有其他因素是主要驱动力？ “我们不确定发生了什么，”他回忆道。

paras.en: So what killed the 500-plus penguins on the landing ramp and the many others on the island?
paras.zh: 那么是什么杀死了着陆坡道上的 500 多只企鹅以及岛上的许多其他企鹅呢？

paras.en: Back on land several months after the voyage, in the Netherlands, Vanstreels' colleagues did more investigation. "Under the microscope, you can see that there's bacteria in the tissues," he says — not virus.
paras.zh: 航行几个月后，范斯特雷尔斯的同事回到荷兰陆地，进行了更多调查。 “在显微镜下，你可以看到组织中存在细菌，”他说，而不是病毒。

paras.en: They discovered a different disease, a bacterial disease that causes avian cholera (which is distinct from human cholera).
paras.zh: 他们发现了一种不同的疾病，一种引起禽霍乱（与人类霍乱不同）的细菌性疾病。

paras.en: Vanstreels and his team's findings were published in October in the journal the Proceedings of the Royal Society B.
paras.zh: Vanstreels 和他的团队的研究结果于 10 月发表在《Proceedings of the Royal Society B》杂志上。

paras.en: So how worried are they about avian cholera?
paras.zh: 那么他们对禽霍乱有多担心呢？

paras.en: The disease is not considered a major threat to humans since the strain that is specialized to birds is distinct from the strain specialized to mammals. "The risk for human infection is not really that high when you see an outbreak on birds," Vanstreels says. But, it does kill birds worldwide — especially in cold environments where the bacteria thrives.
paras.zh: 该疾病不被认为是对人类的主要威胁，因为专门针对鸟类的菌株与专门针对哺乳动物的菌株不同。范斯特雷尔斯说：“当鸟类爆发疫情时，人类感染的风险实际上并没有那么高。”但是，它确实会杀死全世界的鸟类——尤其是在细菌繁殖的寒冷环境中。
