paras.en: While there's not enough research to know exactly how common avian cholera is, the disease has been on the radar of scientists for decades. However, it's not exactly top of mind. The last time researchers looked for it in the Antarctic Peninsula was 25 years ago.
paras.zh: 虽然没有足够的研究来确切了解禽霍乱的常见程度，但这种疾病几十年来一直受到科学家的关注。然而，这并不是最重要的。研究人员上次在南极半岛寻找它已经是 25 年前了。

paras.en: "One could be misled to think that: Well, that was a unique thing that happened back in 2001, and nothing's happened ever since," says Vanstreels. Instead, it is possible that avian cholera die-offs could be occurring regularly, only scientists haven't been checking.
paras.zh: “人们可能会被误导，认为：嗯，这是 2001 年发生的一件独特的事情，从那以后就没有发生过任何事情，”Vanstrees 说。相反，禽霍乱死亡可能会经常发生，只是科学家尚未进行检查。

paras.en: One of his big takeaways from this bird-flu-that-turned-out-to-be-avian-cholera event?
paras.zh: 他从这次禽流感后来演变为禽霍乱的事件中得到的最大收获之一是什么？

paras.en: "Yes, there is a big thing with bird flu. But we still want to keep checking for the other diseases because they might be mixing up in the middle," Vanstreels says.
paras.zh: “是的，禽流感是一个大问题。但我们仍然想继续检查其他疾病，因为它们可能会在中间混合起来，”范斯特雷尔斯说。

paras.en: Like any good mystery, the case of the cholera-stricken penguins has got scientists wondering: Whodunit?
paras.zh: 就像任何精彩的谜团一样，遭受霍乱的企鹅的案例让科学家们想知道：到底是谁？

paras.en: There's a theory that avian cholera might have been introduced to Antarctica decades ago from researchers who brought poultry from the U.S., Vanstreels says.
paras.zh: 范斯特雷尔斯说，有一种理论认为，禽霍乱可能是几十年前由从美国带来家禽的研究人员引入南极洲的。

paras.en: Gamble, of Cornell University, adds that the strain of avian cholera found in penguins in Antarctica is "very close" to the strain found 5,000 miles away on Île Amsterdam in the Southern Indian Ocean.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学的甘布尔补充说，在南极洲企鹅身上发现的禽霍乱菌株与 5000 英里外的南印度洋阿姆斯特丹岛发现的禽霍乱菌株“非常接近”。

paras.en: "Antarctica is way more connected to the rest of the world than we think it is," she says.
paras.zh: “南极洲与世界其他地区的联系比我们想象的要紧密得多，”她说。

paras.en: It's hard to track diseases in Antarctica but, she says, it's turning out to be an important piece in the global pathogen puzzle.
paras.zh: 她说，追踪南极洲的疾病很困难，但事实证明，这已成为全球病原体难题中的重要组成部分。

paras.en: The work of keeping tabs on what's happening has fallen to a number of different countries since Antarctica is not governed by any one government. It was designated as a continent of peace and science by the mid 20th-century Antarctic Treaty, which now has 58 parties — among them are the U.S., France, Japan and Russia. Many nations have research stations and team up on scientific undertakings, including tracking pathogens — be it bird flu or avian cholera — that travel great distances and don't respect borders.
paras.zh: 由于南极洲不由任何一个政府管辖，因此密切关注正在发生的事情的工作已经落到了许多不同的国家身上。它被 20 世纪中叶的《南极条约》指定为和平与科学的大陆，该条约目前有 58 个缔约方，其中包括美国、法国、日本和俄罗斯。许多国家都设有研究站并合作开展科学事业，包括追踪病原体（无论是禽流感还是禽霍乱），这些病原体会传播很远的距离并且不尊重国界。

paras.en: "So this Avian cholera outbreak is just showing this is not a unique event," says Gamble. "We really need international collaboration."
paras.zh: 甘布尔说：“所以这次禽霍乱的爆发只是表明这不是一个独特的事件。” “我们确实需要国际合作。”

articles.title: Brewers continue World Series celebration, raise Commissioner’s Trophy at Lambeau Field during Packers game

paras.en: Less than 24 hours after the Milwaukee Brewers captured the franchise’s first World Series title, the team’s celebration continued roughly 120 miles north at Lambeau Field.
paras.zh: 密尔沃基酿酒人队 (Milwaukee Brewers) 夺得球队首个世界大赛冠军后不到 24 小时，球队的庆祝活动在北边约 120 英里的兰博球场 (Lambeau Field) 继续进行。

paras.en: Brewers pitcher Brandon Woodruff brought the Commissioner’s Trophy onto the field Thursday night at the end of the first quarter of the Green Bay Packers’ game against the Carolina Panthers. Teammates Christian Yelich and Sal Frelick also joined the celebration.
paras.zh: 周四晚上，绿湾包装工队对阵卡罗莱纳黑豹队的比赛第一节结束时，酿酒人队投手布兰登·伍德拉夫将专员奖杯带到了球场上。队友克里斯蒂安·耶利奇和萨尔·弗里利克也参加了庆祝活动。

paras.en: Frelick embraced the moment by attempting a Lambeau Leap of his own, drawing a warm reaction from the Packers faithful.
paras.zh: 弗里利克拥抱了这一时刻，他尝试了自己的朗博飞跃，引起了包装工队忠实球迷的热烈反应。

paras.en: Milwaukee could come to a standstill Friday, with thousands of fans expected to line the streets for a victory parade celebrating the Brewers’ long-awaited championship.
paras.zh: 密尔沃基周五可能会陷入停顿，数千名球迷预计将在街道上排队参加胜利游行，庆祝酿酒人队期待已久的冠军。

paras.en: Wisconsin’s largest school district, Milwaukee Public Schools, announced it would close Friday, citing operational and safety concerns. However, the closure will also give faculty and students the opportunity to enjoy the parade.
paras.zh: 威斯康星州最大的学区密尔沃基公立学校宣布将于周五关闭，理由是运营和安全问题。然而，关闭也给了教师和学生享受游行的机会。

paras.en: The parade route will run through downtown Milwaukee before ending with a fan fest at Henry Maier Festival Park.
paras.zh: 游行路线将穿过密尔沃基市中心，最后在亨利·迈尔节日公园举行粉丝盛会。

paras.en: The Packers are likely hoping to build on the Brewers’ success, despite not having won or reached a Super Bowl since the 2010 season.
paras.zh: 尽管包装工队自 2010 赛季以来尚未赢得或进入超级碗，但他们可能希望在酿酒人队的成功基础上再接再厉。

paras.en: The Brewers’ Game 5 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays to clinch the World Series title and the Bucks' 2021 NBA Finals victory means the Packers now own the longest championship drought among Wisconsin’s major men’s professional sports teams.
paras.zh: 酿酒人队在第五场比赛中击败坦帕湾光芒队，夺得世界大赛冠军，而雄鹿队在 2021 年 NBA 总决赛中取得胜利，意味着包装工队现在拥有威斯康星州主要男子职业运动队中最长的冠军荒。

paras.en: Green Bay entered Thursday night’s game coming off a Week 7 loss to the Detroit Lions. The Panthers jumped out to a 3-0 first-quarter lead. The Packers responded by taking a 20-10 halftime lead and extending the advantage to 27-10 in the third quarter.
paras.zh: 绿湾队在第七周输给底特律雄狮队后进入了周四晚上的比赛。首节黑豹队以3-0领先。包装工队做出回应，半场以20-10领先，并在第三节将优势扩大到27-10。

articles.title: Packers WR Christian Watson gets checked at hospital after scary injury, somehow returns to Lambeau Field

paras.en: Seemingly every other game in the NFL these days, there's a scary injury that requires transportation and tests at the hospital. Just in the past few weeks, Jalen Hurts' blood clots and Terry McLaurin's awful leg injury were major stories around the league.
paras.zh: 如今，在 NFL 的每场比赛中，似乎都会出现可怕的伤病，需要运送到医院进行检查。就在过去的几周里，贾伦受伤的血栓和特里·麦克劳林严重的腿部受伤成为了联盟的重大新闻。

paras.en: During Thursday night's game, that injury went to Green Bay Packers star wide receiver Christian Watson. On a play that also hurt a defensive back.
paras.zh: 在周四晚上的比赛中，绿湾包装工队明星外接手克里斯蒂安·沃森受伤。这场比赛也伤害了防守后卫。

paras.en: Watson was in the middle of a huge night against the Carolina Panthers at Lambeau Field, racking up six catches for 100 receiving yards in the first half. His big play came when he brought in a 53-yard catch on a deep ball from Jordan Love about midway through the second quarter, setting the Packers up in great field position as they drove down for another score.
paras.zh: 沃森在兰博球场对阵卡罗莱纳黑豹队的比赛中度过了一个精彩的夜晚，上半场就完成了 6 次接球，推进 100 码。第二节中段，他接到乔丹·乐福 (Jordan Love) 的长传球，在 53 码处接球，为包装工队创造了绝佳的场上位置，并再次得分。

paras.en: But he hit the ground hard while colliding with Panthers cornerback Will Lee III, and was slow to get up. Lee himself also had to be helped to his feet thanks to a hamstring injury, eventually needing the cart to leave the field.
paras.zh: 但他在与黑豹角卫威尔·李三世相撞时重重地摔倒在地，起身缓慢。由于腿筋受伤，李本人也必须被搀扶才能站起来，最终需要推车离开球场。

paras.en: But Watson's injury, at first glance, seemed more serious. The 27-year-old was transported in an ambulance to a hospital near Lambeau Field, undergoing precautionary checks for a chest injury, while Lee was deemed doubtful to return to the game himself. But that's where the story gets crazier, and so much better.
paras.zh: 但沃森的伤势乍一看似乎更严重。 27岁的李被救护车送往朗博球场附近的一家医院，接受胸部受伤的预防性检查，而李本人则被认为无法重返比赛。但这就是故事变得更疯狂、也更好的地方。

paras.en: Not long after leaving for the hospital, Watson, miraculously, returned to Lambeau Field. Quite literally driven back to the stadium in the ambulance, cameras caught him running out of the tunnel back in full pads to, unsurprisingly, a raucous reception from the home crowd.
paras.zh: 去医院后不久，沃森就奇迹般地回到了朗博机场。毫不夸张地说，他被救护车送回体育场，摄像机拍到他穿着防护服跑出球员通道，不出所料，他受到了主场球迷的喧闹欢迎。

paras.en: Seems like Watson either never got out of pads while going to the hospital, going through medical tests while in full uniform, or did an extremely fast quick change. Then he was driven back to the stadium in an ambulance, running directly from the tunnel out to the field. Less than an hour after sustaining what looked to be a scary, and painful, injury.
paras.zh: 沃森似乎要么在去医院时从未脱下护垫，要么在穿着全套制服进行医学检查时从未脱下护垫，要么进行了极快的更换。然后他被救护车送回体育场，直接从隧道跑到球场上。遭受看起来可怕而痛苦的伤害后不到一个小时。

paras.en: And sure enough, Watson returned to the game not long afterward. Even pulling in another reception, as Love found him for a six-yard completion in Carolina territory right at the start of the fourth quarter. Incredible.
paras.zh: 果然，不久之后沃森就重返赛场。甚至还进行了另一次接球，乐福在第四节开始时就在卡罗莱纳境内发现了他的六码完成球。极好的。

paras.en: That drive wound up in a Love interception, but the Packers still took a 27-13 lead into the middle part of the fourth quarter. And they have their star wide receiver back, somehow, after a brief detour to a local hospital. Not that most fans doubt NFL players are tough, but absolutely nobody will be questioning Christian Watson's toughness and commitment to his team anytime soon.
paras.zh: 那次突破最终被乐福拦截，但包装工队在第四节中段仍以27-13领先。在短暂绕道前往当地一家医院后，不知何故，他们的明星外接手又回来了。并不是说大多数球迷怀疑 NFL 球员是否坚强，但绝对没有人会很快质疑克里斯蒂安·沃森的坚韧和对球队的承诺。

articles.title: Packers top Panthers, Brewers storm Lambeau and Christian Watson returns from hospital

paras.en: The Green Bay Packers opened Week 8 with a crucial win, keeping pace in a tightly contested NFC North race.
paras.zh: 绿湾包装工队以一场关键的胜利开启第 8 周的比赛，在竞争激烈的国联北区比赛中保持领先。

paras.en: Jordan Love threw for 288 yards and three touchdowns as Green Bay defeated the Carolina Panthers 27-19 at Lambeau Field Thursday night.
paras.zh: 周四晚上，乔丹·乐福 (Jordan Love) 传球 288 码并取得 3 次达阵，帮助绿湾队 (Green Bay) 在兰博球场 (Lambeau Field) 以 27-19 击败卡罗莱纳黑豹队 (Carolina Panthers)。

paras.en: Bryce Young was sacked six times and threw an interception as Carolina lost its second straight game. Despite the setback, the Panthers remain atop the NFC South and hold the head-to-head tiebreaker after defeating division rival Atlanta in Week 2.
paras.zh: 布莱斯·杨被解雇六次并被拦截，卡罗莱纳队连续第二场失利。尽管遭遇挫折，黑豹队仍然在国联南区排名第一，并在第二周击败分区对手亚特兰大队后，占据了平局决胜局的位置。

paras.en: Packers wide receiver Christian Watson got taken to the hospital after injuring his chest in the second quarter, only to return to the game in the second half.
paras.zh: 包装工队外接手克里斯蒂安·沃森在第二节胸部受伤被送往医院，直到下半场才重返比赛。

paras.en: Watson’s injury occurred as he made a 53-yard catch, with Panthers cornerback Will Lee also getting hurt on the play while making a diving stop. Lee was carted into the locker room with a hamstring injury and didn’t return to the game.
paras.zh: 沃森在 53 码接球时受伤，黑豹队角卫威尔·李也在跳水时受伤。李因腿筋受伤被送进更衣室，并没有重返比赛。

paras.en: After getting sent to the hospital for examination, Watson returned to Lambeau Field and received a huge ovation as he headed back to the field after the Packers had extended their lead to 27-10 in the third quarter. Watson returned to the game later in the third, after Ryan Fitzgerald’s 50-yard field goal made it 27-13.
paras.zh: 被送往医院检查后，沃森回到朗博球场，在第三节包装工队将领先优势扩大到27-10后，他回到球场时受到了热烈的掌声。在瑞安·菲茨杰拉德 (Ryan Fitzgerald) 的 50 码射门将比分改写为 27-13 后，沃森在第三节晚些时候重返比赛。

paras.en: Brewers take victory lap at Lambeau Field
paras.zh: 酿酒商在兰博球场取得胜利

paras.en: Less than 24 hours after the Milwaukee Brewers captured the franchise’s first World Series title, the team’s celebration continued roughly 120 miles north at Lambeau Field.
paras.zh: 密尔沃基酿酒人队 (Milwaukee Brewers) 夺得球队首个世界大赛冠军后不到 24 小时，球队的庆祝活动在北边约 120 英里的兰博球场 (Lambeau Field) 继续进行。

paras.en: Brewers pitcher Brandon Woodruff brought the Commissioner’s Trophy onto the field Thursday night at the end of the first quarter. Teammates Christian Yelich and Sal Frelick also joined the celebration.
paras.zh: 周四晚上，酿酒人队投手布兰登·伍德拉夫在第一节结束时将专员奖杯带到了球场上。队友克里斯蒂安·耶利奇和萨尔·弗里利克也参加了庆祝活动。

paras.en: Watson had six catches for 100 yards before leaving the game.
paras.zh: 沃森在离场前有六次接球推进100码。

paras.en: The Packers will face New England on Nov. 8, while the Panthers will host the Denver Broncos in Charlotte in Week 9.
paras.zh: 包装工队将于 11 月 8 日迎战新英格兰队，黑豹队将于第 9 周在夏洛特迎战丹佛野马队。

paras.en: The Associated Press contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 美联社对此报道作出了贡献。

articles.title: Electrocutions, disease and no pay: how workers risk exploitation in Europe’s datacentres
articles.author: Mei-Ling McNamara

paras.en: Sandu* checked his watch. He was winding down the last 15 minutes of his shift at a vast Google datacentre site in Saint-Ghislain, Belgium, in March, when the call came in. The 34-year-old electrical tester had already worked almost 10 hours, but says such last-minute jobs were normal: “I had no choice. People have been fired after saying no.”
paras.zh: 桑杜*看了看手表。 3 月份，他在比利时圣吉斯兰的一个大型 Google 数据中心工作，当时正值最后 15 分钟，这时接到电话。这位 34 岁的电气测试员已经工作了近 10 个小时，但他表示，这种最后一刻的工作很正常：“我别无选择。人们在拒绝后就被解雇了。”

paras.en: The task was one Sandu had done many times before and involved a series of tests measuring the safety and integrity of the electrical wiring. A protective suit was locked away in an equipment room. The round trip would have added another 15 minutes to the job, he says, and people were waiting, so he decided not to retrieve the suit.
paras.zh: 这项任务是桑杜之前多次完成的，涉及一系列测量电线安全性和完整性的测试。一套防护服被锁在设备室里。他说，往返会使工作时间再增加 15 分钟，而且人们都在等待，所以他决定不取回这套衣服。

paras.en: Once in the voltage room, Sandu says the managers confirmed the lines had been de-energised. In the first round, everything went as planned. Then, on the second test, while holding insulated tongs, he linked the cables. But this time, the lines were live.
paras.zh: 桑杜说，进入电压室后，管理人员确认线路已断电。第一轮比赛，一切都按计划进行。然后，在第二次测试中，他拿着绝缘钳子连接电缆。但这一次，线路已上线。

paras.en: The blast was immediate and catastrophic. In milliseconds, 400 volts and 12,000 amps hit Sandu’s face and across the right side of his body. “I went completely blind,” he says. When doctors received him in the Grand Hôpital de Charleroi, he says he was placed in an induced coma for five days.
paras.zh: 爆炸是立即发生的，而且是灾难性的。几毫秒内，400 伏特和 12,000 安培的电流击中了 Sandu 的脸部和身体右侧。 “我完全失明了，”他说。当医生在沙勒罗瓦大医院接见他时，他说他处于诱导昏迷状态五天。

paras.en: Hospital records seen by the Guardian and Investigate Europe show that the arc flash electrocution had burned 12% of Sandu’s body, with second-degree burns to the face and neck, as well as third-degree burns across his right shoulder and fingers.
paras.zh: 《卫报》和《欧洲调查》看到的医院记录显示，电弧闪光触电烧伤了桑杜身体的12%，面部和颈部有二度烧伤，右肩和手指有三度烧伤。

paras.en: When Sandu woke from surgery in the intensive care unit a week later, his wife was at his bedside. He says his entire body felt like a “white-hot blister … It was so much pain. The human heart cannot comprehend it.”
paras.zh: 一周后，当桑杜在重症监护室做完手术醒来时，他的妻子就在他的床边。他说他的整个身体感觉就像一个“白热化的水泡……太痛苦了。人心无法理解。”

paras.en: Sandu says the regional director of Google, along with a representative from Dornan Engineering, an Irish company that oversaw his contractor, and his recruiter, came to visit. While he lay bandaged in the hospital bed, he says the Google director told him he was lucky to be alive.
paras.zh: 桑杜说，谷歌的区域总监以及负责监督他的承包商的爱尔兰公司 Dornan Engineering 的一名代表以及他的招聘人员前来拜访。他说，当他躺在医院病床上时，谷歌主管告诉他，他能活着很幸运。

paras.en: To date, no company or contractor appears to have been found liable for the accident. The local labour inspectorate closed its investigation in late October and found no wrongdoing.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，尚未发现任何公司或承包商对这起事故负责。当地劳动监察部门于10月下旬结束调查，未发现任何不当行为。

paras.en: A spokesperson for Dornan Engineering said it was “committed to maintaining safe working conditions, complying with applicable labour laws and continually learning to help prevent incidents like this from happening again”.
paras.zh: 多南工程公司的一位发言人表示，该公司“致力于维持安全的工作条件，遵守适用的劳动法，并不断学习以帮助防止此类事件再次发生”。

paras.en: Sandu’s electrocution appears brutal and harrowing, but far from unique, according to a five-month investigation by Investigate Europe and the Guardian into conditions for migrant workers on datacentre sites across Sweden, Norway, Belgium and the Netherlands.
paras.zh: 根据欧洲调查组织和卫报对瑞典、挪威、比利时和荷兰数据中心的移民工人的条件进行的为期五个月的调查，桑杜的触电事件看似残酷而痛苦，但绝非独一无二。

paras.en: Europe is in the midst of a datacentre boom, the largest infrastructure surge the continent has seen in decades, with more than 2,300 datacentres rapidly altering the physical and energy landscape of Europe (at least 500 of them in the UK) and hundreds more under construction.
paras.zh: 欧洲正处于数据中心的繁荣之中，这是该大陆几十年来最大规模的基础设施激增，超过 2,300 个数据中心迅速改变了欧洲的物理和能源格局（其中至少 500 个在英国），还有数百个正在建设中。

paras.en: But unions say the push for tech sovereignty in Europe is becoming increasingly reliant on the exploitation of migrant workers.
paras.zh: 但工会表示，推动欧洲科技主权的努力越来越依赖于对移民工人的剥削。

paras.en: In dozens of interviews we found evidence of debilitating injuries, squalid living conditions, an unreported infectious outbreak, unpaid wages and exploitative employment practices.
paras.zh: 在数十次采访中，我们发现了伤病、肮脏的生活条件、未报告的传染病爆发、拖欠工资和剥削性就业行为的证据。

paras.en: In the UK, a general contractor died while working on a datacentre site last year, while another fatality was reported in 2024 at an electrical substation being built for a Microsoft datacentre. Serious accidents have also been recorded this year at projects in Italy, Sweden, Norway and Belgium, and exploitative labour practices have been found at projects around the world, including in Brazil.
paras.zh: 在英国，去年有一名总承包商在数据中心工地工作时死亡，而 2024 年又报告了另一起死亡事件，发生在为微软数据中心建造的变电站中。今年，意大利、瑞典、挪威和比利时的项目也发生了严重事故，包括巴西在内的世界各地的项目也发现了剥削劳工行为。

paras.en: On the outskirts of Gävle, a city two hours north of Stockholm, past timber-framed cottages and dense pine forests, lies a smooth road leading to one such site. The remote clearing is part of a 130-hectare, €3bn expansion plan begun in June 2024 to scale up Microsoft’s AI datacentre infrastructure.
paras.zh: 耶夫勒是一座位于斯德哥尔摩以北两小时车程的城市，在其郊区，经过木结构小屋和茂密的松树林，有一条平坦的道路通往这样一个地点。此次远程清算是 2024 年 6 月开始的占地 130 公顷、耗资 30 亿欧元的扩张计划的一部分，旨在扩大微软的人工智能数据中心基础设施规模。

paras.en: One subcontractor at the site is the Irish-owned construction company BenBau. It is among 148 firms working under Collen Construction at the Gävle site, including 28 direct subcontractors.
paras.zh: 该现场的分包商之一是爱尔兰建筑公司 BenBau。该公司是 Collen Construction 在耶夫勒工地工作的 148 家公司之一，其中包括 28 家直接分包商。

paras.en: For months, there has been a growing sense of outrage among Adrian*, 45, and his colleagues working for BenBau on the Microsoft site. They showed evidence of crowded living quarters – 24 people to a kitchen, 14 men to a single bathroom – and say they have reported vermin infestations, broken ventilation systems and lack of heating during the sub-zero Swedish winters, but the problems remain.
paras.zh: 几个月来，45 岁的 Adrian* 和他在 Microsoft 网站上为 BenBau 工作的同事们的愤怒情绪与日俱增。他们展示了居住区拥挤的证据——厨房里有 24 个人，一间浴室里有 14 个人——并表示他们报告了在瑞典零度以下的冬季期间出现害虫出没、通风系统损坏和缺乏暖气的情况，但问题仍然存在。

paras.en: Such conditions can make the transmission of disease more likely. In February this year, one Romanian worker tested positive for active tuberculosis, medical records show. Shortly after, others living in the same shared housing showed similar symptoms. BenBau initially informed only a few men who shared close quarters with the infected worker and then told the men that testing was optional, according to workers. After the first worker who contracted the disease had left for hospital, Benbau moved another worker into his bedroom.
paras.zh: 这种情况会使疾病传播的可能性更大。医疗记录显示，今年二月，一名罗马尼亚工人的活动性肺结核检测呈阳性。不久之后，住在同一栋共用住房中的其他人也出现了类似的症状。据工人称，BenBau 最初只通知了几名与受感染工人近距离接触的男子，然后告诉这些人，检测是可选的。在第一位感染该疾病的工人前往医院后，本鲍将另一名工人搬进了他的卧室。

paras.en: Freedom of information requests made to Sweden’s national work authorities and its Public Health Agency say no outbreak had been reported.
paras.zh: 向瑞典国家工作当局及其公共卫生机构提出的信息自由请求称，尚未报告疫情爆发。

paras.en: The living and working conditions form only part of the story. More than 30 workers have shown hundreds of payslips to the Guardian and Investigate Europe that appear to show some of them working up to 50 or 60 hours a week with no overtime pay and missed holiday pay. With many foreign workers unfamiliar with the laws, unions say inequity can arise quickly.
paras.zh: 生活和工作条件只是故事的一部分。超过 30 名工人向《卫报》和《欧洲调查》出示了数百张工资单，其中一些人每周工作长达 50 或 60 小时，没有加班费和错过的假期工资。由于许多外国工人不熟悉法律，工会表示不平等现象可能很快就会出现。

paras.en: Days before publication of this investigation, the union Solidariska Byggare, representing the 70 Romanian workers at Microsoft’s site in Gävle, brokered a settlement with BenBau, which it says will give workers back pay and allow unions access to sites.
paras.zh: 在本次调查发表前几天，代表 Microsoft 耶夫勒工厂 70 名罗马尼亚工人的工会 Solidariska Byggare 与 BenBau 达成了和解，据称该和解协议将向工人返还工资并允许工会进入工厂。

paras.en: A spokesperson for BenBau said the company “takes all concerns regarding the welfare, health and safety of our people extremely seriously” and has “stringent procedures for reporting, investigating and addressing workplace concerns”.
paras.zh: BenBau 的一位发言人表示，该公司“极其严肃地对待有关员工福利、健康和安全的所有问题”，并拥有“报告、调查和解决工作场所问题的严格程序”。

paras.en: Since 2021, Sweden’s Work Environment Authority (AV) has opened 50 cases into working conditions at datacentre sites involving Microsoft and a number of Irish firms, according to a freedom of information request.
paras.zh: 根据信息自由请求，自 2021 年以来，瑞典工作环境管理局 (AV) 已针对数据中心站点的工作条件启动了 50 个案例，涉及微软和多家爱尔兰公司。

paras.en: Earlier this month, a contractor fell through a roof hatch while carrying out maintenance work on a ventilation system at the Microsoft site in Gävle, according to freedom of information request to AV.
paras.zh: 根据 AV 的信息自由请求，本月早些时候，一名承包商在微软耶夫勒工厂的通风系统进行维护工作时从屋顶舱口坠落。

paras.en: In October 2021, a forklift allegedly ran over the foot of a supervisor working for Collen at the site. The worker subsequently needed surgery. An incident report submitted by Collen to work authorities says that the wrong machine had been used, the driver had no formal certificate for it and the lift plan was incomplete. Still, it had been signed off. The Work Environment Authority saw no grounds to report the employer to prosecutors.
paras.zh: 2021 年 10 月，一辆叉车据称碾压了现场为科伦工作的一名主管的脚。该工人随后需要接受手术。科伦向工作当局提交的一份事故报告称，使用了错误的机器，司机没有正式的证书，而且电梯计划也不完整。尽管如此，它还是被签署了。工作环境管理局认为没有理由向检察官举报该雇主。

paras.en: A spokesperson for Collen said: “We are committed to ensuring that every Collen site is a safe, healthy and respectful place to work, where everyone is treated with dignity and their fundamental human rights are protected. We expect the same throughout our supply chain and have zero tolerance for any conduct inconsistent with these principles.
paras.zh: 科伦的一位发言人表示：“我们致力于确保科伦的每个工厂都是一个安全、健康和受人尊重的工作场所，每个人都受到尊严的对待，他们的基本人权受到保护。我们希望整个供应链也能做到这一点，并对任何不符合这些原则的行为采取零容忍态度。

paras.en: “Our projects are subject to rigorous compliance with our own mandatory policies and procedures, our clients’ requirements, all applicable laws and regulations, and recognised industry standards in every jurisdiction in which we operate.”
paras.zh: “我们的项目必须严格遵守我们自己的强制性政策和程序、客户的要求、所有适用的法律和法规以及我们运营所在的每个司法管辖区公认的行业标准。”

paras.en: A similar pattern is found throughout Europe, says James McCabe from Unite the Union, an Irish-UK group representing more than 1.2 million workers. “Everywhere we’ve encountered Irish datacentre contractors at tech-giant datacentre sites we’ve learned of lack of normal and meaningful union access … as well as serious concerns of labour crimes and exploitation of workers,” he says.
paras.zh: 代表超过 120 万工人的爱尔兰裔英国组织联合工会 (Unite the Union) 的詹姆斯·麦凯布 (James McCabe) 表示，整个欧洲都存在类似的模式。他说：“我们在科技巨头数据中心站点遇到爱尔兰数据中心承包商时，都发现他们缺乏正常且有意义的工会准入……以及对劳工犯罪和剥削工人的严重担忧。”

paras.en: Johan Danielsson, a European parliament rapporteur in charge of regulating subcontracting chains, says: “If people let these big American multinationals come here and import their anti-union business models, then it becomes a problem. Because behind the fence they are abusing workers, and they don’t want anyone to know it.”
paras.zh: 负责监管分包链的欧洲议会报告员约翰·丹尼尔森（Johan Danielsson）表示：“如果人们让这些大型美国跨国公司来到这里并进口他们的反工会商业模式，那么这就成了一个问题。因为他们在幕后虐待工人，而且他们不想让任何人知道这一点。”

paras.en: A spokesperson for Google said: “Our supplier code of conduct and contracts require all suppliers to comply with local labour laws and uphold safe, healthy working conditions. We maintain active dialogue with union leaders and trade groups, and are committed to providing transparent information about our workplace.”
paras.zh: 谷歌发言人表示：“我们的供应商行为准则和合同要求所有供应商遵守当地劳动法，维护安全、健康的工作条件。我们与工会领导人和贸易团体保持积极对话，并致力于提供有关我们工作场所的透明信息。”

paras.en: A spokesperson for Microsoft said: “In our datacentre construction, we work with contractors and suppliers, with whom we set clear requirements on health and safety, working conditions, and the freedom of association and right to collective bargaining. To ensure our contractors’ compliance with Microsoft’s human rights and fair labour policies, we have robust processes in place, including audits.”
paras.zh: 微软发言人表示：“在我们的数据中心建设中，我们与承包商和供应商合作，对健康和安全、工作条件、结社自由和集体谈判权提出了明确的要求。为了确保我们的承包商遵守微软的人权和公平劳工政策，我们制定了健全的流程，包括审计。”

paras.en: This investigation is led by Investigate Europe, a cross-border team of investigative journalists: Lorenzo Buzzoni, Jan Daalder, Pascal Hansens, Ella Joyner, Chris Matthews, Nico Schmidt and Astri Thunold.
paras.zh: 这项调查由 Investigate Europe 领导，这是一个由调查记者组成的跨境团队：Lorenzo Buzzoni、Jan Daalder、Pascal Hansens、Ella Joyner、Chris Matthews、Nico Schmidt 和 Astri Thunold。

articles.title: Former Sydney childcare worker Ashley Paul Griffith hit with 202 more abuse charges
articles.author: Australian Associated Press

paras.en: One of Australia’s most notorious paedophiles is facing hundreds more child abuse charges, including for the alleged rape of children as young as one.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚最臭名昭著的恋童癖者之一正面临数百项虐待儿童指控，其中包括涉嫌强奸年仅一岁的儿童。

paras.en: Days after being extradited from Queensland to New South Wales, Ashley Paul Griffith was hit with 202 charges dating from between 2014 and 2017, with police labelling the allegations “deeply disturbing”.
paras.zh: 阿什利·保罗·格里菲斯 (Ashley Paul Griffith) 从昆士兰州引渡到新南威尔士州几天后，在 2014 年至 2017 年期间受到 202 项指控，警方称这些指控“令人深感不安”。

paras.en: The Queensland man was working at a childcare centre in Sydney’s inner west at the time of the alleged offending, which included dozens of alleged rapes against children between one and five.
paras.zh: 涉嫌犯罪时，这名昆士兰男子正在悉尼内西区的一家儿童保育中心工作，其中包括数十起针对一岁至五岁儿童的强奸案。

paras.en: Griffith, 48, was jailed for life in Queensland in November 2024 after he pleaded guilty to more than 300 child sexual offences against nearly 70 victims.
paras.zh: 48 岁的格里菲斯于 2024 年 11 月在昆士兰州被判终身监禁，此前他承认对近 70 名受害者实施了 300 多起儿童性犯罪行为。

paras.en: The fresh charges from NSW include 68 counts of rape of a child aged less than 10 and 42 counts of aggravated rape of a child aged less than 10 who was under his authority.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州的新指控包括 68 项强奸 10 岁以下儿童的罪名和 42 项严重强奸他管辖下的 10 岁以下儿童的罪名。

paras.en: Other charges include 69 counts of aggravated indecent assault and 23 charges of producing child abuse material.
paras.zh: 其他指控包括 69 项严重猥亵罪和 23 项制作虐待儿童材料的指控。

paras.en: Police said the charges pertained to 23 alleged victims aged between one and five.
paras.zh: 警方表示，这些指控涉及 23 名年龄在 1 岁到 5 岁之间的受害者。

paras.en: He was charged while being held in Silverwater Correctional Complex in Sydney.
paras.zh: 他在悉尼银水惩教中心被关押时受到指控。

paras.en: NSW Det Supt Linda Howlett said charging Griffith with further alleged offending could help potential victims.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州警长琳达·豪莱特表示，指控格里菲斯进一步涉嫌犯罪可能会对潜在的受害者有所帮助。

paras.en: “There’s no other word for it, it’s actually horrific,” she said in relation to the allegations.
paras.zh: “没有其他词可以形容，这实际上是可怕的，”她在谈到这些指控时说道。

paras.en: The child abuse squad commander thanked witnesses, alleged victims and detectives for their work in preparing the challenging but “airtight” case.
paras.zh: 虐待儿童小组指挥官感谢证人、据称受害者和侦探为准备这起具有挑战性但“无懈可击”的案件所做的工作。

paras.en: Police are extending every assistance to those involved, Howlett said.
paras.zh: 豪利特说，警方正在向涉案人员提供一切援助。

paras.en: Griffith did not apply for bail in a brief court appearance on Friday.
paras.zh: 格里菲斯在周五的简短出庭中没有申请保释。

paras.en: The NSW police assistant commissioner Brett Greentree said the lengthy investigation included collaboration with police across the nation.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州警察助理局长布雷特·格林特里表示，漫长的调查包括与全国各地警方的合作。

paras.en: “The allegations before the court are deeply disturbing and involve some of the most vulnerable members of our community,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“法庭上的指控令人深感不安，涉及我们社区中一些最弱势的成员。”

paras.en: “Every child deserves to be safe and protected from harm. NSW Police is committed to ensuring those who exploit positions of trust to offend against children are identified, investigated and brought before the courts.”
paras.zh: “每个儿童都应该受到安全保护，免受伤害。新南威尔士州警方致力于确保那些利用信任地位冒犯儿童的人被识别、调查并送上法庭。”

paras.en: In Queensland, he admitted to assaulting and filming young girls over the course of years while working at childcare centres.
paras.zh: 在昆士兰州，他承认多年来在儿童保育中心工作时袭击和拍摄年轻女孩。

paras.en: His transfer was approved by a Brisbane magistrate earlier in the month, where the alleged victims’ supporters yelled insults at the rapist as he stood in the dock for the decision.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，布里斯班地方法官批准了他的调动，当强奸犯站在被告席上等待这一决定时，据称受害者的支持者对他大喊大叫。

paras.en: In Australia, children, young adults, parents and teachers can contact the Kids helpline on 1800 55 1800, or Bravehearts on 1800 272 831, and adult survivors can contact Blue Knot Foundation on 1300 657 380. Other international helplines can be found at befrienders.org
paras.zh: 在澳大利亚，儿童、青少年、家长和教师可以拨打儿童帮助热线 1800 55 1800，或者拨打勇敢的心 1800 272 831，成年幸存者可以拨打 1300 657 380 联系蓝结基金会。其他国际帮助热线可以在 befrienders.org 上找到。

articles.title: Erin Patterson to die in prison after losing appeal against mushroom murder convictions
articles.author: Nino Bucci  Justice and courts reporter

paras.en: Erin Patterson has lost her bid to overturn her convictions and been resentenced to life behind bars with no chance of release, as Victoria’s highest court handed down its decision on two appeals regarding her triple murder case.
paras.zh: 艾琳·帕特森 (Erin Patterson) 推翻定罪的努力失败了，并被判处终生监禁，没有机会获释，因为维多利亚州最高法院就其三重谋杀案的两次上诉作出了裁决。

paras.en: The court of appeal ruled on the two appeals on Friday, after justices Lesley Taylor, Stephen McLeish and Peter Kidd heard arguments from her legal team and prosecutors in August.
paras.zh: 法官莱斯利·泰勒 (Lesley Taylor)、史蒂芬·麦克利什 (Stephen McLeish) 和彼得·基德 (Peter Kidd) 在八月份听取了她的法律团队和检察官的论点后，上诉法院于周五对这两起上诉做出了裁决。

paras.en: Patterson, 52, did not attend the 15-minute court hearing in person, and showed no emotion on the video feed as McLeish outlined why her appeal had failed, and how the director of public prosecutions had succeeded in seeking a longer sentence.
paras.zh: 52 岁的帕特森没有亲自出席 15 分钟的法庭听证会，在麦克利什概述她的上诉失败的原因以及公诉主任如何成功寻求更长刑期的视频中，她没有表现出任何情绪。

paras.en: Patterson was last year sentenced to life imprisonment, with a non-parole period of 33 years, for the murders of her estranged husband’s parents, Don and Gail Patterson, and his aunt Heather Wilkinson, after she hosted them for lunch.
paras.zh: 去年，帕特森因在招待分居丈夫的父母唐·帕特森和盖尔·帕特森以及姨妈希瑟·威尔金森共进午餐后谋杀了他们，被判处无期徒刑，33年不得假释。

paras.en: She was also convicted of the attempted murder of Heather’s husband, Ian Wilkinson, who survived the beef wellington laced with death cap mushrooms after spending weeks in hospital.
paras.zh: 她还被判谋杀希瑟的丈夫伊恩·威尔金森 (Ian Wilkinson) 未遂罪，后者在医院呆了几周后，吃了配死帽蘑菇的威灵顿牛肉，幸免于难。

paras.en: McLeish said the court had granted leave to appeal on the first two grounds of Patterson’s appeal, but dismissed the appeal, and dismissed the five other grounds raised by her lawyers.
paras.zh: 麦克利什表示，法院已准许帕特森上诉的前两个理由提出上诉，但驳回了上诉，并驳回了她的律师提出的其他五个理由。

paras.en: He said the court granted the DPP appeal against the sentence, however, as it was clear the original sentence did not properly reflect the seriousness of her offending.
paras.zh: 他说，然而，法院批准了民进党对判决的上诉，因为很明显，原判决没有正确反映她罪行的严重性。

paras.en: McLeish said Patterson sustained an intent to murder all four people for three weeks, from the time they were invited to the lunch, during the meal, and during the “protracted suffering and ultimate deaths that resulted”.
paras.zh: 麦克利什说，帕特森在三个星期内一直意图谋杀所有四人，从他们被邀请参加午餐时，到用餐期间，以及“由此导致的长期痛苦和最终死亡”期间。

paras.en: The offending was “carefully planned and deliberate”, he said, and involved an “elaborate series of deceptions” including claims that she had cancer, denying she had foraged mushrooms, and lying about the source of the mushrooms.
paras.zh: 他说，这起犯罪行为是“精心策划和蓄意的”，涉及“一系列精心策划的欺骗行为”，包括声称她患有癌症、否认自己采摘过蘑菇以及对蘑菇的来源撒谎。

paras.en: “This offending was extraordinarily cold and calculated, and stands to be denounced in the strongest possible terms,” McLeish said.
paras.zh: 麦克利什说：“这种犯罪行为极其冷酷且经过精心策划，应该受到最强烈的谴责。”

paras.en: When the judges left court, Patterson also stood, took a book from beside her, and walked off-screen.
paras.zh: 当法官们离开法庭时，帕特森也站了起来，从旁边拿起一本书，走出了屏幕。

paras.en: In the courtroom, family members hugged and were emotional, and detectives involved in the case looked elated. Nobody commented outside court.
paras.zh: 法庭上，家属们拥抱在一起，情绪激动，涉案侦探也显得兴高采烈。法庭外没有人发表评论。

paras.en: Patterson now must apply to the high court for leave to appeal, should she wish to continue fighting her conviction or new sentence.
paras.zh: 帕特森现在必须向高等法院申请上诉许可，如果她希望继续对抗定罪或新的判决。

paras.en: She is one of only a handful of Victorian offenders sentenced to life without parole, and one of the only women in Australian history to be given the sentence.
paras.zh: 她是维多利亚时代少数被判处终身不得假释的罪犯之一，也是澳大利亚历史上唯一被判终身监禁的女性之一。

paras.en: Written reasons for the decision were provided to media later on Friday.
paras.zh: 周五晚些时候向媒体提供了该决定的书面理由。

paras.en: In them, the court said while the first ground of the DPP’s appeal – that trial judge erred in finding that there was a substantial chance Patterson would be in solitary confinement for much of her sentence – had failed, it was clear the second ground, that the sentence was manifestly inadequate, should succeed.
paras.zh: 在其中，法院表示，虽然民进党上诉的第一个理由——初审法官错误地认为帕特森在大部分刑期中很有可能会被单独监禁——已经失败，但很明显，第二个理由，即判决明显不充分，应该成功。

paras.en: The court found they were “heinous crimes” and “we are driven to conclude that a non-parole period of 33 years fails to reflect the calculated criminality of the applicant in committing three murders and attempting a fourth”.
paras.zh: 法院认定这些罪行是“令人发指的罪行”，并且“我们被迫得出结论，33 年的不得假释期限未能反映出申请人在犯下三起谋杀案并企图第四起谋杀案时蓄意犯罪”。

paras.en: “The offending was carefully planned and deliberate. It represented a cruel breach of trust to members of the applicant’s extended family,” the court found.
paras.zh: “这一犯罪行为是经过精心策划和蓄意的。这代表了对申请人大家庭成员的残酷信任，”法院认定。

paras.en: “The taking of three lives (and the attempt on another) in these circumstances called in our view for much stronger denunciation.”
paras.zh: “我们认为，在这种情况下夺走三人生命（以及企图夺走另一人生命）的行为需要更加强烈的谴责。”

paras.en: In relation to Patterson’s appeal, the court described many of the grounds as having no substance, being without merit, or even fanciful.
paras.zh: 关于帕特森的上诉，法院称许多理由没有实质内容、没有依据，甚至是异想天开。

paras.en: In relation to the ground that the sequestering of the jury in the same hotel as the police informant and members of the prosecution amounted to a substantial miscarriage of justice, the court found that it “was plainly unfortunate that [the] situation arose”. It said it was “highly undesirable” and “the judge would not have countenanced this arrangement if approval for it had been sought in advance”.
paras.zh: 关于将陪审团与警方线人和检方成员隔离在同一家酒店构成严重误判的理由，法院认为“出现这种情况显然是不幸的”。它表示，这是“非常不可取的”，并且“如果事先寻求批准，法官不会支持这种安排”。

paras.en: But the justices said there was no evidence any wrongdoing had occurred.
paras.zh: 但法官们表示，没有证据表明发生了任何不当行为。

paras.en: “The accommodation arrangements offered fertile grounds for speculation but no objective basis for the fair-minded person to reasonably apprehend that the jury might not have discharged its function of rendering a verdict according to law. “
paras.zh: “住宿安排为猜测提供了肥沃的理由，但没有客观依据让公正的人合理地理解陪审团可能没有履行依法作出裁决的职能。”

paras.en: In relation to ground two – that undue weight was placed on evidence given by a telecommunications expert that raised the possibility she visited two sites where death cap mushrooms had been reported – the court found the probative value of the evidence was not outweighed by the danger of unfair prejudice to Patterson.
paras.zh: 关于第二个理由——一位电信专家提供的证据被过分重视，该专家提出了她访问过两个报告死帽蘑菇的地点的可能性——法院认为，对帕特森不公平偏见的危险并没有超过证据的证明价值。

paras.en: In August, the court heard Patterson should have been given no possibility of ever being released from prison, or a non-parole period so lengthy that she was likely to die behind bars.
paras.zh: 八月，法庭获悉帕特森不应该被给予出狱的可能性，也不应该给予她很长的非假释期，以至于她很可能会死在监狱里。

paras.en: Her lawyers argued seven grounds for her appeal, including that allowing jurors to stay in the same hotel as police and the prosecution while they deliberated over their verdicts in the triple murder trial represented a “catastrophic” failure of the justice system.
paras.zh: 她的律师为她的上诉提出了七个理由，包括允许陪审员在三重谋杀案审判中与警方和检方同住一家酒店，审议他们的判决，这代表着司法系统的“灾难性”失败。

paras.en: Richard Edney, for Patterson, had said the failure to properly separate the jury during their deliberations was a fundamental irregularity that had denied her a fair trial.
paras.zh: 帕特森的代表理查德·埃德尼表示，陪审团在审议过程中未能正确分开是一种根本性的违规行为，导致她无法获得公平的审判。

paras.en: “What we say has occurred here in the applicant’s trial was an inexplicable and perhaps still unexplained failure of a process,” Edney told the court in August.
paras.zh: “我们所说的在申请人的审判中发生的事情是一个无法解释的、也许仍然无法解释的程序失败，”埃德尼八月告诉法庭。

paras.en: During the hearings, Brendan Kissane KC, the DPP, said that even though Patterson would be aged in her 80s by the time she was eligible for parole, her sentence was still too lenient.
paras.zh: 在听证会上，民进党布伦丹·基桑·KC (Brendan Kissane KC) 表示，尽管帕特森在获得假释资格时已年过 80 多岁，但对她的判决仍然太轻。

articles.title: Three dead after two helicopters collide midair near Oregon airport

paras.en: Three people have died after two helicopters collided midair near a small airport in Oregon, officials said.
paras.zh: 官员称，两架直升机在俄勒冈州一个小机场附近的空中相撞，造成三人死亡。

paras.en: The collision involving a Robinson R22 and an Airbus helicopter occurred near McMinnville Municipal Airport on Thursday afternoon. Both aircraft crashed in a field adjacent to a highway, the sheriff's office said.
paras.zh: 周四下午，一架罗宾逊 R22 直升机与一架空客直升机在麦克明维尔市政机场附近发生相撞事故。治安官办公室称，两架飞机均在高速公路附近的场地坠毁。

paras.en: Authorities identified the victims as a 22-year-old flight instructor from Texas and a student pilot from the United Kingdom, who were aboard one of the helicopters. The sole occupant of the other aircraft was also killed.
paras.zh: 当局确认遇难者是其中一架直升机上的一名来自德克萨斯州的 22 岁飞行教练和一名来自英国的飞行学员。另一架飞机的唯一乘客也被杀。

paras.en: It was not immediately clear what caused the crash.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚坠机原因。

paras.en: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) responded to the scene and are leading the ongoing investigation.
paras.zh: 美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 和国家运输安全委员会 (NTSB) 已赶赴现场并领导正在进行的调查。

paras.en: The BBC has contacted the FAA for comment.
paras.zh: BBC 已联系美国联邦航空局征求意见。

paras.en: The flight instructor on the Robinson R22 was identified Maddie Aasbo. The student pilot from the UK has not yet been publicly identified, as authorities work with the consulate and the FBI to notify the next of kin.
paras.zh: 罗宾逊 R22 上的飞行教练被确认为麦迪·阿斯博 (Maddie Aasbo)。这位来自英国的学生飞行员的身份尚未公开，当局正在与领事馆和联邦调查局合作通知其近亲。

paras.en: The sole occupant of the Airbus was identified as Tyler Delane Sturdevant, 38, of Newberg, Oregon.
paras.zh: 空客飞机的唯一乘客被确认为泰勒·德莱恩·斯特德万特 (Tyler Delane Sturdevant)，38 岁，来自俄勒冈州纽伯格。

paras.en: One of the aircraft was operated by Jerry Trimble Helicopters, a flight training school based at the McMinnville Municipal Airport, according to a statement from the company.
paras.zh: 根据该公司的一份声明，其中一架飞机由位于麦克明维尔市机场的飞行培训学校杰里·特林布尔直升机公司运营。

paras.en: "Jerry Trimble Helicopters is deeply saddened to confirm that one of our aircraft was involved in an aviation incident this afternoon," the company said, adding that they were fully cooperating with investigators.
paras.zh: 该公司表示：“杰里·特林布尔直升机公司深感悲痛地确认，我们的一架飞机今天下午卷入了一起航空事故。”并补充说，他们正在全力配合调查人员。

paras.en: Authorities asked the public to avoid the area as they responded to the incident.
paras.zh: 当局要求公众在回应这一事件时避开该地区。

articles.title: Record number of purges as Xi emphasises 'party discipline' at China political gathering

paras.en: A record 33 members have been expelled from China's Communist Party as it concluded a major annual political gathering, which had the most empty seats ever seen.
paras.zh: 中国共产党一年一度的大型政治集会结束后，有33名党员被开除党籍，创历史新高。

paras.en: The fifth plenum was attended by 279 Central Committee members, compared to 315 at the fourth plenum in October 2025 and 364 at the third one in July 2024.
paras.zh: 五中全会共有 279 名中央委员出席，而 2025 年 10 月四中全会有 315 名中央委员，2024 年 7 月三中全会有 364 名中央委员。

paras.en: While recent plenums focused on economic reforms or social and development issues, party discipline took centre stage at this week's gathering.
paras.zh: 虽然最近的全会重点关注经济改革或社会和发展问题，但党纪在本周的会议上占据了中心位置。

paras.en: Xi Jinping has made the fight against corruption a central pillar of his rule since he took the reins in 2012, calling it the "biggest threat" to the party.
paras.zh: 自2012年上任以来，习近平已将反腐败作为其执政的核心支柱，称其为党的“最大威胁”。

paras.en: Since then, more than two million individuals have been disciplined for cases related to "pointless formalities, bureaucratism, hedonism and extravagance", Zhang Fuhai, from the party's disciplinary commission, told a press briefing on Friday.
paras.zh: 中共纪委书记张福海在周五的新闻发布会上表示，自那时起，已有超过200万人因“形式主义、官僚主义、享乐主义、奢靡之风”相关案件受到纪律处分。

paras.en: He also said the party would enhance its efforts to ensure officials "dare not, cannot, and do not want to be corrupt".
paras.zh: 他还表示，党将加大力度，确保官员“不敢腐败、不能腐败、不想腐败”。

paras.en: Sixteen of the 33 members expelled are from the military, according to a communique issued on Thursday, which marked the end of the four-day closed-door gathering held at a hotel in Beijing.
paras.zh: 根据周四发布的一份公报，被开除的 33 名成员中有 16 名来自军队，这标志着在北京一家酒店举行的为期四天的闭门聚会的结束。

paras.en: It's unclear what specific charges these members face beyond "serious disciplinary and legal violations". Such broad allegations have become routine under Xi's anti-corruption campaign.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚这些成员除了“严重违纪和违法”之外还面临哪些具体指控。在习近平的反腐败运动中，如此广泛的指控已成为常态。

paras.en: It has now become "an effort to consolidate and maintain authority", says Chong Ja Ian, a non-resident scholar with Carnegie China.
paras.zh: 卡内基中国非常驻学者庄家彦表示，现在它已成为“巩固和维护权威的努力”。

paras.en: "In this case, the campaign will continue and expand depending on how secure Xi feels rather than any real issue with corruption."
paras.zh: “在这种情况下，这场运动将继续并扩大，取决于习近平的安全感，而不是任何真正的腐败问题。”

paras.en: In its statement, the party said it has "squarely confronted the grim reality that party leadership had at times weakened or hollowed out" and that it will continue to "enforce strict party self-governance, including turning the knife inwards to... curb disorder".
paras.zh: 该党在声明中表示，它“正视党的领导有时被削弱或空心化的严峻现实”，并将继续“实行严格的党的自治，包括把刀向内转……制乱”。

paras.en: The latest expulsions bring the total number of members removed under Xi's third term to a record 51, up from 35 and five in his first and second terms respectively.
paras.zh: 最新的开除委员人数使习近平第三任期内被开除的委员总数达到创纪录的51人，而他第一任期和第二任期分别为35人和5人。

paras.en: Beyond the plenum, China's top anti-corruption watchdog reported that 680,000 people across the party apparatus have been disciplined in the first nine months of this year.
paras.zh: 在这次全会之外，中国最高反腐败监督机构报告称，今年前九个月，党内共有 68 万人受到纪律处分。

paras.en: This is also the first time in Xi's 14 years of leadership that plenum attendance fell below 300. The current Central Committee started its term in 2022 with more than 370 members.
paras.zh: 这也是习近平领导14年来首次全会出席人数低于300人。本届中央委员会于2022年开始任期，有370多名委员。

paras.en: Observers argue that Xi views corruption not just as graft but also ideological impurity and, crucially, disloyalty.
paras.zh: 观察家认为，习近平不仅将腐败视为腐败，而且将其视为意识形态的杂质，最重要的是，将其视为不忠诚。

paras.en: In January, he warned against "two-faced cadres" who profess political loyalty but defy orders and act in their self-interest.
paras.zh: 今年一月，他警告人们不要出现“两面派干部”，他们声称政治忠诚，但却违抗命令、为一己私利行事。

paras.en: Among the high-ranking officials expelled are former Xinjiang party chief Ma Xingrui, and ex-top generals Zhang Youxia and Liu Zhenli. Official statements announcing their removal this year said they "seriously violating [the party's] discipline and rules", which is widely read as a euphemism for corruption.
paras.zh: 被开除的高级官员包括前新疆自治区党委书记马兴瑞、前高级将领张又侠和刘振立。今年宣布撤职的官方声明称，他们“严重违反党的纪律和规矩”，这被广泛解读为腐败的委婉说法。

paras.en: The culling of the military's top brass has been particularly significant, with Neil Thomas, Lobsang Tsering and Shengyu Wang from the Asia Society Policy Institute describing it as "in a category of its own".
paras.zh: 对军方高级官员的剔除尤为重要，亚洲协会政策研究所的尼尔·托马斯、洛桑次仁和王胜宇将其描述为“自成一类”。

paras.en: "It raises serious questions about organisational leadership and combat readiness, even as China continues to unveil formidable new military hardware," they wrote.
paras.zh: 他们写道：“尽管中国继续推出强大的新军事硬件，但这对组织领导和战备状态提出了严重问题。”

paras.en: Zhang was also vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission, which controls the armed forces. The seven-member commission has since been whittled down to just two members: Xi as chairman and Zhang Shengmin vice-chairman.
paras.zh: 张还担任控制武装部队的中央军事委员会副主席。此后，这个由七名成员组成的委员会只剩下两名成员：习近平担任主席，张生民担任副主席。

paras.en: Ma and Zhang Youxia were former Politburo members. Their removal, along with former general He Weidong in 2025, meant the powerful 24-man Politburo was at one point left with 21 members.
paras.zh: 马云和张又侠都是前政治局委员。他们以及前将军何卫东于 2025 年被免职，这意味着强大的 24 人政治局一度只剩下 21 名成员。

paras.en: Zhang Shengmin was promoted to the top decision-making body at the fifth plenum, bringing the number to 22.
paras.zh: 五中全会，张胜民被提升为最高决策机构，使委员人数达到22人。

paras.en: Former prominent diplomat Liu Jianchao, who disappeared from public view in July last year, was also named among those who have been purged.
paras.zh: 去年7月从公众视野中消失的前著名外交官刘建超也被列为被清洗的人之一。

paras.en: "Xi has few qualms about removing people he promoted," Chong says. "That he does so at will with little opposition underscores how unassailable his position is at the moment."
paras.zh: “习近平对于罢免他提拔的人并没有什么疑虑，”张说。 “他随意这样做，几乎没有遇到反对，这突显了他目前的地位是多么无懈可击。”

paras.en: Analysts believe one reason for the increased emphasis on discipline â which many interpret as loyalty â is next year's Party Congress, when the CCP will vote again for its next leader.
paras.zh: 分析人士认为，越来越强调纪律（许多人将其解释为忠诚）的一个原因是明年的党代表大会，届时中共将再次投票选出下一任领导人。

paras.en: A leadership reshuffle is due in 2027 and many analysts expect Xi to hold on to the top job for a fourth term and beyond. No leader has served that long except Mao Zedong, the founder Communist China.
paras.zh: 领导层改组将于 2027 年进行，许多分析人士预计习近平将连任第四个任期及更长任期。除了共产主义中国的创始人毛泽东之外，没有任何领导人任职这么久。

paras.en: Xi has reason to "scrutinise the next cohort more closely" given the fall of so many officials from the current committee, Thomas says.
paras.zh: 托马斯表示，鉴于现任委员会中如此多的官员落马，习近平有理由“更仔细地审视下一代”。

paras.en: "Today's rising stars tend to be relatively young, boast technocratic backgrounds, and have connections to Xi's political network," he says, adding that "provincial leadership ranks are a promising place to look".
paras.zh: “当今的后起之秀往往相对年轻，拥有技术官僚背景，并与习近平的政治网络有联系，”他说，并补充说“省级领导阶层是一个有前途的地方”。

paras.en: Observers say that ultimately, Xi is expected to dominate personnel selection at the 21st Party Congress, which will further cement his grip on the party and the country.
paras.zh: 观察人士表示，预计习近平最终将在党的第二十一次代表大会上主导人事选拔，这将进一步巩固他对党和国家的控制。

paras.en: "Xi's focus is further consolidating power around himself... The readout from the plenum suggests he intends to be at the centre of China and the Communist Party for the foreseeable future," Chong says.
paras.zh: “习近平的重点是进一步巩固自己的权力……全会的结果表明，他打算在可预见的未来成为中国和共产党的中心，”庄说。

paras.en: "However, further down the road, such concentration of power may pave the way for a more serious power vacuum when Xi ages and slows down."
paras.zh: “然而，在未来的道路上，这种权力集中可能会为习近平年老和放慢脚步时出现更严重的权力真空铺平道路。”

articles.title: Crypto giant Binance hit by hack suspected to be largest in history

paras.en: Cryptocurrency giant Binance said on Thursday that $6.3bn (Â£4.7bn) of digital assets have been impacted by what could be the largest hack in history".
paras.zh: 加密货币巨头币安周四表示，63 亿美元（47 亿英镑）的数字资产受到了可能是历史上最大的黑客攻击的影响。

paras.en: The world's biggest crypto exchange said about half of those assets have been frozen with the help of other platforms, adding that it will "cover all losses".
paras.zh: 全球最大的加密货币交易所表示，在其他平台的帮助下，这些资产中约有一半已被冻结，并补充说它将“弥补所有损失”。

paras.en: Early checks show the incident may have involved an engineer's laptop that had been compromised, which allowed an attacker to make unauthorised withdrawals, Binance said.
paras.zh: 币安表示，早期检查显示，该事件可能涉及一名工程师的笔记本电脑，该笔记本电脑已被入侵，导致攻击者可以进行未经授权的提款。

paras.en: Two analytics firms have attributed the incident, which eclipses a record-setting $1.5bn hack on the Bybit exchange in 2025, to a North Korean hacking unit called TraderTraitor.
paras.zh: 两家分析公司将这一事件归咎于朝鲜黑客组织 TraderTraitor，该事件超过了 2025 年 Bybit 交易所创纪录的 15 亿美元黑客攻击事件。

paras.en: AI-powered investigations company TRM Labs said in a report that several elements of the Binance attack resemble earlier North Korean-linked incidents, including the Bybit hack.
paras.zh: 人工智能调查公司 TRM Labs 在一份报告中表示，币安攻击的几个要素与早期与朝鲜有关的事件类似，包括 Bybit 黑客攻击。

paras.en: The lab's global head of policy Ari Redbord told the BBC the Binance hack is a "watershed moment" that is unlike anything the industry has seen.
paras.zh: 该实验室的全球政策主管阿里·雷德博德 (Ari Redbord) 告诉 BBC，币安遭受黑客攻击是一个“分水岭时刻”，与业界前所未见的情况不同。

paras.en: The attacker still holds an enormous sum of stolen assets, meaning efforts to trace and recover the funds are far from over, Redbord added.
paras.zh: 雷德博德补充说，攻击者仍然持有大量被盗资产，这意味着追查和追回资金的努力还远未结束。

paras.en: Chainalysis, another crypto analytics firm, also said it has "high confidence" that the North Korean group are linked to the hack.
paras.zh: 另一家加密货币分析公司 Chainaanalysis 也表示，“高度确信”该朝鲜组织与此次黑客攻击有关。

paras.en: Eric Jardine, Chainalysis' Head of Research, urged every exchange to remain vigilant as the platforms are attractive targets for hackers due to the sheer value of assets.
paras.zh: Chainalysis 研究主管 Eric Jardine 敦促每个交易所保持警惕，因为这些平台因其资产的巨大价值而成为黑客的有吸引力的目标。

paras.en: Binance did not directly respond to BBC queries about the incident's potential links to North Korea but said: "We are working closely with our law enforcement partners to confirm the identity of these criminals and bring them to justice."
paras.zh: 币安没有直接回应英国广播公司有关该事件与朝鲜潜在联系的询问，但表示：“我们正在与执法合作伙伴密切合作，以确认这些罪犯的身份并将他们绳之以法。”

paras.en: The incident concerns Binance.com - while much smaller crypto platform Binance.US, which provides trading services specifically for American residents - said its platform is not affected by the issue.
paras.zh: 该事件涉及 Binance.com，而专门为美国居民提供交易服务的小型加密货币平台 Binance.US 表示，其平台并未受到该问题的影响。

paras.en: In a series of posts, Yi He, Binance's co-chief executive, thanked various cryptocurrency issuers for freezing the assets.
paras.zh: 币安联席首席执行官何一在一系列帖子中感谢多家加密货币发行商冻结资产。

paras.en: "Safety first: withdrawals are currently disabled until the environment is confirmed to be secure," she said.
paras.zh: “安全第一：在确认环境安全之前，目前无法提款，”她说。

paras.en: Two other major crypto platforms, Tether and Circle, said they have frozen a total of about $2.4bn of assets in response to the potential Binance hack.
paras.zh: 另外两个主要加密货币平台 Tether 和 Circle 表示，为了应对潜在的币安黑客攻击，他们已冻结了总计约 24 亿美元的资产。

paras.en: Circle chief executive Jeremy Allaire said his firm is "closely tracking reports of a potential exploit involving Binance" and that his company has frozen more than $800m in assets linked to the incident.
paras.zh: Circle 首席执行官杰里米·阿莱尔 (Jeremy Allaire) 表示，他的公司正在“密切跟踪涉及币安的潜在漏洞的报告”，并且他的公司已冻结与该事件相关的超过 8 亿美元的资产。

paras.en: Circle is the issuer and co-creator of the USDC, one of the world's largest US dollar-backed cryptocurrencies.
paras.zh: Circle 是 USDC 的发行者和共同创建者，USDC 是世界上最大的美元支持的加密货币之一。

paras.en: Tether CEO Paolo Ardoino said his firm has frozen around $1.6bn "related to a potential Binance exchange hack."
paras.zh: Tether 首席执行官 Paolo Ardoino 表示，他的公司已冻结约 16 亿美元，“与潜在的币安交易所黑客攻击有关”。

paras.en: "Protecting the industry and our partners is our main priority," said Ardoino, whose company issues a cryptocurrency known as USDT.
paras.zh: “保护行业和我们的合作伙伴是我们的首要任务，”Ardoino 说，他的公司发行了一种名为 USDT 的加密货币。

paras.en: World Liberty Financial, a crypto company linked to US President Donald Trump and his family, said it has worked with its partners to freeze stolen funds.
paras.zh: 与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普及其家人有联系的加密货币公司世界自由金融公司表示，它已与其合作伙伴合作冻结被盗资金。

paras.en: Crypto exchange Coinbase said it was unaffected by the incident and was monitoring the situation.
paras.zh: 加密货币交易所 Coinbase 表示，未受到该事件的影响，并正在监控事态发展。

paras.en: Several crypto industry observers had flagged concerns about a potential hack on Binance hours before the exchange confirmed the security issue.
paras.zh: 在币安确认安全问题前几个小时，几位加密货币行业观察人士就表达了对币安可能遭受黑客攻击的担忧。

paras.en: Binance, which was founded in China in 2017, allows users to trade digital assets and is estimated to have more than 300 million registered users worldwide.
paras.zh: 币安于 2017 年在中国成立，允许用户交易数字资产，估计在全球拥有超过 3 亿注册用户。

paras.en: The exchange has been subject of regulatory scrutiny around the world.
paras.zh: 该交易所一直受到世界各地监管机构的审查。

paras.en: The company said in 2024 that it has more than $160bn in assets under custody.
paras.zh: 该公司在 2024 年表示，其托管资产超过 1600 亿美元。

paras.en: Bitcoin dropped by more than 4% following the alerts. The price of other major cryptocurrencies including Ethereum and Solana also fell sharply.
paras.zh: 警报发出后，比特币下跌超过 4%。包括以太坊和Solana在内的其他主要加密货币的价格也大幅下跌。

articles.title: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life

paras.en: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life

(MEDINA, OH, September 12, 2023) – Carlisle Brake & Friction is excited to announce the launch of EL121 Disc Brake Pads for mine haul truck applications. The new product series will be named Extended Life, or the EL Series, and EL121 will be the first friction formulation of the series to launch.

Carlisle’s EL121 Series friction material nearly doubles the service life of front-axle, mine haul truck brake pads. The result is increased equipment uptime, and reduced maintenance costs when utilizing the OEM calipers and rotors.

Autonomous haul trucks experience higher pad temperatures, which drive elevated pad wear from increased braking cycles as the retarder and the service brake are applied. EL121 features a highly wear-resistant friction material blend that provides extended brake pad life with consistent and fade-resistant braking performance. EL121 is the ideal solution for today’s autonomous mine haul trucks (may also be used in manned mine haul trucks for increased performance and longevity).

“We understand that mine operators need to keep their haul trucks on the job and not in the shop for brake service. Our latest innovation allows for up to double the service life of the front-axle mine haul truck brake pads and are a will-fit replacement to existing OEM pads. These were thoroughly lab tested as well as field tested on Komatsu 830E-1 trucks,” said Ron Ratell, Product Line Director Friction Products at Carlisle Brake & Friction.

EL121 friction has been dyno tested to replicate the application and is proven to deliver an innovative, high-energy material to meet market needs. EL121 disc brake pads also feature an industry-proven mechanical retention system with backing plate technology designed for superior bonding and durability, capable of withstanding abusive conditions in even the harshest Off-Highway environments.

Carlisle’s EL121 Series disc brake pads are available now through authorized Carlisle dealers and distributors. To learn more, visit https://www.carlislecbf.com/products/brake-friction/disc-brake-pads/off-highway-disc-brake-pads/el. To locate an authorized Carlisle dealer near you, search our online distributor listing https://www.carlislecbf.com/support/find-a-distributor.

Carlisle Brake & Friction is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of Carlisle’s brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com

articles.title: Carlisle Releases Video Highlighting Solutions for Ag

paras.en: Carlisle Releases Video Highlighting Solutions for Ag

Carlisle Brake & Friction launches a new product solutions video: Carlisle Solutions for Tractor Applications, to showcase all of the latest motion control technologies available for agriculture equipment, specifically tractor applications.
From power valves, to disc brakes, to PTO and shuttle clutch friction options, this video breaks down all of the features and benefits of Carlisle’s newest brake system and powertrain solutions.
For improved visualization, the video features 3D animation and demonstrations of the product fitments within a standard tractor model.

articles.title: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification

paras.en: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification

(MEDINA, January 25, 2024) – Carlisle Brake & Friction announced its Suzhou facility has won a Supplier Excellence Recognition (SER) Certification from Caterpillar Inc. The Caterpillar SER is a new supplier management system featuring "Certified" and "Excellent" levels. Caterpillar officially launched the program in 2022. Carlisle's Suzhou manufacturing facility achieved a "Certified" level of recognition and celebrated the achievement alongside the Caterpillar team with a ceremony at the Carlisle Suzhou plant.

paras.en: Of 27,000 suppliers, 250 were among the selected companies awarded by Caterpillar. Carlisle, a leading global supplier of brake, clutch, and transmission friction products, is the only friction products manufacturer worldwide to win the coveted certification.

"We are honored to be recognized by Caterpillar as a Certified level supplier," said Doug Wagner, Global VP of Sales, Carlisle Brake & Friction. "This award recognizes the superior efforts and dedication of the entire Suzhou team that supports our global business."
Carlisle earned SER Certification in recognition of the company's exemplary commitment to supporting Caterpillar's global growth strategy goals.

articles.title: SCRS to Host Welding, Refinishing Competitions at 2026 SEMA Show
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Society of Collision Repair Specialists (SCRS) is inviting SEMA Show attendees to step up, show their skills and compete for automotive trade schools at the 2026 SEMA Show.

From Tuesday through Friday, Nov. 3-6, visitors to the SCRS booth in the Upper South Hall booth no. 31147 can take part in a welding and refinishing competition powered by Skillveri’s virtual and mixed-reality training technology. The competition will sort out the “best of the best” while attendees compete to drive equipment prizes home to their local trade school programs.

Competitions will run daily from 9:30-11:30 a.m. and 1-4:30 p.m., with winners announced via SCRS’ Facebook and LinkedIn social pages on Friday afternoon, Nov. 6. Attendees do not need to pre-register. Participants can visit the SCRS booth during competition hours to compete in either the welding category, the refinishing category, or both.
Attendees will compete for the titles of “Best Welder” and “Best Refinisher,” but the real winners will be automotive trade schools.

Finalists in each category will receive a Full Series Pass to the 2027 SCRS Repairer Driven Education program at the SEMA Show. Each winner will also have the opportunity to select a U.S.-based automotive trade school to receive an equipment and training package, made possible through contributions from Skillveri, Southern California Collision Equipment, Milwaukee Tool and Car-O-Liner.

First-place finalists in both welding and refinishing will select a school to receive a Skillveri virtual and mixed reality training system, including a lifetime software license, VR headset, specialized welding or spray painting equipment, laptop and supporting hardware.

The second-place welding finalist will select a school to receive a Goliath Carts weld test cart and Bench mount combo for welding, and the second-place refinish finalists will direct a Goliath Carts painters toolbox to the school program of their choice. Both prize packages are made possible by Southern California Collision Equipment.

Third-place finalists will select a school to receive a Milwaukee Tool equipment package featuring M12 and M18 FUEL cordless power tools, impact wrenches, ratchets, sanders, grinders, lighting and specialty automotive repair equipment. The collection also includes socket, wrench and hand tool sets, along with a modular PACKOUT storage and organization system.
In the event of a third-place tie, Car-O-Liner has provided a WEL32 MIG-MAG welding machine. If no third-place tie occurs, the welding machine will be added to the first-place welding award.

The finalists will not be the direct recipients of the prize packages and have no rights in the packages themselves. Finalists are competing to receive the Full Series Pass and to appoint a U.S.-based automotive trade school program to receive one of the prize packages.

“This is more than a competition; it’s a way for our industry to give back,” said Michael Bradshaw, chairman of SCRS. “The SEMA Show gives us an opportunity to showcase the technical skills that are essential to collision repair while creating a meaningful connection between our industry and the schools preparing the next generation of technicians. We’re grateful to Skillveri, Southern California Collision Equipment, Milwaukee Tool and CAR-O-LINER for helping make this opportunity possible and for investing in the future of collision repair education.”

articles.title: CRASH Network’s Insurer Report Card Survey Now Open
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: CRASH Network announced that its annual “Insurer Report Card” survey is now open. By taking the survey, collision repairers can help consumers choose a better auto insurer by sharing their firsthand knowledge of how different carriers handle claims.

More than 1,000 collision repair professionals participate each year, grading insurers doing business in their state from “A+” to “F” based on how well each company’s claims practices help ensure quality repairs and customer service.

“Most consumers probably aren’t aware that they likely have dozens and dozens of companies from which they could buy their auto insurance policy,” said John Yoswick, editor of CRASH Network. “Through the Insurer Report Card, collision repairers can share what they see in their shops every day to help consumers realize there are differences among carriers beyond just price and brand recognition, and to help introduce consumers to insurers they may not have previously been familiar with.”

The results reach consumers throughout the year. In addition to being available for free download, the grades are incorporated into auto insurance rankings from more than a dozen sources such as the Wall Street Journal, Money and USA Today. Insurers that consistently receive top grades also tout those results in their own consumer marketing.

“The Insurer Report Card allows repairers to grade 20 or 30 insurers doing business in their state,” Yoswick said. “Because of that, we’re able to show consumers grades received by about 80 or more different carriers.”

The Insurer Report Card can be completed in less than three minutes (though shops are encouraged to spend time to explain why they gave each insurer the grade they did), and all individual shop grades and identification information remains confidential.
Shops that complete the Insurer Report Card and provide an e-mail address will be sent the results at no charge to share with their customers.
To request a link to the survey, shops can click here.

articles.title: All Clear Diagnostics & Calibration Expands into Colorado

paras.en: All Clear Diagnostics & Calibration, a provider of automotive diagnostics, ADAS calibration, OEM programming and repair services, has expanded its service presence into the Colorado market as part of its continued commitment to supporting collision repair facilities.

As vehicle technology continues to evolve, collision repair shops face increasingly complex repair requirements. All Clear helps shops navigate those challenges by providing the technical expertise and services needed to keep repairs moving.

With more than 200 technicians, All Clear brings diagnostics, ADAS calibration, OEM programming, and mechanical and electrical repair services directly to collision repair shops across its service markets.

articles.title: California insurance commissioner race receives record PAC donations
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Political Action Committees (PACs) have contributed a record $6 million in campaign donations to the California Insurance Commission race, according to a CalMatters report.
The article says this includes $3.2 million to support state Sen. Ben Allen, a Democrat, and $1.5 million to oppose his opponent, Jane Kim, also a Democrat.
While both candidates have said they wouldn’t take donations from insurance companies, CalMatters reports that some of the PAC funding comes from insurance groups.

Bail bonds insurers donated $30,000 to PACs supporting Allen, the article states. It adds that a company connected to the bail bonds industry donated another $9,500, and a health insurance PAC donated $48,000.
“I didn’t ask for this and don’t welcome it,” Allen told CalMatters.
CalMatters explains that super PACs can spend unlimited money as long as they don’t coordinate with the candidate’s campaign. Candidates also cannot return the money.
Allen did return some insurance industry donations made early in the campaign, the article states.

“The contributions that come in are a reflection of what the (insurance) industry believes is the best outcome for them,” CalMatters reports Kim as saying. “These contributions are an investment in him and themselves, not for consumers.”
Kim also argues that she hasn’t accepted corporate PAC donations.
Allen has served in the state’s legislature since 2014, according to his campaign website. He lists climate and environmental policies as a focus during his tenure.
Allen’s plan focuses on strengthening the state’s insurance market as wildfires and climate disasters intensify.

“My plan will restore a competitive insurance market, ensure Californians are treated fairly after disasters, and build resilient communities that can withstand the climate challenges ahead,” he states on his website.
Fighting insurers that “deny and delay” and post-disaster insurer compliance are other planned action items, Allen’s site claims.
This would include higher upfront payments for coverage requiring insurers to clearly explain claim denials and maintain post-disaster real-time reporting on delays and outstanding claims.

Allen also outlines how he’d make the department more transparent and accountable. The website states Allen would modernize customer service and filings infrastructure, improve consumer communication, and provide data transparency.

Kim previously served on the San Francisco Board of Supervisors, as California political director for Bernie Sanders, and as California director for the Working Families Party, according to her campaign website.
Her priorities focus on “affordable, available insurance for all,” the website states. She proposes a single-payer disaster insurance policy for state residents.
The website also says she’ll ensure premiums cover claims, or lower them.

“Insurance companies should spend premium dollars on their intended purpose: protecting policyholders,” the website states. “If companies collect more than they need to cover claims and a reasonable profit, that money should go back to policyholders or be invested in statewide resilience, not huge payouts at our expense — like the $27 million salary one insurance company CEO was paid last year.”
Her site states that a long-term goal is to build a public auto insurance option to compete in the market.
She also notes that she’s focused on “fast and fair claims.” This includes freezing rates when a claim is filed, penalizing delays to speed up payments, and immediate payouts.

Under Kim, insurance companies would be held accountable through market conduct examinations and elevated complaint rates, according to the website. She also proposes an insurance performance dashboard that consumers can use to assess insurer risks before choosing a policy.

articles.title: Tuesday during SEMA Week: CIC and the annual Red Carpet Awards
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Tuesday during SEMA Week in Las Vegas will be packed with industry news and celebration as the Collision Industry Conference (CIC) fall meeting takes place, followed by a CIC reception and the annual Collision Industry Red Carpet Awards.

Both will be held at the Westgate Las Vegas Resort & Casino. Red Carpet Awards will bring together collision repair professionals from across the industry to celebrate the individuals and organizations whose leadership, service, and contributions continue to move the industry forward, according to a Society of Collision Repair Specialists (SCRS) press release.

The CIC meeting will be from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., followed by its reception at 6 p.m. The awards program will begin at 7:30 p.m. The Red Carpet Awards ceremony is free to attend with first-come, first-served seating; cocktail attire is encouraged.
From industry veterans to rising stars, the evening will spotlight outstanding accomplishments across collision repair.

The program brings together recognition programs from BodyShop Business, CIC, the Collision Repair Education Foundation (CREF), FenderBender and ABRN, I-CAR, the National Auto Body Council (NABC), and SCRS.
Andy Tylka of TAG Auto Group will host the evening and guide attendees through a lineup of award presentations.
Awards presented during the evening will include:
- Jeff Silver Memorial Award — Platinum Individual
- Russ Verona Memorial Award — Gold Class Shop
- Collision Industry Individual Service Award

SCRS says the March Taylor Kina’Ole Award honors an individual who exemplifies the Hawaiian principle of Kina’Ole: doing the right thing, in the right way, at the right time, and for the right reasons.

The award celebrates the legacy of March Taylor, whose commitment to technical excellence, mentorship, and service to others left a lasting impression on the collision repair community and around the SCRS table.
It recognizes individuals who demonstrate those same values and passion for doing what is right through their contributions to the industry and the people around them.

The theme of the Nov. 3 meeting, to be held in Westgate’s Pavilion 1, is “Customer Impacts.” Chairman Dan Risley will kick off the meeting, followed by incoming chairman Trent Tinsley, who will share his thoughts and goals for 2027.
Attendees will hear from CIC’s Governmental and Estimating and Repair Planning committees on AI disclosure in the repair and claims process and on submitting technical inquiries.

CIC says the Governmental Committee members will discuss documenting AI’s role, identifying who changed or approved an estimate, and making sure a qualified person can review decisions that affect payment or vehicle safety. Estimating and Repair Planning Committee members will break down how to craft and submit clear, complete technical inquiries to OEMs and estimating databases, according to CIC’s agenda.

The Industry Exchange, a podcast-esque portion of CIC’s meetings with Aaron Schulenburg, will include Kristin Dziczek, senior policy advisor for the Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago. The agenda lists her as one of the nation’s leading voices on the economic forces shaping the automotive industry.

Dziczek’s research focuses on transportation and is backed by decades of experience studying automotive manufacturing, labor, supply chains, policy, and technology, according to the agenda. Earlier this year, Dziczek described the 2025 auto industry as a shock absorber during the Automotive Insights Symposium.

The OEM Industry Relations Committee plans to discuss how post-COVID economic and technological shifts are affecting aftermarket repair quality, warranty implications, and customer satisfaction. They’ll also go over strategies for OEMs to support repair readiness, manage repair costs, and maintain brand loyalty in an increasingly complex market.
Next, the Parts & Materials Committee will talk about how vehicle-specific consumables, as critical components of the OEM repair process, directly influence repair quality, safety, and compliance.

In a game of “Family Feud,” the Business Operations and Management Committee will cover retirement and exit planning for shop owners, whether through succession, management buyouts, employee stock ownership plans, or sale.

To close out committee presentations, Repair Process and Procedures will lead a panel discussion to showcase the details of what today’s modern collision repair facilities face in replicating modern, technical OEM finishes.
A special presentation on the 2026 SEMA Show New Products Showcase entries and winners, including personal favorites from CIC leaders, will wrap up the meeting.
