articles.title: Hundreds of Baby Whales Have Died in Argentina This Year—and Scientists Are Scrambling to Understand Why

paras.en: Hundreds of whale calves have washed up dead along Argentina’s coast in recent months, leaving scientists scrambling to determine what’s causing the deaths.
paras.zh: 最近几个月，数百只鲸鱼幼崽在阿根廷海岸被冲死，科学家们正在争先恐后地确定导致死亡的原因。

paras.en: Every year, southern right whales migrate to the sheltered waters off Argentina’s Peninsula Valdes to give birth and rear their young. Between May and December, it’s not uncommon for dead whale calves to be found along the coast of Chubut province, in the center of the Patagonia region—some 20 to 30 percent of calves born in a given season may not survive, per Live Science’s María de los Ángeles Orfila. But this year, experts say the death toll appears to be much higher than usual.
paras.zh: 每年，南露脊鲸都会迁徙到阿根廷巴尔德斯半岛（ Peninsula Valdes ）外受保护的水域，分娩和抚养幼鲸。根据Live Science的María de los Ángeles Orfila的数据，在5月至12月期间，在巴塔哥尼亚地区中心的丘布特省沿海地区发现死亡的鲸鱼幼崽并不罕见，在某个特定季节出生的幼崽中，约有20 ％至30 ％可能无法存活。但专家表示，今年的死亡人数似乎比平时高得多。

paras.en: They’re holding off on releasing the final tally until after the season ends. But preliminary figures suggest more than 300 southern right whale calves have died since June, roughly three times the previous record of 113 deaths set in 2012.
paras.zh: 他们推迟发布最终统计，直到赛季结束后。但初步数据显示，自6月以来，已有300多头南露脊鲸幼鲸死亡，大约是2012年113头死亡记录的三倍。

paras.en: “The death rate [among young whales] is quite high this season in particular,” Mariano Coscarella, a biologist with Argentina’s Center for the Study of Marine Systems, tells the Agence France-Presse.
paras.zh: 阿根廷海洋系统中心生物学家马里亚诺·科斯卡雷拉（ Mariano Coscarella ）告诉法新社： “本赛季（幼鲸）的死亡率非常高。”

paras.en: Because of the unusually high calf mortality, scientists sent tissue samples for analysis earlier than usual this year. Those samples tested positive for Erysipelothrix rhusiopathiae, a bacterium that can cause a skin infection called erysipelas.
paras.zh: 由于小牛死亡率异常高，科学家今年比平时更早地发送了组织样本进行分析。这些样本检测出Erysipelothrix rhusiopathiae阳性， Erysipelothrix rhusiopathiae是一种可引起称为丹毒的皮肤感染的细菌。

paras.en: Scientists suspect gulls are spreading the bacteria by pecking at southern right whale calves as they surface to breathe, creating wounds in their skin. The bacteria could already be present on the whales’ skin, or it might be transferred by a gull that previously pecked an infected whale.
paras.zh: 科学家怀疑海鸥通过啄食南露脊鲸幼崽来传播细菌，因为它们浮出水面呼吸，在皮肤上造成伤害。这些细菌可能已经存在于鲸鱼的皮肤上，或者可能是由以前啄食受感染鲸鱼的海鸥转移的。

paras.en: E. rhusiopathiae was first detected in southern right whale calves in 2013. Scientists are still trying to understand what could have made it so deadly this year.
paras.zh: 2013年， E. rhusiopathiae首次在南露脊鲸幼崽中被发现。科学家们仍在试图弄清楚是什么原因导致了今年如此致命的灾难。

paras.en: One possibility is that the bacteria itself has evolved, leading to more severe infections. Or perhaps, changes in food availability are affecting the mothers’ body condition and, as a result, the health and resilience of their newborn calves.
paras.zh: 一种可能性是细菌本身已经进化，导致更严重的感染。或者，食物供应的变化正在影响母亲的身体状况，从而影响新生小牛的健康和复原力。

paras.en: The deaths might also be connected to changes to marine conditions, such as water temperature, salinity or pH, possibly caused by climate change or El Niño. These shifts might be creating “this perfect storm where this bacteria is powerful enough to overcome the immunity of the babies and cause their deaths,” Marcela Uhart, a veterinarian at the University of California, Davis, who leads the Southern Right Whale Health Monitoring Program, tells the Associated Press.
paras.zh: 死亡也可能与海洋条件的变化有关，例如可能由气候变化或厄尔尼诺现象引起的水温、盐度或pH值。负责南露脊鲸健康监测计划的加州大学戴维斯分校兽医Marcela Uhart告诉美联社，这些转变可能正在创造“这种完美的风暴，这种细菌足以克服婴儿的免疫力并导致他们死亡”。

paras.en: Southern right whales were hunted to the brink of extinction during the 19th and 20th centuries. However, the population has rebounded since an international moratorium on commercial whaling was enacted in the 1980s. Today, an estimated 12,000 to 15,000 individuals live across the Southern Hemisphere.
paras.zh: 在19世纪和20世纪，南露脊鲸被猎杀到濒临灭绝的边缘。然而，自20世纪80年代颁布国际暂停商业捕鲸以来，人口已经反弹。今天，估计有12,000至15,000人居住在南半球各地。

paras.en: Whalers are no longer killing southern right whales for their oil, meat and baleen. But these massive marine mammals—which can weigh up to 176,000 pounds and reach lengths of up to 56 feet—still face numerous threats. They’re vulnerable to chemical and noise pollution, entanglement in fishing gear, climate change, habitat degradation and vessel strikes.
paras.zh: 捕鲸者不再为了油、肉和须而捕杀南露脊鲸。但是，这些巨大的海洋哺乳动物--体重可达176,000磅，长度可达56英尺--仍然面临着众多威胁。它们易受化学和噪音污染、渔具纠缠、气候变化、栖息地退化和船只撞击的影响。

paras.en: For now, scientists say it’s too soon to tell whether and how this year’s calf die-off might affect the broader southern right whale population. But some are cautiously optimistic. Southern right whales have exceptionally long life spans, with some individuals possibly reaching 150 years old. Because of that, each cohort of calves has a smaller impact on the population as a whole.
paras.zh: 目前，科学家们表示，现在判断今年的小牛死亡是否以及如何影响更广泛的南露脊鲸种群还为时过早。但有些人持谨慎乐观态度。南露脊鲸的寿命特别长，有些个体可能达到150岁。因此，每组小牛对整个种群的影响较小。

paras.en: “What would be concerning is if there were two, three or four episodes like this,” Coscarella tells Live Science.
paras.zh: Coscarella告诉Live Science ： “如果有两集、三集或四集这样的剧集，那将是令人担忧的。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, juvenile and adult whales have also been found dead in Argentine Patagonia, which is unusual, reports Delfina Torres Cabreros for El País. Scientists think the more than dozen deaths might be related to harmful algal blooms, which occur when toxic algae grow rapidly due to climatic and environmental conditions. The blooms were also responsible for an unusual mortality event that primarily affected adult females in 2022.
paras.zh: 与此同时，在阿根廷巴塔哥尼亚也发现了幼鲸和成年鲸的尸体，据El País的Delfina Torres Cabreros报道，这是不寻常的。科学家认为，十几例死亡可能与有害的藻华有关，当有毒藻类由于气候和环境条件而迅速生长时，就会发生有害藻华。水花也导致了2022年主要影响成年女性的异常死亡事件。

paras.en: Necropsies revealed that some of the juvenile and adult whales were in good physical condition and had large amounts of food in their stomachs when they died. Southern right whales are filter feeders that use their baleen—flexible plates that hang from their upper jaws—to skim tiny creatures called copepods and krill from the water.
paras.zh: 尸检显示，一些幼鲸和成年鲸在死亡时身体状况良好，胃里有大量食物。南露脊鲸是过滤喂食器，它们使用从上颚悬挂的鲸须柔性盘子从水中掠过称为桡足类和磷虾的微小生物。

paras.en: The necropsy findings suggest they might have eaten prey that was contaminated by toxic algae, but researchers won’t know for sure until testing confirms whether biotoxins are present in the whale carcasses.
paras.zh: 尸检结果表明，他们可能吃了被有毒藻类污染的猎物，但在测试确认鲸鱼尸体中是否存在生物毒素之前，研究人员无法确定。

paras.en: “This does not in itself prove poisoning, but it is a factor we are considering as part of the investigation,” Víctor Fratto, director of the Native Wildlife Rescue Program in Argentina who is helping to conduct the necropsies, tells the United Press International’s Banyeliz Muñoz.

articles.title: See 18 Captivating Images From the European Wildlife Photographer of the Year Contest

paras.en: See 18 Captivating Images From the European Wildlife Photographer of the Year Contest
paras.zh: 观看欧洲野生动物摄影师年度大赛的18张精彩图片

paras.en: From tranquil landscapes to a thunderous flock of seabirds, the recognized photos reveal stunning scenes of often-hidden aspects of the natural world
paras.zh: 从宁静的景观到雷鸣般的海鸟群，公认的照片揭示了自然世界经常隐藏的惊人场景

paras.en: Surrounded by dozens of hibernating horseshoe bats holding tight to the ceiling of a mine tunnel, one would be forgiven for taking in the scene by simply looking up. But as photographer Imre Potyó walked through this restricted-access environment in Hungary’s Börzsöny Mountains, where he has been documenting bats for 13 years, he instead looked down.
paras.zh: 被几十只冬眠的马蹄蝙蝠包围着，紧紧抓住矿洞的天花板，只要抬头看一看，就会原谅你进入现场。但是，当摄影师Imre Potyó走过匈牙利Börzsöny山脉的这个限制进入的环境时，他在那里记录了13年的蝙蝠，他转而向下看。

paras.en: Because the bats occasionally get up from their roost to hunt, they leave behind droppings that accumulate in a layer on the ground. In a photograph that just won the German Society for Nature Photography’s European Wildlife Photographer of the Year contest, Potyó took a macro look at a small pin mold that had grown in a whitish layer on the guano.
paras.zh: 由于蝙蝠偶尔会从栖息地起身狩猎，因此它们会在地面上留下堆积在一层的粪便。在刚刚赢得德国自然摄影学会年度欧洲野生动物摄影师大赛的照片中， Potyó宏观地观察了鸟粪上生长在白色层中的小针模。

paras.en: By shifting focus, he captured both the filaments of the mold and the bats in the background.
paras.zh: 通过转移焦点，他捕捉到了模具的细丝和背景中的蝙蝠。

paras.en: “This image speaks to a larger truth about the natural world: Much of life exists beyond our immediate awareness, in places we seldom visit and among organisms we rarely notice,” says contest judge Tom Gilks, managing director of the Nature Picture Library and pictures editor for BBC Wildlife magazine, in a statement. “At a time of unprecedented biodiversity loss, many of these worlds are disappearing before they have even been properly documented, let alone understood,” Gilks adds.
paras.zh: 大赛评委汤姆·吉尔克斯（ Tom Gilks ）在一份声明中说： “这张照片说明了一个关于自然世界的更大真相：许多生命存在于我们的直接意识之外，在我们很少访问的地方，在我们很少注意到的生物体中。”自然图片库董事总经理兼英国广播公司野生动物杂志图片编辑。Gilks补充道： “在这个生物多样性前所未有地丧失的时代，许多这样的世界正在消失，甚至没有得到适当的记录，更不用说被理解了。”

paras.en: Wildlife photographers try to make those mysterious worlds less obscure, bringing into focus the rare, tiny, gut-wrenching and beautiful aspects of nature. They strive to take Earth’s biodiversity—even miniscule organisms and those found in remote locations—and share it with the world.
paras.zh: 野生动物摄影师试图让这些神秘的世界变得不那么模糊，聚焦于自然的罕见、微小、令人痛苦和美丽的方面。他们努力将地球的生物多样性--甚至是微小的生物和那些在偏远地区发现的生物--与世界分享。

paras.en: Since 2001, the European Wildlife Photographer of the Year competition has highlighted images that “celebrate the beauty of our planet, reveal its vulnerability and send a clear message for its protection,” according to the contest.
paras.zh: 自2001年以来，欧洲年度野生动物摄影师比赛突出了“庆祝我们星球的美丽，揭示它的脆弱性，并发出保护它的明确信息”的图像。

paras.en: This year, amateur and professional photographers from 46 countries submitted more than 26,000 entries, setting a record for participation. An international jury whittled down this pool of photos to 107 winners across nine categories and two special prizes.
paras.zh: 今年，来自46个国家的业余和专业摄影师提交了超过26,000份参赛作品，创下了参赛纪录。一个国际评审团将这些照片减少到107名获奖者，涉及9个类别和2个特别奖。

paras.en: All the contest’s winners, runners up and highly commended images can be seen on the German Society for Nature Photography’s website. Here’s a selection of some of those photographs, from a secretive cat to a playful sea lion and a glowing crab.
paras.zh: 所有获奖者、亚军和备受推崇的图片都可以在德国自然摄影协会的网站上看到。这里有一些精选照片，从神秘的猫到俏皮的海狮和发光的螃蟹。

articles.title: Dolores Huerta, Farmworker Rights Activist Who Coined 'Sí Se Puede,' Dies at 96

paras.en: Dolores Huerta, a labor leader and civil rights activist who dedicated her life to improving working conditions for migrant farmworkers in the United States, has died at the age of 96.
paras.zh: 多洛雷斯·韦尔塔（ Dolores Huerta ）是一名劳工领袖和民权活动家，她毕生致力于改善美国农民工的工作条件，现年96岁。

paras.en: Huerta died at her home in Bakersfield, California, surrounded by close family members on October 28, according to a statement released by her foundation. The cause of death was cancer, Erik Olvera, a spokesman for the family, tells the Los Angeles Times’ James Rainey.
paras.zh: 根据她的基金会发布的一份声明，韦尔塔于10月28日在加利福尼亚州贝克斯菲尔德的家中去世，周围是亲密的家庭成员。该家族的发言人埃里克·奥尔维拉（ Erik Olvera ）告诉《洛杉矶时报》的詹姆斯·雷尼（ James Rainey ） ，死因是癌症。

paras.en: “It’s a tough time,” Olvera adds. “She was incredibly beloved, and not only was she beloved, but she was an icon to so many people around the country and around the world, really. If anything, her family is clinging to memories and clinging to each other as they mourn.”
paras.zh: “这是一段艰难的时期，” Olvera补充道。“她深受喜爱，不仅深受喜爱，而且在全国和世界各地的许多人中都是偶像。如果有的话，她的家人在哀悼时紧紧抓住记忆，紧紧抓住彼此。”

paras.en: Born in 1930 in New Mexico, Huerta moved to Stockton, California, as a child with her mother and two brothers after her parents divorced. She graduated from Stockton High School and earned a degree from Stockton College (now San Joaquin Delta College) at a time when educational opportunities for women, especially Mexican American women, were limited.
paras.zh: Huerta于1930年出生于新墨西哥州，父母离婚后，她与母亲和两个兄弟一起搬到了加利福尼亚州的斯托克顿。她毕业于斯托克顿高中，并在斯托克顿学院（现为圣华金三角洲学院）获得学位，当时女性，特别是墨西哥裔美国女性的教育机会有限。

paras.en: Huerta began her career as an elementary school teacher but pivoted to advocacy after seeing farmworkers’ children coming to school hungry and barefoot. She began working for the Community Service Organization, a Latino civil rights group, where she met Cesar Chavez, who shared her commitment to improving conditions for farmworkers.
paras.zh: 韦尔塔的职业生涯始于小学教师，但在看到农场工人的孩子饿着肚子赤脚上学后，她转向了倡导。她开始为拉丁裔民权组织社区服务组织工作，在那里她遇到了塞萨尔·查韦斯（ Cesar Chavez ） ，后者分享了她对改善农场工人条件的承诺。

paras.en: “They were only earning like 50 cents an hour,” Huerta told Good Morning America in 2020. “They had no unemployment insurance … They weren’t even able to have any kind of access to the food banks ... No bathrooms in the field, especially for the women. That was really horrible. No access to drinking water. They would actually charge them for the water that they would give the workers and of course, no rest periods, as if they were pretty much brutalized.”
paras.zh: “他们每小时的收入只有50美分，” Huerta在2020年告诉《早安美国》。“他们没有失业保险……他们甚至无法进入食物银行……田间没有卫生间，尤其是女性。那真是太可怕了。无法获得饮用水。他们实际上会向他们收取他们给工人的水费，当然，没有休息时间，就好像他们几乎被残酷对待一样。”

paras.en: In 1962, Huerta and Chavez co-founded the National Farm Workers Association, which later became the United Farm Workers. Throughout the 1960s and 1970s, the union orchestrated strikes, nonviolent protests and nationwide produce boycotts.
paras.zh: 1962年，韦尔塔和查韦斯共同创立了全国农场工人协会，后来成为美国农场工人联合会。在整个20世纪60年代和70年代，工会精心策划了罢工、非暴力抗议和全国范围内的抵制活动。

paras.en: “The farmworkers couldn’t win by themselves,” Huerta told Smithsonian magazine’s Ryan P. Smith in 2017. “They had to reach out to the American public, and all of the 17 million Americans that decided not to eat grapes or lettuce and Gallo wine. And that’s the way that we won.”
paras.zh: “农场工人自己赢不了，”韦尔塔在2017年告诉史密森尼杂志的瑞恩· P ·史密斯（ Ryan P. Smith ）。“他们必须接触美国公众，以及决定不吃葡萄、生菜和加洛葡萄酒的1700万美国人。这就是我们获胜的方式。”

paras.en: Those efforts paved the way for the passage of the California Agricultural Labor Relations Act of 1975, which gave farmworkers the right to self-organize, form unions and engage in collective bargaining. It was the country’s first major farm-labor law outside of Hawaii, per the New York Times’ Robert D. McFadden.
paras.zh: 这些努力为1975年《加州农业劳动关系法》的通过铺平了道路，该法赋予了农场工人自我组织、组建工会和参与集体谈判的权利。根据《纽约时报》的罗伯特· D ·麦克法登（ Robert D. McFadden ）的说法，这是夏威夷以外的第一部主要农场劳动法。

paras.en: The mother of 14 children, Huerta served as Chavez’s second-in-command until his death in 1993 and the union’s vice president for nearly four decades. Earlier this year, Huerta told the New York Times’ Manny Fernandez and Sarah Hurtes that Chavez had twice forced her into having sex, resulting in two pregnancies. She said she kept quiet about the sexual assaults because she didn’t want to hurt the farmworkers movement. She arranged for both girls to be raised by others but later reconnected with them.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The Times investigation also found that Chavez had groomed and sexually abused girls as young as 12. Huerta said she had not been aware of Chavez’s sexual misconduct involving underage girls. “Unfortunately, he used some of his great leadership to abuse women and children—it’s really awful,” Huerta told Times.
paras.zh: 《泰晤士报》的调查还发现，查韦斯对年仅12岁的女孩进行了整理和性虐待。韦尔塔说，她不知道查韦斯涉及未成年女孩的性行为不端。Huerta告诉《纽约时报》： “不幸的是，他利用自己的一些伟大领导力来虐待妇女和儿童--这真的很糟糕。”

paras.en: In 2003, Huerta founded the Dolores Huerta Foundation, a social justice nonprofit, and promoted women candidates for public office as part of the Feminist Majority Foundation. She remained active into her later years, advocating for racial equality, economic justice, LGBTQ rights and women's rights.
paras.zh: 2003年，韦尔塔创立了社会正义非营利组织多洛雷斯·韦尔塔基金会（ Dolores Huerta Foundation ） ，并作为女权主义多数派基金会（ Feminist Majority Foundation ）的一部分，提拔女性候选人担任公职。她一直活跃到晚年，倡导种族平等、经济正义、LGBTQ权利和妇女权利。

paras.en: Huerta earned numerous awards, including 15 honorary degrees and the Presidential Medal of Freedom. In 2019, California established an annual Dolores Huerta Day in recognition of her lifelong pursuit of justice.
paras.zh: 韦尔塔获得了许多奖项，包括15个荣誉学位和总统自由勋章。2019年，加利福尼亚州设立了一年一度的多洛雷斯·韦尔塔日（ Dolores Huerta Day ） ，以表彰她对正义的终

paras.en: “She made history,” Tey Marianna Nunn, associate director of content and interpretation at the Smithsonian’s National Museum of the American Latino, tells Smithsonian magazine. “We can never forget the impact she has had on all of us.”
paras.zh: “她创造了历史，”史密森尼国家拉丁裔美国人博物馆（ Smithsonian's National Museum of the American Latino ）的内容和解释副主任泰伊·玛丽安娜·纳恩（ Tey Marianna Nunn ）告诉史密森尼杂志“我们永远不会忘记她对我们所有人的影响。”

paras.en: Huerta is credited with coining the phrase “Sí se puede,” or “yes we can,” which became a “rallying cry for workers, women, immigrants and people fighting for justice around the world,” according to the statement from her foundation. “She gave people the courage to recognize their own power—and showed them how to use it.”
paras.zh: 根据她的基金会的声明，韦尔塔被认为创造了“Sí se puede”或“是的，我们可以”这个短语，这成为“全世界工人、妇女、移民和为正义而战的人们的号召力”。“她让人们有勇气认识到自己的力量，并向他们展示了如何使用它。”

paras.en: After starting as a grocery service, Hungryroot spent years piecing together proprietary AI long before AI became the byword of everything from your electric shaver to your literal kitchen sink. articles.title: Judge rejects DOJ effort to remove 20K California mail-in ballots

paras.en: Oct. 28 (UPI) -- A federal judge on Wednesday rejected a Trump administration effort to force California to remove mail-in ballots belonging to more than 20,000 registered voters it says are "likely" non-citizens, warning the move would "wreak havoc" on the midterm elections and threaten Americans' right to vote.
paras.zh: 10 月 28 日（合众社）——周三，一名联邦法官驳回了特朗普政府强迫加州撤回超过 20,000 名登记选民的邮寄选票的努力，称这些选民“可能”是非公民，并警告称此举将对中期选举“造成严重破坏”，并威胁美国人的投票权。

paras.en: "Never before in American history has the federal government, on the eve of an election, sought to coerce a state and local government to abandon their own Constitutional elections procedures and bend to the will of the Executive Branch," U.S. District Judge David Carter of the Central District of California said in his ruling.
paras.zh: 加州中区联邦地区法官戴维·卡特在裁决中表示，“在美国历史上，联邦政府从未在选举前夕试图强迫州和地方政府放弃自己的宪法选举程序并屈服于行政部门的意愿。”

paras.en: "In bringing this lawsuit, the Executive would have this Court believe that it reigns as a sole sovereign. But California and its people are sovereign, too."
paras.zh: “在提起这起诉讼时，行政部门会让法院相信它是唯一的主权国家。但加州及其人民也拥有主权。”

paras.en: Federal lawyers swiftly filed an appeal.
paras.zh: 联邦律师迅速提起上诉。

paras.en: The fight over the mail-in ballots goes back to last year, when the Trump administration sought to secure California's unredacted voter registration rolls. After Carter dismissed the Justice Department's lawsuit in January, federal investigators obtained commercially available voter registration data, which they cross-referenced with federal immigration and other records.
paras.zh: 关于邮寄选票的争论可以追溯到去年，当时特朗普政府试图确保加州未经编辑的选民登记名册。卡特一月份驳回司法部的诉讼后，联邦调查人员获得了商业上可用的选民登记数据，并将这些数据与联邦移民和其他记录进行交叉引用。

paras.en: In July, the Department of Homeland Security claimed that as many as 190,832 noncitizens might be registered to vote in California. The state then asked the federal government to explain the methodology used to produced that number, but DHS officials declined to answer.
paras.zh: 7 月，国土安全部声称，加州可能有多达 190,832 名非公民登记投票。该州随后要求联邦政府解释产生该数字的方法，但国土安全部官员拒绝回答。

paras.en: Then on Oct. 13 -- nearly two weeks after Los Angeles County had begun mailing ballots to registered voters -- the Justice Department provided Los Angeles County with a list of more than 20,000 registered voters it identified as "likely" noncitizens and gave the officials 48 hours to determine whether any were citizens and then segregate the ballots of those whose citizenship could not be confirmed.
paras.zh: 然后在 10 月 13 日，即洛杉矶县开始向登记选民邮寄选票近两周后，司法部向洛杉矶县提供了一份被确定为“可能”非公民的 20,000 多名登记选民名单，并给官员 48 小时的时间来确定是否有公民，然后将无法确认公民身份的选票分开。

paras.en: The county responded that the list contained addresses throughout the state, not just Los Angeles County, while arguing that complying with the department's demands would violate state laws as well as be impractical.
paras.zh: 该县回应称，该名单包含整个州的地址，而不仅仅是洛杉矶县，同时认为遵守该部门的要求将违反州法律，而且不切实际。

paras.en: Shortly after the deadline expired on Oct. 15, the Justice Department sued California, alleging its mailing and counting of ballots from suspected violated the Constitutions' Supremacy Clause by interfering with federal law prohibiting noncitizens from voting.
paras.zh: 10 月 15 日截止日期到期后不久，司法部起诉加州，指控其邮寄和点算嫌疑人选票的行为违反了宪法至上条款，干扰了禁止非公民投票的联邦法律。

paras.en: It then filed an emergency application for a temporary restraining order amid litigation.
paras.zh: 随后，它在诉讼中紧急申请临时限制令。

paras.en: Carter on Wednesday denied the federal government's request for emergency relief, ruling the effort to exclude the ballots "violates longstanding constitutional principles mandating that states have control over their elections."
paras.zh: 卡特周三拒绝了联邦政府的紧急救济请求，裁定排除选票的努力“违反了要求各州控制选举的长期宪法原则”。

paras.en: "If plaintiff's last-minute request for relief were granted, either party could create chaos for their own political purposes to disrupt the election process," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“如果原告最后一刻的救济请求得到批准，任何一方都可以为了自己的政治目的制造混乱，扰乱选举进程。”

paras.en: "Over 20,000 registered Californians would potentially lose the right that generations of Americans have fought to preserve."
paras.zh: “超过 20,000 名注册的加州人可能会失去几代美国人努力维护的权利。”

paras.en: Carter also criticized the Trump administration's broader efforts to obtain states' voter registration records, stating that the Justice Department had not won any of the 26 decided cases.
paras.zh: 卡特还批评特朗普政府为获取各州选民登记记录而采取的更广泛努力，并表示司法部在已判决的 26 起案件中没有赢得任何一案。

paras.en: He also questioned its demands for states to act on its own lists of alleged noncitizens registered to vote, pointing to its effort in Nevada where it had initially claimed there were nearly 16,000 registered noncitizens, a figure it reduced to a hand-picked subset of 185 -- all of whom Nevada said were U.S. citizens.
paras.zh: 他还质疑其要求各州根据自己的所谓非公民登记投票名单采取行动的要求，并指出其在内华达州所做的努力，最初声称该州有近 16,000 名登记非公民，但后来将这一数字减少到精心挑选的 185 人——内华达州称所有这些人都是美国公民。

paras.en: "There is a clear remedy available. The United States can prosecute individuals according to Section 611, as it has historically and recently done. California also has established procedures to cancel the voter registrations of any individuals proven ineligible," Carter said.
paras.zh: “有明确的补救措施。美国可以根据第 611 条起诉个人，就像历史上和最近所做的那样。加州还制定了程序，取消任何被证明不符合资格的个人的选民登记，”卡特说。

paras.en: "Eroded trust in our democracy is irreparable. Once a vote is segregated, lasting harm has occurred. If the executive can discount votes and threaten an ongoing election due to unproven allegations, then our democracy is in danger."
paras.zh: “对我们民主的信任受到侵蚀是无法挽回的。一旦投票被隔离，就会造成持久的伤害。如果行政部门可以因未经证实的指控而打折选票并威胁正在进行的选举，那么我们的民主就处于危险之中。”

articles.title: Milwaukee Brewers beat Tampa Bay Rays for first World Series title

paras.en: Oct. 28 (UPI) -- Timber cracks sang thunderous echoes through Tropicana Field as the contact-zealous Milwaukee Brewers sprayed the turf with hits to beat the Tampa Bay Rays 4-1 in Game 5 and clinch the franchise's first World Series title Wednesday in St. Petersburg, Fla.
paras.zh: 10 月 28 日（合众国际社）——星期三，在佛罗里达州圣彼得堡，狂热的密尔沃基酿酒人队 (Milwaukee Brewers) 在第五场比赛中以 4-1 击败坦帕湾光芒队 (Tampa Bay Rays)，赢得了球队的第一个世界系列赛冠军，在纯果康纳球场 (Tropicana Field) 中，木材裂缝发出雷鸣般的回声。

paras.en: The Brewers' small-ball approach, which helped them post the MLB's best regular-season run differential despite hitting the fewest home runs in the National League, endured for an 11-2 postseason mark.
paras.zh: 酿酒人队的小球策略帮助他们取得了美国职业棒球大联盟（MLB）常规赛中最好的分差，尽管他们是全国联盟中本垒打最少的，并且在季后赛中取得了 11 胜 2 负的战绩。

paras.en: "I think about the city of Milwaukee, the state of Wisconsin, they pushed us through, for sure," Brewers manager Pat Murphy said at the trophy presentation.
paras.zh: “我想到了威斯康星州的密尔沃基市，他们肯定帮助我们渡过难关，”酿酒人队主教练帕特·墨菲在颁奖典礼上说道。

paras.en: "This group of guys here will be remembered forever. They deserve that because they were a team."
paras.zh: “这里的这群人将被永远铭记。他们应得的，因为他们是一个团队。”

paras.en: On the mound, the Brewers turned to fireballer Jacob Misiorowski to cement their first title run. The 6-foot-7 right-handed pitcher unleashed 51 fastballs of at least 100 mph in Game 5.
paras.zh: 在投手丘上，酿酒人队求助于火球手雅各布·米西奥罗夫斯基（Jacob Misiorowski），以巩固他们的首个冠军头衔。这位身高 6 英尺 7 英寸的右手投手在第五场比赛中投出了 51 个速度至少为 100 英里/小时的快球。

paras.en: He allowed just two hits over 5 2/3 innings and is now on track to become the first Cy Young Award winner to clinch a title in the same year since Orel Hershiser accomplished the feat in 1988.
paras.zh: 他在 5 2/3 局中仅失两支安打，现在有望成为自 1988 年奥雷尔·赫希瑟 (Orel Hershiser) 完成这一壮举以来第一位在同一年获得赛扬奖的得主。

paras.en: "I don't even have words," Misiorowski said. "It's amazing watching my guys celebrate. I know they are going crazy in Milwaukee."
paras.zh: “我什至无话可说，”米西奥罗夫斯基说。 “看着我的球员们庆祝真是太棒了。我知道他们在密尔沃基会变得疯狂。”

paras.en: Brewers relief pitchers JoJo Romero, Abner Uribe and Trevor Megill allowed two hits and one run over the final 3 2/3 innings of the title clincher. Rookie shortstop Cooper Pratt, who went 4 for 5 in Game 4, followed with a 2 for 3 performance in the finale. He also drove in half of the Brewers' runs.
paras.zh: 酿酒人队的后援投手乔乔·罗梅罗、阿布纳·乌里韦和特雷弗·梅吉尔在冠军争夺战的最后 3 2/3 局中失两安打和一分。新秀游击手库珀·普拉特在第四场比赛中5投4中，在决赛中打出3投2中的表现。他还参与了酿酒人队一半的比赛。

paras.en: "It's crazy, the pressure is out of this world," Pratt said. "It's some of the hardest, but most fun baseball I've ever been a part of."
paras.zh: “这太疯狂了，压力来自这个世界，”普拉特说。 “这是我参加过的最难但最有趣的棒球比赛之一。”

paras.en: Catcher Williams Contreras, who went 8 for 21 (.380) in the series, earned World Series MVP honors. Left fielder Jackson Chourio went 11 for 24 (.458) to help fuel the Brewers run.
paras.zh: 捕手威廉姆斯·孔特雷拉斯 (Catcher Williams Contreras) 在系列赛中 21 投 8 中 (0.380)，获得了世界大赛 MVP 荣誉。左外野手杰克逊·乔里奥（Jackson Chourio）24投11中（0.458）帮助酿酒人队继续前进。

paras.en: Like in the previous four games of the best-of-seven-game series, Brewers hitters drove up pitch counts against the Rays staff and won in the margins.
paras.zh: 就像七场四胜系列赛的前四场比赛一样，酿酒人队的击球手在对阵光芒队工作人员的比赛中增加了投球数，并以微弱优势获胜。

paras.en: Pratt drove in second baseman Brice Turang with a second-inning single off Drew Rasmussen for Game 5's first run. Third baseman David Hamilton singled in Pratt for a 2-0 edge in the fifth. The Brewers struck twice more in the sixth -- off an RBI double from Contreras and a Pratt sacrifice fly.
paras.zh: 普拉特在第二局击出二垒手布里斯·图朗（Brice Turang），击中德鲁·拉斯穆森（Drew Rasmussen），打出第五场第一分。三垒手大卫·汉密尔顿在第五局中安打普拉特，以 2-0 领先。酿酒人队在第六局又击中两次——孔特雷拉斯的打点双打和普拉特的牺牲飞球。

paras.en: The Rays attempted a ninth-inning rally, but scored just once off a double from left fielder Chandler Simpson. Megill slammed the door on the attempted comeback by forcing a game-ending ground out from second baseman Richie Palacios in the next at-bat.
paras.zh: 光芒队在第九局试图发起反击，但左外野手钱德勒·辛普森 (Chandler Simpson) 打出两垒安打，仅得一分。梅吉尔在下一次击球时迫使二垒手里奇·帕拉西奥斯投出一个结束比赛的滚地球，从而彻底结束了她的反扑尝试。

paras.en: The Brewers relief pitcher, who did not pitch two consecutive innings once during the regular season, allowed two hits and one run, with three strikeouts, over the final two frames of Game 5.
paras.zh: 这位酿酒人队的替补投手在常规赛中没有一次连续投出两局，但在第五场比赛的最后两局中失了两安打和一分，三振三振。

paras.en: Turang went 2 for 4 for the Brewers. Center fielder Garrett Mitchell, who went 1 for 3 with a walk, was the only other Brewers player to reach base more than once in Game 5.
paras.zh: 图朗为酿酒人队4投2中。中外野手加勒特·米切尔（Garrett Mitchell）保送三投一中，是酿酒人队唯一一位在第五场比赛中多次上垒的球员。

paras.en: With a fifth-inning single, Pratt set a rookie record for the most consecutive at-bats with a hit at a World Series -- with six. He went 8 for 19 (.421) in the title series.
paras.zh: 普拉特在第五局打出一垒安打，创造了世界大赛上连续击球数最多的新秀纪录——六次。他在冠军系列赛中19投8中（0.421）。

paras.en: The Brewers, who set a franchise record with 103 regular-season wins, outhit the Rays 51-30 in the World Series. They held a 25-12 scoring advantage.
paras.zh: 酿酒人队以 103 场常规赛胜利创造了队史纪录，并在世界大赛中以 51-30 击败光芒队。他们以25-12的比分优势领先。

paras.en: "It's the best feeling ever," Brewers designated hitter Christian Yelich said. "I know the city has waited a long, long time for this. We're so happy to bring it home for them."
paras.zh: “这是有史以来最好的感觉，”酿酒人指定击球手克里斯蒂安·耶利奇说。 “我知道这座城市已经等了很长一段时间了。我们很高兴能为他们把它带回家。”

paras.en: With their loss, the Rays remain one of four MLB teams to never win a World Series. That group also features the San Diego Padres, Colorado Rockies and Seattle Mariners, who have never appeared in the title series.
paras.zh: 由于失利，光芒队仍然是美国职业棒球大联盟四支从未赢得过世界大赛冠军的球队之一。该小组还包括圣地亚哥教士队、科罗拉多洛矶队和西雅图水手队，他们从未出现在冠军系列赛中。

articles.title: James O'Keefe charged with voter fraud, identity theft in Minnesota

paras.en: Oct. 29 (UPI) -- Prosecutors in Minnesota have charged two conservative activists, including James O'Keefe, with election-related offenses for giving election judges the names of registered voters without the individuals' consent.
paras.zh: 10 月 29 日（合众国际社）——明尼苏达州检察官指控包括詹姆斯·奥基夫在内的两名保守派活动人士犯有与选举有关的罪行，因为他们未经个人同意向选举法官提供了登记选民的姓名。

paras.en: Hennepin County Attorney Mary Moriarty announced during a press conference Wednesday that O'Keefe, 42, and 26-year-old Cam Higby, a political commentator, were charged with unlawful voting and identity theft, both felony offenses.
paras.zh: 亨内平县检察官玛丽·莫里亚蒂在周三的新闻发布会上宣布，42 岁的奥基夫和 26 岁的政治评论员卡姆·希格比被指控非法投票和身份盗窃，这两项都是重罪。

paras.en: "Free and fair elections are the bedrock of democracy, and their protection is one of our highest priorities," Moriarty said.
paras.zh: 莫里亚蒂说：“自由公正的选举是民主的基石，保护选举是我们的首要任务之一。”

paras.en: The charges stem from Aug. 11, the date of the Minnesota primary election, when the two men, dressed in traditional Muslim garb, including Higby in a burqa, visited several precincts for a video they were shooting concerning a Minnesota law that allows people to register to vote on the day of the election.
paras.zh: 这些指控源于 8 月 11 日，也就是明尼苏达州初选的日期，当时两名男子穿着传统的穆斯林服装，其中希格比穿着罩袍，他们访问了几个选区，拍摄了一段有关明尼苏达州法律的视频，该法律允许人们在选举当天登记投票。

paras.en: Minnesota's decades-old voter-vouching law permits a registered voter to vouch for the residence of up to eight other people in their precinct in order to allow eligible voters to register on Election Day without conventional proof of address. The registered voter must sign an oath confirming that the applicant residents in the precinct.
paras.zh: 明尼苏达州已有数十年历史的选民担保法允许登记选民为其选区内最多八人的居住提供担保，以便合格选民在选举日无需传统地址证明即可登记。登记选民必须签署一份宣誓书，确认申请人居住在该选区。

paras.en: In a statement published with the video in August, O'Keefe said he went "undercover" at polling places in Minneapolis as Muslims and "presented an intentionally extreme scenario to expose the sheer lunacy of Minnesota's 'vouching' system."
paras.zh: 在八月份随视频一起发表的一份声明中，奥基夫表示，他以穆斯林身份在明尼阿波利斯的投票站进行“卧底”，并“故意呈现出一种极端的场景，以揭露明尼苏达州‘凭证’系统的纯粹疯狂。”

paras.en: "We documented workers explaining how Minnesota's vouching process could be used to establish residency for people registering at the polls without standard identification."
paras.zh: “我们记录了工作人员的情况，解释了如何利用明尼苏达州的担保程序为在没有标准身份证明的情况下在投票站登记的人确定居住权。”

paras.en: In the video, O'Keefe speaks with an accent and presents himself under names not his own when asking the election officials about the vouching program.
paras.zh: 在视频中，奥基夫在向选举官员询问有关担保计划的问题时，说话带有口音，并以非自己的名字出现。

paras.en: Moriarty said during the press conference that O'Keefe and Higby identified themselves using names of registered voters without those voters' knowledge or permission, and stopped short of signing the voter registration oath.
paras.zh: 莫里亚蒂在新闻发布会上表示，奥基夫和希格比在选民不知情或未经许可的情况下使用登记选民的姓名表明自己的身份，并且没有签署选民登记誓言。

paras.en: She accused the men of having entered polling places without legitimate purposes and intentionally misrepresenting their identities to election judges in applying for a ballot. Her office said the purpose of the videos and posting them online was to "sow doubt about Minnesota's secure voting systems."
paras.zh: 她指控这些男子没有合法目的进入投票站，并在申请投票时故意向选举法官谎报自己的身份。她的办公室表示，这些视频并将其发布到网上的目的是“引发人们对明尼苏达州安全投票系统的怀疑”。

paras.en: Moriarty explained that the vouching law, which accounted for less than 0.6% of votes cast in the 2024 general election, is most commonly used in senior living facilities by residents who have not updated their driver's license to reflect their current address.
paras.zh: 莫里亚蒂解释说，担保法在 2024 年大选中所获选票不到 0.6%，最常被未更新驾驶执照以反映其当前地址的居民用于高级生活设施。

paras.en: "Minnesota law states clearly that no individual shall intentionally misrepresent their identity in applying for a ballot," she said.
paras.zh: “明尼苏达州法律明确规定，任何个人在申请选票时不得故意歪曲自己的身份，”她说。

paras.en: Moriarty told reporters that the election judges at all the precincts the men had visited noted "this strange behavior." The Hennepin County Attorney's Office was notified of the situation by the Minnesota Secretary of State's Office and the charges followed an investigation and a review.
paras.zh: 莫里亚蒂告诉记者，这些人访问过的所有选区的选举法官都注意到了“这种奇怪的行为”。明尼苏达州国务卿办公室向亨内平县检察官办公室通报了这一情况，并在进行调查和审查后提出指控。

paras.en: She said they would have been able to charge the men even without them having published video of their interactions with the election officials online.
paras.zh: 她说，即使这些人没有在网上发布与选举官员互动的视频，他们也可以对他们提出指控。

paras.en: "We know that they gave the names of registered voters without their permission," she said. "So, yes, we would have been able to go forward without their video."
paras.zh: “我们知道他们未经许可就提供了登记选民的姓名，”她说。 “所以，是的，如果没有他们的视频，我们就能继续前进。”

paras.en: Where the men allegedly obtained the names of the registered voters was unknown, she said, adding that they have interviewed those people.
paras.zh: 她说，这些人据称从哪里获得了登记选民的姓名，目前尚不清楚，并补充说他们已经采访了这些人。

paras.en: "Some were deceased, but others were alive and did not have any idea how these people got their information and certainly did not consent to them using their identity," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“有些人已经去世，但其他人还活着，他们不知道这些人是如何获得信息的，当然也不同意他们使用自己的身份。”

paras.en: O'Keefe and Higby were issued summons but were not in police custody. They are to appear in court on Nov. 16, officials said.
paras.zh: 奥基夫和希格比收到了传票，但没有被警方拘留。官员称，他们将于 11 月 16 日出庭。

paras.en: Higby online reposted clips from the video of them visiting the polling precincts, calling the charges against him "lawfare."
paras.zh: 希格比在网上转发了他们参观投票区的视频片段，称对他的指控是“违法的”。

paras.en: "I am not afraid of Minnesota," he said on X.
paras.zh: “我不害怕明尼苏达，”他在 X 上说道。

paras.en: O'Keefe stated he was facing felony charges for "exposing fraud in Minnesota."
paras.zh: 奥基夫表示，他因“揭露明尼苏达州的欺诈行为”而面临重罪指控。

paras.en: "This is not political," he said in a statement. "It is fundamental. It is about whether citizens still have the right to question their government."
paras.zh: “这不是政治，”他在一份声明中说。 “这是根本性的。这关系到公民是否仍然有权质疑政府。”

paras.en: O'Keefe has had numerous run-ins with the law stemming from his political activism, including pleading guilty in 2010 to a federal misdemeanor charge of entering government property under false pretenses, stemming from an operation where he tried to show a Democratic senator was avoiding calls from constituents opposed to President Barack Obama's healthcare reforms.
paras.zh: 奥基夫因其政治活动而多次触犯法律，包括在 2010 年承认以虚假借口进入政府财产的联邦轻罪指控，原因是他试图向一位民主党参议员表明，他正在躲避反对巴拉克·奥巴马总统医疗改革的选民的呼吁。

articles.title: Hayden Panettiere’s Death Ruled as Accidental, Case Closed: Reports
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: The investigation into Hayden Panettiere’s death is now closed after an investigation found that an accidental overdose was to blame.
paras.zh: 在调查发现海顿·潘妮蒂尔的死亡归咎于意外服药过量后，对海顿·潘妮蒂尔死亡的调查现已结束。

paras.en: The Greenville Police Department has confirmed to reporters that the actor’s passing on Aug. 16 was not being treated as suspicious.
paras.zh: 格林维尔警察局已向记者证实，该演员于 8 月 16 日去世并没有被视为可疑。

paras.en: “Based on the Medical Examiner’s determination and the findings of the investigation, Hayden Panettiere’s death has been ruled accidental,” reads a statement provided to Entertainment Weekly. “The Greenville Police Department has concluded its investigation.”
paras.zh: “根据法医的判定和调查结果，海顿·潘妮蒂尔的死亡被裁定为意外死亡，”《娱乐周刊》提供的一份声明中写道。 “格林维尔警察局已结束调查。”

paras.en: That decision follows a coroner’s report, seen last month by Associated Press, that claimed her death was from an accidental overdose of several drugs, including fentanyl, following a stint in rehab.
paras.zh: 美联社上个月看到验尸官的报告称，她的死亡是由于在戒毒所一段时间后意外服用了包括芬太尼在内的几种药物所致。

paras.en: The former Nashville and Heroes star was found in cardiac arrest at a residence in South Carolina, aged 36. “It is with profound sadness that we share the tragic passing of our beloved Hayden. She was an incredible light and a force of nature who brought immeasurable love and joy to all who knew her — and to the millions who watched her onscreen,” said her father, Skip Panettiere, in a statement.
paras.zh: 这位《纳什维尔》和《英雄》的前明星在南卡罗来纳州的一处住所被发现心脏骤停，享年 36 岁。“我们怀着深深的悲痛，分享我们挚爱的海登的悲惨去世。她是一道不可思议的光芒，是一股自然的力量，给所有认识她的人以及数以百万计在银幕上观看她的人带来了不可估量的爱和欢乐，”她的父亲斯基普·潘妮蒂尔在一份声明中说道。

paras.en: Panettiere had an 11-year-old daughter, Kaya Evdokia Klitschko, with ex-fiancé Wladimir Klitschko, the former heavyweight champion boxer. In 2018, she agreed to give full custody of Kaya to Klitschko amid her struggles with postpartum depression and addiction.
paras.zh: 潘妮蒂尔与前未婚夫、前重量级冠军拳击手弗拉基米尔·克里琴科 (Wladimir Klitschko) 育有一个 11 岁的女儿卡雅·叶夫多基亚·克里琴科 (Kaya Evdokia Klitschko)。 2018年，在卡亚与产后抑郁症和毒瘾作斗争时，她同意将卡亚的全部监护权交给克里琴科。

paras.en: According to AP, it’s remains unclear whether federal authorities will separately continue to examine the case. In a petition last month to a California court, Klitschko noted that federal law enforcement agents had taken some of her items for their own probe. The U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration did not immediately respond to emailed requests from the news agency.
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，目前尚不清楚联邦当局是否会单独继续调查此案。在上个月向加州法院提交的请愿书中，克里琴科指出，联邦执法人员拿走了她的一些物品，以进行自己的调查。美国缉毒局没有立即回复该通讯社通过电子邮件发送的请求。

paras.en: Though she was best known for her small screen work, which got underway with a commercial shoot at 11 months old for a Playskool toy train, back in 1990, Panettiere also left behind a music imprint thanks to her run on Nashville from 2012-2018.
paras.zh: 尽管潘妮蒂尔最出名的作品是她 11 个月大时为 Playskool 玩具火车拍摄的小屏幕作品，但早在 1990 年，潘妮蒂尔就因 2012 年至 2018 年在纳什维尔的跑步而留下了音乐印记。

paras.en: She played ambitious country-pop singer Juliette Barnes on Nashville opposite Connie Britton and her vocals anchored the series’ Billboard-charting companion soundtrack albums on Big Machine Records. She also recorded songs for family films and teen-pop compilations as a teenager, and after taking on the role of Claire Bennet in NBC’s modern superheroes saga Heroes, she signed to Hollywood Records and released the 2008 single “Wake Up Call.” Panettiere cracked Billboard’s Digital Song Sales chart in 2012 with Nashville number “Undermine,” a collaboration with Charles Esten (peaking at No. 58).
paras.zh: 她在《纳什维尔》中扮演雄心勃勃的乡村流行歌手朱丽叶·巴恩斯，与康妮·布里顿演对手戏，她的歌声在 Big Machine Records 上为该剧的广告牌排行榜配套原声专辑奠定了基础。十几岁时，她还为家庭电影和青少年流行音乐合辑录制了歌曲，在 NBC 的现代超级英雄传奇英雄中扮演克莱尔·班尼特 (Claire Bennet) 角色后，她与好莱坞唱片公司签约并发行了 2008 年单曲“Wake Up Call”。 2012 年，潘妮蒂尔凭借与 Charles Esten 合作的纳什维尔单曲《Undermine》打破了公告牌数字歌曲销售排行榜（最高排名第 58 位）。

articles.title: Zach Bryan’s ‘Young Manhood and Other Donatable Organs’ Debuts Atop Three Album Charts
articles.author: Russ Penuell

paras.en: Zach Bryan’s Young Manhood and Other Donatable Organs debuts at No. 1 on Billboard’s Top Country Albums, Top Rock Albums and Americana/Folk Albums charts, and No. 2 on the Billboard 200, earning 65,000 equivalent album units in the United States in its first week, Oct. 16-22, according to Luminate.
paras.zh: 据 Luminate 报道，扎克·布莱恩的《Young Manhood and Other Donatable Organs》首张专辑就在 Billboard 顶级乡村专辑、顶级摇滚专辑和美国/民谣专辑排行榜上排名第一，并在 Billboard 200 排行榜上排名第二，首周（10 月 16 日至 22 日）在美国获得了 65,000 张同等专辑销量。

paras.en: The set is Bryan’s fifth to top those three tallies. It follows January’s With Heaven on Top, 2024’s The Great American Bar Scene, 2023’s self-titled release and 2022’s American Heartbreak. With Heaven on Top and Zach Bryan also led the all-genre Billboard 200.
paras.zh: 这是布莱恩第五次打破这三项纪录。继 1 月的《With Heaven on Top》、2024 年的《The Great American Bar Scene》、2023 年的同名专辑和 2022 年的《American Heartbreak》之后。 《Heaven on Top》和扎克·布莱恩 (Zach Bryan) 也在 Billboard 200 的所有类型排行榜中名列前茅。

paras.en: Young Manhood and Other Donatable Organs likewise makes an immediate splash at the song level. All eight of its tracks debut on Hot Country Songs and Hot Rock Songs, led by the Lana Del Rey-featuring “Lies,” which enters at No. 1 on the latter, becoming their fourth and first leader, respectively, and No. 2 on the former. The haul swells one of the deepest catalogs in the style, as Bryan has now charted 106 titles on Hot Rock Songs and 97 on Hot Country Songs.
paras.zh: 《Young Manhood and Other Donatable Organs》同样在歌曲层面立即引起轰动。它的全部八首歌曲均首次出现在《热门乡村歌曲》和《热门摇滚歌曲》中，其中以拉娜·德雷 (Lana Del Rey) 的《谎言》领衔，在后者中排名第一，分别成为第四和第一位领军者，在前者中排名第二。布莱恩目前已收录了 106 首热门摇滚歌曲和 97 首热门乡村歌曲，成为该风格中最深入的歌曲之一。

paras.en: Few artists open in the Hot Country Songs top 10 like Bryan. With “Lies” and “Lodi When” bowing at Nos. 2 and 9, he has now debuted 14 of his 17 career top 10s directly in the tier. That’s the third-most top 10 debuts among all acts since the chart adopted its multimetric methodology in October 2012, trailing only Morgan Wallen (34) and Taylor Swift (17). Bryan’s two No. 1s are “Something in the Orange” and his Kacey Musgraves collaboration “I Remember Everything,” which ruled for six and 20 weeks, respectively.
paras.zh: 很少有艺术家能像布莱恩一样跻身热门乡村歌曲前十名。随着《Lies》和《Lodi When》分别位列第 2 和第 9，他在职业生涯 17 首歌曲中，有 14 首直接进入该级别。这是自 2012 年 10 月该榜单采用多重衡量方法以来，在所有首次亮相的前 10 名艺人中排名第三的，仅次于摩根·沃伦 (Morgan Wallen)（第 34 位）和泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift)（第 17 位）。布莱恩的两首冠军歌曲分别是《Something in the Orange》和他与 Kacey Musgraves 合作的《I Remember Everything》，分别统治了 6 周和 20 周。

paras.en: On the Billboard Hot 100, “Lies” enters at No. 4, becoming Bryan’s fourth top 10 and Del Rey’s third.
paras.zh: 在 Billboard Hot 100 排行榜上，《Lies》排名第四，成为 Bryan 的第四个前十名，Del Rey 的第三个。

paras.en: The streaming numbers also put Bryan’s reach in perspective. During the tracking week, he ranked fourth among all artists in the U.S., drawing 151.3 million official streams. He trailed only Drake (298.6 million), Wallen (204.2 million) and Swift (183.1 million).
paras.zh: 流媒体数据也让我们看到了布莱恩的影响力。在追踪周期间，他在美国所有艺术家中排名第四，吸引了 1.513 亿官方流媒体播放。他仅落后于德雷克（2.986 亿）、沃伦（2.042 亿）和斯威夫特（1.831 亿）。

articles.title: Josh Hogan and Ned Beckley Dominate 2026 Screen Music Awards
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: With four victories, Josh Hogan and Ned Beckley were the big winners Wednesday night (Oct. 28) at the 2026 Screen Music Awards, presented at Brisbane’s Fortitude Music Hall.
paras.zh: 周三晚（10 月 28 日）在布里斯班 Fortitude 音乐厅举行的 2026 年影视音乐奖颁奖典礼上，乔什·霍根 (Josh Hogan) 和内德·贝克利 (Ned Beckley) 凭借四次胜利成为大赢家。

paras.en: The West Australian composers were honored for their output on the Australian Broadcasting Corporation’s animated kid’s series Tales from Outer Suburbia, taking home best music for children’s programming, best opening title television theme and best soundtrack album, as well as best original song composed for the screen alongside composer Joni Hogan.
paras.zh: 西澳大利亚作曲家因其在澳大利亚广播公司的动画儿童系列片《远郊故事》中的作品而获得殊荣，荣获最佳儿童节目音乐、最佳开场电视主题曲和最佳配乐专辑，以及与作曲家乔尼·霍根一起为银幕创作的最佳原创歌曲。

paras.en: It was a perfect night for the pair, as they snagged all four categories they were nominated for.
paras.zh: 这对两人来说是一个完美的夜晚，因为他们获得了所有四个类别的提名。

paras.en: There were multiple donut-shaped awards, too, for Adam Gock and Dinesh Wicks, who bagged most performed screen composer – Australia for the 12th time for their work on MasterChef, My Kitchen Rules and Travel Guides; plus most performed screen composer – overseas for Con Girl, Lego Masters and Married at First Sight; and best music for unscripted or reality television series for Million Dollar Secret alongside fellow composers Adam Sofo, Brontë Horder, Cassie To, David Bruggemann, Lydia Davies, Mitch Stewart and Rory Chenoweth.
paras.zh: 亚当·戈克 (Adam Gock) 和迪内什·威克斯 (Dinesh Wicks) 也获得了多个甜甜圈奖，他们凭借《厨艺大师》、《我的厨房规则》和《旅行指南》的作品，第 12 次获得澳大利亚表演次数最多的屏幕作曲家奖。以及演出次数最多的屏幕作曲家——海外《Con Girl》、《乐高大师》和《一见钟情》；与其他作曲家 Adam Sofo、Brontë Horder、Cassie To、David Bruggemann、Lydia Davies、Mitch Stewart 和 Rory Chenoweth 一起为《百万美元的秘密》的无剧本或真人秀电视连续剧获得最佳音乐。

paras.en: Helena Czajka went back-to-back in the best music for a documentary category, winning for Sentient, while Finn Clarke scooped emerging screen composer of the year. Benjamin Lam, Nicholas Gardiner, Georgina Darvidis, Matthew Sheers and Peter Corrigan were among the first-time winners.
paras.zh: 海伦娜·查伊卡 (Helena Czajka) 凭借《Sentient》连续两年获得纪录片类最佳音乐奖，而芬恩·克拉克 (Finn Clarke) 则荣获年度新兴银幕作曲家奖。 Benjamin Lam、Nicholas Gardiner、Georgina Darvidis、Matthew Sheers 和 Peter Corrigan 是首次获奖者。

paras.en: As previously reported, Cezary Skubiszewski was feted with the distinguished services to the Australian screen award, in recognition of his impressive body of work spanning more than 30 years. Following a standing ovation, the prolific Polish music man was presented with the award by film producer Nelson Woss, with whom he collaborated on the soundtrack for Red Dog.
paras.zh: 正如之前报道的那样，Cezary Skubiszewski 荣获澳大利亚银幕杰出服务奖，以表彰他 30 多年来令人印象深刻的作品。在全场起立鼓掌后，这位多产的波兰音乐人被电影制片人尼尔森·沃斯授予了该奖项，他与他合作制作了《红狗》的配乐。

paras.en: An initiative of APRA AMCOS (APRA this year celebrates its 100th anniversary) and the Australian Guild of Screen Composers (AGSC), the annual event celebrates excellence and innovation in screen composition across 16 categories, praising outstanding contributions in short film, television series, documentaries, children’s programming, feature films and more.
paras.zh: 这项年度活动由 APRA AMCOS（APRA 今年庆祝其成立 100 周年）和澳大利亚电影作曲家协会 (AGSC) 发起，旨在庆祝 16 个类别的电影创作的卓越和创新，表彰短片、电视剧、纪录片、儿童节目、故事片等领域的杰出贡献。

paras.en: If music for the screen was the reason behind the celebration, artificial intelligence and the career of late, great actor Sam Neill were the themes.
paras.zh: 如果说银幕音乐是庆祝活动背后的原因，那么人工智能和近来的职业生涯、伟大演员山姆·尼尔就是主题。

paras.en: Right now, Australia’s government is considering proposals, pitched by big tech, that would usher in copyright reforms for the purposes of AI training. The creative community has, in a united front, warned those exceptions to the Copyright Act would jeopardize artists’ ability to earn a living.
paras.zh: 目前，澳大利亚政府正在考虑由大型科技公司提出的提案，该提案将引入以人工智能培训为目的的版权改革。创意界一致警告，《版权法》的这些例外情况将危及艺术家的谋生能力。

paras.en: That message was carried from the stage on several occasions last night, as guests were encouraged to wear badges bearing the statement, “human made.”
paras.zh: 昨晚，舞台上多次传达了这一信息，鼓励嘉宾佩戴印有“人造”字样的徽章。

paras.en: “We are here to celebrate what AI cannot do,” remarked The Go-Betweens’ Amanda Brown at the top of proceedings, for what was her first speech as AGSC president. “No matter how much digitized data the technology consumes, it is no substitute for human experience, and it is precisely those experiences that inform our creative work, and for every composer or songwriter, it will be different. Our personal histories and our relationships, our musical obsessions, our mistakes, and our triumphs. The bonds we form with colleagues and our musicians, these are the foundations that bring us together tonight. So let’s celebrate our messy, creative, uniquely human differences and enjoy the music.”
paras.zh: “我们来这里是为了庆祝人工智能无法做到的事情，”The Go-Betweens 的阿曼达·布朗 (Amanda Brown) 在会议顶部说道，这是她作为 AGSC 主席的第一次演讲。 “无论技术消耗多少数字化数据，它都无法替代人类经验，而正是这些经验为我们的创造性工作提供了信息，对于每一位作曲家或词曲作者来说，它都会有所不同。我们的个人历史和我们的关系，我们的音乐痴迷，我们的错误和我们的胜利。我们与同事和音乐家形成的纽带，这些是今晚我们聚集在一起的基础。所以，让我们庆祝我们混乱的、创造性的、独特的人类差异，享受音乐。”

paras.en: APRA CEO Dean Ormston delivered a history lesson. The very first license APRA issued was to a little town hall on King Island back in 1926. “That license still stands today,” he explained. “The principle behind it hasn’t changed. If someone wants to use your work, they ask you first. And AI doesn’t change that at all. We’ve had the door open to negotiate a license based on permission and payments. And yet, not one major AI platform has walked through it.”
paras.zh: APRA 首席执行官 Dean Ormston 上了一堂历史课。 APRA 于 1926 年向国王岛的一个小市政厅颁发了第一个许可证。“该许可证至今仍然有效，”他解释道。 “它背后的原则没有改变。如果有人想使用你的作品，他们会先询问你。人工智能根本不会改变这一点。我们已经敞开了大门，可以根据许可和付款谈判许可证。然而，没有一个主要的人工智能平台已经通过了这一过程。”

paras.en: Antony Partos used the platform of his victory speech for winning best music for a television drama (The Artful Dodger (Season 2, Episode 3)) to rally his fellow creators. With the threat of big AI “scraping all music,” he remarked, Australia finds itself “at a crossroads.” Partos seized the moment, shut down the wrap-up cue, and told the full house to sign AGSC’s Change.org petition. “AI can be a source of immense good,” he insisted, “but should be something that is legally sourced from us, creators.”
paras.zh: 安东尼·帕托斯（Antony Partos）利用他赢得电视剧（《狡猾的道奇》（第 2 季，第 3 集））最佳音乐奖的获奖感言来团结他的创作者们。他表示，随着大人工智能“废除所有音乐”的威胁，澳大利亚发现自己“处于十字路口”。帕托斯抓住了这个时机，关闭了总结提示，并要求全体人员签署 AGSC 的 Change.org 请愿书。他坚称：“人工智能可以成为巨大善行的源泉，但它应该是来自我们创造者的合法来源。”

paras.en: Hosts on the night were Rob Collins, alongside guest presenters Claudia Karvan and Ayesha Madon, with Erkki Veltheim leading a live orchestra on stage for his final year as music director.
paras.zh: 当晚的主持人是罗布·柯林斯 (Rob Collins)、客座主持人克劳迪娅·卡万 (Claudia Karvan) 和阿耶莎·马顿 (Ayesha Madon)，艾尔基·维尔特海姆 (Erkki Veltheim) 在舞台上带领一支现场管弦乐队，这是他作为音乐总监的最后一年。

paras.en: Visit apraamcos.com.au for the full list of winners.
paras.zh: 请访问 apraamcos.com.au 查看完整的获奖者名单。

articles.title: David Bruckner Set to Direct ‘Smile 3’
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: David Bruckner is preparing to make horror fans smile, as the director has signed on to direct Smile 3.
paras.zh: 大卫·布鲁克纳已签约执导《微笑 3》，他正准备让恐怖片粉丝们会心一笑。

paras.en: The Hellraiser reboot director will helm the follow-up to 2024’s Smile 2 for Paramount. Nick Antosca will pen the script.
paras.zh: 这位《猛鬼追魂》重启导演将为派拉蒙执导 2024 年《微笑 2》的后续作品。尼克·安托斯卡将撰写剧本。

paras.en: Parker Finn, creator, writer and director of the first two Smile films, developed and pitched the framework of the third entry. He will remain involved as a producer for Smile 3, and Jonathan Fass will executive produce.
paras.zh: 前两部《微笑》电影的创作者、编剧和导演帕克·芬恩 (Parker Finn) 开发并提出了第三部影片的框架。他将继续担任《微笑 3》的制片人，乔纳森·法斯将担任执行制片人。

paras.en: Bruckner directed Hulu’s Hellraiser remake in 2022, and also previously helmed The Night House and The Ritual. Outside of Smile 3, he’s also attached to direct Universal Pictures’ The Caretaker, which is an adaptation of Marcus Kliewer’s book of the same name, starring Sydney Sweeney, and horror film Mice for A24. Bruckner is also writing and developing a remake of The Blob.
paras.zh: 布鲁克纳于 2022 年执导了 Hulu 的《猛鬼追魂》翻拍版，此前还执导过《夜屋》和《仪式》。除了《微笑3》之外，他还参与了环球影业执导的《看守者》（改编自马库斯·克莱尔的同名小说，由西德尼·斯威尼主演）和 A24 的恐怖片《老鼠》。布鲁克纳还在编写和开发《The Blob》的翻拍版。

paras.en: Finn signed a first-look deal with Paramount Pictures in 2023. He is also directing the studio’s Possession remake starring Callum Turner and Margaret Qualley that will release on June 11, 2027.
paras.zh: 芬恩于 2023 年与派拉蒙影业公司签署了首映协议。他还执导了派拉蒙影业公司翻拍的《Possession》，由卡勒姆·特纳和玛格丽特·库利主演，该片将于 2027 年 6 月 11 日上映。

paras.en: In an interview with The Hollywood Reporter after the release of Smile 2, Finn shared his hopes for the future of the film franchise.
paras.zh: 在《微笑2》上映后接受《好莱坞报道》采访时，芬恩分享了他对电影系列未来的希望。

paras.en: “There’s a lot of really exciting places that Smile could go to from here. I love this idea that potential future iterations of Smile could go bigger and more off the rails and even crazier and more unhinged,” he said. “But, for me, what’s important about Smile is that there is a real human, character-driven, intimate nature to the storytelling. So even if the world gets much larger, I’d want to make sure that the stories we’re telling inside of it are still quite impactful on a human level.”
paras.zh: “从这里出发，Smile 可以去很多真正令人兴奋的地方。我喜欢这个想法，即 Smile 未来的潜在迭代可能会变得更大、更偏离轨道，甚至更疯狂、更精神错乱，”他说。 “但是，对我来说，《微笑》的重要之处在于，故事讲述具有真实的人性、角色驱动、亲密的本质。因此，即使世界变得更大，我也想确保我们在其中讲述的故事在人类层面上仍然具有相当大的影响力。”

paras.en: Smile emerged as the top-grossing original horror film of 2022, while the franchise as a whole has grossed more than $350 million worldwide.
paras.zh: 《微笑》成为 2022 年票房最高的原创恐怖片，而该系列电影的全球总票房已超过 3.5 亿美元。

articles.title: Cate Blanchett Warns Against “Unthinking Certainty” as She Accepts Japan’s Praemium Imperiale
articles.author: Patrick Brzeski

paras.en: Two-time Oscar-winner Cate Blanchett added to her stack of global honors on Wednesday, accepting Japan’s prestigious Praemium Imperiale award at a black-tie ceremony in Tokyo.
paras.zh: 周三，两届奥斯卡奖得主凯特·布兰切特 (Cate Blanchett) 在东京举行的正式仪式上接受了日本享有盛誉的高松文化奖，为她的全球荣誉增添了新的一笔。

paras.en: At a news conference ahead of the presentation, the actress used the occasion to reflect on the value of creative uncertainty — and the destructive hubris of its opposite.
paras.zh: 在演讲前的新闻发布会上，这位女演员利用这个机会反思了创意不确定性的价值，以及其对立面的破坏性傲慢。

paras.en: “In an uncertain world riddled with unthinking certainty I believe doubt is vital to the creative process,” Blanchett said. “It’s what starts the challenge, the questioning, the exploration. It allows conversation and connection. It allows change.”
paras.zh: “在一个充满不假思索的确定性的不确定世界中，我相信怀疑对于创作过程至关重要，”布兰切特说。 “这是挑战、质疑和探索的开始。它允许对话和联系。它允许改变。”

paras.en: Presented by the Japan Art Association, the Praemium Imperiale recognizes lifetime achievement across five disciplines: painting, sculpture, architecture, music and theater/film. Often described as the Nobel Prize of the arts, the honor places Blanchett among good company — past theater and film recipients have included Federico Fellini, Akira Kurosawa, Jean-Luc Godard, Martin Scorsese, Judi Dench and Catherine Deneuve. Ang Lee was the last Hollywood-associated recipient, taking the prize in 2024.
paras.zh: 由日本艺术协会主办的“Praemium Imperiale”旨在表彰五个学科领域的终身成就：绘画、雕塑、建筑、音乐和戏剧/电影。布兰切特经常被誉为艺术界的诺贝尔奖，这一荣誉让布兰切特跻身优秀伙伴之列——过去的戏剧和电影获奖者包括费德里科·费里尼、黑泽明、让-吕克·戈达尔、马丁·斯科塞斯、朱迪·丹奇和凯瑟琳·德纳芙。李安是最后一位与好莱坞相关的获奖者，于 2024 年获奖。

paras.en: Japan’s Princess Hitachi presented Blanchett with her medal at the Meiji Kinenkan in Tokyo’s Moto-Akasaka district. Each laureate also receives a testimonial letter and an honorarium of 15 million yen (just under $100,000). This year’s other recipients were American artist Jenny Holzer, British sculptor Andy Goldsworthy, American architect Daniel Libeskind and Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt.
paras.zh: 日本日立公主在东京本赤坂区的明治纪念馆向布兰切特颁发了奖章。每位获奖者还会收到一封推荐信和 1500 万日元（略低于 10 万美元）的酬金。今年的其他获奖者包括美国艺术家珍妮·霍尔泽、英国雕塑家安迪·戈兹沃西、美国建筑师丹尼尔·里伯斯金和瑞典指挥家赫伯特·布隆斯泰特。

paras.en: Blanchett used her acceptance speech to offer a meditation on the limits of language and how artistic work finds its power in the inexpressable. Opening her remarks with a reference to surrealist artist Leonora Carrington, she described acting as “a profession that at its worst sinks into a quagmire of literalness but at its best can leave people speechless.”
paras.zh: 布兰切特在获奖感言中对语言的局限性以及艺术作品如何在无法表达的事物中发现其力量进行了思考。她以超现实主义艺术家利奥诺拉·卡林顿(Leonora Carrington)作为开场白，她将表演描述为“一种职业，在最坏的情况下会陷入字面意义的泥潭，但在最好的情况下却可以让人无言以对。”

paras.en: Her creative starting point, she explained, is often the mysterious gap between what a character says and what they can’t seem to convey with language.
paras.zh: 她解释说，她的创作起点往往是角色所说的话与他们似乎无法用语言传达的内容之间的神秘差距。

paras.en: “I always look for meaning, for opportunity in the spaces between what is said, in what is not said, in what people are trying to say, in what they wish they had said and in what they wish they had not,” she said.
paras.zh: “我总是在所说的话、未说的话、人们试图说的话、他们希望自己说过的话和他们希望自己没有说过的话之间的空间中寻找意义和机会，”她说。

paras.en: That search, Blanchett suggested, requires a willingness to remain unsure, even when uncertainty is read as weakness.
paras.zh: 布兰切特表示，这种探索需要愿意保持不确定性，即使不确定性被视为弱点。

paras.en: “The doubt that I will ever fully communicate is always with me. And as a woman that doubt is often interpreted as a lack of confidence. It is not. That doubt is my artistic starting point,” she said. “It’s what allows me to hear, it allows me to see, it allows me to sense.”
paras.zh: “我始终对自己能否充分沟通感到怀疑。作为一名女性，这种怀疑常常被解释为缺乏自信。事实并非如此。这种怀疑是我的艺术起点，”她说。 “它让我能够听到，它让我看到，它让我感觉到。”

paras.en: Continuing to take artistic risks over a long career, she added, requires courage and rigor — qualities she praised in her fellow laureates.
paras.zh: 她补充说，在漫长的职业生涯中继续承担艺术风险需要勇气和严谨——她赞扬其他获奖者的品质。

paras.en: Former U.S. Secretary of State Hillary Clinton, who serves as the prize’s U.S. international adviser, was also present at the press conference. Clinton is part of the international advisory network whose committees recommend candidates, with the final selections made by the Japan Art Association.
paras.zh: 担任该奖项美国国际顾问的美国前国务卿希拉里·克林顿也出席了新闻发布会。克林顿是国际咨询网络的一部分，该网络的委员会推荐候选人，最终选择由日本艺术协会做出。

paras.en: Clinton said the prize makes “a global declaration that artists and culture are essential pillars of our societies,” arguing that its role has only become more important amid threats to democratic values and the anxieties surrounding artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 克林顿表示，该奖项“向全球宣告艺术家和文化是我们社会的重要支柱”，并认为在民主价值观受到威胁和人工智能引发焦虑的情况下，该奖项的作用只会变得更加重要。

paras.en: “It’s also, I think, even more essential that we bolster the arts in a time when we are facing the transformations being brought about by artificial intelligence,” she said, making a call to rein in the technology’s risks while preserving the human capacities of imagination and connection.
paras.zh: 她说：“我认为，在我们面临人工智能带来的变革的时候，更重要的是支持艺术。”她呼吁控制技术风险，同时保留人类的想象力和联系能力。

paras.en: Blanchett’s visit to Japan will next include appearances at the 39th Tokyo International Film Festival, which runs through Nov. 4. On Friday, she is scheduled to join filmmakers Mohammad Rasoulof and Shahrbanoo Sadat for a Q&A following the Japanese premieres of five shorts supported by the Displacement Film Fund, the initiative she co-founded and leads to support displaced filmmakers.
paras.zh: 布兰切特接下来的日本之行将包括出席将于 11 月 4 日结束的第 39 届东京国际电影节。周五，她计划与电影制片人穆罕默德·拉苏洛夫 (Mohammad Rasoulof) 和沙赫巴努·萨达特 (Shahrbanoo Sadat) 一起在由流离失所电影基金 (Displacement Film Fund) 支持的五部短片在日本首映后进行问答，该基金是她共同创立并领导的旨在支持流离失所电影制片人的倡议。

paras.en: Later Friday, she is due to appear with directors David and Nathan Zellner for a discussion accompanying their alien comedy Alpha Gang, in which she stars.
paras.zh: 周五晚些时候，她将与导演大卫·泽尔纳和内森·泽尔纳一起出席由她主演的外星喜剧《阿尔法帮》的讨论。

paras.en: Blanchett concluded her Tokyo remarks on Wednesday with characteristic poise.
paras.zh: 布兰切特以特有的平静结束了周三在东京的讲话。

paras.en: “I am profoundly grateful to have this honor bestowed upon me,” she said. “It’s an Olympus of sorts that I never conceived of even touching. It’s a beautiful, soul-soaring surprise, and a deep honor indeed.”
paras.zh: 她说：“我非常感激能获得这项荣誉。” “这是我从未想过要触摸的奥林巴斯山。这是一个美丽的、令人灵魂飞扬的惊喜，确实是一种深深的荣幸。”

articles.title: South Carolina Police Close Hayden Panettiere Death Investigation
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: Police in South Carolina have closed their investigation into the overdose death of actor Hayden Panettiere following a coroner’s finding that it was accidental.
paras.zh: 验尸官发现演员海顿·潘妮蒂尔服药过量死亡是意外，南卡罗来纳州警方已结束调查。

paras.en: The decision was based on the medical examiner’s determination as well as the findings of the investigation, Greenville police said Wednesday in a statement.
paras.zh: 格林维尔警方周三在一份声明中表示，这一决定是基于法医的决定以及调查结果。

paras.en: Panettiere, who starred in the TV series Heroes and Nashville, was pronounced dead in an apartment in Greenville on Aug. 16 at age 36 after paramedics found her unresponsive.
paras.zh: 主演电视剧《英雄与纳什维尔》的潘妮蒂尔于 8 月 16 日在格林维尔的一间公寓中被宣布死亡，享年 36 岁，医护人员发现她失去了知觉。

paras.en: A coroner’s report obtained by the Associated Press last month said her death was from an accidental overdose of several drugs, including fentanyl, and she had been in rehab just weeks before. Her on-and-off boyfriend, Brian Hickerson, and his brother Zach Hickerson were at the home.
paras.zh: 美联社上个月获得的验尸官报告称，她的死亡原因是意外服用过量药物，包括芬太尼，几周前她还在康复中心。她时断时续的男友布莱恩·希克森(Brian Hickerson)和他的兄弟扎克·希克森(Zach Hickerson)都在家。

paras.en: It remains unclear whether federal authorities may still be examining the case separately. In a petition to a California court last month, Panettiere’s ex-fiance, former boxer Wladimir Klitschko, said some of her property had been taken by federal law enforcement agents investigating her death and by an unnamed nonrelative looking to sell it.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚联邦当局是否仍在单独审查此案。潘妮蒂尔的前未婚夫、前拳击手弗拉基米尔·克里琴科(Wladimir Klitschko)在上个月向加州法院提交的一份请愿书中表示，她的一些财产被调查她死亡的联邦执法人员和一位不愿透露姓名的非亲属想要出售的财产拿走。

paras.en: The U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration did not immediately respond to emailed requests for comment Wednesday, and Greenville police Sgt. Diana Munoz said she could not comment on whether any other agencies were investigating.
paras.zh: 美国缉毒局周三没有立即回复通过电子邮件发送的置评请求，格林维尔警察中士。戴安娜·穆尼奥斯表示，她无法评论是否有其他机构正在调查。

paras.en: The California court granted Klitschko legal status this month to protect Panettiere’s property for their 11-year-old daughter, who is her sole heir.
paras.zh: 加州法院本月授予克里琴科合法地位，以保护潘妮蒂尔 11 岁女儿（她是她唯一的继承人）的财产。

paras.en: In This Is Me: A Reckoning, a memoir that was published in May, Panettiere acknowledged being addicted to alcohol and having postpartum depression after her daughter’s birth in 2014. The girl went to live with Klitschko full-time when she was two.
paras.zh: 在 5 月出版的回忆录《这就是我：清算》中，潘妮蒂尔承认自己在 2014 年女儿出生后酗酒并患有产后抑郁症。女孩两岁时就开始与克里琴科全职生活。

paras.en: Panettiere’s father told investigators that at the time of her death, she had plans to visit her daughter in Ukraine days later.
paras.zh: 潘妮蒂尔的父亲告诉调查人员，她去世时，她计划几天后去乌克兰看望女儿。

articles.title: Billionaire Ambani cries tears of joy as Jio Platforms becomes the second most valued Indian firm

paras.en: Billionaire Mukesh Ambani has become the owner of the two most valued companies in India, after a stellar listing of Jio Platforms, the country's largest telecom operator and digital services firm.
paras.zh: 在印度最大的电信运营商和数字服务公司 Jio Platforms 出色上市后，亿万富翁穆克什·安巴尼 (Mukesh Ambani) 成为印度两家最有价值公司的所有者。

paras.en: The share of Jio Platforms continued to climb higher on Thursday, opening 3.3% higher a day after its market debut.
paras.zh: Jio Platforms 的股价周四继续攀升，上市后第二天开盘上涨 3.3%。

paras.en: The Meta- and Google-backed company listed on Wednesday at a premium of over 25% to its IPO price, leading to a market capitalization of 13.05 trillion rupees ($137.1 billion).
paras.zh: 这家由 Meta 和 Google 支持的公司于周三上市，其发行价较 IPO 价格溢价超过 25%，市值达到 13.05 万亿卢比（1,371 亿美元）。

paras.en: Ambani's flagship company, Reliance Industries, also the most valued company in India, owns more than a 64% stake in Jio Platforms after the initial public offering.
paras.zh: 安巴尼的旗舰公司 Reliance Industries 也是印度估值最高的公司，在 Jio Platforms 首次公开募股后拥有超过 64% 的股份。

paras.en: Ahead of the listing, the patriarch of the Ambani family teared up as his three children shared the journey of building Jio and vowed to create value for investors over the next 50 years.
paras.zh: 上市前，安巴尼家族的族长热泪盈眶，他的三个孩子分享了 Jio 的创建历程，并誓言在未来 50 年为投资者创造价值。

paras.en: Analysts expect Jio's free cash flow to improve significantly as the funds from the initial public offering will be used to repay legacy telecom debt, and the company's 5G investment cycle is slowing down.
paras.zh: 分析师预计，Jio 的自由现金流将显着改善，因为首次公开募股的资金将用于偿还遗留电信债务，而且该公司的 5G 投资周期正在放缓。

paras.en: However, they cautioned that most of the value has been priced in after the listing gains, with the company now being valued on par with some of the global telecom giants.
paras.zh: 然而，他们警告说，大部分价值已在上市收益后被定价，该公司目前的估值与一些全球电信巨头相当。

paras.en: With just 3% share dilution, Jio has wiped out nearly 300 billion rupees of debt, said Anurag Singh, founder and managing partner of U.S. based Ansid Capital, told CNBC. He added Jio's current market cap puts it in the league of American telecom giants such as AT&T and Verizon Communications.
paras.zh: 美国 Ansid Capital 创始人兼执行合伙人阿努拉格·辛格 (Anurag Singh) 向 CNBC 表示，仅 3% 的股权稀释，Jio 就消除了近 3000 亿卢比的债务。他补充说，Jio 目前的市值使其与 AT&T 和 Verizon Communications 等美国电信巨头并驾齐驱。

paras.en: AT&T has a market cap of $139 billion and Verizon of $179 billion, as per LSEG data.
paras.zh: 根据 LSEG 的数据，AT&T 的市值为 1,390 亿美元，Verizon 的市值为 1,790 亿美元。

paras.en: In the next 10 years, Jio will "democratize every technology that can transform Indian lives," Akash Ambani, the eldest son of Mukesh and the managing director of Jio Platforms, said on Wednesday, ahead of the listing.
paras.zh: 穆克什的长子、Jio Platforms 董事总经理阿卡什·安巴尼 (Akash Ambani) 周三在上市前表示，未来 10 年，Jio 将“使每一项能够改变印度生活的技术民主化”。

paras.en: The 35-year-old scion listed out artificial intelligence, Cloud, connected devices, and "connectivity from even space," as some of the key areas for future growth.
paras.zh: 这位 35 岁的接班人将人工智能、云、互联设备和“甚至空间的连接”列为未来增长的一些关键领域。

paras.en: The company's plans to launch satellite communications drew the ire of trillionaire Elon Musk, who blamed the Ambanis for the delays in the launch of Starlink in India earlier this month.
paras.zh: 该公司发射卫星通信的计划引起了亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克(Elon Musk)的愤怒，他指责安巴尼家族造成了本月早些时候印度星链发射的延误。

paras.en: "Jio brings a rare scale to Indian equities," with a customer base of more than half a billion, operating margins of 52% and net leverage of 0.36 times, Vaqarjaved Khan, senior analyst at Indian broking firm Angel One, told CNBC.
paras.zh: 印度经纪公司 Angel One 的高级分析师 Vaqarjaved Khan 向 CNBC 表示，“Jio 为印度股市带来了罕见的规模”，其客户群超过 5 亿，营业利润率为 52%，净杠杆率为 0.36 倍。

paras.en: He added that at a price-to-earnings of 34 times, much of the "quality" is priced in and future returns will be driven by improvement in average revenue per user and AI services.
paras.zh: 他补充说，市盈率为 34 倍，大部分“质量”已被定价，未来回报将由每用户平均收入和人工智能服务的改善推动。

paras.en: Meanwhile, after Jio's listing pop, Reliance Group's market value of 30 trillion rupees has surpassed that of Tata Group's 25 trillion rupees, making Ambani family business the top conglomerate in the country, as per a Bloomberg report.
paras.zh: 与此同时，据彭博社报道，Jio 上市后，信实集团 30 万亿卢比的市值已超过塔塔集团 25 万亿卢比的市值，使安巴尼家族企业成为该国最大的企业集团。

articles.title: Judge says Trump's bid to set aside California ballots would ‘wreak havoc’ on democracy

paras.en: A U.S. judge strongly rebuked the Trump administration on Wednesday by rejecting a request by the Justice Department to temporarily block California from counting mail ballots for the midterm elections from more than 20,000 registered voters the department alleges are likely noncitizens.
paras.zh: 周三，一名美国法官强烈谴责特朗普政府，拒绝了司法部提出的暂时阻止加州清点中期选举邮寄选票的请求，该部门称，该部门声称这些选民可能是非公民。

paras.en: The decision marks the latest setback for President Donald Trump's effort to boost the federal government's role in elections ahead of the November 3 midterms, with his Republican Party locked in a tight battle to retain control of both houses of Congress.
paras.zh: 这一决定标志着唐纳德·特朗普总统在 11 月 3 日中期选举之前提升联邦政府在选举中的作用的努力遭遇最新挫折，他领导的共和党为保住国会参众两院的控制权陷入了一场激烈的战斗。

paras.en: US District Judge David Carter issued the decision after a hearing on Tuesday in Los Angeles federal court over the Justice Department's request for a temporary restraining order barring officials from counting any ballots from the individuals it flagged.
paras.zh: 美国地区法官戴维·卡特周二在洛杉矶联邦法院就司法部请求颁发临时限制令以禁止官员清点其标记的个人的任何选票后做出了这一决定。

paras.en: The Justice Department's lawsuit, filed on October 15, was a rare intervention in the voting process weeks before an election and signaled the Trump administration's willingness to contest the midterm results in court.
paras.zh: 司法部于 10 月 15 日提起的诉讼是选举前几周对投票过程的罕见干预，表明特朗普政府愿意在法庭上对中期选举结果提出质疑。

paras.en: "Never before in American history has the federal government, on the eve of an election, sought to coerce a state and local government to abandon their own Constitutional elections procedures and bend to the will of the Executive Branch," Carter wrote on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 卡特周三写道：“在美国历史上，联邦政府从未在选举前夕试图强迫州和地方政府放弃自己的宪法选举程序并屈服于行政部门的意愿。”

paras.en: The judge, an appointee of Democratic President Bill Clinton, said the Justice Department's last-minute request to exclude over 20,000 ballots ran afoul of "longstanding constitutional principles mandating that states have control over their elections."
paras.zh: 这位由民主党总统比尔·克林顿任命的法官表示，司法部在最后一刻要求排除 20,000 多张选票，这违反了“要求各州控制选举的长期宪法原则”。

paras.en: Carter warned that a ruling in the Trump administration's favor would "wreak havoc" and cause thousands of registered voters to "potentially lose the right that generations of Americans have fought to preserve."
paras.zh: 卡特警告说，对特朗普政府有利的裁决将“造成严重破坏”，并导致数千名登记选民“可能失去几代美国人努力维护的权利”。

paras.en: "Eroded trust in our democracy is irreparable," Carter wrote. "Once a vote is segregated, lasting harm has occurred. If the Executive can discount votes and threaten an ongoing election due to unproven allegations, then our democracy is in danger."
paras.zh: “对我们民主的信任受到的侵蚀是无法弥补的，”卡特写道。 “一旦投票被隔离，就会造成持久的伤害。如果行政部门可以因未经证实的指控而打折选票并威胁正在进行的选举，那么我们的民主就处于危险之中。”

paras.en: The Justice Department swiftly appealed the decision to the 9th US Circuit Court of Appeals.
paras.zh: 司法部迅速就这一决定向美国第九巡回上诉法院提出上诉。

paras.en: "Every day, more ballots are processed by election officials," Justice Department lawyer Bill Essayli said in a statement. "This ongoing emergency disenfranchises American citizens through dilution."
paras.zh: 司法部律师比尔·埃萨利在一份声明中说：“选举官员每天都会处理更多选票。” “这种持续的紧急情况通过稀释而剥夺了美国公民的权利。”

paras.en: California has said the state's safeguards against noncitizen voting are robust. It said the Justice Department's assertions relied on "suspect data" and that complying with its demands would risk disenfranchising eligible voters.
paras.zh: 加州表示，该州针对非公民投票的保障措施是强有力的。它表示，司法部的主张依赖于“可疑数据”，遵守其要求可能会导致合格选民被剥夺选举权。

paras.en: California is the most populous US state and a Democratic stronghold. It has more seats in the House of Representatives — 52 — than any other state.
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州是美国人口最多的州，也是民主党的大本营。它在众议院拥有 52 个席位，比任何其他州都多。

paras.en: Trump has made California a focal point of his sweeping immigration crackdown since returning to the White House, accusing it of undermining public safety through its "sanctuary state" policies that limit cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
paras.zh: 自重返白宫以来，特朗普将加州作为其全面打击移民的焦点，指责该州通过限制与联邦移民执法部门合作的“庇护州”政策破坏了公共安全。

paras.en: Trump has repeatedly insisted that states are not doing enough to stop voting by noncitizens, which he says is widespread despite multiple studies and state audits showing it is rare.
paras.zh: 特朗普一再坚称，各州在阻止非公民投票方面做得不够，他说这种情况很普遍，尽管多项研究和州审计表明这种情况很少见。

paras.en: Carter ruled two days after a federal appeals court on Monday rejected an unusual emergency request by the Justice Department asking the appeals court to temporarily block California from counting the ballots before Carter had the chance to rule.
paras.zh: 两天前，联邦上诉法院周一驳回了司法部一项不同寻常的紧急请求，要求上诉法院在卡特有机会做出裁决之前暂时阻止加州计票。两天后，卡特做出了裁决。

paras.en: The Justice Department did not indicate how many of the more than 20,000 people it flagged in California had actually submitted a mail ballot.
paras.zh: 司法部没有透露在其标记的加州 20,000 多人中，有多少人实际上提交了邮寄选票。

paras.en: It had argued that a restraining order was necessary to ensure that California did not impede prosecutors' ability to enforce a federal law that makes it illegal for noncitizens to vote in federal elections.
paras.zh: 它认为，有必要制定限制令，以确保加州不会妨碍检察官执行联邦法律，该法律规定非公民在联邦选举中投票为非法。

paras.en: But Carter said the Justice Department never explained why counting ballots would impair any prosecutions under the law, as states are not required to help the federal government investigate and prosecute crimes.
paras.zh: 但卡特表示，司法部从未解释过为什么计票会损害法律规定的任何起诉，因为各州不需要帮助联邦政府调查和起诉犯罪行为。

paras.en: Apart from California, the Trump administration has sought to intervene in elections in two states that are home to competitive races.
paras.zh: 除加州外，特朗普政府还试图干预两个竞争激烈的州的选举。

paras.en: In Alaska, the Justice Department last week asked a judge to prevent certification of election results if the Republican incumbent senator loses by a slim margin, alleging that the presence of another candidate with a similar name on the ballot could confuse voters. Alaska has urged that the case be dismissed, arguing it has taken steps to distinguish the two candidates on the ballot.
paras.zh: 在阿拉斯加州，司法部上周要求法官，如果共和党现任参议员以微弱优势落败，则阻止对选举结果进行认证，声称选票上出现另一名姓名相似的候选人可能会迷惑选民。阿拉斯加州敦促驳回此案，称其已采取措施区分选票上的两位候选人。

paras.en: In Washington state, the Justice Department on Monday sent a letter asking officials not to count any ballots received from 400 voters it said may not be citizens. Washington's top elections official said the timing of the request indicated it was intended to cast unfounded suspicion on election results.
paras.zh: 在华盛顿州，司法部周一发出一封信，要求官员不要清点 400 名可能不是公民的选民的选票。华盛顿最高选举官员表示，提出这一请求的时机表明，其目的是对选举结果提出毫无根据的怀疑。

paras.en: California had 23 million registered voters as of December 2025, while Washington had 5 million registered voters as of 2024, state records show.
paras.zh: 州记录显示，截至 2025 年 12 月，加州有 2300 万登记选民，而华盛顿州截至 2024 年有 500 万登记选民。

paras.en: Voting rights activists have expressed concern that the federal government's methods for scrutinizing state voter lists to identify noncitizen voters risk wrongly flagging naturalized citizens for removal from the rolls.
paras.zh: 投票权活动人士表示担心，联邦政府审查州选民名单以识别非公民选民的方法可能会错误地将入籍公民标记为从选民名册中除名。

articles.title: Microsoft stock jumps 4% as cloud growth drives earnings and revenue beat

paras.en: Microsoft shares rose 4% in extended trading on Wednesday after the company reported better-than-expected quarterly results, driven by 48% growth in its Azure cloud infrastructure business.
paras.zh: 微软股价周三在盘后交易中上涨 4%，此前该公司公布了好于预期的季度业绩，受 Azure 云基础设施业务增长 48% 的推动。

paras.en: Here's how the company fared relative to LSEG consensus:
paras.zh: 以下是该公司相对于 LSEG 共识的表现：

paras.en: - Earnings per share: $4.89 adjusted vs. $4.73 expected
paras.zh: - 每股收益：调整后 4.89 美元，预期 4.73 美元

paras.en: - Revenue: $92.28 billion vs. $90.69 billion expected
paras.zh: - 收入：922.8 亿美元，预期为 906.9 亿美元

paras.en: Microsoft's revenue grew 19% year over year in the quarter, which ended on Sept. 30, according to a statement, with Azure now its biggest single business.
paras.zh: 一份声明称，截至 9 月 30 日的该季度，微软收入同比增长 19%，Azure 目前是其最大的单一业务。

paras.en: The software giant has been rapidly building out data center infrastructure to meet artificial intelligence demand, while also maintaining positive free cash flow unlike its fellow hyperscalers. Microsoft reported $45.2 billion worth of capital expenditures and finance leases during the quarter, up about 30% from a year earlier. Analysts surveyed by StreetAccount had projected $50.67 billion.
paras.zh: 这家软件巨头一直在快速建设数据中心基础设施，以满足人工智能需求，同时与其他超大规模企业不同，它还保持着正的自由现金流。微软公布本季度资本支出和融资租赁价值 452 亿美元，同比增长约 30%。 StreetAccount 调查的分析师预计该公司的营收将达到 506.7 亿美元。

paras.en: With respect to guidance, Microsoft called for $96 billion to $97.1 billion in fiscal second-quarter revenue, which works out to 18.8% growth at the middle of the range. Analysts polled by LSEG had predicted $95.60 billion in revenue.
paras.zh: 在指导方面，微软预计第二财季收入将达到 960 亿美元至 971 亿美元，相当于该区间中间值的 18.8% 增长。伦敦证券交易所集团 (LSEG) 调查的分析师预测营收为 956 亿美元。

paras.en: For Azure, Microsoft's finance chief, Amy Hood, said on a conference call with analysts that she anticipates 49% to 50% growth at constant currency for the fiscal second quarter, compared with the 45.1% StreetAccount consensus.
paras.zh: 对于Azure，微软首席财务官艾米·胡德(Amy Hood)在与分析师的电话会议上表示，她预计第二财季按固定汇率计算将实现49%至50%的增长，而StreetAccount的共识为45.1%。

paras.en: "We still have demand that exceeds supply," she said.
paras.zh: “我们的需求仍然超过供应，”她说。

paras.en: During the fiscal first quarter, Microsoft flagged a higher growth rate for cash paid for property and equipment than overall capital expenditures, which include finance leases. "Some third-party capacity deliveries we expected in Q1 were delayed," Hood said.
paras.zh: 在第一财季，微软表示，用于财产和设备的现金支付增长率高于总体资本支出（包括融资租赁）的增长率。胡德表示：“我们预计第一季度的一些第三方产能交付被推迟。”

paras.en: Around 75% of capital expenditures are now tied to short-lived assets such as Intel chips and Nvidia graphics processing units, up from about 66% in the past three quarters and half in the year-ago quarter. The shift indicates Microsoft's prioritization of infrastructure it can can quickly turn into revenue.
paras.zh: 目前，约 75% 的资本支出与英特尔芯片和 Nvidia 图形处理单元等短期资产相关，高于过去三个季度的约 66% 和去年同期的一半。这一转变表明微软对基础设施的优先考虑可以很快转化为收入。

paras.en: Hood said the company is aiming at over $50 billion in fiscal second-quarter capital expenditures and finance leases, above the StreetAccount consensus of $53.10 billion, with $170 billion for all of calendar 2027 because of the capacity issues.
paras.zh: Hood 表示，该公司第二财季资本支出和融资租赁的目标是超过 500 亿美元，高于 StreetAccount 共识的 531 亿美元，由于产能问题，2027 年全年资本支出和融资租赁为 1700 亿美元。

paras.en: "In the second half of the fiscal year, we currently expect capex spend to accelerate primarily from CPUs, inclusive of higher memory and storage costs, and GPUs, as well as the 3P capacity deliveries that shifted to H2," she said. The delays have to do with GPU-as-a-service providers, she said.
paras.zh: 她表示：“在本财年下半年，我们目前预计资本支出将主要来自 CPU，包括更高的内存和存储成本、GPU 以及转向 H2 的 3P 容量交付。”她说，延迟与 GPU 即服务提供商有关。

paras.en: Free cash flow for the fiscal first quarter declined 27% to $18.63 billion. Cloud rival Alphabet reported more than $9 billion in negative free cash flow in the quarter after Meta said last week its cash flow turned negative for the first time.
paras.zh: 第一财季自由现金流下降 27% 至 186.3 亿美元。云计算竞争对手 Alphabet 在 Meta 上周表示其现金流首次转为负值后，本季度自由现金流为负，超过 90 亿美元。

paras.en: Microsoft will continue to generate free cash flow through the 2027 fiscal year, but the company will access additional sources of funding when it's attractive to do so, Hood said.
paras.zh: 胡德表示，微软将在 2027 财年继续产生自由现金流，但当有吸引力时，该公司将获得额外的资金来源。

paras.en: "We're fortunate to have access in the debt markets, given where our rates ratings are, and sort of we haven't been able to — we haven't yet, I would say, tapped that," she said. "And then, of course, there's other options."
paras.zh: “考虑到我们的利率评级，我们很幸运能够进入债务市场，但我们还未能做到这一点——我想说，我们还没有利用这一点，”她说。 “当然，还有其他选择。”

paras.en: Microsoft's net income increased to $36.63 billion, or $4.92 per share, from $27.75 billion, or $3.72 per share, a year ago. Adjusted earnings exclude a roughly $200 million loss on its investment in OpenAI.
paras.zh: 微软的净利润从一年前的 277.5 亿美元（即每股 3.72 美元）增至 366.3 亿美元（即每股 4.92 美元）。调整后收益不包括对 OpenAI 的投资造成的约 2 亿美元损失。

paras.en: For the first time, Microsoft disclosed revenue from its Azure cloud in dollars, at $33.17 billion in the quarter, despite the delays from third-party providers.
paras.zh: 尽管第三方提供商推迟了披露，但微软首次以美元形式披露了 Azure 云的收入，该季度的收入为 331.7 亿美元。

paras.en: Analysts polled by StreetAccount expected $32.32 billion. The growth rate in the June quarter was 42%.
paras.zh: StreetAccount 调查的分析师预计该公司的营收将达到 323.2 亿美元。六月季度的增长率为 42%。

paras.en: Microsoft reported results under two operating segments — Agents and Infra, and Devices and Consumer. For the past 11 years, the company had three segments that divided up its Azure, Office and Windows businesses.
paras.zh: 微软报告了两个运营部门的业绩——代理和基础设施，以及设备和消费者。在过去的 11 年里，该公司分为三个部门，分别是 Azure、Office 和 Windows 业务。

paras.en: In Agents and Infra, revenue rose almost 25% to $76.8 billion, more than the $75.63 billion consensus among analysts polled by StreetAccount. The segment contains Azure, along with Microsoft 365 cloud products, productivity and server licensing, industry solutions and frontier and support services.
paras.zh: 在代理和基础设施方面，收入增长了近 25%，达到 768 亿美元，高于 StreetAccount 调查的分析师一致认为的 756.3 亿美元。该部门包含 Azure 以及 Microsoft 365 云产品、生产力和服务器许可、行业解决方案以及前沿和支持服务。

paras.en: The number of people using the Microsoft 365 Copilot AI assistant is up 50% from last quarter, CEO Satya Nadella said on the call. The company did not disclose the number of paid seats. The recently announced high-end Microsoft 365 E7 productivity bundle now has millions of seats, Hood said.
paras.zh: 首席执行官 Satya Nadella 在电话会议上表示，使用 Microsoft 365 Copilot AI 助手的人数比上季度增加了 50%。该公司没有透露付费座位的数量。 Hood 表示，最近发布的高端 Microsoft 365 E7 生产力捆绑包现已拥有数百万个席位。

paras.en: Revenue in the Devices and Consumer business slipped 3% to $15.48 billion, beating the StreetAccount consensus of $15.05 billion. The unit includes search and advertising, Xbox, devices and Windows operating system licenses sold to device makers.
paras.zh: 设备和消费者业务收入下滑 3%，至 154.8 亿美元，超过 StreetAccount 预期的 150.5 亿美元。该部门包括搜索和广告、Xbox、设备以及出售给设备制造商的Windows操作系统许可证。
