articles.title: Sen Dan Sullivan brands Peltola’s alleged ballot scheme a ‘scandal at the highest order’

paras.en: Sen. Dan Sullivan, R-Alaska, told Fox News that Democrats will do "anything" to gain power while addressing reports that the campaign of his Democratic challenger Mary Peltola secretly participated in a months-long process to recruit people with his name to run in the Alaska U.S. Senate race.
paras.zh: 阿拉斯加州共和党参议员丹·沙利文对福克斯新闻表示，民主党将“不惜一切代价”获得权力，同时回应有关其民主党挑战者玛丽·佩尔托拉的竞选团队秘密参与为期数月的招募以他的名字命名的人参加阿拉斯加美国参议院竞选的报道。

paras.en: The New York Times reported Wednesday that Peltola’s campaign, as well as senior aides at the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee, carried out the alleged election scheme in hopes that voters would be confused by two Dan Sullivans and therefore draw support from the incumbent Republican senator.
paras.zh: 《纽约时报》周三报道称，佩尔托拉的竞选团队以及民主党参议员竞选委员会的高级助手实施了所谓的选举计划，希望选民被两个丹·沙利文迷惑，从而获得现任共和党参议员的支持。

paras.en: "This is a scandal at the highest order," Sen. Sullivan said during an interview on "Hannity" Wednesday.
paras.zh: “这是最高级别的丑闻，”参议员沙利文周三在接受“汉尼蒂”采访时表示。

paras.en: "She and her team, and at the highest levels of the DSCC, spent over a year scheming in a secret operation to trick Alaskans to get them to throw away their vote," Sullivan said. "It's remarkable. The Democrats will do anything to gain power."
paras.zh: 沙利文说：“她和她的团队以及 DSCC 的最高层花了一年多的时间策划一项秘密行动，欺骗阿拉斯加人，让他们放弃投票。” “这太了不起了。民主党会不惜一切代价获得权力。”

paras.en: The Justice Department is moving to delay certification of Alaska’s U.S. Senate election results since two individuals by the name of Dan Sullivan appear alongside each other on the ballot. Listed on the ballot as "Sullivan, Dan S.," is the state’s incumbent U.S. senator, while "Sullivan, Daniel J. Jr.," is a retired schoolteacher.
paras.zh: 由于两个名叫丹·沙利文的人同时出现在选票上，司法部正在采取行动推迟对阿拉斯加美国参议院选举结果的认证。选票上的“沙利文，丹·S.”是该州现任美国参议员，而“沙利文，丹尼尔·J. Jr.”是一名退休教师。

paras.en: "They've been lying for almost a year about it, and now they're caught," Sullivan told Fox News host Sean Hannity.
paras.zh: 沙利文对福克斯新闻主持人肖恩·汉尼提说：“他们在这件事上撒了将近一年的谎，现在他们被抓住了。”

paras.en: Peltola has dismissed reports of the alleged election scheme as "just another distraction," arguing that The New York Times’ report was solely purposed to "sell newspapers."
paras.zh: 佩尔托拉驳斥了有关所谓选举计划的报道，称其“只是另一种干扰”，他认为《纽约时报》的报道纯粹是为了“卖报纸”。

paras.en: Her campaign also continues to assert innocence, previously telling Fox News in part that the Alaskans for Mary campaign "has no involvement with either Sullivan campaign."
paras.zh: 她的竞选团队也继续坚称自己无罪，此前曾部分告诉福克斯新闻，“阿拉斯加人支持玛丽”竞选活动“与沙利文的竞选活动没有任何关系”。

paras.en: Republican Sen. Sullivan called out what he described as Peltola’s hypocrisy, saying the alleged election scheme shows her "total contempt" for the people of Alaska.
paras.zh: 共和党参议员沙利文痛斥佩尔托拉的虚伪，称所谓的选举计划显示了她对阿拉斯加人民的“彻底蔑视”。

paras.en: "She's run a campaign about supposed corruption. She's the corrupt one working with D.C. insiders to trick Alaskans," he said.
paras.zh: “她发起了一场关于所谓腐败的运动。她是与华盛顿特区内部人士合作欺骗阿拉斯加人的腐败分子，”他说。

paras.en: "[Peltola and the DSCC] think so little of Alaskans that they thought they can trick them," he added.
paras.zh: “[佩尔托拉和 DSCC] 太不重视阿拉斯加人了，以至于他们认为自己可以欺骗他们，”他补充道。

paras.en: The Alaska senator argued that Peltola made a concerted effort to trick voters with another Dan Sullivan because her campaign had "nothing to run on."
paras.zh: 这位阿拉斯加州参议员辩称，佩尔托拉与另一位丹·沙利文齐心协力欺骗选民，因为她的竞选活动“没有任何依据”。

paras.en: "This is what happens when you have a candidate like Peltola — far-left — who's got nothing to run on," Sullivan said. "I have a much stronger record… We have a vision for Alaskans that the Alaskan people want, and when they recognize that, they're like, ’Shoot, I guess we've got to cheat.’"
paras.zh: 沙利文说：“当你有像佩尔托拉这样的极左候选人时，就会发生这种情况，他没有什么可竞选的。” “我的记录要强得多……我们对阿拉斯加人有一个阿拉斯加人想要的愿景，当他们认识到这一点时，他们会说，‘开枪，我想我们必须作弊了。’”

paras.en: Sullivan also noted that the alleged ballot scheme does not just apply to Alaska, but to the entire country as the state’s Senate race holds significant power in determining which party will hold a majority in the Senate.
paras.zh: 沙利文还指出，所谓的投票计划不仅适用于阿拉斯加，而且适用于整个国家，因为该州的参议院竞选在决定哪个政党将在参议院获得多数席位方面拥有重要权力。

paras.en: "This goes to the highest levels of the government," he said on "Hannity." "The seat in Alaska could determine who controls the United States Senate. This isn't just about Alaska — this is about America."
paras.zh: “这将提交给政府最高层，”他在“汉尼蒂”节目中说道。 “阿拉斯加的席位可以决定谁控制美国参议院。这不仅关系到阿拉斯加，还关系到美国。”

paras.en: Federal prosecutors are conducting an "aggressive criminal investigation" into how the second Sullivan secured a spot on Alaska's ballot, two sources familiar with the matter told Fox News.
paras.zh: 两位知情人士告诉福克斯新闻，联邦检察官正在对第二个沙利文如何在阿拉斯加州的选票上获得一席之地进行“积极的刑事调查”。

paras.en: Sullivan told "Hannity" he will do his best to inform every single Alaskan of the scheme.
paras.zh: 沙利文告诉“汉尼蒂”，他将尽最大努力将该计划告知每一位阿拉斯加人。

paras.en: "We're going to make sure every single Alaskan knows about this," Sullivan said.
paras.zh: “我们将确保每个阿拉斯加人都知道这一点，”沙利文说。

paras.en: "We are campaigning 24/7, and we're telling every Alaskan, ‘Don't let your vote be stolen.’"
paras.zh: “我们正在进行 24/7 的竞选活动，我们告诉每个阿拉斯加人，‘不要让你的选票被窃取。’”

paras.en: Fox News Digital reached out to the Peltola campaign for comment.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字媒体联系了佩尔托拉竞选团队请其置评。

paras.en: Fox News Digital's Robert Schmad and Olivia Palombo contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字频道的罗伯特·施马德 (Robert Schmad) 和奥利维亚·帕伦博 (Olivia Palombo) 对本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: Brewers win World Series for first time in franchise history with Game 5 victory over Rays

paras.en: For the first time in franchise history, the Milwaukee Brewers can call themselves World Series champions.
paras.zh: 密尔沃基酿酒人队在球队历史上第一次可以称自己为世界大赛冠军。

paras.en: The Brewers couldn’t get the job done in seven games against the St. Louis Cardinals in the 1982 World Series, and it took them 44 years to get back to the Fall Classic this season.
paras.zh: 酿酒人队在 1982 年世界职业棒球大赛中与圣路易斯红雀队的七场比赛中未能完成任务，他们花了 44 年才在本赛季重返秋季经典赛。

paras.en: In Game 5 against the Tampa Bay Bays, one night after getting walked off in the bottom of the 13th inning, the Brewers defeated their AL opponent, 4-1, to claim their title.
paras.zh: 在对阵坦帕湾海湾队的第五场比赛中，酿酒人队在第 13 局下半被罚下场后的一个晚上，以 4-1 击败了美联对手，夺得了冠军。

paras.en: Game 4 was a suspenseful thriller, where it seemed like 22-year-old rookie Cooper Pratt would go down in World Series history after belting a top of the 13th solo homer to finally break a 2-2 tie.
paras.zh: 第四场比赛是一场悬疑惊悚的比赛，22 岁的新秀库珀·普拉特 (Cooper Pratt) 打出第 13 个独奏全垒打，最终以 2-2 平局打破了比赛的记录，似乎将载入世界大赛的历史。

paras.en: But, facing a potential sweep at the hands of the Brewers, who did the same to the Los Angeles Dodgers in the NLCS, the Rays strung together four straight singles in the bottom of the frame to walk off Game 4 and keep their season alive.
paras.zh: 但是，面对酿酒人队的潜在横扫，后者在国联杯中也对洛杉矶道奇队进行了同样的横扫，光芒队在比赛的底部连续四次单打，结束了第四场比赛并保持了他们的赛季活力。

paras.en: In Game 5, the Brewers didn’t blink despite momentum swinging in the Rays’ favor ever so slightly.
paras.zh: 在第五场比赛中，酿酒人队并没有眨眼，尽管势头稍稍有利于光芒队。

paras.en: Once again, it was Pratt, three years removed from playing high school baseball in Mississippi, coming through in the clutch with an RBI single in the top of the second inning off Drew Rasmussen, who made a start on short rest given the circumstances, to take a 1-0 lead.
paras.zh: 普拉特再次在密西西比州打高中棒球三年了，他在第二局上半打点一垒安打，在关键时刻击败了德鲁·拉斯穆森，后者在这种情况下短暂休息，取得了 1-0 的领先。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Jacob Misiorowski, the likely NL Cy Young winner, was dealing triple-digit fastballs the Rays couldn’t handle in the bottom frames. He went 5.2 innings before cramping in the bottom of the sixth inning forced manager Pat Murphy to finally go into his bullpen, which was exhausted in Game 4 due to extra innings. Misiorowski gave up just two hits and one walk, while striking out two.
paras.zh: 与此同时，可能成为国联赛扬赛冠军的雅各布·米西奥罗夫斯基(Jacob Misiorowski)正在发出三位数的快球，光芒队在下局无法处理。他打了5.2局，然后在第六局下半时抽筋，迫使主教练帕特·墨菲最终进入牛棚，而牛棚在第四场比赛中由于加时赛而筋疲力尽。米西奥罗夫斯基只失掉了两次安打和一次保送，同时三振了两次。

paras.en: The Milwaukee bullpen took over with run support, though, as David Hamilton shot an RBI single past a diving Rays defender in the top of the fifth, and two more runs would come across one inning later thanks to another RBI from Pratt on a sac fly and Williams Contreras roping a double to score Christian Yelich.
paras.zh: 不过，密尔沃基牛棚在跑动支持下接管了比赛，大卫·汉密尔顿在第五局上半打出一记打点单打，越过了一名跳水的光芒队后卫，一局后，由于普拉特的一次飞球打点和威廉姆斯·康特雷拉斯打出二垒安打，克里斯蒂安·耶利奇得分，一局后又打出两分。

paras.en: A 4-0 lead was just what the Brewers needed, as the bullpen continued to get its outs and the suspense this time was felt from Tampa Bay all the way to Wisconsin, where fans were inching closer toward a history-defining victory.
paras.zh: 4-0 的领先正是酿酒人队所需要的，因为牛棚继续出局，这一次从坦帕湾一直到威斯康星州都感受到了悬念，那里的球迷正在一步步接近一场定义历史的胜利。

paras.en: This was a team that had the best record in MLB this regular season at 103-59 despite having a payroll in the middle of the pack (19th overall at $146 million). The Rays' payroll was even lower at $95.6 million, which ranked 28th among the 30 teams, making this a World Series matchup of two teams that operated in another spectrum compared to those at the top of the list filled with All-Stars in every facet.
paras.zh: 这支球队在本赛季常规赛中取得了 103 胜 59 胜的 MLB 最佳战绩，尽管他们的薪资处于中等水平（总收入 1.46 亿美元，排名第 19）。光芒队的工资总额甚至更低，为 9560 万美元，在 30 支球队中排名第 28 位，这使得这场世界大赛的对决成为两支球队的对决，与排名靠前的全明星球队相比，两支球队的表现截然不同。

paras.en: "Brewer Ball," however, became a fascinating watch for both baseball traditionalists and modern-day fans. New York Yankees great Derek Jeter said, "Quite frankly, that's how baseball's supposed to be played."
paras.zh: 然而，“布鲁尔球”却成为了棒球传统主义者和现代球迷的迷人手表。纽约洋基队伟大的德里克·杰特说：“坦率地说，这就是棒球应该如何进行的。”

paras.en: The Brewers do everything needed to win games, especially those close ones. They did it during the regular season, and they did so in the postseason, including Games 1 and 2 against the Rays before blowing them out in Game 3, 10-1, at Tropicana Field.
paras.zh: 酿酒人队竭尽全力赢得比赛，尤其是那些势均力敌的比赛。他们在常规赛中做到了这一点，在季后赛中也做到了这一点，包括对阵光芒队的第一场和第二场比赛，然后在纯果康纳球场的第三场比赛中以 10-1 击败光芒队。

paras.en: So, in the bottom of the ninth inning, the Brewers did exactly what was needed one last time to cap their magical season in the best way possible.
paras.zh: 因此，在第九局下半，酿酒人队最后一次做了所需要的事情，以尽可能最好的方式结束他们神奇的赛季。

paras.en: Time to celebrate, Brewers fans. Your team just won it all.
paras.zh: 酿酒人球迷们，是时候庆祝了。你的团队刚刚赢得了一切。

articles.title: DHS investigates massive data breach exposing 40,000 employees, including ICE and Border Patrol agents

paras.en: The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) is investigating a potentially massive data breach that may have exposed the identities and contact information of tens of thousands of employees, sources told Fox News.
paras.zh: 消息人士告诉福克斯新闻，国土安全部 (DHS) 正在调查一起潜在的大规模数据泄露事件，该事件可能泄露了数万名员工的身份和联系信息。

paras.en: The suspected breach, which sources described as a "catastrophic" security incident, may have exposed the names, titles, locations and, in some cases, phone numbers and email addresses of approximately 40,000 DHS employees and contractors, including roughly 10,000 ICE personnel, according to sources familiar with the data.
paras.zh: 据知情人士透露，此次涉嫌泄露事件被消息人士描述为“灾难性”安全事件，可能泄露了约 40,000 名国土安全部员工和承包商的姓名、头衔、位置，在某些情况下还包括电话号码和电子邮件地址，其中包括约 10,000 名 ICE 人员。

paras.en: The data also includes records associated with more than 20,000 U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) employees, including Border Patrol personnel.
paras.zh: 这些数据还包括与 20,000 多名美国海关和边境保护局 (CBP) 员工（包括边境巡逻人员）相关的记录。

paras.en: Multiple sources confirmed the authenticity of portions of the data.
paras.zh: 多个来源证实了部分数据的真实性。

paras.en: The data leak website Distributed Denial of Secrets said Wednesday it had released information about the employees.
paras.zh: 数据泄露网站 Distributed Denial of Secrets 周三表示，已公布有关员工的信息。

paras.en: Fox News independently confirmed that the leaked records include the names of several undercover ICE agents working in different parts of the country.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻独立证实，泄露的记录包括在该国不同地区工作的几名 ICE 便衣特工的姓名。

paras.en: An anti-fascist hacking group calling itself the "Department of Peace" claimed responsibility for obtaining the data.
paras.zh: 一个自称“和平部”的反法西斯黑客组织声称对获取这些数据负责。

paras.en: "DHS is aware of a potential breach and is actively working to address the situation swiftly and effectively," a department spokesperson told Fox News.
paras.zh: “国土安全部意识到潜在的违规行为，并正在积极努力迅速有效地解决这一问题，”部门发言人告诉福克斯新闻。

paras.en: "We take all security threats against our employees and officers seriously and will work to ensure all are properly protected," the statement continued. "We will update the public when more information is available."
paras.zh: 声明继续说道：“我们认真对待针对员工和官员的所有安全威胁，并将努力确保所有人都得到适当的保护。” “当有更多信息时，我们将向公众通报最新情况。”

paras.en: Distributed Denial of Secrets co-founder Emma Best said in a statement that a tool had been developed to allow the public to search the data, saying it would "replace anonymity with accountability."
paras.zh: Distributed Denial of Secrets 联合创始人艾玛·贝斯特 (Emma Best) 在一份声明中表示，已经开发出一种工具来允许公众搜索数据，并称它将“用问责制取代匿名”。

paras.en: The Department of Peace said in its own statement that DHS employees "have our information, so it's only fair that we have theirs" and that it hoped the data "can be used to limit further harm by the DHS and supports all efforts in that direction."
paras.zh: 和平部在自己的声明中表示，国土安全部员工“拥有我们的信息，因此我们拥有他们的信息是公平的”，并希望这些数据“可以用来限制国土安全部的进一步伤害，并支持朝这个方向的所有努力。”

paras.en: The reported breach comes amid broader concerns about the security of government personnel records.
paras.zh: 此次泄露事件发生之际，人们对政府人事记录的安全性产生了更广泛的担忧。

paras.en: Last month, a Pentagon personnel database breach exposed sensitive personal information belonging to more than 2.76 million living U.S. military and civilian personnel and 294,000 deceased individuals.
paras.zh: 上个月，五角大楼人员数据库遭到泄露，涉及超过 276 万名在世美国军事和文职人员以及 294,000 名死者的敏感个人信息。

paras.en: Unauthorized users accessed unencrypted files containing Social Security numbers and military or civilian employment information between October 2025 and July 2026, a Pentagon official previously confirmed to Fox News.
paras.zh: 五角大楼官员此前向福克斯新闻证实，2025 年 10 月至 2026 年 7 月期间，未经授权的用户访问了包含社会安全号码以及军事或平民就业信息的未加密文件。

paras.en: Fox News Digital's Brittany Miller and Fox News' Liz Friden, along with Reuters, contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字版的布列塔尼·米勒和福克斯新闻的利兹·弗里登以及路透社对本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: Spain begins mourning period after deadly train crash
articles.author: Staff and agencies

paras.en: Spain has begun three days of mourning after a high-speed rail collision – its second this year – killed 68 people and injured scores, with relatives desperately seeking news about their loved ones.
paras.zh: 西班牙已开始为期三天的哀悼，此前发生了今年第二次高铁相撞事故，造成 68 人死亡、数十人受伤，亲属们拼命寻找亲人的消息。

paras.en: The trains, one from Spain’s state-owned Renfe and the other from the private rail company Iryo, were travelling on Wednesday morning in the same direction on the line that stretches from the Spanish capital, Madrid, to the southern region of Andalusia. After the Iryo train came to a halt, the other slammed into its rear, knocking several carriages off the track near the town of Urda.
paras.zh: 周三上午，这两趟列车一趟来自西班牙国有铁路公司 Renfe，另一趟来自私营铁路公司 Iryo，沿从西班牙首都马德里延伸至安达卢西亚南部地区的线路沿同一方向行驶。 Iryo列车停下来后，另一列列车猛烈地撞到了它的后部，将乌尔达镇附近的几节车厢撞出了轨道。

paras.en: Officials said on Wednesday another 107 people had needed medical treatment in hospital, including 15 who were in a serious condition.
paras.zh: 官员周三表示，另有 107 人需要住院治疗，其中 15 人伤势严重。

paras.en: The disaster has raised fresh questions about safety on Spain’s rail network after the transport minister reported an “error” and “inexplicable circumstances” that led to the crash.
paras.zh: 在西班牙交通部长报告了导致事故发生的“错误”和“无法解释的情况”后，这场灾难引发了有关西班牙铁路网络安全的新问题。

paras.en: Emergency services combed through the wreckage overnight to find further victims, hoisting pieces of mangled metal with cranes, according to Agence France-Presse.
paras.zh: 据法新社报道，紧急服务人员连夜梳理残骸，寻找更多受害者，用起重机吊起破碎的金属碎片。

paras.en: Emiliano García-Page, the leader of the Castilla-La Mancha regional government, told reporters on Wednesday that more victims were likely as “it has not yet been possible to reach the bottom of the carriages”.
paras.zh: 卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰地区政府领导人埃米利亚诺·加西亚-佩奇（ Emiliano García-Page ）周三告诉记者，可能有更多的受害者，因为“还没有可能到达车厢底部”。

paras.en: The Civil Guard has set up four offices in the cities of Madrid, Toledo, Córdoba and Seville to enable relatives to provide DNA samples and help identify victims. Blood donation points have also been set up in Castilla-La Mancha and Madrid.
paras.zh: 国民警卫队已在马德里、托莱多、科尔多瓦和塞维利亚等城市设立了四个办事处，以便亲属能够提供 DNA 样本并帮助识别受害者。卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰和马德里也设立了献血点。

paras.en: A school in the nearby village of Urda, around 130km (80 miles) south of Madrid, is being used to allow relatives to enquire about their loved ones. Teams of Red Cross workers offered support to groups of people who arrived, some of them in tears.
paras.zh: 马德里以南约 130 公里（80 英里）处，附近乌尔达村的一所学校被用来允许亲戚询问亲人的情况。红十字会工作人员为抵达的人群提供支持，其中一些人流着泪。

paras.en: Red Cross psychologist Carmen Garcia said “long and hard hours” were in store because “every person will manage it in their own way”. “We have people who are in shock, who haven’t taken on board what has happened, angry people, sad, worried people. The grieving will be complicated,” Garcia said.
paras.zh: 红十字会心理学家卡门·加西亚表示，“漫长而艰难的工作时间”即将到来，因为“每个人都会以自己的方式应对”。 “我们有人感到震惊，没有接受所发生的事情，有人愤怒，有人悲伤，有人担心。悲伤会很复杂，”加西亚说。

paras.en: In January, 46 people were killed and dozens more injured after two trains – again, one from Renfe and one from Iryo – collided on the same line near the town of Adamuz in Andalucía.
paras.zh: 今年 1 月，两列火车（一列来自 Renfe，一列来自 Iryo）在安达卢西亚阿达穆斯镇附近的同一条线路上相撞，造成 46 人死亡，数十人受伤。

paras.en: The prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, said it was “unacceptable for a country like Spain to suffer two high-speed train accidents in the same year, as we have”.
paras.zh: 首相佩德罗·桑切斯表示，“像西班牙这样的国家在同一年发生两起高铁事故，就像我们一样，这是不可接受的”。

paras.en: The causes of the accident were under investigation, he added. If it emerged that it was due to failures in the security system or negligence, these shortcomings would be addressed with the “utmost severity”, he said.
paras.zh: 他补充说，事故原因正在调查中。他说，如果发现是由于安全系统故障或疏忽造成的，这些缺陷将得到“最严厉的”解决。

paras.en: The first victims to be named included a 31-year-old Guardia civil agent, José Manuel Chacón.
paras.zh: 第一批被点名的受害者包括 31 岁的瓜迪亚民事特工何塞·曼努埃尔·查孔 (José Manuel Chacón)。

paras.en: The national law enforcement agency expressed its “deepest condolences” to his family, friends and colleagues. Spanish media said the missing included a former minister for the People’s party and several foreigners who were likely on holiday in the country.
paras.zh: 国家执法机构向他的家人、朋友和同事表示“最深切的哀悼”。西班牙媒体称，失踪者包括一名人民党前部长和几名可能在该国度假的外国人。

paras.en: The opposition People’s party leader, Alberto Núñez Feijóo, called for an immediate investigation into what had happened, as well as a “complete and independent review” of Spain’s entire rail network. “Spain has the right to know what is going on with its infrastructure,” he told reporters.
paras.zh: 反对党人民党领袖阿尔贝托·努涅斯·费霍 (Alberto Núñez Feijóo) 呼吁立即调查所发生的事情，并对西班牙整个铁路网络进行“全面、独立的审查”。 “西班牙有权知道其基础设施的状况，”他告诉记者。

articles.title: Defence backed claim that social media footage of public servants could invite bullying
articles.author: Josh Butler

paras.en: The secretary of the defence department approved a senior official’s controversial idea to tell a Senate hearing that footage of public servants giving evidence should not be shared on social media because it could invite online bullying and raise national security concerns.
paras.zh: 国防部部长批准了一位高级官员的有争议的想法，即告诉参议院听证会，公务员提供证据的镜头不应该在社交媒体上分享，因为这可能会招致在线欺凌并引发国家安全问题。

paras.en: Emails obtained by Guardian Australia under freedom of information reveal deputy secretary Celia Perkins’ planned request to the parliamentary inquiry was flagged with the offices of deputy prime minister Richard Marles and assistant defence minister Peter Khalil, and received the backing of department secretary Meghan Quinn.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚卫报根据信息自由获得的电子邮件显示，副总理西莉亚·珀金斯（ Celia Perkins ）计划向议会调查提出的请求被标记为副总理理查德·马尔斯（ Richard Marles ）和助理国防部长彼得·哈利勒（ Peter Khalil ）的办公室，并得到了部门秘书梅根·奎因（ Meghan Quinn ）的支持

paras.en: Perkins – defence’s deputy secretary of security and estate – drew criticism across the political divide with her 4 September statement to a committee hearing, where she said defence witnesses “do not consent to the reposting of our evidence to social media sites”.
paras.zh: 负责安全和遗产事务的国防部副部长帕金斯 9 月 4 日在委员会听证会上发表的声明引起了政治分歧的批评，她在声明中表示，辩方证人“不同意将我们的证据转发到社交媒体网站”。

paras.en: She pointed to a submission from the secretaries board of the Australian Public Service, which had raised similar concerns about evidence being taken out of context, and alleged “edited and embellished” videos from previous hearings had “generated significant highly inappropriate and highly personal commentary that was distressing for staff and invited ridicule, hostility and abuse”.
paras.zh: 她指出，澳大利亚公共服务部秘书委员会提交的一份意见书也对断章取义的证据提出了类似的担忧，并声称之前听证会的“经过编辑和修饰”的视频“产生了严重的高度不恰当和高度个人化的评论，令工作人员感到痛苦，并引发了嘲笑、敌意和辱骂”。

paras.en: The Greens senator David Shoebridge instantly objected, saying: “This is evidence given in an open public hearing … These witnesses do not get to censor what the Australian public sees.”
paras.zh: 绿党参议员大卫·舒布里奇立即表示反对，他说：“这是在公开听证会上提供的证据……这些证人无权审查澳大利亚公众所看到的内容。”

paras.en: The committee rejected Perkins’ request on the advice of the Senate clerk.
paras.zh: 委员会根据参议院书记员的建议拒绝了帕金斯的请求。

paras.en: Newly revealed correspondence shows that concerns about online bullying, as well as national security fears, were used as a “defensible” reason to not share clips from hearings online – and that the plan was backed by the defence department.
paras.zh: 新披露的信件显示，对在线欺凌的担忧以及对国家安全的担忧被用作不分享在线听证会剪辑的“可辩护”的理由，该计划得到了国防部的支持。

paras.en: “Meghan is fully supportive, as is [Khalil]. I discussed today in a meeting with [Khalil] and staff from [Marles] and his office,” Perkins told two fellow deputy secretaries two days before the hearing.
paras.zh: “梅根全力支持，[哈利勒]也是如此。我今天在与[哈利勒]以及[马尔斯]和他办公室的工作人员的会议上进行了讨论，”帕金斯在听证会前两天告诉两位副秘书。

paras.en: Guardian Australia requested documents under FOI from the defence department relating to the preparation of Perkins’ statement. Emails between senior department officials showed Perkins’ proposal to make such a statement had been strongly endorsed by her colleagues and superiors, and that she had told Quinn on 25 August that officials could be put in danger if their evidence before public committees was published online.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚卫报根据《信息自由法》向国防部索取了与帕金斯声明准备相关的文件。高级部门官员之间的电子邮件显示，帕金斯提出的此类声明的提议得到了她的同事和上级的强烈支持，而且她已于 8 月 25 日告诉奎因，如果官员们向公共委员会提供的证据在网上公布，他们可能会面临危险。

paras.en: “As senior leaders in Defence – we actively discourage security clearance holders from a social media presence that identifies us and our roles,” Perkins wrote to Quinn, outlining “core arguments” to support her statement.
paras.zh: 帕金斯在给奎因的信中写道：“作为国防部长，我们积极劝阻安全许可持有者不要在社交媒体上展示我们和我们的角色，”并概述了支持她声明的“核心论点”。

paras.en: “And these post[s], designed to invite outraged responses – increase the personal risk from malign online actors, including cyber and foreign intelligence threats.”
paras.zh: “这些帖子旨在引起愤怒的回应，增加了来自恶意在线行为者的个人风险，包括网络和外国情报威胁。”

paras.en: The offices of Marles and Khalil were contacted for comment. Neither provided an on-record response, but Guardian Australia understands neither office directed Perkins on the content of her statement.
paras.zh: 我们联系了马勒斯和哈利勒的办公室征求意见。两人都没有做出正式回应，但澳大利亚《卫报》了解到，这两个办公室都没有就帕金斯的声明内容向她发出指示。

paras.en: Defence did not supply a response to Guardian Australia, but a spokesperson pointed to Quinn’s opening statement to a Senate estimates committee on Thursday, in which she said she supported the submission from the secretaries board and claimed that the treatment of staff after committee hearings could sometimes conflict with an employer’s duty to ensure the health and safety of employees.
paras.zh: 国防部没有对澳大利亚卫报做出回应，但发言人指出奎因周四向参议院评估委员会发表的开场陈述，她在其中表示支持秘书委员会提交的意见，并声称委员会听证会后员工的待遇有时可能与雇主确保员工健康和安全的责任相冲突。

paras.en: In the 25 August email, which discussed the upcoming hearing, Perkins told Quinn she wanted “to add an explicit statement that the Defence witnesses appearing do not consent to our evidence being reproduced in edited format on social media platforms”.
paras.zh: 在 8 月 25 日讨论即将举行的听证会的电子邮件中，帕金斯告诉奎因，她想“添加一份明确的声明，表明出庭的辩方证人不同意我们的证据在社交媒体平台上以经过编辑的格式复制”。

paras.en: “We’d need to settle a form of words that is defensible,” Perkins wrote, outlining concerns about maintaining a safe workplace for staff and that previous hearings led to “significant vile, personal commentary that was distressing for staff and invited online bullying.” Perkins also raised the concern about cyber and foreign intelligence threats.
paras.zh: 帕金斯写道：“我们需要以一种站得住脚的方式解决问题。”他概述了对为员工维持安全工作场所的担忧，以及之前的听证会导致了“严重的恶意个人评论，这些评论让员工感到痛苦，并引发了网上欺凌行为”。帕金斯还提出了对网络和外国情报威胁的担忧。

paras.en: In response, Quinn wrote: “Very happy to support you using such words.”
paras.zh: 奎因回应道：“很高兴支持你使用这样的话语。”

paras.en: On 2 September, Perkins emailed two other deputy secretaries in the department, John Reid and Cath Patterson, flagging her intention to make the statement and “to specifically call out the social media posting matter”, and seeking their feedback on wording.
paras.zh: 9 月 2 日，帕金斯向该部门的另外两名副部长约翰·里德 (John Reid) 和凯思·帕特森 (Cath Patterson) 发送了电子邮件，表明她打算发表声明并“特别指出社交媒体发布问题”，并征求他们对措辞的反馈。

paras.en: Patterson responded to Perkins’ email: “Those words look fine – polite and clear and safe given in the Sec Board submission”.
paras.zh: 帕特森回应了珀金斯的电子邮件： “这些话看起来很好–在美国证券交易委员会提交的文件中给出了礼貌，清晰和安全的说法”。

paras.en: Reid concurred: “I agree with Cath; this is a good statement and makes the point clearly and respectfully.” Reid suggested minor changes to Perkins’ original suggested wording, with that version read at the committee.
paras.zh: 里德表示同意：“我同意凯丝的观点；这是一个很好的声明，清楚而尊重地表达了这一点。”里德建议对帕金斯最初建议的措辞进行细微修改，并在委员会上宣读了该版本。

articles.title: Australian politics live: PM grilled over golf club grant again as five ejected from question time; woman dies after drive-by shooting
articles.author: Achol Arok (now) and Kat Wong (earlier)

paras.en: Military chief chides Jacqui Lambie over disclosure of harassment investigation
paras.zh: 军事首长斥责雅基·兰比披露骚扰调查

paras.en: Australia’s defence force chief has admonished a senator for going public with an investigation into a recording device being planted inside the female bathroom of a naval ship.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚国防部长对一名公开调查海军舰艇女卫生间内安装录音装置的参议员提出了警告。

paras.en: The camera was discovered in a cabin aboard the HMAS Leeuwin on 11 October, while the ship was docked in Cairns.
paras.zh: 10 月 11 日，该相机在英国皇家海军卢纹号 (HMAS Leeuwin) 的船舱内被发现，当时该船正停靠在凯恩斯。

paras.en: Three days later, the allegation was aired on the floor of the Senate by Tasmanian independent Jacqui Lambie, who said the video recording device had been found hidden in a women’s shower.
paras.zh: 三天后，塔斯马尼亚独立人士雅基·兰比(Jacqui Lambie)在参议院提出了这一指控，他表示视频记录设备被发现藏在女浴室里。

paras.en: The defence force confirmed the incident hours later.
paras.zh: 几小时后，国防军证实了这一事件。

paras.en: During Senate estimates hearings on Thursday, chief of the Australian Defence Force Admiral Mark Hammond expressed dismay at how the alleged sexual harassment incident became public.
paras.zh: 在周四的参议院预算听证会上，澳大利亚国防军参谋长马克·哈蒙德上将对涉嫌性骚扰事件的公开表示失望。

paras.en: The investigation was under way before you drew national attention to it …My preference, if you would indulge me, would be to where you become aware of an active investigation, perhaps bring it to my attention first.
paras.zh: 在你提请全国注意之前，调查正在进行中……如果你愿意纵容我，我的偏好是你意识到正在进行调查的地方，也许首先提请我注意。

paras.en: Hammond rejected a suggestion from Lambie sexual violence investigations should be taken out of the defence force’s hands:
paras.zh: 哈蒙德拒绝了兰比性暴力调查应由国防部队负责的建议：

paras.en: 80 per cent of the three star (generals) in this room have partners or children serving in the Australian Defence Force – I assure you we are absolutely committed to eradicating sexual violence.
paras.zh: 在座的三星级（将军）中 80% 的伴侣或子女在澳大利亚国防军服役——我向你们保证，我们绝对致力于消除性暴力。

paras.en: AI Safety Institute not informed of Medicare breach for over a week
paras.zh: 人工智能安全研究所已经一周多没有收到有关医疗保险违规的通知

paras.en: Australia’s AI Safety Institute was not told of the OpenAI agent attack on a Medicare portal until eight days after OpenAI alerted Services Australia, Senate estimates has heard.
paras.zh: 据参议院估计，澳大利亚人工智能安全研究所直到 OpenAI 向澳大利亚服务部发出警报八天后才获悉 OpenAI 代理对医疗保险门户网站发起的攻击。

paras.en: The institute was established late last year, and in May, Dr Kate Conroy was appointed general manager, charged with monitoring and testing AI for potential risks and harms.
paras.zh: 该研究所于去年年底成立，5 月，Kate Conroy 博士被任命为总经理，负责监控和测试人工智能的潜在风险和危害。

paras.en: Conroy told Senate estimates that the June OpenAI attack on the Medicare portal was not revealed by Services Australia to the new agency until 19 September, after OpenAI disclosed the breach on 11 September. She said:
paras.zh: Conroy told Senate estimates that the June OpenAI attack on the Medicare portal was not revealed by Services Australia to the new agency until 19 September, after OpenAI disclosed the breach on 11 September.她说：

paras.en: So the way that the incident was first understood was primarily through a traditional cybersecurity incident framework. And my understanding is that Services Australia and ASD conducted an investigation of that as a cyber incident at the time.
paras.zh: 因此，最初理解该事件的方式主要是通过传统的网络安全事件框架。据我了解，澳大利亚服务部和 ASD 当时将此作为网络事件进行了调查。

paras.en: And so through the course of that, exploration and understanding of the incident, they then reached out to others, including the Australian AI Safety Institute, in order to then better understand the nature of the incident and to draw on our technical expertise.
paras.zh: 因此，通过对事件的探索和了解，他们随后联系了其他人，包括澳大利亚人工智能安全研究所，以便更好地了解事件的性质并利用我们的技术专业知识。

paras.en: Liberal senator Jane Hume asked why PM&C is leading the review into the incident rather than the institute, and officials said PM&C is examining how agencies across government might coordinate in the event of future incidents, and the institute is working closely with the department.
paras.zh: 自由党参议员简·休姆 (Jane Hume) 询问为何是 PM&C 而不是该研究所来主导此次事件的审查，官员们表示，PM&C 正在研究政府各机构如何在未来发生事件时进行协调，并且该研究所正在与该部门密切合作。

paras.en: The chief of the defence force has told Senate estimates that a newspaper article alleging that US security agents secretly infiltrated Australian naval bases in order to test their security was “factually incorrect”.
paras.zh: 国防军参谋长告诉参议院估计，一篇报纸文章声称美国安全特工秘密渗透澳大利亚海军基地以测试其安全性“实际上是错误的”。

paras.en: The report – replete with videos of self-styled US secretary of war Pete Hegseth bench-pressing and jumping up and down – claimed the US Naval Criminal Investigative Service (NCIS) deployed undercover agents to secretly infiltrate multiple Australian bases — including HMAS Stirling in Western Australia and HMAS Kuttabul in Sydney — to “test existing physical security measures”.
paras.zh: 该报告充斥着自封的美国战争部长皮特·赫格斯（Pete Hegseth）卧推和上蹿下跳的视频，声称美国海军刑事调查局（NCIS）部署卧底特工秘密渗透到多个澳大利亚基地——包括西澳大利亚的斯特林号海军舰艇和悉尼的库塔布尔号海军舰艇——以“测试现有的物理安全措施”。

paras.en: The report said the agents were able to breach security measures, walk unchallenged into secure areas and take photographs in restricted zones.
paras.zh: 报告称，这些特工能够突破安全措施，不受阻碍地走进安全区域，并在禁区拍照。

paras.en: Chief of the defence force, Admiral Mark Hammond, told estimates:
paras.zh: 国防军参谋长马克·哈蒙德海军上将表示：

paras.en: That report is wrong. It is factually incorrect. What does occur around the world where US naval assets visit foreign ports is a collaborative arrangement between US embassies and host defence organisations to assess and agree security protocols for visiting programs.
paras.zh: 那个报道是错误的。事实上这是不正确的。当美国海军资产访问外国港口时，世界各地发生的事情是美国大使馆和东道国国防组织之间的合作安排，以评估和商定访问项目的安全协议。

paras.en: And that has always been the case, we have been supporting those ship visit security protocols collaboratively with US authorities for decades.
paras.zh: 情况一直如此，几十年来我们一直与美国当局合作支持这些船舶访问安全协议。

paras.en: Estimates heard the security tests were done in conjunction and “full knowledge and concurrence” with Australian authorities. The US agents were accompanied by Australian officials.
paras.zh: 据估计，安全测试是在澳大利亚当局“完全知情并同意”的情况下进行的。美国特工由澳大利亚官员陪同。

paras.en: “We work in partnership with the US authorities so they can understand the security apparatus in place for their visiting ships,” Hammond said.
paras.zh: 哈蒙德说： “我们与美国当局合作，以便他们了解访问船只的安全设施。”

paras.en: Estimates hears 155,000 children to be kicked off NDIS before June 2031
paras.zh: 预计 2031 年 6 月之前将有 155,000 名儿童被踢出 NDIS

paras.en: Just jumping back to Senate estimates for a hot second, where it’s just been discussed that 155,000 children will be exited from the NDIS by 30 June 2031, with changes to eligibility starting in 2028.
paras.zh: 回到参议院的估计，刚刚讨论了到 2031 年 6 月 30 日将有 155,000 名儿童退出 NDIS，资格变更从 2028 年开始。

paras.en: Under questioning by Greens senator Penny Allman-Payne, assistant secretary NDIS sustainability taskforce Anthea Long said:
paras.zh: 在绿党参议员Penny Allman-Payne的询问下，助理国务卿NDIS可持续发展工作组Anthea Long说：

paras.en: Senator, I can give you figures around children, 18 and under, if that’s helpful. And so, in terms of the projected number of participants who would be assumed to exit the scheme under the reforms, it would be 155,000 children by the 30th of June, 2031.
paras.zh: 参议员，如果有帮助的话，我可以给您提供 18 岁及以下儿童的数据。因此，就预计根据改革退出该计划的参与者人数而言，到 2031 年 6 月 30 日，预计将有 155,000 名儿童。

paras.en: Year on year, she said the cumulative departures would be:
paras.zh: 她表示，年复一年，累计离职人数为：

paras.en: So for 30th June 2028, it is 21,000. For 30th June 2029, 87,000, for 30th June 2030 137,000. And I should say that this is cumulative. So it’s not that many of children each year, it’s cumulative, up and to, up to a total of 155,000 by 30th June 2031.
paras.zh: 因此，2028 年 6 月 30 日的人数为 21,000。 2029年6月30日为87,000，2030年6月30日为137,000。我应该说这是累积的。因此，每年的儿童数量并不算多，但到 2031 年 6 月 30 日为止，总数已达到 155,000 人。

paras.zh: 在座的三星级（将军）中 80% 的伴侣或子女在澳大利亚国防军服役——我向你们保证，我们绝对致力于消除性暴力。

paras.en: Queensland police said that at about 8.18pm on Saturday a “number of shots” were fired from the front window of a car occupied by two males wearing balaclavas and gloves, hitting a total of four people who were gathered in the passenger drop-off zone outside a pub.
paras.zh: 昆士兰警方表示，周六晚上 8 点 18 分左右，一辆汽车的前窗发射了“多枪”，车内有两名戴着头套和手套的男子，总共击中了聚集在酒吧外乘客落客区的四人。

paras.en: A 19-year-old Jimboomba woman was shot in the neck and head and underwent surgery, but died from her injuries in hospital this morning.
paras.zh: 一名 19 岁的 Jimboomba 妇女颈部和头部中弹，接受了手术，但今天早上在医院因伤重不治身亡。

paras.en: Detective Ian Galpin, who previously described the woman as an “innocent bystander”, told reporters on Thursday police are searching for the offenders in what is now a homicide investigation.
paras.zh: 侦探伊恩·加尔平（Ian Galpin）此前将这名女子描述为“无辜的旁观者”，他周四告诉记者，警方正在寻找凶手，目前正在进行凶杀案调查。

paras.en: We will not stop until these people are identified and taken into custody.
paras.zh: 在查明这些人的身份并将其拘留之前，我们不会停止。

paras.en: A 19-year-old woman in the prime of her life, who was simply going out for a night with friends, has had her life taken from her in the most cowardly way.
paras.zh: 一个19岁的风华正茂的女人，只是和朋友出去玩了一晚，她的生命却被以最懦弱的方式夺走了。

paras.en: There are people out there who know exactly who was involved in this offence, and exactly why this occurred. I’m asking those people to be brave enough to come forward with that information and contact police.”
paras.zh: 有人确切地知道谁参与了这起犯罪行为，以及发生这种情况的确切原因。我要求那些人勇敢地提供这些信息并联系警方。”

paras.en: Galpin said it remains unclear whether the incident was gang-related, and a motive can’t be determined until the alleged suspects are found.
paras.zh: 加尔平表示，目前尚不清楚这起事件是否与帮派有关，在找到嫌疑人之前无法确定动机。

paras.en: One of the other victims remains in hospital as they recover from surgery while the other two have been released.
paras.zh: 其他受害者之一仍在医院接受手术康复，另外两人已出院。

paras.en: NDIA spent more than $30,000 in three months ‘maintaining plants and flowers’
paras.zh: NDIA 在三个月内花费了超过 30,000 美元“维护植物和花卉”

paras.en: The NDIA spent $31,960 over three months to March on maintaining plants and flowers in its offices, Senate estimates have heard.
paras.zh: 据参议院估计，截至 3 月份的三个月内，NDIA 花费了 31,960 美元用于维护办公室内的植物和花卉。

paras.en: Under questions from Liberal senator Chris Gatenby, chief operating officer, Matthew Swainson, said:
paras.zh: 在自由党参议员 Chris Gatenby 的提问下，首席运营官 Matthew Swainson 表示：

paras.en: I would observe that we’ve got 149 offices nationally. Some of those are standalone NDIA offices. Some of them are co-located with Services Australia.
paras.zh: 我发现我们在全国设有 149 个办事处。其中一些是独立的 NDIA 办事处。其中一些与澳大利亚服务部位于同一地点。

paras.en: We are looking for efficiencies right across our property portfolio and program. As I mentioned earlier, we are deeply committed to managing the agency within the budget envelope that we’ve been provided with.
paras.zh: 我们正在寻求整个房地产投资组合和计划的效率。正如我之前提到的，我们坚定地致力于在我们提供的预算范围内管理该机构。

paras.en: Asic to review accounts of Woodside, Santos and six other oil and gas companies
paras.zh: 澳大利亚证券投资委员会将审查伍德赛德、桑托斯和其他六家石油和天然气公司的账目

paras.en: Australia’s corporate regulator will audit the accounts of Woodside, Santos and six other oil and gas companies to check they are accounting for the cost of cleaning up offshore infrastructure.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚企业监管机构将审计伍德赛德、桑托斯和其他六家石油和天然气公司的账目，以检查他们是否核算了清理海上基础设施的成本。

paras.en: In response to questions from Greens senator Vanessa Bleyer in Senate estimates on Thursday, the Asic commissioner, Kate O’Rourke, confirmed the corporate regulator was reviewing how eight oil and gas companies disclose decommissioning liabilities in their financial statements.
paras.zh: 周四，在回答绿党参议员凡妮莎·布莱尔在参议院预算中提出的问题时，澳大利亚证券监管委员会委员凯特·奥罗克证实，企业监管机构正在审查八家石油和天然气公司如何在财务报表中披露退役负债。

paras.en: The companies under review are Woodside, Santos, Beach Energy, Amplitude Energy, Horizon Oil, Strike Energy, Cue Energy and Canarvon Energy.
paras.zh: 接受审查的公司包括 Woodside、Santos、Beach Energy、Amplitude Energy、Horizo​​n Oil、Strike Energy、Cue Energy 和 Canarvon Energy。

paras.en: “We have attempted to do a … sample of those whom we think are representative of the issues of importance … We hope it’s a valuable and sufficiently wide sample for us to draw conclusions.
paras.zh: “我们试图对我们认为能够代表重要问题的人进行抽样......我们希望这是一个有价值且足够广泛的样本，以便我们得出结论。

paras.en: After a complaint from the Wilderness Society, Asic named the review of decommissioning as a 2026-27 focus area in May.
paras.zh: 在收到荒野协会的投诉后，Asic 于 5 月将退役审查列为 2026-27 年的重点领域。

paras.en: Amanda Holly, manager of corporate advocacy and engagement at the Wilderness Society, said:
paras.zh: 荒野协会企业宣传和参与经理阿曼达·霍利 (Amanda Holly) 表示：

paras.en: This intervention didn’t come out of nowhere. It follows years of investigation by the Wilderness Society, two complaints to Asic, and the exposure of serious deficiencies in how the oil and gas sector reports its clean-up liabilities.
paras.zh: This intervention didn’t come out of nowhere.在此之前，荒野协会进行了多年的调查，向澳大利亚证券监管委员会提出了两次投诉，并暴露了石油和天然气行业报告其清理责任的严重缺陷。

paras.en: There is over $60bn worth of oil and gas infrastructure sitting off Australia’s coastline that has to be cleaned up. Right now, too many companies are lowballing that bill in their accounts, and if they can’t pay when the time comes, it could land on taxpayers.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚海岸线有价值超过 600 亿美元的石油和天然气基础设施需要清理。目前，太多公司在账目中低估了这笔账单，如果到时候无法支付，这笔费用可能会落在纳税人身上。

paras.en: NDIA managers subject to ‘adverse findings’ by anti-corruption commission
paras.zh: NDIA 经理受到反腐败委员会的“不利调查结果”

paras.en: Two National Disability Insurance Agency senior staff members who have been investigated by Ibac for attempting to conceal almost $260m in Covid-19 grants were paid to ineligible businesses when they worked in the Victorian public service now hold high-level roles at the NDIA, it’s been revealed in Senate estimates.
paras.zh: 参议院的估计显示，两名国家残疾保险局高级工作人员因试图隐瞒近 2.6 亿美元的 Covid-19 补助金而受到 Ibac 调查，他们在维州公共服务部门工作时向不符合资格的企业支付了款项，现在他们在 NDIA 担任高级职务。

paras.en: Speaking about the situation, CEO of the NDIA, Graeme Head, said the officers, who held high-level positions in the NDIA and who cannot be named, are currently not on duty:
paras.zh: NDIA 首席执行官格雷姆·海德 (Graeme Head) 在谈到这一情况时表示，这些在 NDIA 担任高级职务且不愿透露姓名的官员目前没有值班：

paras.en: I can confirm that two current NDIA employees are the subject of adverse findings by Ibac in its operation.
paras.zh: 我可以确认，Ibac 在其运营中发现了两名现任 NDIA 员工。

paras.en: I want to reassure the committee that as agency head, I am taking all steps available to me to ensure the matters are considered carefully and appropriately, and that work is under way.
paras.zh: 我想向委员会保证，作为机构负责人，我正在采取一切可用的步骤，以确保这些问题得到仔细和适当的考虑，并且工作正在进行中。

paras.en: Neither officer is on duty in the agency. It’s important that the work be allowed to proceed properly and fairly, in accordance with all applicable legislative and procedural requirements.
paras.zh: Neither officer is on duty in the agency.重要的是，工作必须根据所有适用的立法和程序要求正确、公平地进行。

paras.en: The cost of living and the growing chances of a rate rise loomed large over the chamber, fuelling taunts and jabs from both sides of the political aisle.
paras.zh: 生活成本和不断增加的加息可能性笼罩着众议院，引发了政治两派的嘲讽和攻击。

paras.en: A $6m grant to the Marrickville golf club continued to offer ample opportunity for the opposition to dig into the government.
paras.zh: 向马里克维尔高尔夫俱乐部提供的600万美元赠款继续为反对派提供充足的机会来挖掘政府。

paras.en: Energy minister, Chris Bowen, proudly took accountability for “triggering” the opposition after mentioning renewable energy in the government’s datacentre requirements
paras.zh: 能源部长克里斯·鲍恩（ Chris Bowen ）在政府数据中心要求中提到可再生能源后，自豪地对“触发”反对派负责

paras.en: Jason Clare pleads with Coalition to support digital duty of care bill
paras.zh: 杰森克莱尔恳求联盟支持数字谨慎责任法案

paras.en: Education minister, Jason Clare, offers harrowing recollections of a child subject to online bullying, and another who died by suicide after engaging with an AI chatbot.
paras.zh: 教育部长杰森·克莱尔 (Jason Clare) 讲述了一名遭受网络欺凌的儿童和另一名在与人工智能聊天机器人互动后自杀身亡的悲惨回忆。

paras.en: He makes an impassioned plea for the Coalition to support the government’s digital duty of care bill:
paras.zh: 他热情地请求联盟支持政府的数字谨慎责任法案：

paras.en: This is not about censorship. It’s not about freedom of speech. It’s about them.
paras.zh: 这与审查制度无关。这与言论自由无关。是关于他们的。

paras.en: And so I say to my colleagues and friends on the other side of the chamber, please think again about it. It’s not too late.
paras.zh: 所以我对会议厅另一边的同事和朋友说，请再考虑一下。还不算太晚。

paras.en: Biggest driver of inflation is petrol, Chalmers says
paras.zh: 查尔默斯说，通货膨胀的最大驱动因素是汽油

paras.en: Asked by the about interest rate rises, the treasurer says takes another jab:
paras.zh: 当被问及关于加息的问题时，财务主管说又一次猛烈抨击：

paras.en: I find it bizarre, frankly, that those opposite won’t acknowledge what was factually the biggest driver of yesterday’s inflation figures, which was higher petrol prices.
paras.zh: 坦率地说，我觉得奇怪的是，那些反对者不承认昨天通胀数据的最大推动因素实际上是汽油价格上涨。

paras.en: It’s this weird post-truth stuff that they get engaged in, where they see the same ABS data that we see, and the biggest driver of yesterday’s inflation number – which was too high – was fuel.
paras.zh: 他们所从事的就是这种奇怪的事后事实，他们看到的ABS数据与我们看到的相同，而昨天通胀数据（太高了）的最大驱动因素是燃料。

paras.en: In one fell swoop he has punted the shadow treasurer, Tim Wilson, the member for Herbert, Phillip Thompson, and the former Nationals leader David Littleproud.
paras.zh: 他一举击败了影子财务主管蒂姆·威尔逊、赫伯特的成员、菲利普·汤普森和前国民党领袖大卫·利特普劳德。

paras.en: Tribute to Queensland police officers who lost their lives at Wieambilla
paras.zh: 向在维安比拉牺牲的昆士兰警察致敬

paras.en: The prime minister and the home affairs minister, Tony Burke, have paid tribute to a number of police officers, including Matthew Arnold and Rachel McCrow, who died while conducting a check at the property in Wieambilla.
paras.zh: 总理和内政部长托尼·伯克（ Tony Burke ）向包括马修·阿诺德（ Matthew Arnold ）和雷切尔·麦克罗（ Rachel McCrow ）在内的一些警察表示敬意，他们在维埃安比拉（ Wieambilla ）的房产进行检查时死亡。

paras.en: The opposition leader, Angus Taylor, agrees:
paras.zh: 反对党领袖安格斯·泰勒也同意：

paras.en: I’d like to associate the Coalition with the fine words of the prime minister and the minister of home affairs, and pay tribute alongside them to those brave police officers who put themselves in harm’s way, to all our police officers, preventing, detecting, responding to or investigating crime.
paras.zh: 我谨向联盟表示赞同总理和内政部长的美好言辞，并与他们一起向那些冒着危险的勇敢警察以及我们所有预防、侦查、应对或调查犯罪的警察致敬。

articles.title: High-speed train crash kills at least 68 people in Spain

paras.en: A high-speed train crash has killed at least 68 people and injured dozens more in central Spain.
paras.zh: 西班牙中部发生一起高速列车相撞事故，已造成至少 68 人死亡、数十人受伤。

paras.en: It occurred when a train travelling from Madrid to Seville barrelled into another train - which was stationary on the tracks - on Wednesday morning. The force saw several carriages fall down an embankment.
paras.zh: 周三早上，一列从马德里开往塞维利亚的火车与另一辆停在铁轨上的火车发生冲撞。部队看到几辆马车从路堤上掉下来。

paras.en: The transport minister said a computer failure followed by human error caused the crash, which is one of the worst in Europe's modern history, and Spain's deadliest train disaster in 13 years.
paras.zh: 交通部长表示，此次事故是由电脑故障和人为失误造成的，这是欧洲现代史上最严重的事故之一，也是西班牙 13 年来最严重的火车事故。

paras.en: Survivors described harrowing scenes of passengers being thrown into the air, trapped in the wreckage and smashing windows to get out.
paras.zh: 幸存者描述了乘客被抛到空中、被困在残骸中、砸碎窗户才能逃生的悲惨场景。

paras.en: The crash happened just after 09:00 (08:00 GMT) around 140km (87 miles) south of Madrid, between the municipalities of Mora and Orgaz.
paras.zh: 事故发生在 09:00（格林威治标准时间 08:00）之后，位于马德里以南约 140 公里（87 英里）处，莫拉市和奥尔加斯市之间。

paras.en: The stationary train, run by private rail operator Iryo, had 147 passengers on board, and had stopped on the tracks because of a computer failure, Spain's Transport Minister Ãscar Puente said.
paras.zh: 西班牙交通部长阿斯卡尔·普恩特表示，这趟固定列车由私营铁路运营商 Iryo 运营，车上载有 147 名乘客，由于计算机故障，该列车停在铁轨上。

paras.en: He explained that when there is a system failure, a 24-hour control centre in Madrid takes over, but it had made an "inexplicable" decision to instruct the trains to move again, without any speed restrictions.
paras.zh: 他解释说，当系统出现故障时，马德里的一个24小时控制中心接手，但它做出了一个“莫名其妙”的决定，指示火车再次行驶，没有任何速度限制。

paras.en: Iryo said its train was "struck from behind" by another train, run by Spain's state-owned railway company, Renfe, which was carrying 397 passengers.
paras.zh: Iryo 表示，其列车被另一列由西班牙国有铁路公司 Renfe 运营的列车“从后面撞上”，该列车载有 397 名乘客。

paras.en: The force of the crash was "brutal", said 62-year-old passenger Salvador Arriza who was sitting in the Renfe-operated train.
paras.zh: 坐在西班牙国家铁路公司 (Renfe) 运营的火车上的 62 岁乘客萨尔瓦多·阿里扎 (Salvador Arriza) 表示，这次事故的力量是“残酷的”。

paras.en: Passengers started breaking the windows to get out, he told Reuters, adding that "some people couldn't move because they were trapped amongst the seats."
paras.zh: 他告诉路透社，乘客开始打破窗户逃生，并补充说“有些人无法移动，因为他们被困在座位之间。”

paras.en: One of the carriages caught fire, and passengers described devastating scenes of trapped people crying and bleeding, with some buried under debris.
paras.zh: 其中一辆车厢起火，乘客们描述了被困人员哭泣、流血的毁灭性场景，其中一些人被埋在废墟下。

paras.en: Pictures show that a long piece of railway track had speared through one of the carriages.
paras.zh: 图片显示，一条长长的铁轨刺穿了其中一节车厢。

paras.en: Tangui Binier, 22, was on the Iryo train and told the BBC that "suitcases started flying and people were screaming" when the train finally came to a halt.
paras.zh: 22 岁的坦吉·比尼尔 (Tangui Binier) 在 Iryo 火车上，他告诉 BBC，当火车最终停下来时，“行李箱开始飞扬，人们尖叫起来”。

paras.en: There was a lot of smoke and confusion, he said, and described seeing the train "completely flipped over" when he stepped outside.
paras.zh: 他说，当时烟雾弥漫，混乱不堪，当他走出去时，他看到火车“完全翻了”。

paras.en: "It was hard to witness", Binier said, adding that his father carried a girl who had a broken hip out of the wreckage.
paras.zh: 比尼尔说：“这很难目睹。”他补充说，他的父亲从残骸中抱出了一名臀部骨折的女孩。

paras.en: He also described seeing dead bodies and missing limbs: "I don't know if I'll ever recover."
paras.zh: 他还描述了看到尸体和肢体缺失的情况：“我不知道我是否还能康复。”

paras.en: Spanish journalist Antonio JimÃ©nez Barca, who works for El Pais newspaper, was walking to the Renfe train's cafeteria when the crash happened.
paras.zh: 事故发生时，为《国家报》工作的西班牙记者安东尼奥·希梅内斯·巴尔卡 (Antonio Jiménez Barca) 正步行前往西班牙国家铁路公司 (Renfe) 列车的自助餐厅。

paras.en: "I felt like I was being pushed from behind, like I was being thrown to the ground," he described.
paras.zh: “我感觉我被从后面推了，就像我被扔到了地上，”他描述道。

paras.en: "I hit my head horribly... I was covered in blood. There were people on top of me. One person had an injured arm, and another had a head injury."
paras.zh: “我的头严重受伤……我浑身是血。我身上有人。一个人的手臂受伤，另一个人的头部受伤。”

paras.en: Another passenger, 46-year-old SebastiÃ¡n Herrero, told El Mundo newspaper that he saw "many people with broken noses, broken arms."
paras.zh: 另一位乘客、46 岁的塞巴斯蒂安·埃雷罗 (Sebastián Herrero) 告诉《世界报》，他看到“许多人鼻子骨折、手臂骨折”。

paras.en: "It was a terrible, terrible impact," he said, adding that he was "in the air for about four or five seconds," which felt like a lifetime.
paras.zh: “这是一次非常非常可怕的撞击，”他说，并补充说他“在空中停留了大约四五秒”，感觉就像度过了一生。

paras.en: Many of the passengers said they were in shock, and one sobbed during an interview with a local television station as he described a woman dying in his arms.
paras.zh: 许多乘客表示他们感到震惊，其中一名乘客在接受当地一家电视台采访时，当他描述一名妇女在他怀里死去时，他抽泣起来。

paras.en: "She was very cold and she was all alone," he said, to which the show's presenter also started to cry.
paras.zh: “她很冷，而且孤身一人，”他说，节目主持人也开始哭泣。

paras.en: Dozens of ambulances rushed to the scene, and a helicopter evacuated those with the most serious injuries.
paras.zh: 数十辆救护车赶到现场，一架直升机疏散了伤势最重的人。

paras.en: Spain's Civil Guard said it would need DNA samples from relatives to identify some victims.
paras.zh: 西班牙国民警卫队表示，需要亲属的 DNA 样本来识别一些遇难者的身份。

paras.en: "The whole of Spain is grieving", Prime Minister Pedro SÃ¡nchez said during a visit to the crash site. "Lives have been shattered, families have been torn apart, the pain is immense."
paras.zh: “整个西班牙都在悲伤”，首相佩德罗·桑切斯在视察坠机现场时表示。 “生活支离破碎，家庭支离破碎，痛苦是巨大的。”

paras.en: Most political parties in Spain cancelled their campaign events scheduled for Wednesday.
paras.zh: 西班牙大多数政党取消了原定于周三举行的竞选活动。

paras.en: The exception was the far-right party Vox. Its leader, Santiago Abascal, said his party would not take part in what he described as attempts to "use mourning to silence criticism" of the country's rail infrastructure.
paras.zh: 极右翼政党 Vox 是个例外。该党领导人圣地亚哥·阿巴斯卡尔表示，他的政党不会参与他所说的“利用哀悼来平息对该国铁路基础设施的批评”的活动。

paras.en: Spain was already reeling from a high-speed rail disaster near CÃ³rdoba in January that killed 46 people. It happened on the same rail line, but much further south.
paras.zh: 1 月份，西班牙科尔多瓦附近发生了一场高铁灾难，造成 46 人死亡。事情发生在同一条铁路线上，但距离更南。

paras.en: The prime minister said it was "unacceptable" for Spain to have two serious train crashes in one year, and vowed to "get to the bottom of this" and determine if there was any negligence.
paras.zh: 首相表示，西班牙一年内发生两起严重火车相撞事故是“不可接受的”，并发誓要“彻查此事”并确定是否存在疏忽。

paras.en: "Spain has the right to know what is happening with its infrastructure," said Alberto NÃºÃ±ez FeijÃ³o, leader of the the main opposition People's Party.
paras.zh: “西班牙有权了解其基础设施的状况，”主要反对党人民党领袖阿尔贝托·努涅斯·费约说。

paras.en: "If there have been failures in the security system, they will be addressed with the utmost firmness."
paras.zh: “如果安全系统出现故障，我们将坚决予以解决。”

paras.en: Spanish trade union CSIF has demanded the transport minister resign, accusing him of "scapegoating" a traffic manager, by blaming human error in the control room, instead of "taking responsibility".
paras.zh: 西班牙工会CSIF要求交通部长辞职，指责他将控制室的人为错误归咎于交通经理“替罪羊”，而不是“承担责任”。

paras.en: Wednesday's crash is the worst the country has seen since 2013, when when 80 people died on the outskirts of Santiago de Compostela in north-west Spain.
paras.zh: 周三的事故是该国自 2013 年以来最严重的事故，当时西班牙西北部圣地亚哥德孔波斯特拉郊区有 80 人死亡。

articles.title: Girl seriously injured in wolf attack at German wildlife park

paras.en: An eight-year-old girl has been seriously injured in a wolf attack at a German wildlife park.
paras.zh: 德国野生动物园一名八岁女孩在狼袭击中受重伤。

paras.en: She was inside an enclosure at the JohannismÃ¼hle park in Brandenburg, south of Berlin, with a staff member and two other children when the attack happened, police said.
paras.zh: 警方称，袭击发生时，她与一名工作人员和另外两名儿童正在柏林南部勃兰登堡约翰尼斯穆勒公园的围栏内。

paras.en: They said in a statement that the "precise circumstances of the incident are the subject of an ongoing police investigation".
paras.zh: 他们在一份声明中表示，“事件的具体情况正在警方正在进行的调查中”。

paras.en: The girl was taken to hospital by helicopter after the incident on Wednesday. No one else was injured.
paras.zh: 周三事件发生后，女孩被直升机送往医院。没有其他人受伤。

paras.en: The park, in the town of Baruth/Mark, has been closed temporarily and is set to reopen on 2 November, according to its website, which did not give further details.
paras.zh: 据公园网站称，位于巴鲁斯/马克镇的公园已暂时关闭，预计于 11 月 2 日重新开放，但未提供更多细节。

paras.en: The park keeps grey and arctic wolves, along with other animals including the brown bear and lynx.
paras.zh: 该公园饲养着灰狼和北极狼，以及棕熊和山猫等其他动物。

paras.en: The girl was injured by at least one animal and suffered head injuries, according to German newspaper Bild.
paras.zh: 据德国《图片报》报道，这名女孩至少被一只动物咬伤，头部受伤。

paras.en: It reported that the incident happened before the park opened at 10:00 local time (09:00 GMT) and that the girl could have been taking part in a special visit.
paras.zh: 报道称，事件发生在当地时间 10:00（格林威治标准时间 09:00）公园开放之前，女孩可能是在参加一次特别参观。

paras.en: JohannismÃ¼hle offers small group tours to allow visitors to spend time with some animals, with its site mentioning feeding wolves or petting a llama.
paras.zh: Johannismühle 提供小团体旅游，让游客可以与一些动物共度时光，其网站提到了喂狼或抚摸美洲驼。

paras.en: The incident comes after a number of other animal attacks at zoos and wildlife parks in Europe.
paras.zh: 在此事件发生之前，欧洲动物园和野生动物园还发生了多起动物袭击事件。

paras.en: A keeper at a Dutch zoo died this week after being mauled by a leopard, and a man was killed by a tiger at Yorkshire Wildlife Park earlier this month.
paras.zh: 荷兰一家动物园的一名饲养员本周在被豹子咬伤后死亡，本月早些时候在约克郡野生动物公园，一名男子被老虎杀死。

articles.title: Flávio Bolsonaro denies fleeing Brazil after landing in Miami

paras.en: Brazilian Senator FlÃ¡vio Bolsonaro, who landed in Miami after losing the presidential election on Sunday, has said it was never his intention to "leave my homeland".
paras.zh: 周日在总统选举中落败后抵达迈阿密的巴西参议员弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗表示，他从来没有打算“离开我的祖国”。

paras.en: "I did not flee Brazil; I left for the sake of Brazil," he said in his first statement since his departure.
paras.zh: “我没有逃离巴西；我是为了巴西而离开的，”他在离开后的第一份声明中说道。

paras.en: The US provided visas to him and his family after Brazil cancelled his passports as part of a criminal investigation. Bolsonaro denies any wrongdoing. On Wednesday, US President Donald Trump told reporters: "We gave him a pass to come into the country".
paras.zh: 在巴西因刑事调查而吊销他的护照后，美国向他和他的家人提供了签证。博尔索纳罗否认有任何不当行为。周三，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普告诉记者：“我们给了他进入该国的通行证”。

paras.en: Newly re-elected President Luiz InÃ¡cio Lula da Silva has criticised Bolsonaro's secretive exit from the country, saying "those who have nothing to hide have nothing to fear".
paras.zh: 新当选的总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦批评博尔索纳罗秘密出境，称“那些没有什么可隐瞒的人没有什么可害怕的”。

paras.en: Bolsonaro's arrival in Florida ended days of confusion over his whereabouts, after he was reported to have travelled to Argentina, and then prematurely reported to have already entered the US on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗抵达佛罗里达结束了数日来对其行踪的困惑，此前有报道称他曾前往阿根廷，然后又过早地报道称他已于周二进入美国。

paras.en: In a statement, Bolsonaro thanked both the presidents of Argentina and the US, and the American public "who share the same values ââas the good people of my own country".
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗在一份声明中感谢阿根廷和美国总统以及美国公众“与我自己国家的好人民有着相同的价值观”。

paras.en: "It was never my intention to leave my homeland, but I know exactly where this is heading," he said. "I departed from a regime of exception so that I could become the leader my people deserve."
paras.zh: “我从来没有打算离开我的祖国，但我确切地知道这将走向何方，”他说。 “我脱离了例外政权，这样我才能成为我的人民应得的领导人。”

paras.en: He called himself a victim of a coup d'Ã©tat and political persecution, and said his travel to the US was to protect his family.
paras.zh: 他称自己是政变和政治迫害的受害者，并表示他前往美国是为了保护家人。

paras.en: In the lengthy letter, he also repeated unsubstantiated allegations of "electoral fraud" which he said allowed a "mathematical impossibility" to occur in the election.
paras.zh: 在这封冗长的信中，他还重复了未经证实的“选举舞弊”指控，他说这使得选举中出现了“数学上的不可能”。

paras.en: On Wednesday, Trump declined to discuss the allegations made in Bolsonaro's letter.
paras.zh: 周三，特朗普拒绝讨论博尔索纳罗信中的指控。

paras.en: "I won't get involved. It was a very strange election, that's for sure," Trump said. He went on to add that he thought Bolsonaro "and his family were treated very unfairly".
paras.zh: “我不会参与其中。这是一场非常奇怪的选举，这是肯定的，”特朗普说。他接着补充说，他认为博尔索纳罗“和他的家人受到了非常不公平的对待”。

paras.en: After Bolsonaro won the first round of Brazil's election, Lula won the second round by more than four million votes, which was attributed to significantly higher turnout, and swaying more undecided voters.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗赢得巴西大选首轮选举后，卢拉以超过400万票的优势赢得了第二轮选举，这归因于投票率显着提高，并影响了更多犹豫不决的选民。

paras.en: The result was confirmed by the president of Brazil's top electoral court, who was appointed by Bolsonaro's father, former president Jair Bolsonaro.
paras.zh: 这一结果得到了巴西最高选举法院院长的确认，该法院院长由博尔索纳罗的父亲、前总统雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗任命。

paras.en: Speculation about Bolsonaro's whereabouts was first triggered by a report on an Argentine news site, which claimed that he had crossed the land border between Brazil and Argentina and then boarded a private plane en route to the US.
paras.zh: 关于博尔索纳罗行踪的猜测首先是由阿根廷一家新闻网站的报道引发的，该报道称博尔索纳罗越过巴西和阿根廷之间的陆地边界，然后登上一架私人飞机前往美国。

paras.en: Brazilian police took the rumours seriously. Early on Tuesday, they checked border crossings but found no evidence that Bolsonaro had left the country, and Argentine officials said they had no reports of him crossing.
paras.zh: 巴西警方严肃对待这一谣言。周二早些时候，他们检查了过境点，但没有发现博尔索纳罗已离开该国的证据，阿根廷官员表示，他们没有收到有关他过境的报告。

paras.en: For a little while, it seemed like Bolsonaro may just be keeping an uncharacteristically low-profile after being unexpectedly beaten by his left-wing rival in the presidential run-off vote on Sunday, in addition to a criminal investigation that led to orders that his passports be turned into authorities.
paras.zh: 有一段时间，博尔索纳罗在周日的总统决选投票中出人意料地被左翼竞争对手击败后，似乎一直保持着一反常态的低调，此外还进行了一项刑事调查，导致当局下令将他的护照上交。

paras.en: But when he failed to surrender his passports in time to meet a 24-hour deadline on Tuesday, Brazilian authorities cancelled the documents and ordered police to make checks at border posts.
paras.zh: 但当他未能在周二的 24 小时期限内及时交出护照时，巴西当局取消了这些文件，并命令警察在边境哨所进行检查。

paras.en: Speculation quickly grew that he'd left the country and Bolsonaro's lawyers said they had no idea where he was.
paras.zh: 关于他离开该国的猜测迅速增多，博尔索纳罗的律师表示，他们不知道他在哪里。

paras.en: Hours later on Tuesday evening, several sources told the BBC and other broadcasters that he was on his way to the US.
paras.zh: 周二晚上几个小时后，几位消息人士告诉英国广播公司和其他广播公司，他正在前往美国的途中。

paras.en: A cousin, who is close to FlÃ¡vio Bolsonaro and his younger brother Eduardo, told BBC Brasil that the defeated right-wing candidate had arrived in Miami.
paras.zh: 一位与弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗及其弟弟爱德华多关系密切的表弟告诉 BBC 巴西，这位落败的右翼候选人已抵达迈阿密。

paras.en: Another close aide to Eduardo Bolsonaro told BBC Mundo that FlÃ¡vio was with his younger brother in Miami.
paras.zh: 爱德华多·博尔索纳罗的另一位亲密助手告诉 BBC Mundo，弗拉维奥和他的弟弟在迈阿密。

paras.en: Neither FlÃ¡vio nor Eduardo Bolsonaro could be reached directly for comment at the time.
paras.zh: 当时无法直接联系到弗拉维奥和爱德华多·博尔索纳罗置评。

paras.en: But later, however, Argentine migration authorities posted on social media saying that Bolsonaro, his wife, and two daughters had only just crossed into Argentina over land on Tuesday night local time.
paras.zh: 但随后，阿根廷移民当局在社交媒体上发文称，博尔索纳罗、他的妻子和两个女儿才于当地时间周二晚上通过陆路进入阿根廷。

paras.en: Flight tracking data verified by the BBC suggested the Bolsonaros departed from Puerto IguazÃº in Argentina at 12:18 local time (03:18 GMT) on Wednesday to head to Guayaquil in Ecuador.
paras.zh: BBC核实的航班跟踪数据显示，博索纳罗夫妇于当地时间周三12点18分（格林威治标准时间03点18分）从阿根廷伊瓜苏港出发，前往厄瓜多尔瓜亚基尔。

paras.en: After a brief stop, the same private jet took them to Miami-Opa Locka Executive Airport, where they were pictured disembarking just before 09:30 local time (13:30 GMT).
paras.zh: 短暂停留后，同一架私人飞机将他们带到迈阿密奥帕洛卡行政机场，照片中他们于当地时间 09:30（格林威治标准时间 13:30）前下机。

paras.en: Photographers, who had been waiting for his arrival to finally put an end to all the speculation, swarmed around Bolsonaro as he left the airport in Miami, while his team tried to cover him with umbrellas.
paras.zh: 当博尔索纳罗离开迈阿密机场时，摄影师们一直在等待他的到来，最终结束所有的猜测，而他的团队则试图用雨伞遮住他。

paras.en: Later, Eduardo Bolsonaro posted a photo with his brother FlÃ¡vio on social media, with the location listed as "United States".
paras.zh: 随后，爱德华多·博尔索纳罗在社交媒体上发布了与弟弟弗拉维奥的合影，拍摄地点标注为“美国”。

paras.en: The caption read: "Today's photo after reuniting with my brother Flavio Bolsonaro. Yesterday was a long day, perhaps the longest of my life. But we prevailed. Even here outside, we will not give up on Brazil."
paras.zh: 标题写道：“今天与我的兄弟弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗重聚后的照片。昨天是漫长的一天，也许是我一生中最长的一天。但我们胜利了。即使在外面，我们也不会放弃巴西。”

paras.en: FlÃ¡vio Bolsonaro is not the first member of his family to travel to the United States.
paras.zh: 弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗并不是其家族中第一个前往美国的成员。

paras.en: His father, Jair Bolsonaro, also left Brazil for Florida in December 2022 before his successor, Lula, was inaugurated.
paras.zh: 他的父亲贾尔·博尔索纳罗 (Jair Bolsonaro) 也于 2022 年 12 月离开巴西前往佛罗里达州，随​​后他的继任者卢拉 (Lula) 就职。

paras.en: Jair was still in the US when his supporters stormed Brazil's government buildings and Supreme Court on 8 January. He later used his absence as part of his defence in his coup trial, which ultimately led to his conviction and 27-year sentence.
paras.zh: 1 月 8 日，当贾尔的支持者冲进巴西政府大楼和最高法院时，贾尔仍在美国。后来，他利用缺席的机会在政变审判中进行辩护，最终被定罪并被判 27 年徒刑。

paras.en: FlÃ¡vio's brother, Eduardo Bolsonaro, meanwhile, has been living in Texas after taking leave from Brazil's Congress. While in the US, he lobbied officials there in an attempt to influence the coup trial of his father, which led to the US imposing punitive tariffs on Brazil and sanctions on key officials.
paras.zh: 与此同时，弗拉维奥的兄弟爱德华多·博尔索纳罗在从巴西国会休假后一直住在德克萨斯州。在美国期间，他游说当地官员，试图影响其父亲的政变审判，导致美国对巴西征收惩罚性关税，并对主要官员实施制裁。

paras.en: Eduardo was convicted in absentia over this by Brazil's highest court earlier this year.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，巴西最高法院缺席判处爱德华多有罪。

paras.en: It is not yet clear what FlÃ¡vio Bolsonaro's ultimate destination will be, nor how long he plans to stay in the US.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗的最终目的地是什么，也不清楚他计划在美国停留多久。

paras.en: He is the subject of two investigations currently pending before Brazil's Supreme Federal Court.
paras.zh: 他是巴西最高法院目前正在等待的两项调查的对象。

paras.en: One is regarding possible irregularities in the transfer of nearly $70m (Â£53m) from private bank Banco Master to the film Dark Horse â a biopic about his father.
paras.zh: 其中一个问题是，私人银行 Banco Master 向电影《黑马》（一部关于他父亲的传记片）转账近 7000 万美元（5300 万英镑）时可能存在违规行为。

paras.en: The second investigation relates to alleged money laundering, both of which Bolsonaro denies.
paras.zh: 第二项调查涉及涉嫌洗钱，博尔索纳罗均否认了这两项调查。

paras.en: He is set to lose his parliamentary immunity on 31 January, when his eight-year Senate term ends.
paras.zh: 他将于 1 月 31 日失去议会豁免权，届时他的八年参议院任期结束。

articles.title: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

paras.en: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian
paras.zh: 卓越的非公路制动和摩擦性能均来自意大利

paras.en: SK Wellman, a company specializing in the production of brake and frictions components for off-highway, has a lively DNA. A historical reality in Orzinuovi (Bs), where the plant is still located, over the years it has undergone transformations and changes that have contributed to making it what it is today: an evolved company, able to grow in loyalty to the local Italian territory and to innovate its sector with creativity and flexibility worldwide. Today, as part of the CentroMotion Group and its Carlisle Brake & Friction division, SK Wellman is a leader in its segment, recognized and chosen by major brands in earthmoving, agricultural and construction machinery. Engineer Alessandro Gamba, Global Director of Friction Engineering, tells us about the ongoing growth.
paras.zh: SK Wellman 是一家专门生产非公路用制动和摩擦部件的公司，拥有活跃的基因。工厂仍位于 Orzinuovi (Bs) 的历史现实中，多年来，它经历了转型和变化，从而使其成为今天的样子：一家不断发展的公司，能够不断发展对意大利当地领土的忠诚度，并在全球范围内以创造力和灵活性创新其行业。如今，作为 CentroMotion 集团及其 Carlisle 制动与摩擦部门的一部分，SK Wellman 已成为该领域的领导者，受到土方、农业和建筑机械领域主要品牌的认可和选择。摩擦工程全球总监工程师 Alessandro Gamba 向我们介绍了持续增长的情况。

paras.en: "S.K. Wellman S.R.L. has 340 employees and a turnover of 127 million by 2023," Gamba begins. In the last five years, a strong push has come from the market but above all from the characteristics of SK, such as creativity, innovation, flexibility, which, in the final analysis, are the result of the greatest wealth of this company: people". They are the ones who make the Brescia-based company an authentic and tenacious company, to the point of being able to export not only their products successfully, but also their skills and design skills to the other plants of the Carlisle Brake & Friction division. The year 2023, which has just ended, confirms a positive performance in turnover for sales revenues alone, recording a slight decrease of -5% compared to the previous exceptional 2022 financial year; A year, the latter, probably unrepeatable for many realities of the Brescia and non-Brescia economy. In fact, 2023 was undoubtedly the year of change that helped people develop a greater ability to manage uncertainty, accepting and dealing with unexpected situations with more resilience.
paras.zh: “S.K. Wellman S.R.L. 拥有 340 名员工，到 2023 年营业额将达到 1.27 亿美元，”Gamba 开始说道。在过去的五年里，强大的推动力来自于市场，但最重要的是来自 SK 的特点，如创造力、创新性、灵活性，归根结底，这些都是这家公司最大财富的结果：“人”。正是他们使这家位于布雷西亚的公司成为一家真正的、顽强的公司，以至于不仅能够成功出口他们的产品，而且能够将他们的技能和设计技能出口到卡莱尔制动和摩擦部门的其他工厂。刚刚结束的 2023 年，仅销售收入就实现了积极的表现，与上一个出色的 2022 财年相比，略有下降 -5%；对于布雷西亚和非布雷西亚经济的许多现实来说，后者可能是不可重复的一年。事实上，2023 年无疑是变革的一年，帮助人们培养了更强的能力来管理不确定性，以更强的韧性接受和处理意外情况。

paras.en: "At the base of success there is a matrix organization developed thanks to group governance - explains the engineer -: a verticality driven on all functions and skills, able to define and guide processes on a global scale and generate best practices. And that's not all," adds Gamba, "we are one of the companies with the lowest level of turnover, and this allows us to transfer the experience of those who have been with us for a long time to young people, on whom we particularly focus. Added to this is a company population of 15 different nationalities, whose strong collaboration creates a truly serene working climate," says the HR Manager. It is no coincidence that the direction of growth is particularly social responsibility.
paras.zh: 工程师解释说：“成功的基础是通过集团治理形成的矩阵组织：所有职能和技能的垂直驱动，能够在全球范围内定义和指导流程并产生最佳实践。而这还不是全部，”Gamba 补充道，“我们是人员流动率最低的公司之一，这使我们能够将长期与我们在一起的人的经验传授给我们特别关注的年轻人。除此之外，公司人口还来自 15 个不同的国家，他们的强有力的合作创造了真正宁静的工作氛围，”人力资源经理说道。成长的方向尤其是社会责任并非巧合。

paras.en: "Among the main projects of SK Wellman and Carlisle - he observes - stands out Enactus, an international non-profit organization that, thanks to its activity, involves university students in the creation of sustainable entrepreneurial projects, helping to bridge the gap between university and business; and then Treedom, which involves the company's commitment to planting 1,600 trees in three years, involving its stakeholders in the project". Two more rare gems for the metalworking industry? A level of accidents at work that borders on zero, and the centrality of talent development. Towards excellence and beyond.
paras.zh: 他指出，“SK Wellman 和 Carlisle 的主要项目中，最突出的是 Enactus，这是一家国际非营利组织，通过其活动，让大学生参与创建可持续创业项目，帮助缩小大学和企业之间的差距；然后是 Treedom，该公司承诺在三年内种植 1,600 棵树，并让利益相关者参与到该项目中”。金属加工行业还有两颗稀有宝石吗？工作事故率接近于零，并且以人才发展为中心。迈向卓越并超越。

paras.en: Source: Il Corriere della Sera – edizione Lombardia

articles.title: Crash Champions Hosts NABC F.R.E.E. Training at Tigard EV Center
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Crash Champions welcomed approximately 30 local first responders to its LUXE | EV Certified repair center in Tigard, Ore., on Wednesday, Oct. 21 for a National Auto Body Council (NABC) First Responder Emergency Extrication (F.R.E.E.) training event.
paras.zh: Crash Champions 迎来了大约 30 名当地急救人员来到其 LUXE |俄勒冈州泰格德的电动汽车认证维修中心于 10 月 21 日星期三举办国家汽车车身委员会 (NABC) 急救员紧急救援 (F.R.E.E.) 培训活动。

paras.en: The event, held at 7585 SW Hunziker Road, provided participating firefighters with an opportunity to strengthen their emergency response skills through specialized instruction focused on vehicle extrication. Jake Alquire of MES Life Safety led the training, sharing techniques and considerations designed to help first responders navigate challenging vehicle rescue situations.
paras.zh: 该活动在 7585 SW Hunziker Road 举行，为参与的消防员提供了通过以车辆救援为重点的专门指导来加强其应急响应技能的机会。 MES Life Safety 的 Jake Alquire 领导了培训，分享了旨在帮助急救人员应对充满挑战的车辆救援情况的技术和注意事项。

paras.en: As vehicle construction and safety technologies continue to evolve, hands-on training plays an important role in preparing emergency personnel to respond effectively to serious collisions. The NABC F.R.E.E. program brings together collision repair industry professionals, equipment specialists and first responders to support practical training and improve familiarity with modern vehicle structures and extrication procedures.
paras.zh: As vehicle construction and safety technologies continue to evolve, hands-on training plays an important role in preparing emergency personnel to respond effectively to serious collisions. NABC F.R.E.E. program brings together collision repair industry professionals, equipment specialists and first responders to support practical training and improve familiarity with modern vehicle structures and extrication procedures.

paras.en: “Hosting an event like this gives us an opportunity to support the local first responders who serve our communities every day,” said Matt Ebert, founder and CEO of Crash Champions. “Our industry has valuable knowledge of vehicle construction and repair, and we’re proud to help bring that expertise together with specialized training that can make a difference when first responders are called into action.”
paras.zh: Crash Champions 创始人兼首席执行官马特·埃伯特 (Matt Ebert) 表示：“举办这样的活动让我们有机会支持每天为我们社区服务的当地急救人员。” “我们的行业在车辆制造和维修方面拥有宝贵的知识，我们很自豪能够帮助将这些专业知识与专门培训结合起来，当急救人员被要求采取行动时，这些知识可以发挥重要作用。”

paras.en: Crash Champions is a longtime supporter of the NABC and its initiatives, including NABC F.R.E.E., which connects collision repair industry resources with first responder training opportunities across the country. Participation in the Oct. 21 event reflects the company’s continued commitment to strengthening community partnerships and supporting those who respond to emergencies.
paras.zh: Crash Champions 是 NABC 及其举措的长期支持者，其中包括 NABC F.R.E.E.，该举措将碰撞修复行业资源与全国各地的急救人员培训机会联系起来。参加 10 月 21 日的活动反映了该公司对加强社区合作伙伴关系和支持应对紧急情况的人员的持续承诺。

paras.en: For more information about Crash Champions, visit crashchampions.com.
paras.zh: 有关碰撞冠军的更多信息，请访问 crashchampions.com。

articles.title: Collision Industry Red Carpet Awards Set for 2026 SEMA Show
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Society of Collision Repair Specialists (SCRS) announced that the collision repair community will gather Tuesday evening, Nov. 3 during the 2026 SEMA Show in Las Vegas for the Collision Industry Red Carpet Awards sponsored by BodyShop Business, Collision Industry Conference (CIC), I-CAR and the SCRS.
paras.zh: 碰撞修复专家协会 (SCRS) 宣布，碰撞修复界将于 11 月 3 日星期二晚上在拉斯维加斯举行的 2026 年 SEMA 展会期间齐聚一堂，参加由 BodyShop Business、碰撞行业会议 (CIC)、I-CAR 和 SCRS 赞助的碰撞行业红地毯奖。

paras.en: Returning to the Westgate Las Vegas Resort & Casino, the Red Carpet Awards will follow the CIC event and bring together collision repair professionals to celebrate the individuals and organizations whose leadership, service and contributions continue to move the industry forward. The awards program will begin at 7:30 p.m., following a 6 p.m. CIC reception.
paras.zh: 红地毯奖将重返拉斯维加斯西门度假村及赌场，紧随 CIC 活动，碰撞修复专业人士将齐聚一堂，表彰那些凭借领导力、服务和贡献不断推动行业向前发展的个人和组织。颁奖典礼将于下午 6 点后于晚上 7 点 30 分开始。 CIC接待处。

paras.en: The Collision Industry Red Carpet Awards remain free to attend, thanks to participating industry organizations and event sponsors.
paras.zh: 感谢参与的行业组织和活动赞助商，碰撞行业红地毯奖仍然可以免费参加。

paras.en: From industry veterans to rising stars, the evening will spotlight accomplishments across collision repair. The program brings together recognition programs from BodyShop Business, CIC, the Collision Repair Education Foundation (CREF), FenderBender and ABRN, I-CAR, the National Auto Body Council (NABC) and SCRS.
paras.zh: 从行业资深人士到后起之秀，当晚将聚焦碰撞修复领域的成就。该计划汇集了来自 BodyShop Business、CIC、碰撞修复教育基金会 (CREF)、FenderBender 和 ABRN、I-CAR、国家汽车车身委员会 (NABC) 和 SCRS 的认可计划。

paras.en: Cocktail attire is encouraged, and seating is first-come, first-served. Attendees are encouraged to arrive early.
paras.zh: 鼓励穿着鸡尾酒会服装，座位先到先得。我们鼓励与会者尽早到达。

paras.en: Andy Tylka of TAG Auto Group will host the evening and guide attendees through a lineup of award presentations recognizing excellence and service throughout the collision repair industry.
paras.zh: TAG Auto Group 的 Andy Tylka 将主持晚会，并引导与会者进行一系列颁奖典礼，表彰整个碰撞修复行业的卓越表现和服务。

paras.en: Awards presented during the evening will include:
paras.zh: 当晚颁发的奖项包括：

paras.en: - BodyShop Business – Executive of the Year Awards
paras.zh: - BodyShop 业务 – 年度最佳高管奖

paras.en: - Collision Industry Conference (CIC) – Volunteer of the Year Award
paras.zh: - 碰撞行业大会 (CIC) – 年度志愿者奖

paras.en: - Collision Repair Education Foundation (CREF) – Fueling the Future Award, Clark Plucinski Legacy Award
paras.zh: - 碰撞修复教育基金会 (CREF) – 推动未来奖、Clark Plucinski 遗产奖

paras.en: - FenderBender and ABRN – Best Repair Planner/Estimator Award
paras.zh: - FenderBender 和 ABRN – 最佳维修规划师/估算师奖

paras.en: - I-CAR – Jeff Silver Memorial Award/Platinum Individual, Russ Verona Memorial Award/Gold Class Shop
paras.zh: - I-CAR – Jeff Silver 纪念奖/白金个人奖、Russ Verona 纪念奖/金级商店

paras.en: - NABC – Changing and Saving Lives Award
paras.zh: - NABC – 改变和拯救生命奖

paras.en: - SCRS – Humanitarian Award, Collision Industry Individual Service Award, 2026 March Taylor Kina’Ole Award
paras.zh: - SCRS – 人道主义奖、碰撞行业个人服务奖、2026 年 3 月 Taylor Kina’Ole 奖

paras.en: Among the evening’s recognitions, SCRS will present the 2026 March Taylor Kina’Ole Award, honoring an individual who exemplifies the Hawaiian principle of Kina’Ole: doing the right thing, in the right way, at the right time, and for the right reasons.
paras.zh: 在当晚的表彰活动中，SCRS 将颁发 2026 年 3 月泰勒 Kina’Ole 奖，表彰体现夏威夷 Kina’Ole 原则的个人：以正确的方式、在正确的时间、出于正确的理由做正确的事。

paras.en: The award celebrates the legacy of March Taylor, whose commitment to technical excellence, mentorship and service to others left a lasting impression on the collision repair community and around the SCRS table. It recognizes individuals who demonstrate those same values and passion for doing what is right through their contributions to the industry and the people around them.
paras.zh: 该奖项旨在表彰 March Taylor 留下的宝贵遗产，他对卓越技术、指导和服务的承诺给碰撞修复界和 SCRS 界留下了持久的印象。它表彰那些通过对行业和周围人的贡献而表现出同样价值观和做正确事的热情的个人。

paras.en: For more information about SCRS or to become a member, visit scrs.com, call (877) 841-0660 or e-mail [email protected].

articles.title: Georgia insurance commissioner incumbent and former state legislator face off for position
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Two candidates are running for a four-year term as Georgia Commissioner of Insurance and Safety Fire on Nov. 3.
paras.zh: 两名候选人将于 11 月 3 日竞选佐治亚州保险和安全消防专员，任期四年。

paras.en: Incumbent John King, a Republican, is running against Keisha Waites, a former state representative and Atlanta city councilwoman.
paras.zh: 现任共和党人约翰·金正在与前州众议员、亚特兰大市议员凯莎·韦特斯竞选。

paras.en: King was appointed to the position in 2019 and elected to a full term in 2022, according to his campaign website.
paras.zh: 据他的竞选网站称，金于 2019 年被任命为该职位，并于 2022 年当选完成任期。

paras.en: The website adds that he retired from the U.S. Army as a major general and also previously served as the chief of the Doraville Police Department.
paras.zh: 该网站补充说，他以少将身份从美国陆军退役，此前还曾担任多拉维尔警察局局长。

paras.en: “As Georgia’s Insurance and Safety Fire Commissioner, General King has disrupted the status quo, put Georgia families first, and held the powerful accountable,” the website states.
paras.zh: 该网站称：“作为佐治亚州保险和安全消防专员，金将军打破了现状，将佐治亚州家庭放在第一位，并追究了当权者的责任。”

paras.en: King says that his office fields 10,000 complaints from Georgians per year and has recovered more than $100 million from insurance companies.
paras.zh: 金表示，他的办公室每年都会收到 10,000 起格鲁吉亚人的投诉，并已从保险公司追回超过 1 亿美元。

paras.en: “When insurance companies try to take advantage of Georgians, we’re there,” King says on the website. “Since 2019, my office has leveled more than $22 million in fines against insurance companies, including the single largest fine in Georgia history at $5 million. Now, I’m fighting to increase the maximum initial fines allowed.”
paras.zh: 金在网站上表示：“当保险公司试图利用格鲁吉亚人的利益时，我们就会介入。” “自 2019 年以来，我的办公室已对保险公司处以超过 2200 万美元的罚款，其中包括佐治亚州历史上最大的单笔罚款 500 万美元。现在，我正在努力提高允许的最高初始罚款额。”

paras.en: The office has delivered tort and lawsuit reform in the state, his website claims.
paras.zh: 他的网站称，该办公室已在该州实施侵权和诉讼改革。

paras.en: “When disaster strikes, we’re there,” he says. “Over the last six years, my team has responded to natural disasters throughout Georgia, deploying teams on the ground and setting up claims villages to connect storm victims directly with providers.”
paras.zh: “当灾难来袭时，我们就在那里，”他说。 “在过去的六年里，我的团队应对了佐治亚州各地的自然灾害，在当地部署了团队并建立了索赔村，将风暴受害者与提供者直接联系起来。”

paras.en: Waites previously worked as a disaster reservist/commercial loan specialist for the U.S. Small Business Administration Disaster Assistance Division and in several Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) roles, according to her LinkedIn.
paras.zh: 据 LinkedIn 介绍，维特斯此前曾担任美国小企业管理局灾难援助部门的灾难预备役人员/商业贷款专家，并在联邦紧急事务管理局 (FEMA) 担任过多个职务。

paras.en: “This combination — federal disaster work, state legislation, and citywide governance — directly aligns with the mission of the Georgia Office of Insurance and Safety Fire Commissioner: protecting families through fair regulation, consumer services, rate review, and oversight of insurers and agents,” Waites’ website states. “I stand on a foundation of public service and legislative victories. The people of Georgia deserve proven leadership; look at the record, look at the results.”
paras.zh: 韦特斯的网站称：“这种结合——联邦灾难工作、州立法和全市治理——与佐治亚州保险和安全消防专员办公室的使命直接一致：通过公平监管、消费者服务、费率审查以及对保险公司和代理人的监督来保护家庭。” “我站在公共服务和立法胜利的基础上。佐治亚州人民应该得到经过验证的领导力；看看记录，看看结果。”

paras.en: Waites says that the rate freeze initiative is a top priority. This includes aggressively reviewing and challenging unjustified auto and home insurance rate hikes.
paras.zh: 韦茨表示，冻结利率举措是重中之重。这包括积极审查和挑战不合理的汽车和家庭保险费率上涨。

paras.en: She also wants to end ZIP code and credit score discrimination by investing in modern equipment and faster response times for Georgia’s rural and underserved communities.
paras.zh: 她还希望通过投资现代设备并为佐治亚州的农村和服务欠缺的社区提供更快的响应时间，结束邮政编码和信用评分歧视。

paras.en: Another of Waites’s priorities is a “Consumer Fraud Strike Force” to protect seniors and vulnerable families from predatory insurance scams.
paras.zh: 韦特斯的另一个优先事项是建立“消费者欺诈打击部队”，以保护老年人和弱势家庭免受掠夺性保险诈骗。

paras.en: An Insurify analysis says the next Georgia commissioner will play a key role in market oversight and consumer protection as home insurance costs continue rising in the state. It found that the state’s average annual home insurance premium increased by 25% from 2023 to mid-2026.
paras.zh: Insurify 的一项分析称，随着该州家庭保险成本持续上涨，下一任佐治亚州专员将在市场监管和消费者保护方面发挥关键作用。研究发现，从 2023 年到 2026 年中期，该州平均每年家庭保险保费增加了 25%。

paras.en: “Georgia recently passed a massive insurance bill imposing expanded regulations on insurers to help protect consumers and, among other things, expanding the insurance commissioner’s authority,” Insurify says. “For example, effective Jan. 1, 2027, the commissioner will be able to increase penalties and factor an insurer’s claims conduct history into rate review decisions. And the insurance commissioner elected in November will be the first to exercise the new authority.”
paras.zh: Insurify 表示：“佐治亚州最近通过了一项大规模的保险法案，扩大了对保险公司的监管，以帮助保护消费者，并扩大保险专员的权力。” “例如，自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起，专员将能够加大处罚力度，并将保险公司的索赔行为历史纳入费率审查决定中。11 月当选的保险专员将是第一个行使新权力的人。”
